text_uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
translation_text: He wants to expel you from your land with his sorcery. So what do you suggest?”

text_uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
translation_text: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"

text_uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
translation_text: He means to use his sorcery to drive you out of your land! What do you suggest?’

text_uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 35. "He wants to drive you out of your land by his sorcery: what is it then that you command?"

text_uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
translation_text: who wants to drive you out of your land by his magic.1 Tell us, what do you advise us?"2

text_uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
translation_text: Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikumbisihrihi famatha ta/muroon

text_uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
translation_text: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye?

text_uthmani: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
translation_text: "His plan is to get you out of your land by his sorcery; then what is it ye counsel?"

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: They said, “Leave him and his brother alone for some time, and send heralds to the cities,

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: They answered, ‘Delay him and his brother for a while, and send messengers to all the cities

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. They said: "Put him off and his brother (for a while), and send callers to the cities;

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: They said: "Detain him and his brother for a while and send forth heralds to the cities

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: Qaloo arjih waakhahu wabAAathfee almada-ini hashireen

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: They said: "Keep him and his brother in suspense (for a while), and dispatch to the Cities heralds to collect-

text_uthmani: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: so that they bring to you every highly expert sorcerer.”

text_uthmani: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."

text_uthmani: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: to bring every accomplished sorcerer to you.’

text_uthmani: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. "To bring up to you every well-versed sorcerer."

text_uthmani: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: to mobilise all skilled magicians."

text_uthmani: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Ya/tooka bikulli sahharin AAaleem

text_uthmani: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard.

text_uthmani: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: "And bring up to thee all (our) sorcerers well-versed."

text_uthmani: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: So the sorcerers were assembled for the appointed time of a known day,

text_uthmani: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.1

text_uthmani: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: The sorcerers were [to be] assembled at the appointed time on a certain day

text_uthmani: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. So the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time on a day appointed.

text_uthmani: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: So the magicians were brought together on a particular day at a set time1

text_uthmani: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: FajumiAAa assaharatu limeeqatiyawmin maAAloom

text_uthmani: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.

text_uthmani: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: So the sorcerers were got together for the appointment of a day well-known,

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
translation_text: and it was said to the people, “Would you assemble,

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
translation_text: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
translation_text: and the people were asked, "Are you all coming?

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. And it was said to the people: "Are you (too) going to assemble?

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
translation_text: and the people were told: "Will you join the assembly?1

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
translation_text: Waqeela linnasi hal antummujtamiAAoon

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
translation_text: And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
translation_text: And the people were told: "Are ye (now) assembled?-

text_uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: so that we may follow the sorcerers if they are victorious?”

text_uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

text_uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: We may follow the sorcerers if they win!"

text_uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. "That we may follow the sorcerers [who were on Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) religion of disbelief] if they are the winners."

text_uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: We may perhaps follow the religion of the magicians if they triumph."1

text_uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: LaAAallana nattabiAAu assaharatain kanoo humu alghalibeen

text_uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.

text_uthmani: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: "That we may follow the sorcerers (in religion) if they win?"

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: So, when the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, “Will there be a sure reward for us, if we are the victorious?”

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: When the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we be rewarded if we win?’

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh): "Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?"

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: When the magicians came forth (for the encounter) they said to Pharaoh: "Is there a reward for us if we triumph?"1

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: Falamma jaa assaharatuqaloo lifirAAawna a-inna lana laajran in kunnanahnu alghalibeen

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Pharaoh: "Of course - shall we have a (suitable) reward if we win?

text_uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation_text: He said, “Yes, and of course, you will then be among the closer ones.”

text_uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation_text: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

text_uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation_text: and he said, ‘Yes, and you will join my inner court.’

text_uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 42. He said: "Yes, and you shall then verily be of those brought near (to myself)."

text_uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation_text: He said: "Yes, you will then become those near-stationed to me."1

text_uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation_text: Qala naAAam wa-innakum ithanlamina almuqarrabeen

text_uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation_text: He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me).

text_uthmani: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation_text: He said: "Yea, (and more),- for ye shall in that case be (raised to posts) nearest (to my person)."

text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
translation_text: Mūsā said to them, “Throw you down what you are to throw.”

text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
translation_text: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."

text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
translation_text: Moses said to them, ‘Throw down whatever you will.’

text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. Mûsâ (Moses) said to them: "Throw what you are going to throw!"

text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
translation_text: Moses said to them: "Throw down whatever you wish to throw."

text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
translation_text: Qala lahum moosa alqoo maantum mulqoon

text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
translation_text: Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw!

text_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
translation_text: Moses said to them: "Throw ye - that which ye are about to throw!"

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: So they threw down their ropes and their staffs and said, “By the majesty of Pharaoh, we will be the triumphant for sure.”

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: They threw their ropes and staffs, saying, ‘By Pharaoh’s might, we shall be victorious.’

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. So they threw their ropes and their sticks, and said: "By the might of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), it is we who will certainly win!"

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: Thereupon they threw down their ropes and their rods, and said: "By the glory of Pharaoh, we shall prevail."1

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: Faalqaw hibalahum waAAisiyyahumwaqaloo biAAizzati firAAawna inna lanahnualghaliboon

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners.

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: So they threw their ropes and their rods, and said: "By the might of Pharaoh, it is we who will certainly win!"

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
translation_text: Then Mūsā threw down his staff, and in no time it started swallowing the falsehood they invented.

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
translation_text: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
translation_text: But Moses threw his staff and- lo and behold!- it swallowed up their trickery

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 45. Then Mûsâ (Moses) threw his stick, and behold, it swallowed up all that they falsely showed!

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
translation_text: Thereafter, Moses threw down his rod and behold, it went about swallowing up all the false devices they had contrived.

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
translation_text: Faalqa moosa AAasahufa-itha hiya talqafu ma ya/fikoon

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
translation_text: Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show.

text_uthmani: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
translation_text: Then Moses threw his rod, when, behold, it straightway swallows up all the falsehoods which they fake!

text_uthmani: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ
فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ
translation_text: So the sorcerers were made (by the truth they saw) to fall down in prostration.

text_uthmani: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ
translation_text: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].

text_uthmani: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ
translation_text: and the sorcerers fell down on their knees,

text_uthmani: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 46. And the sorcerers fell down prostrate.

text_uthmani: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ
translation_text: Thereupon the magicians fell down in prostration,

text_uthmani: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ
translation_text: Faolqiya assaharatu sajideen

text_uthmani: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ
translation_text: And the wizards were flung prostrate,

text_uthmani: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ
translation_text: Then did the sorcerers fall down, prostrate in adoration,

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: They said, “We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: exclaiming, ‘We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 47. Saying: "We believe in the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: saying: "We (now) believe in the Lord of the Universe,

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Qaloo amanna birabbialAAalameen

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Saying: "We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,

text_uthmani: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: the Lord of Mūsā and Hārūn.”

text_uthmani: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

text_uthmani: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 48. "The Lord of Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)."

text_uthmani: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.’

text_uthmani: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: the Lord of Moses and Aaron."1

text_uthmani: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: Rabbi moosa waharoon

text_uthmani: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.

text_uthmani: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: "The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

text_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: He (Pharaoh) said, “You have believed in him before I permit you. Surely, he (Mūsā) is the chief of you all, who has taught you sorcery. So you will soon know (your fate). I will cut off your hands and feet from different sides, and will crucify you all together.

text_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."

text_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: Pharaoh said, ‘How dare you believe in him before I have given you permission? He must be the master who taught you sorcery! Soon you will see: I will cut off your alternate hands and feet and then crucify the lot of you!’

text_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 49. [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "You have believed in him before I give you leave. Surely, he indeed is your chief, who has taught you magic! So verily, you shall come to know. Verily, I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all."

text_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: Pharaoh said: "You accepted the word of Moses even before I granted you the leave to do so. Surely he is your chief who has taught you magic.1 Soon shall you come to know. I shall cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides and shall crucify all of you."2

text_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athanalakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu assihrafalasawfa taAAlamoona laoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakummin khilafin walaosallibannakum ajmaAAeen

text_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one.

text_uthmani: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: Said (Pharaoh): "Believe ye in Him before I give you permission? surely he is your leader, who has taught you sorcery! but soon shall ye know! Be sure I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will cause you all to die on the cross!"

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
translation_text: They said, “There is no harm. We will return to our Lord.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
translation_text: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
translation_text: ‘That will do us no harm,’ they said, ‘for we are sure to return to our Lord.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 50. They said: "No harm! Surely, to our Lord (Allâh) we are to return.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
translation_text: They said: "We do not care, for we are bound to return to our Lord,

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
translation_text: Qaloo la dayra innaila rabbina munqaliboon

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
translation_text: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
translation_text: They said: "No matter! for us, we shall but return to our Lord!

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: We really hope that our Lord will forgive us our faults, as we are the first of the believers.”

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: We hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we were the first to believe.’

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 51. "Verily we really hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we are the first of the believers [in Mûsâ (Moses) and in the Monotheism which he has brought from Allâh]."

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: and we surely expect that Our Lord will forgive us our sins for we are the first ones to believe."1

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Inna natmaAAu an yaghfira lanarabbuna khatayana an kunnaawwala almu/mineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: "Only, our desire is that our Lord will forgive us our faults, that we may become foremost among the believers!"

text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: And We revealed to Mūsā saying, “Make My servants travel at night. You will be pursued.”

text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."

text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: Then We revealed Our will to Moses, ‘Leave with My servants by night, for you will be pursued!’

text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 52. And We revealed to Mûsâ (Moses), saying: "Depart by night with My slaves, verily you will be pursued."

text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: We revealed to Moses:1 "Set forth with My servants by night for you will be pursued."2

text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: Waawhayna ila moosaan asri biAAibadee innakum muttabaAAoon

text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: By inspiration we told Moses: "Travel by night with my servants; for surely ye shall be pursued."

text_uthmani: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: So Pharaoh sent into the cities (his) men to muster (people)

text_uthmani: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers1

text_uthmani: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 53. Then Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) sent callers to (all) the cities.

text_uthmani: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: Pharaoh sent messengers into the cities, proclaiming,

text_uthmani: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities (to mobilise troops)

text_uthmani: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: Faarsala firAAawnu fee almada-ini hashireen

text_uthmani: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners,

text_uthmani: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
translation_text: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to (all) the Cities,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
translation_text: saying, “These are a small band,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
translation_text: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
translation_text: ‘These people are a puny band––

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 54. (Saying): "Verily these indeed are but a small band.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
translation_text: saying: "These (Israelites) are only a small band of people

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
translation_text: Inna haola-i lashirthimatunqaleeloon

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
translation_text: (Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
translation_text: (Saying): "These (Israelites) are but a small band,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
translation_text: and indeed they are enraging us,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
translation_text: And indeed, they are enraging us,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
translation_text: they have enraged us-

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 55. "And verily, they have done what has enraged us.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
translation_text: who have certainly provoked our wrath.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
translation_text: Wa-innahum lana lagha-ithoon

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
translation_text: And lo! they are offenders against us.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
translation_text: "And they are raging furiously against us;

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ
وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ
translation_text: and we are a host, well-armed.”

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ
translation_text: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ
translation_text: and we are a large army, on the alert.’

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 56. "But we are a host all assembled, amply fore-warned."

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ
translation_text: But we are a numerous host, ever on guard."1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ
translation_text: Wa-inna lajameeAAun hathiroon

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ
translation_text: And lo! we are a ready host.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ
translation_text: "But we are a multitude amply fore-warned."

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Thus We expelled them (i.e. the people of Pharaoh) from gardens and springs,

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: So We removed them from gardens and springs

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: So it was that We made them leave their gardens and their springs,

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 57. So, We expelled them from gardens and springs,

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Thus did We drive them out of their gardens and springs

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Faakhrajnahum min jannatinwaAAuyoon

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings,

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: So We expelled them from gardens, springs,

text_uthmani: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: and from treasures and a noble abode.

text_uthmani: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: And treasures and honorable station1 -

text_uthmani: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 58. Treasures, and every kind of honourable place.

text_uthmani: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: their treasures and their noble dwellings-

text_uthmani: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: and their treasures and excellent dwellings.1

text_uthmani: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: Wakunoozin wamaqamin kareem

text_uthmani: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: And treasures and a fair estate.

text_uthmani: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: Treasures, and every kind of honourable position;

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: Thus it was. And We made the children of Isrā’īl inherit all such things.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: We gave [such] things [later]to the Children of Israel.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 59. Thus [We turned them (Pharaoh’s people) out] and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: This happened with them; (but on the other hand), We enabled the Children of Israel to inherit those bounties.1

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: Kathalika waawrathnahabanee isra-eel

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: Thus it was, but We made the Children of Israel inheritors of such things.

text_uthmani: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
translation_text: So they (the people of Pharaoh) pursued them (the people of Mūsā) at the time of sunrise.

text_uthmani: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
translation_text: So they pursued them at sunrise.

text_uthmani: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
translation_text: Pharaoh and his people pursued them at sunrise,

text_uthmani: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 60. So they pursued them at sunrise.

text_uthmani: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
translation_text: At sunrise they set off in pursuit of them

text_uthmani: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
translation_text: FaatbaAAoohum mushriqeen

text_uthmani: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
translation_text: And they overtook them at sunrise.

text_uthmani: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
translation_text: So they pursued them at sunrise.

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
translation_text: And when the two hosts saw each other, the companions of Mūsā said, “Surely we are overtaken.”

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
translation_text: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 61. And when the two hosts saw each other, the companions of Mûsâ (Moses) said: "We are sure to be overtaken."

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
translation_text: and as soon as the two sides came within sight of one another, Moses’ followers said, ‘We shall definitely be caught.’

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
translation_text: and when the groups came face to face, the companions of Moses cried out: "We are overtaken!"

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
translation_text: Falamma taraa aljamAAaniqala as-habu moosa innalamudrakoon

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
translation_text: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught.

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
translation_text: And when the two bodies saw each other, the people of Moses said: "We are sure to be overtaken."

text_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: He said, “Never! Indeed with me is my Lord. He will guide me.”

text_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

text_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: Moses said, ‘No, my Lord is with me: He will guide me,’

text_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 62. [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Nay, verily with me is my Lord. He will guide me."

text_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: Moses said: "Certainly not. My Lord is with me; He will direct me."1

text_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: Qala kalla inna maAAiya rabbeesayahdeen

text_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.

text_uthmani: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: (Moses) said: "By no means! my Lord is with me! Soon will He guide me!"

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: So We revealed to Mūsā saying, “Strike the sea with your staff.” So it was severed apart, and each part became like a big mountain.

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: and We revealed to Moses: ‘Strike the sea with your staff.’ It parted- each side like a mighty mountain-

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 63. Then We revealed to Mûsâ (Moses) (saying): "Strike the sea with your stick." And it parted, and each separate part (of that sea water) became like huge mountain.

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: Then We revealed to Moses, (commanding him): "Strike the sea with your rod." Thereupon the sea split up, and then each became like the mass of a huge mount.1

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: Faawhayna ila moosaani idrib biAAasaka albahra fanfalaqafakana kullu firqin kattawdi alAAatheem

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: Then We told Moses by inspiration: "Strike the sea with thy rod." So it divided, and each separate part became like the huge, firm mass of a mountain.

text_uthmani: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Then We brought others close to that place.

text_uthmani: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].

text_uthmani: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 64. Then We brought near the others [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) party] to that place.

text_uthmani: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: and We brought the others to that place:

text_uthmani: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: We also brought the other party close to the same spot,

text_uthmani: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Waazlafna thamma al-akhareen

text_uthmani: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Then brought We near the others to that place.

text_uthmani: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: And We made the other party approach thither.

text_uthmani: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: And We saved Mūsā and all those with him.

text_uthmani: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

text_uthmani: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: We saved Moses and all his companions,

text_uthmani: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 65. And We saved Mûsâ (Moses) and all those with him.

text_uthmani: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: and We delivered Moses and his companions, all of them,

text_uthmani: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: Waanjayna moosa waman maAAahuajmaAAeen

text_uthmani: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: And We saved Moses and those with him, every one;

text_uthmani: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: We delivered Moses and all who were with him;

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Then we drowned the others.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Then We drowned the others.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: and drowned the rest.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 66. Then We drowned the others.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: then We drowned the others.1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Thumma aghraqna al-akhareen

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: And We drowned the others.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: But We drowned the others.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 67. Verily in this is indeed a sign (or a proof), yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely there is a Sign in this,1 but most of them would not believe.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Inna fee thalika laayatan wamakana aktharuhum mu/mineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 68. And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Ever Compassionate.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu arraheem

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: And recite before them the narrative of Ibrāhīm,

text_uthmani: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

text_uthmani: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: Tell them the story of Abraham,

text_uthmani: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 69. And recite to them the story of Ibrâhîm (Abraham).

text_uthmani: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: And recount to them the story of Abraham:1

text_uthmani: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: Watlu AAalayhim nabaa ibraheem

text_uthmani: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: Recite unto them the story of Abraham:

text_uthmani: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: And rehearse to them (something of) Abraham's story.

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: when he said to his father and to his people, “What do you worship?”

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: when he asked his father and his people, ‘What do you worship?’

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 70. When he said to his father and his people: "What do you worship?"

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: when he asked his father and his people: "What do you worship?"1

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: Ith qala li-abeehi waqawmihi mataAAbudoon

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: Behold, he said to his father and his people: "What worship ye?"

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
translation_text: They said, “We worship idols, and stay devoted to them.”

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
translation_text: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
translation_text: They said, ‘We worship idols, and are constantly in attendance on them.’

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 71. They said: "We worship idols, and to them we are ever devoted."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
translation_text: They answered: "There are some idols that we worship and are devoted to them with constancy."1

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
translation_text: Qaloo naAAbudu asnamanfanathallu laha AAakifeen

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
translation_text: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
translation_text: They said: "We worship idols, and we remain constantly in attendance on them."

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
translation_text: He said, “Do they listen to you when you call (them)

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
translation_text: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
translation_text: He asked, ‘Do they hear you when you call?

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 72. He said: "Do they hear you, when you call on (them)?

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
translation_text: He asked: "Do they hear you when you call them

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
translation_text: Qala hal yasmaAAoonakum ithtadAAoon

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
translation_text: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry?

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
translation_text: He said: "Do they listen to you when ye call (on them)?"

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
translation_text: or do they bring benefit to you or harm?”

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
translation_text: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
translation_text: Do they help or harm you?’

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 73. "Or do they benefit you or do they harm (you)?"

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
translation_text: or do they cause you any benefit or harm?"

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
translation_text: Aw yanfaAAoonakum aw yadurroon

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
translation_text: Or do they benefit or harm you?

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
translation_text: "Or do you good or harm?"

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: They said, “No, but we have found our fathers doing like this.”

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: They replied, ‘No, but this is what we saw our fathers doing.’

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 74. They said: "(Nay) but we found our fathers doing so."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: They answered: "No; but we found our forefathers doing so."1

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: Qaloo bal wajadna abaanakathalika yafAAaloon

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: They said: "Nay, but we found our fathers doing thus (what we do)."

قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: He said, “Have you then ever considered what you have been worshipping,

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: Abraham said, ‘Those idols you have worshipped,

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 75. He said: "Do you observe that which you have been worshipping -

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: Thereupon, Abraham said: "Have you seen (with your eyes) those whom you have been worshipping,

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: Qala afaraaytum ma kuntumtaAAbudoon

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: He said: See now that which ye worship,

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: He said: "Do ye then see whom ye have been worshipping,-

text_uthmani: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
translation_text: you and your ancient fathers,

text_uthmani: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
translation_text: You and your ancient forefathers?

text_uthmani: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
translation_text: you and your forefathers,

text_uthmani: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 76. "You and your ancient fathers?

text_uthmani: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
translation_text: you and your forefathers of yore?1

text_uthmani: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
translation_text: Antum waabaokumu al-aqdamoon

text_uthmani: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
translation_text: Ye and your forefathers!

text_uthmani: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
translation_text: "Ye and your fathers before you?-

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: they all are an enemy to me, except the Lord of the worlds,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,1

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: are my enemies; not so the Lord of the Worlds,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 77. "Verily they are enemies to me, save the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: They are all enemies to me;1 all, except the Lord of the Universe2

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Fa-innahum AAaduwwun lee illa rabbaalAAalameen

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: "For they are enemies to me; not so the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds;

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
translation_text: who created me, and who guides me,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
translation_text: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
translation_text: who created me. It is He who guides me;

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 78. "Who has created me, and it is He Who guides me.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
translation_text: Who created me1 and Who guides me;

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
translation_text: Allathee khalaqanee fahuwa yahdeen

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
translation_text: Who created me, and He doth guide me,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
translation_text: "Who created me, and it is He Who guides me;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
translation_text: and Who feeds me and gives me drink,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
translation_text: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
translation_text: He who gives me food and drink;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 79. "And it is He Who feeds me and gives me to drink.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
translation_text: Who gives me food and drink,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
translation_text: Wallathee huwa yutAAimuneewayasqeen

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
translation_text: And Who feedeth me and watereth me.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
translation_text: "Who gives me food and drink,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
translation_text: and when I become sick, He heals me,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
translation_text: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
translation_text: He who cures me when I am ill;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 80. "And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
translation_text: and Who, when I am ill, heals me;1

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
translation_text: Wa-itha maridtu fahuwayashfeen

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
translation_text: And when I sicken, then He healeth me,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
translation_text: "And when I am ill, it is He Who cures me;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
translation_text: and who will make me die, then will give me life,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
translation_text: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
translation_text: He who will make me die and then give me life again;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 81. "And Who will cause me to die, and then will bring me to life (again).

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
translation_text: Who will cause me to die and then will again restore me to life;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
translation_text: Wallathee yumeetunee thummayuhyeen

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
translation_text: And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again),

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
translation_text: "Who will cause me to die, and then to life (again);

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: and who, I hope, will forgive my fault on the Day of Retribution.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: and He who will, I hope, forgive my faults on the Day of Judgement.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 82. "And Who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Recompense, (the Day of Resurrection).

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Who, I hope, will forgive me my sins on the Day of Judgement."1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Wallathee atmaAAu anyaghfira lee khatee-atee yawma addeen

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: "And who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the day of Judgment.

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: O my Lord, give me wisdom, and make me join the righteous,

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: My Lord, grant me wisdom; join me with the righteous;

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 83. My Lord! Bestow Hukm (religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) on me, and join me with the righteous.

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: (And then Abraham prayed): "My Lord, endow me with knowledge and wisdom1 and join me with the righteous,2

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: Rabbi hab lee hukman waalhiqneebissaliheen

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: "O my Lord! bestow wisdom on me, and join me with the righteous;

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: and destine for me a truthful description among the next generations,

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: give me a good name among later generations;

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 84. And grant me an honourable mention in later generations.

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: and grant me an honourable reputation among posterity,1

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: WajAAal lee lisana sidqinfee al-akhireen

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And give unto me a good report in later generations.

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: "Grant me honourable mention on the tongue of truth among the latest (generations);

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: and make me among those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss,

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: make me one of those given the Garden of Bliss-

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 85. And make me one of the inheritors of the Paradise of Delight.

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: and make me of those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss,

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: WajAAalnee min warathati jannati annaAAeem

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight,

text_uthmani: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: "Make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss;

text_uthmani: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation_text: and forgive my father. Indeed he was one of those who went astray,

text_uthmani: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation_text: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.

text_uthmani: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation_text: forgive my father, for he is one of those who have gone astray-

text_uthmani: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 86. And forgive my father, verily he is of the erring.

text_uthmani: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation_text: and forgive my father for he is among those who strayed,1

text_uthmani: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation_text: Waghfir li-abee innahu kanamina addalleen

text_uthmani: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation_text: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err.

text_uthmani: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation_text: "Forgive my father, for that he is among those astray;

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: and do not put me to disgrace on the Day when all will be raised to life,

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: and do not disgrace me on the Day when all people are resurrected:

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 87. And disgrace me not on the Day when (all the creatures) will be resurrected.

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: and disgrace me not on the Day when people will be raised to life,1

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: Wala tukhzinee yawma yubAAathoon

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: And abase me not on the day when they are raised,

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: "And let me not be in disgrace on the Day when (men) will be raised up;-

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
translation_text: the Day when neither wealth will be of any use (to any one) nor sons,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
translation_text: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
translation_text: the Day when neither wealth nor children can help,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 88. The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
translation_text: the Day when nothing will avail, neither wealth nor offspring,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
translation_text: Yawma la yanfaAAu malun walabanoon

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
translation_text: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
translation_text: "The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: except to him who will come to Allah with a sound heart,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: when the only one who will be saved is the one who comes before God with a heart devoted to Him.’

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 89. Except him who brings to Allâh a clean heart [clean from Shirk (polytheism) and Nifâq (hypocrisy)]."

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: but only he that brings to Allah a sound heart will (attain to success)."1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Illa man ata Allahabiqalbin saleem

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: "But only he (will prosper) that brings to Allah a sound heart;

text_uthmani: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: and the Paradise will be brought near to the God-fearing

text_uthmani: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

text_uthmani: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: When the Garden is brought near to the righteous

text_uthmani: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 90. And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).

text_uthmani: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: (On that Day)1the Garden will be brought near to the God-fearing,

text_uthmani: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeen

text_uthmani: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil).

text_uthmani: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: "To the righteous, the Garden will be brought near,

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
translation_text: and the Hell will be fully uncovered for the perverse,

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
translation_text: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
translation_text: and the Fire is placed in full view of the misguided,

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 91. And the (Hell) Fire will be placed in full view of the erring.

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
translation_text: and the Fire will be uncovered for those who strayed,1

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
translation_text: Waburrizati aljaheemu lilghaween

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
translation_text: And hell will appear plainly to the erring.

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
translation_text: "And to those straying in Evil, the Fire will be placed in full view;

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: and it will be said to them, ‘Where is that which you used to worship

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: it will be said to them, ‘Where are those you worshipped

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 92. And it will be said to them: "Where are those (the false gods whom you used to set up as rivals with Allâh) that you used to worship.

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: and they will be asked: "Where are the gods that you worshipped

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: Waqeela lahum ayna ma kuntumtaAAbudoon

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: "And it shall be said to them: 'Where are the (gods) ye worshipped-

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation_text: beside Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?’

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation_text: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation_text: beside God? Can they help you now, or even help themselves?’

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 93. "Instead of Allâh? Can they help you or (even) help themselves?"

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation_text: beside Allah? Can they be of any help to you, or even be of any help to themselves?"

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation_text: Min dooni Allahi hal yansuroonakumaw yantasiroon

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation_text: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation_text: "'Besides Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?'

text_uthmani: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
translation_text: So they (their false gods) will be thrown on their faces into it - they and the erring people

text_uthmani: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
translation_text: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators

text_uthmani: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
translation_text: and then they will all be hurled into Hell, together with those that misled them,

text_uthmani: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 94. Then they will be thrown on their faces into the (Fire), they and the Ghâwûn (devils, and those who were in error).

text_uthmani: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
