translation_text: Then the idols and those who strayed will be hurled into the Fire headlong, one upon another,1

text_uthmani: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
translation_text: Fakubkiboo feeha hum walghawoon

text_uthmani: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
translation_text: Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers

text_uthmani: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
translation_text: "Then they will be thrown headlong into the (Fire),- they and those straying in Evil,

text_uthmani: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation_text: and the entire army of Iblīs (Satan), all together.

text_uthmani: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation_text: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

text_uthmani: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation_text: and all Iblis’s supporters.

text_uthmani: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 95. And the whole hosts of Iblîs (Satan) together.

text_uthmani: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation_text: and so too the hosts of Iblis, all of them.

text_uthmani: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation_text: Wajunoodu ibleesa ajmaAAoon

text_uthmani: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation_text: And the hosts of Iblis, together.

text_uthmani: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation_text: "And the whole hosts of Iblis together.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation_text: They will say when they will be quarreling there with each other,

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation_text: They will say while they dispute therein,

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation_text: There they will say to their gods, as they bicker among themselves,

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 96. They will say while contending therein,

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation_text: There they will quarrel with one another and the erring ones will say (to their deities):

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation_text: Qaloo wahum feeha yakhtasimoon

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation_text: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
translation_text: "They will say there in their mutual bickerings:

text_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: ‘By Allah, we were in open error

text_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error

text_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: ‘We were clearly misguided

text_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 97. By Allâh, we were truly in a manifest error,

text_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: "By Allah, we were surely in clear error

text_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Tallahi in kunna lafeedalalin mubeen

text_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest

text_uthmani: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: "'By Allah, we were truly in an error manifest,

text_uthmani: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: when we used to equate you with the Lord of the worlds,

text_uthmani: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: when we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 98. When We held you (false gods) as equals (in worship) with the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists);

text_uthmani: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: when we assigned to you a position equal to that of the Lord of the Universe.

text_uthmani: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Ith nusawweekum birabbi alAAalameen

text_uthmani: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: "'When we held you as equals with the Lord of the Worlds;

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: and it is only the sinners who misguided us.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: It was the evildoers who led us astray,

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 99. And none has brought us into error except the Mujrimûn [Iblîs (Satan) and those of human beings who commit crimes, murderers, polytheists, oppressors].

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: It is none but those steeped in guilt who led us into this error,1

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: Wama adallana illaalmujrimoon

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: It was but the guilty who misled us.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: "'And our seducers were only those who were steeped in guilt.

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ
فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: Now we have neither any intercessors

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: So now we have no intercessors

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 100. Now we have no intercessors,

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: and now we have no intercessor

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: and now we have none to intercede on our behalf,1

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: Fama lana min shafiAAeen

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: Now we have no intercessors

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: "'Now, then, we have none to intercede (for us),

text_uthmani: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: nor any true friend.

text_uthmani: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: And not a devoted friend.

text_uthmani: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: and no true friend.

text_uthmani: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 101. Nor a close friend (to help us).

text_uthmani: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: nor do we have a truly sincere friend.1

text_uthmani: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: Wala sadeeqin hameem

text_uthmani: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: Nor any loving friend.

text_uthmani: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: "'Nor a single friend to feel (for us).

text_uthmani: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Would that we have a chance to return whereby we may join the believers!’”

text_uthmani: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."1

text_uthmani: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 102. (Alas!) If we only had a chance to return (to the world), we shall truly be among the believers!

text_uthmani: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: If only we could live our lives again, we would be true believers!’

text_uthmani: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: If only we could return we would be among the believers."1

text_uthmani: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Falaw anna lana karratan fanakoonamina almu/mineen

text_uthmani: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!

text_uthmani: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: "'Now if we only had a chance of return we shall truly be of those who believe!'"

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 103. Verily in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely there is a Sign in this,1 but most of them would not believe.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Inna fee thalika laayatan wamakana aktharuhum mu/mineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers!

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Verily in this is a Sign but most of them do not believe.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 104. And verily, your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Ever Compassionate.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu arraheem

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of NūH rejected the messengers

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of Noah denied the messengers1

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of Noah, too, called the messengers liars.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 105. The people of Nûh (Noah) belied the Messengers.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of Noah1 gave the lie to the Messengers.2

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Kaththabat qawmu noohinalmursaleen

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of Noah rejected the messengers.

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: when their brother NūH said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Their brother Noah said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 106. When their brother Nûh (Noah) said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Recall when their brother Noah said to them: "Do you have no fear?1

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Ith qala lahum akhoohum noohunala tattaqoon

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Behold, their brother Noah said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am an honest messenger for you.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 107. "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you;1

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Innee lakum rasoolun ameen

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust:

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So, fear Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: be mindful of God and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 108. "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: so fear Allah and obey me.1

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Fattaqoo Allaha waateeAAoon

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: "So fear Allah, and obey me.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds;

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds:

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 109. "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: I seek of you no reward for this: my reward is with none except the Lord of the Universe.1

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Wama as-alukum AAalayhi min ajrin inajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameen

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds:

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: so, fear Allah and obey me.”

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allāh and obey me."

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 110. "So keep your duty to Allâh, fear Him and obey me."

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: be mindful of God and obey me.’

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allah and obey me."1

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Fattaqoo Allaha waateeAAoon

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: "So fear Allah, and obey me."

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
translation_text: They said, “Shall we believe in you while you are followed by the lowest people?”

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
translation_text: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
translation_text: They answered, ‘Why should we believe you when the worst sort of people follow you?’

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 111. They said: "Shall we believe in you, when the meanest (of the people) follow you?"

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
translation_text: They answered: "Shall we accept you even though it is the meanest of people who follow you?"1

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
translation_text: Qaloo anu/minu laka wattabaAAakaal-arthaloon

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
translation_text: They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee?

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
translation_text: They said: "Shall we believe in thee when it is the meanest that follow thee?"

text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: He said, “I do not know about what they do;

text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?

text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: He said: "And what knowledge have I of what they used to do?

text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: He said, ‘What knowledge do I have of what they used to do?

text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Noah said: "What knowledge do I have about their deeds?

text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Qala wama AAilmee bimakanoo yaAAmaloon

text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)?

text_uthmani: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: He said: "And what do I know as to what they do?

text_uthmani: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: their account is with none but with my Lord, if you have sense.

text_uthmani: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.

text_uthmani: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 113. "Their account is only with my Lord, if you could (but) know.

text_uthmani: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: It is for my Lord alone to bring them to account- if only you could see-

text_uthmani: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: It is only for my Lord to take account of them. Would that you made use of your understanding!1

text_uthmani: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: In hisabuhum illa AAalarabbee law tashAAuroon

text_uthmani: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew;

text_uthmani: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: "Their account is only with my Lord, if ye could (but) understand.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: And I am not the one who would drive the believers away;

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: And I am not one to drive away the believers.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 114. "And I am not going to drive away the believers.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: I will not drive believers away.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: It is not for me to repel those who choose to believe.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Wama ana bitaridialmu/mineen

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: And I am not (here) to repulse believers.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: "I am not one to drive away those who believe.

text_uthmani: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: I am no more than a plain warner.”

text_uthmani: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: I am only a clear warner."

text_uthmani: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: I am here only to give people a clear warning.’

text_uthmani: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 115. I am only a plain warner."

text_uthmani: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: I am none but a plain warner."1

text_uthmani: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: In ana illa natheerunmubeen

text_uthmani: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: I am only a plain warner.

text_uthmani: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: "I am sent only to warn plainly in public."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
translation_text: They said, “Should you not stop, O NūH, you will surely be stoned.”

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
translation_text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 116. They said: "If you cease not, O Nûh (Noah) you will surely be among those stoned (to death)."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
translation_text: So they said, ‘Noah, if you do not stop this, you will be stoned.’

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
translation_text: They said: "O Noah! If you do not desist, you will certainly become one of the accursed."1

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
translation_text: Qaloo la-in lam tantahi yanoohu latakoonanna mina almarjoomeen

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
translation_text: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death).

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
translation_text: They said: "If thou desist not, O Noah! thou shalt be stoned (to death)."

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
translation_text: He said, “My Lord, my people have rejected me.

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
translation_text: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 117. He said: "My Lord! Verily, my people have belied me.

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
translation_text: He said, ‘My Lord, my people have rejected me,

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
translation_text: He said: "My Lord! My people have branded me a liar.1

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
translation_text: Qala rabbi inna qawmee kaththaboon

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
translation_text: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me.

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
translation_text: He said: "O my Lord! truly my people have rejected me.

text_uthmani: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: So judge between me and them with an open verdict, and save me and all the believers who are with me.”

text_uthmani: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."

text_uthmani: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 118. Therefore judge You between me and them, and save me and those of the believers who are with me."

text_uthmani: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: so make a firm judgement between me and them, and save me and my believing followers.’

text_uthmani: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: So pass a clear judgement between me and them and rescue me and the believers with me."1

text_uthmani: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Faftah baynee wabaynahum fathanwanajjinee waman maAAiya mina almu/mineen

text_uthmani: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.

text_uthmani: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: "Judge Thou, then, between me and them openly, and deliver me and those of the Believers who are with me."

text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: So We saved him and those with him in the Ark that was fully occupied.

text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: So We saved him and his followers in the fully laden ship,

text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 119. And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: Thereafter We rescued him and those who were with him in the laden Ark1

text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: Faanjaynahu waman maAAahu feealfulki almashhoon

text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

text_uthmani: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: So We delivered him and those with him, in the Ark filled (with all creatures).

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: Then We drowned, after that, all the remaining.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: and drowned the rest.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 120. Then We drowned the rest (disbelievers) thereafter.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: and drowned the rest.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: Thumma aghraqna baAAdu albaqeen

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: Then afterward We drowned the others.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: Thereafter We drowned those who remained behind.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 121. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Inna fee thalika laayatan wamakana aktharuhum mu/mineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Very-Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 122. And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Ever Compassionate.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu arraheem

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The (people of) ‘Ād rejected the messengers

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: ʿAad denied the messengers

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 123. ‘Âd (people) belied the Messengers.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of Ad, too, called the messengers liars.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The Ad gave the lie to the Messengers.1

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Kaththabat AAadun almursaleen

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: (The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah).

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The 'Ad (people) rejected the messengers.

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: when their brother Hūd said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 124. When their brother Hûd said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Their brother Hud said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Recall, when their brother Hud said to them:1 "Have you no fear?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Ith qala lahum akhoohumhoodun ala tattaqoon

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Behold, their brother Hud said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am an honest messenger for you,

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 125. "Verily I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Innee lakum rasoolun ameen

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust:

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: so fear Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 126. "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: be mindful of God and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Fattaqoo Allaha waateeAAoon

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: "So fear Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 127. "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists).

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: I seek of you no reward for this; my reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Wama as-alukum AAalayhi min ajrin inajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameen

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
translation_text: Do you erect on every height a monument, having no sound purpose,

text_uthmani: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
translation_text: Do you construct on every elevation a sign,1 amusing yourselves,

text_uthmani: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
translation_text: How can you be so vain that you set up monuments on every high place?

text_uthmani: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 128. "Do you build high palaces on every high place, while you do not live in them?

text_uthmani: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
translation_text: What, you build a monument on every hill merely for fun1

text_uthmani: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
translation_text: Atabnoona bikulli reeAAin ayatantaAAbathoon

text_uthmani: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
translation_text: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight?

text_uthmani: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
translation_text: "Do ye build a landmark on every high place to amuse yourselves?

text_uthmani: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
translation_text: and take the objects of architecture as if you are going to live forever,

text_uthmani: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
translation_text: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?

text_uthmani: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
translation_text: Do you build fortresses because you hope to be immortal?

text_uthmani: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: "And do you get for yourselves palaces (fine buildings) as if you will live therein for ever.1

text_uthmani: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
translation_text: and erect huge palaces as though you will live for ever,1

text_uthmani: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
translation_text: Watattakhithoona masaniAAalaAAallakum takhludoon

text_uthmani: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
translation_text: And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever?

text_uthmani: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
translation_text: "And do ye get for yourselves fine buildings in the hope of living therein (for ever)?

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
translation_text: and when you seize (someone) you seize as tyrants?

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
translation_text: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 130. "And when you seize (somebody), seize you (him) as tyrants?

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
translation_text: Why do you act like tyrants whenever you attack someone?

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
translation_text: and when you strike you strike like tyrants?1

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
translation_text: Wa-itha batashtum batashtumjabbareen

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
translation_text: And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants?

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
translation_text: "And when ye exert your strong hand, do ye do it like men of absolute power?

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Be mindful of God and obey me;

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 131. "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Fattaqoo Allaha waateeAAoon

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Rather keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: "Now fear Allah, and obey me.

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: And fear the One who has supported you with what you know.

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: be mindful of Him who has provided you with everything you know-

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 132. "And keep your duty to Him, fear Him Who has aided you with all (good things) that you know.

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Have fear of Him Who has provided you with all the (good) things you know;

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Wattaqoo allathee amaddakumbima taAAlamoon

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know,

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: "Yea, fear Him Who has bestowed on you freely all that ye know.

text_uthmani: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ
أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: He has supported you with cattle and sons,

text_uthmani: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: Provided you with grazing livestock and children

text_uthmani: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: He has given you livestock, sons,

text_uthmani: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 133. "He has aided you with cattle and children.

text_uthmani: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: Who has provided you with flocks and children

text_uthmani: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: Amaddakum bi-anAAamin wabaneen

text_uthmani: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: Hath aided you with cattle and sons.

text_uthmani: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: "Freely has He bestowed on you cattle and sons,-

text_uthmani: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: and with gardens and springs.

text_uthmani: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: And gardens and springs.

text_uthmani: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 134. "And gardens and springs.

text_uthmani: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: gardens, springs-

text_uthmani: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: and with gardens and springs.

text_uthmani: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Wajannatin waAAuyoon

text_uthmani: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: And gardens and watersprings.

text_uthmani: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: "And Gardens and Springs.

text_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: In fact I fear for you the punishment of a horrible day.”

text_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

text_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: for I truly fear that the torment of a grievous day will overtake you.’

text_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 135. "Verily, I fear for you the torment of a Great Day."

text_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: I fear for you the chastisement of an Awesome Day."

text_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: Innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathabayawmin AAatheem

text_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day.

text_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: "Truly I fear for you the Penalty of a Great Day."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
translation_text: They said, “It is all equal for us, whether you give us advice or you do not become one of the advisors.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
translation_text: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 136. They said: "It is the same to us whether you preach or be not of those who preach.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
translation_text: They replied, ‘It makes no difference to us whether you warn us or not,

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
translation_text: They replied: "It is all the same for us whether you admonish us or not.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
translation_text: Qaloo sawaon AAalaynaawaAAathta am lam takun mina alwaAAitheen

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
translation_text: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach;

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
translation_text: They said: "It is the same to us whether thou admonish us or be not among (our) admonishers!

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: This is nothing but the practice of the ancient,

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: "This is no other than the false tales and religion of the ancients, [Tafsir At-Tabarî]

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: for we only do what our forefathers used to do:

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: This has been happening all along.1

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: In hatha illa khuluqual-awwaleen

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: This is but a fable of the men of old,

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: "This is no other than a customary device of the ancients,

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: and we are not going to be punished.”

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: And we are not to be punished."

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: we shall not be punished.’

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 138. "And we are not going to be punished."

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: We will not be subjected to any chastisement."

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: Wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeen

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: And we shall not be doomed.

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: "And we are not the ones to receive Pains and Penalties!"

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus they rejected him, so We destroyed them. Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 139. So they belied him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: They denounced him as a liar, and so We destroyed them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Eventually they gave the lie to him and We destroyed them.1 Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Fakaththaboohu faahlaknahuminna fee thalika laayatan wama kanaaktharuhum mu/mineen

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: So they rejected him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 140. And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu arraheem

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The (people of) Thamūd rejected the messengers

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Thamūd denied the messengers

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 141. Thamûd (people) belied the Messengers.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of Thamud, too, called the messengers liars.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The Thamud gave the lie to the Messengers.1

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Kaththabat thamoodu almursaleen

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The Thamud (people) rejected the messengers.

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: when their brother SāliH said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 142. When their brother Sâlih said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Their brother Salih said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Recall when their brother Salih said to them: "Have you no fear?"

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Ith qala lahum akhoohum salihunala tattaqoon

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Behold, their brother Salih said to them: "Will you not fear (Allah)?

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am an honest messenger for you.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am a faithful messenger to you:

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 143. "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.1

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Innee lakum rasoolun ameen

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So, fear Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 144. "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: be mindful of God and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Fattaqoo Allaha waateeAAoon

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: "So fear Allah, and obey me.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: I do not claim from you any reward for it. My reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 145. "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: I ask of you no reward. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Wama as-alukum AAalayhi min ajrin inajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameen

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: Will you be left secure in whatever is here,

text_uthmani: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

text_uthmani: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 146. "Will you be left secure in that which you have here?

text_uthmani: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: [Do you think] you will be left secure for ever in what you have here-

text_uthmani: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: Do you believe that you will be left here to live securely in the present state1

text_uthmani: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: Atutrakoona fee ma hahunaamineen

text_uthmani: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us,

text_uthmani: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: "Will ye be left secure, in (the enjoyment of) all that ye have here?-

فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: in gardens and springs,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Within gardens and springs

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: gardens, springs,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 147. "In gardens and springs.

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: amidst gardens and springs
