translation_text: Fee jannatin waAAuyoon

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: In gardens and watersprings.

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: "Gardens and Springs,

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
translation_text: and in farms and date-palms, the spathes of which are interwoven?

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
translation_text: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
translation_text: fields, palm trees laden with fruit-

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 148. And green crops (fields) and date-palms with soft spadix.

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
translation_text: and cornfields and date-palms laden with juicy fruits?1

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
translation_text: WazurooAAin wanakhlin talAAuhahadeem

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
translation_text: And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees,

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
translation_text: "And corn-fields and date-palms with spathes near breaking (with the weight of fruit)?

text_uthmani: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ
وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ
translation_text: You hew out houses from the hills with pride.

text_uthmani: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ
translation_text: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.

text_uthmani: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 149. "And you hew out in the mountains, houses with great skill.

text_uthmani: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ
translation_text: carving your fine houses from the mountains?

text_uthmani: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ
translation_text: You hew dwellings in mountains and exult in that.1

text_uthmani: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ
translation_text: Watanhitoona mina aljibalibuyootan fariheen

text_uthmani: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ
translation_text: Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful?

text_uthmani: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ
translation_text: "And ye carve houses out of (rocky) mountains with great skill.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allah and obey me,

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Be mindful of God and obey me:

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 150. "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Fear Allah and obey me

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Fattaqoo Allaha waateeAAoon

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me,

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: "But fear Allah and obey me;

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: and do not obey the order of the transgressors

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: do not obey those who are given to excess

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 151. "And follow not the command of Al-Musrifûn [i.e. their chiefs: leaders who were polytheists, criminals and sinners],

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: and do not follow the biddings of those that go to excesses

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: Wala tuteeAAoo amraalmusrifeen

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: And obey not the command of the prodigal,

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: "And follow not the bidding of those who are extravagant,-

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
translation_text: who make mischief on the land and who do not set things right”.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
translation_text: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
translation_text: and who spread corruption in the land instead of doing what is right.’

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 152. "Who make mischief in the land, and reform not."

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
translation_text: and spread mischief in the land rather than set things right."1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
translation_text: Allatheena yufsidoona fee al-ardiwala yuslihoon

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
translation_text: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
translation_text: "Who make mischief in the land, and mend not (their ways)."

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: They said, “You are merely one of those bewitched.

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 153. They said: "You are only of those bewitched!

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: They said, ‘You are bewitched!

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: They replied: "You are nothing but one of those who are bewitched;1

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: Qaloo innama anta mina almusahhareen

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched!

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: You are nothing but a human like us. So, bring a sign if you are one of the truthful.”

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: You are nothing but a man like us. Show us a sign, if you are telling the truth.’

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 154. "You are but a human being like us. Then bring us a sign if you are of the truthful."

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: you are no different from a mortal like us. So produce a sign if you are truthful."1

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Ma anta illa basharun mithlunafa/ti bi-ayatin in kunta mina assadiqeena

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Thou art but a mortal like us. So bring some token if thou art of the truthful.

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: "Thou art no more than a mortal like us: then bring us a Sign, if thou tellest the truth!"

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: He said, “This is a she-camel. She has a share of water, and you have a share of water on a specified day.

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: He said, "This is a she-camel.1 For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: He said, ‘Here is a camel. She should have her turn to drink and so should you, each on a specified day,

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 155. He said: "Here is a she-camel: it has a right to drink (water), and you have a right to drink (water) (each) on a day, known.

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: Salih said: "This is a she-camel.1 There is a day set for her to drink and there is a day set for you to drink.2

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: Qala hathihi naqatunlaha shirbun walakum shirbu yawmin maAAloom

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day.

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: He said: "Here is a she-camel: she has a right of watering, and ye have a right of watering, (severally) on a day appointed.

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: So do not touch her with evil (intent), lest you should be seized by a painful punishment.”

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: so do not harm her, or the punishment of a terrible day will befall you.’

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 156. "And touch her not with harm, lest the torment of a Great Day should seize you."

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: Do not molest her lest the chastisement of an Awesome Day should seize you."

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: Wala tamassooha bisoo-infaya/khuthakum AAathabu yawmin AAatheem

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: And touch her not with ill lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day.

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: "Touch her not with harm, lest the Penalty of a Great Day seize you."

text_uthmani: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ
فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ
translation_text: But they killed her, then they became remorseful,

text_uthmani: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ
translation_text: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

text_uthmani: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ
translation_text: But they hamstrung her. In the morning they had cause to regret it:

text_uthmani: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 157. But they killed her, and then they became regretful.

text_uthmani: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ
translation_text: But they hamstrung her1 and then regretted it.

text_uthmani: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ
translation_text: FaAAaqarooha faasbahoonadimeen

text_uthmani: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ
translation_text: But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent.

text_uthmani: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَـٰدِمِينَ
translation_text: But they ham-strung her: then did they become full of regrets.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: and the punishment seized them. Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: the punishment fell upon them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 158. So the torment overtook them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: So the chastisement seized them.1 Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Faakhathahumu alAAathabu innafee thalika laayatan wama kanaaktharuhum mu/mineen

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: So the retribution came on them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: But the Penalty seized them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 159. And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu arraheem

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of LūT rejected the messengers

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of Lot denied the messengers

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of Lot, too, called the messengers liars.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: The people of Lût (Lot) (-who dwelt in the town of Sodom in Palestine) belied the Messengers.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of Lot rejected the Messengers,1 branding them liars.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Kaththabat qawmu lootinalmursaleen

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah),

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of Lut rejected the messengers.

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: when their brother LūT said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Their brother Lot said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 161. When their brother Lût (Lot) said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Recall, when their brother Lot said to them: "Have you no fear?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Ith qala lahum akhoohum lootunala tattaqoon

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: When their brother Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Behold, their brother Lut said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am an honest messenger for you.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am a faithful messenger to you:

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 162. "Verily I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Innee lakum rasoolun ameen

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: and subjected them to a terrible rain. So evil was the rain of those who were warned.

text_uthmani: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

text_uthmani: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: and poured a rain of destruction down upon them. How dreadful that rain was for those who had been forewarned!

text_uthmani: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 173. And We rained on them a rain (of torment). And how evil was the rain of those who had been warned!

text_uthmani: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: and We sent upon them a rain, an evil rain that fell on those who had been warned.1

text_uthmani: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: Waamtarna AAalayhim mataranfasaa mataru almunthareen

text_uthmani: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: And We rained on them a rain. And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.

text_uthmani: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: We rained down on them a shower (of brimstone): and evil was the shower on those who were admonished (but heeded not)!

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 174. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Inna fee thalika laayatan wamakana aktharuhum mu/mineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 175. And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu arraheem

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of Aaikah rejected the messengers

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The forest-dwellers, too, called the messengers liars.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 176. The dwellers of Al-Aikah [near Madyan (Midian)] belied the Messengers.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The people of Aykah also gave the lie to the Messengers.1

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Kaththaba as-habual-aykati almursaleen

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah),

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: The Companions of the Wood rejected the messengers.

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: when Shu‘aib said to them, “Do you not fear Allah?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Shuayb said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 177. When Shu‘aib said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh (and obey Him)?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Recall, when Shuayb said to them: "Have you no fear?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Ith qala lahum shuAAaybun alatattaqoon

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Behold, Shu'aib said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am an honest messenger for you.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am a faithful messenger to you:

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 178. "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Innee lakum rasoolun ameen

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,

text_uthmani: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: be mindful of God and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 179. "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So fear Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Fattaqoo Allaha waateeAAoon

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: "So fear Allah and obey me.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And I do not claim from you any reward for it; my reward is with none but with the Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 180. "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: I ask of you no reward for this. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Wama as-alukum AAalayhi min ajrin inajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameen

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
translation_text: Give full measure, and do not be among those who bring loss to others.

text_uthmani: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
translation_text: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.

text_uthmani: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 181. "Give full measure, and cause no loss (to others).

text_uthmani: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
translation_text: Give full measure: do not sell others short.

text_uthmani: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
translation_text: Fill up the measure and do not diminish the goods of people,

text_uthmani: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
translation_text: Awfoo alkayla wala takoonoo minaalmukhsireen

text_uthmani: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
translation_text: Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due).

text_uthmani: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
translation_text: "Give just measure, and cause no loss (to others by fraud).

text_uthmani: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
translation_text: Weigh with an even balance,

text_uthmani: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
translation_text: And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.

text_uthmani: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
translation_text: Weigh with correct scales:

text_uthmani: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 182. "And weigh with the true and straight balance.

text_uthmani: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
translation_text: weigh with an even balance

text_uthmani: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
translation_text: Wazinoo bilqistasialmustaqeem

text_uthmani: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
translation_text: And weigh with the true balance.

text_uthmani: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
translation_text: "And weigh with scales true and upright.

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
translation_text: and do not make people short of their things, and do not spread disorder in the land as mischief-makers,

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
translation_text: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
translation_text: do not deprive people of what is theirs. Do not spread corruption on earth.

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 183. "And defraud not people by reducing their things, nor do evil, making corruption and mischief in the land.

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
translation_text: and do not deliver short, and do not go about creating mischief in the land,

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
translation_text: Wala tabkhasoo annasaashyaahum wala taAAthaw fee al-ardimufsideen

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
translation_text: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
translation_text: "And withhold not things justly due to men, nor do evil in the land, working mischief.

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: and be fearful of the One who created you and the former generations.”

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: And fear He who created you and the former creation."1

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Be mindful of God who created you and former generations,’

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: "And fear Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old."

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: and have fear of Him Who created you and the earlier generations."

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Wattaqoo allathee khalaqakumwaljibillata al-awwaleen

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: "And fear Him Who created you and (who created) the generations before (you)"

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: They said, “You are but one of the bewitched men.

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: but they replied, ‘You are bewitched!

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 185. They said: "You are only one of those bewitched!

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: They said: "You are no more than one of those who have been bewitched,

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: Qaloo innama anta mina almusahhareen

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
translation_text: They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched!

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
translation_text: You are no more than a human like us, and in fact we consider you to be one of the liars.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
translation_text: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
translation_text: You are nothing but a man like us. In fact we think you are a liar.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 186. "You are but a human being like us and verily, we think that you are one of the liars!

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
translation_text: you are only a mortal like us. Indeed we believe that you are an utter liar.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
translation_text: Wama anta illa basharunmithluna wa-in nathunnuka lamina alkathibeen

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
translation_text: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
translation_text: "Thou art no more than a mortal like us, and indeed we think thou art a liar!

text_uthmani: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: So cause a piece from the sky to fall down upon us, if you are one of the truthful.”

text_uthmani: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."

text_uthmani: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 187. "So cause a piece of the heaven to fall on us, if you are of the truthful!"

text_uthmani: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Make bits of the heavens fall down on us, if you are telling the truth.’

text_uthmani: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: So cause a piece of the sky to fall upon us if you are truthful."

text_uthmani: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Faasqit AAalayna kisafan minaassama-i in kunta mina assadiqeen

text_uthmani: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful.

text_uthmani: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: "Now cause a piece of the sky to fall on us, if thou art truthful!"

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: He said, “My Lord knows well what you do.”

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: He said, ‘My Lord knows best what you do.’

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 188. He said: "My Lord is the Best Knower of what you do."

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Shuayb said: "My Lord knows well all what you do."1

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Qala rabbee aAAlamu bimataAAmaloon

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: He said: "My Lord knows best what ye do."

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: Thus they rejected him, so they were seized by the torment of the Day of Canopy. Indeed it was the punishment of a terrible day.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 189. But they belied him, so the torment of the day of shadow (a gloomy cloud) seized them. Indeed that was the torment of a Great Day.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: They called him a liar, and so the torment of the Day of Shadow came upon them- it was the torment of a terrible day.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: Then they branded him a liar, whereupon the chastisement of the Day of Canopy overtook them.1 It was the chastisement of a very awesome day.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: Fakaththaboohu faakhathahumAAathabu yawmi aththullati innahu kanaAAathaba yawmin AAatheem

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: But they rejected him. Then the punishment of a day of overshadowing gloom seized them, and that was the Penalty of a Great Day.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely, in this there is a sign, but most of them are not believers,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 190. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Inna fee thalika laayatan wamakana aktharuhum mu/mineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Verily in that is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: and indeed your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 191. And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Wa-inna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu arraheem

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: This (Qur’ān) is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Truly, this Quran has been sent down by the Lord of the Worlds:

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 192. And truly, this (the Qur’ân) is a revelation from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Indeed this1 is a revelation from the Lord of the Universe;2

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Wa-innahu latanzeelu rabbi alAAalameen

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Verily this is a Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds:

text_uthmani: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
translation_text: The Trusted Spirit has brought it down

text_uthmani: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
translation_text: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down

text_uthmani: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
translation_text: the Trustworthy Spirit brought it down

text_uthmani: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 193. Which the trustworthy Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] has brought down

text_uthmani: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
translation_text: which the truthful spirit1 has carried down

text_uthmani: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
translation_text: Nazala bihi arroohu al-ameen

text_uthmani: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
translation_text: Which the True Spirit hath brought down

text_uthmani: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
translation_text: With it came down the spirit of Faith and Truth-

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: upon your heart, so that you become one of the warners

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: to your heart [Prophet], so that you could bring warning

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 194. Upon your heart (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) that you may be (one) of the warners,

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: to your heart that you might become one of those who warn (others on behalf of Allah),

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: AAala qalbika litakoona mina almunthireen

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: To thy heart and mind, that thou mayest admonish.

text_uthmani: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ
بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: in plain Arabic language.

text_uthmani: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: In a clear Arabic language.

text_uthmani: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: in a clear Arabic tongue.

text_uthmani: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 195. In the plain Arabic language.

text_uthmani: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: (a revelation) in clear Arabic language,1

text_uthmani: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Bilisanin AAarabiyyin mubeen

text_uthmani: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: In plain Arabic speech.

text_uthmani: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: In the perspicuous Arabic tongue.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: And of course, it is (mentioned) in the Scriptures of the former people.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: This was foretold in the scriptures of earlier religions.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 196. And verily, it (the Qur’ân, and its revelation to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is (announced) in the Scriptures [i.e. the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] of former people.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: (a revelation embodied) in the scriptures of the ancients.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Wa-innahu lafee zuburi al-awwaleen

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Without doubt it is (announced) in the mystic Books of former peoples.

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: Is it not a proof for them that the knowledgeable of the children of Isrā’īl recognize him (the prophet)?

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: Is it not proof enough for them that the learned men of the Children of Israel have recognized it?

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Is it not a sign to them that the learned scholars (like ‘Abdullâh bin Salâm رضي الله عنه who embraced Islâm)1 of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: Is it not a Sign to them � (to wit, the Makkans) � that the learned men of the Children of Israel know that?1

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: Awa lam yakun lahum ayatan anyaAAlamahu AAulamao banee isra-eel

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation_text: Is it not a Sign to them that the Learned of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
translation_text: Even if We had revealed it to a Non-Arab,

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
translation_text: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners1

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 198. And if We had revealed it (this Qur’ân) unto any of the non-Arabs,

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
translation_text: If We had sent it down to someone who was not an Arab,

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
translation_text: (But such is their adamance) that had We revealed it to one of the non-Arabs and even if he had recited(this clear Arabic discourse) to them

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
translation_text: Walaw nazzalnahu AAala baAAdial-aAAjameen

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
translation_text: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
translation_text: Had We revealed it to any of the non-Arabs,

text_uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: and he had recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.

text_uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: And he had recited it to them [perfectly],1 they would [still] not have been believers in it.

text_uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 199. And he had recited it unto them, they would not have believed in it.

text_uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: and he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it.

text_uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: they would still not have believed in it.1

text_uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Faqaraahu AAalayhim ma kanoobihi mu/mineen

text_uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.

text_uthmani: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: And had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: This is how We have made it pass through the hearts of the sinners.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: So We make it pass straight through the hearts of the guilty:

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 200. Thus have We caused it (the denial of the Qur’ân) to enter the hearts of the Mûjrimûn (criminals, polytheists, sinners).

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Thus have We caused this (Admonition) to penetrate the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod).1

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Kathalika salaknahu feequloobi almujrimeen

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَـٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Thus have We caused it to enter the hearts of the sinners.

text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: They will not believe in it until they will see the painful punishment

text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.

text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 201. They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment.

text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: they will not believe in it until they see the grievous torment,

text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: They will not believe in it until they clearly see the grievous chastisement.1

text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: La yu/minoona bihi hattayarawoo alAAathaba al-aleem

text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,

text_uthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: They will not believe in it until they see the grievous Penalty;

text_uthmani: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: and it will come to them suddenly while they will not be anticipating (it),

text_uthmani: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.

text_uthmani: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 202. It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not.

text_uthmani: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: which will suddenly hit them when they are not expecting it,

text_uthmani: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: But when it comes upon them suddenly, taking them unawares,

text_uthmani: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: Faya/tiyahum baghtatan wahum layashAAuroon

text_uthmani: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.

text_uthmani: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
translation_text: But the (Penalty) will come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not;

text_uthmani: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
translation_text: and (then) they will say, “Is it (possible) that we are given some respite?”

text_uthmani: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
translation_text: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"

text_uthmani: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 203. Then they will say: "Can we be respited?"

text_uthmani: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
translation_text: and then they will say, ‘Can we have more time?’

text_uthmani: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
translation_text: they say: "Can we be granted some respite?"1

text_uthmani: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
translation_text: Fayaqooloo hal nahnu muntharoon

text_uthmani: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
translation_text: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?

text_uthmani: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
translation_text: Then they will say: "Shall we be respited?"

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: Is it then Our punishment that they are trying to hasten up?

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: So for Our punishment are they impatient?

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 204. Would they then wish for Our Torment to be hastened on?

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: How can they ask that Our punishment be brought to them sooner?

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: Do they really want Our chastisement to be expedited?

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: AfabiAAathabina yastaAAjiloon

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: Do they then ask for Our Penalty to be hastened on?

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
translation_text: So tell me, if We give them enjoyment for years,

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
translation_text: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
translation_text: Think, if we let them enjoy this life for some years

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 205. Tell Me, (even) if We do let them enjoy for years,

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
translation_text: Did you consider that if We were to let them enjoy life for many years

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
translation_text: Afaraayta in mattaAAnahum sineen

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
translation_text: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
translation_text: Seest thou? If We do let them enjoy (this life) for a few years,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: then comes to them what they are warned of,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: And then there came to them that which they were promised?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: and then the promised torment came upon them,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 206. And afterwards comes to them that (punishment) which they had been promised,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: and then the chastisement of which they were being warned were to come upon them,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: Thumma jaahum ma kanooyooAAadoon

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: And then cometh that which they were promised,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: Yet there comes to them at length the (Punishment) which they were promised!

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
translation_text: what help can they receive from the comforts they were given to enjoy?

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
translation_text: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 207. All that with which they used to enjoy shall not avail them.

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
translation_text: what good would their past enjoyment be to them?

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
translation_text: of what avail will be the provisions of life which they have been granted to enjoy?1

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
translation_text: Ma aghna AAanhum ma kanooyumattaAAoon

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
translation_text: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
translation_text: It will profit them not that they enjoyed (this life)!

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
translation_text: We did not destroy any town unless it has had warners

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
translation_text: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
translation_text: Never have We destroyed a town without sending down messengers to warn it,

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 208. And never did We destroy a township but it had its warners

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
translation_text: We never destroyed any habitation but that it had warners

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
translation_text: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illalaha munthiroon

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
translation_text: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
translation_text: Never did We destroy a population, but had its warners -

text_uthmani: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: to give advice, and We have never been unjust.

text_uthmani: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.

text_uthmani: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: as a reminder from Us: We are never unjust.

text_uthmani: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 209. By way of reminder, and We have never been unjust.

text_uthmani: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: to admonish them. We have never been unjust.1

text_uthmani: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: Thikra wama kunnathalimeen

text_uthmani: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: For reminder, for We never were oppressors.

text_uthmani: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: By way of reminder; and We never are unjust.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
translation_text: And this (Qur’ān) is not brought down by devils.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
translation_text: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.1

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 210. And it is not the Shayâtîn (devils) who have brought it (this Qur’ân) down.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
translation_text: It was not the jinn who brought down this Quran:

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
translation_text: The satans1 did not bring down this (Clear Book),

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
translation_text: Wama tanazzalat bihi ashshayateen

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
translation_text: The devils did not bring it down.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
translation_text: No evil ones have brought down this (Revelation):

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: It neither suits them, nor are they able to (do this).

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: it is neither in their interests nor in their power,

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 211. Neither would it suit them, nor they can (produce it).

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: nor does it behove them,1 nor does it lie in their power.2

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: Wama yanbaghee lahum wamayastateeAAoon

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: It would neither suit them nor would they be able (to produce it).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
translation_text: In fact, they are kept far away from hearing (it at the time of revelation).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
translation_text: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
translation_text: indeed they are prevented from overhearing it.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 212. Verily, they have been removed far from hearing it.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
translation_text: Indeed they are debarred from even hearing it.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
translation_text: Innahum AAani assamAAilamaAAzooloona

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
translation_text: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
translation_text: Indeed they have been removed far from even (a chance of) hearing it.

text_uthmani: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: So do not invoke any other god along with Allah, otherwise you will be among those who are to be punished.

text_uthmani: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: So do not invoke1 with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.

text_uthmani: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: So [Prophet] do not invoke any gods beside God, or you will incur punishment.

text_uthmani: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 213. So invoke not with Allâh another ilâh (god) lest you should be among those who receive punishment.

text_uthmani: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: So do not call any other god beside Allah lest you become of those who will be punished,1

text_uthmani: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: Fala tadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahanakhara fatakoona mina almuAAaththabeen

text_uthmani: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.

text_uthmani: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: So call not on any other god with Allah, or thou wilt be among those under the Penalty.

text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
translation_text: And warn the nearest people of your clan,

text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
translation_text: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.

text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
translation_text: Warn your nearest kinsfolk

text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And warn your tribe (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of near kindred.1

text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
translation_text: and warn your nearest kinsmen;1

text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
translation_text: Waanthir AAasheerataka al-aqrabeen

text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
translation_text: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,

text_uthmani: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
translation_text: And admonish thy nearest kinsmen,

text_uthmani: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: and be kind with humbleness to the believers who followed you.

text_uthmani: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.

text_uthmani: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: and lower your wing tenderly over the believers who follow you.

text_uthmani: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 215. And be kind and humble to the believers who follow you.

text_uthmani: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: and be meek to the believers who follow you.

text_uthmani: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Wakhfid janahakalimani ittabaAAaka mina almu/mineen

text_uthmani: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.

text_uthmani: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: And lower thy wing to the Believers who follow thee.

text_uthmani: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: So if they disobey you, then say, “I disown what you do,”

text_uthmani: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."

text_uthmani: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: If they disobey you, say, ‘I bear no responsibility for your actions.’

text_uthmani: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 216. Then if they disobey you, say: "I am innocent of what you do."

text_uthmani: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Then if they disobey you say to them: "I am quit of what you do."1

text_uthmani: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Fa-in AAasawka faqul innee baree-onmimma taAAmaloon

text_uthmani: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.

text_uthmani: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Then if they disobey thee, say: "I am free (of responsibility) for what ye do!"

text_uthmani: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_text: and place your trust in the Mighty, the Merciful,

text_uthmani: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_text: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

text_uthmani: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_text: Put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful,

text_uthmani: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 217. And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,

text_uthmani: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_text: And put your trust in Him Who is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate,1

text_uthmani: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_text: Watawakkal AAala alAAazeezi arraheem

text_uthmani: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_text: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
translation_text: And put thy trust on the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,-

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: Who sees you when you stand (in prayer,)

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: Who sees you when you arise1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: who sees you when you stand up [for prayer]

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 218. Who sees you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) when you stand up (alone at night for Tahajjud prayers).

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: Who observes you when you rise (to pray)1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: Allathee yaraka heenataqoom

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: Who seeth thee standing forth (in prayer),

text_uthmani: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
translation_text: and (sees) your movement among those who prostrate themselves.

text_uthmani: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
translation_text: And your movement among those who prostrate.1

text_uthmani: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
translation_text: and sees your movements among the worshippers:
