text_uthmani: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
translation_text: They are looking for nothing but for a single Cry that will seize them when they will be quarrelling.

text_uthmani: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
translation_text: They do not await except one blast1 which will seize them while they are disputing.

text_uthmani: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 49. They await only but a single Saihah (shout), which will seize them while they are disputing!

text_uthmani: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
translation_text: But all they are waiting for is a single blast that will overtake them while they are still arguing with each other.

text_uthmani: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
translation_text: The Truth is that they are waiting for nothing but a mighty Blast to seize them the while they are disputing (in their worldly affairs),

text_uthmani: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
translation_text: Ma yanthuroona illasayhatan wahidatan ta/khuthuhum wahumyakhissimoon

text_uthmani: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
translation_text: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.

text_uthmani: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
translation_text: They will not (have to) wait for aught but a single Blast: it will seize them while they are yet disputing among themselves!

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: So they will not be able to make a bequest, nor will they return to their household.

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: They will have no time to make bequests, nor will they have the chance to return to their own people.

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 50. Then they will not be able to make bequest, nor they will return to their family.

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: and they will not even be able to make a testament, nor to return to their households.1

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: Fala yastateeAAoona tawsiyatanwala ila ahlihim yarjiAAoon

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: No (chance) will they then have, by will, to dispose (of their affairs), nor to return to their own people!

text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
translation_text: And the Horn will be blown, and suddenly they will be rushing from their graves towards their Lord.

text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
translation_text: And the Horn will be blown;1 and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.

text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 51. And the Trumpet will be blown (i.e. the second blowing) and behold from the graves they will come out quickly to their Lord.

text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
translation_text: The Trumpet will be sounded and- lo and behold!- they will rush out to their Lord from their graves.

text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
translation_text: Then the Trumpet shall be blown and lo! they will come out of their graves and be on the move towards their Lord,1

text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
translation_text: Wanufikha fee assoori fa-ithahum mina al-ajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloon

text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
translation_text: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,

text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
translation_text: The trumpet shall be sounded, when behold! from the sepulchres (men) will rush forth to their Lord!

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: They will say, “Woe to us! Who has raised us from our sleeping place? “This is what RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) had promised, and the messengers had told the truth.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: They will say, ‘Alas for us! Who has resurrected us from our resting places?’ [They will be told], ‘This is what the Lord of Mercy promised, and the messengers told the truth.’

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 52. They will say: "Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of sleep." (It will be said to them): "This is what the Most Gracious (Allâh) had promised, and the Messengers spoke truth!"

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: (nervously) exclaiming. “Alas for us! Who roused us out of our sleeping-place?”1 “This is what the Merciful One had promised, and what (His) Messengers had said was true.”2

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: Qaloo ya waylana manbaAAathana min marqadina hatha mawaAAada arrahmanu wasadaqaalmursaloon

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: They will say: "Ah! Woe unto us! Who hath raised us up from our beds of repose?"... (A voice will say:) "This is what (Allah) Most Gracious had promised. And true was the word of the messengers!"

text_uthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: It will be no more than a single Cry, and in no time they will all be arraigned before Us.

text_uthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.

text_uthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 53. It will be but a single Saihah (shout), so behold they will all be brought up before Us!

text_uthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: It was just one single blast and then- lo and behold!- they were all brought before Us.

text_uthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: Then there will simply be one single Blast, and all will have gathered before Us.

text_uthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: In kanat illa sayhatanwahidatan fa-itha hum jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroon

text_uthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us!

text_uthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: It will be no more than a single Blast, when lo! they will all be brought up before Us!

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Then, nobody will be subjected to injustice in the least, and you will not be recompensed but for what you used to do.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: ‘Today, no soul will be wronged in the least: you will only be repaid for your deeds.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 54. This Day (Day of Resurrection), none will be wronged in anything, nor will you be requited anything except that which you used to do.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Today1 no one shall suffer the least injustice, and you shall not be recompensed except according to your deeds.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Falyawma la tuthlamunafsun shay-an wala tujzawna illa ma kuntumtaAAmaloon

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Then, on that Day, not a soul will be wronged in the least, and ye shall but be repaid the meeds of your past Deeds.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
translation_text: The people of the Paradise are engaged today in (their) activities, happily enjoying (them).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
translation_text: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -

text_uthmani: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
translation_text: The people of Paradise today are happily occupied-

text_uthmani: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 55. Verily, the dwellers of the Paradise, that Day, will be busy with joyful things.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
translation_text: Indeed, the people of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves:1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
translation_text: Inna as-haba aljannati alyawmafee shughulin fakihoon

text_uthmani: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
translation_text: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
translation_text: Verily the Companions of the Garden shall that Day have joy in all that they do;

text_uthmani: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
translation_text: They and their spouses are in pleasant shades, reclining on couches.

text_uthmani: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
translation_text: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

text_uthmani: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
translation_text: they and their spouses- seated on couches in the shade.

text_uthmani: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 56. They and their wives will be in pleasant shade, reclining on thrones.

text_uthmani: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
translation_text: they and their spouses shall be reclining on their couches in shady groves;

text_uthmani: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
translation_text: Hum waazwajuhum fee thilalinAAala al-ara-iki muttaki-oon

text_uthmani: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
translation_text: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;

text_uthmani: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
translation_text: They and their associates will be in groves of (cool) shade, reclining on Thrones (of dignity);

text_uthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: For them there are fruits, and for them there is whatever they ask for.

text_uthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

text_uthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: There they have fruit and whatever they ask for.

text_uthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 57. They will have therein fruits (of all kinds) and all that they ask for.

text_uthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: therein there will be all kinds of fruits to eat, and they shall have all that they desire.

text_uthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: Lahum feeha fakihatun walahumma yaddaAAoon

text_uthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;

text_uthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: (Every) fruit (enjoyment) will be there for them; they shall have whatever they call for;

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
translation_text: “Salām ”(Peace upon you) is the word (they receive) from Merciful Lord.

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
translation_text: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
translation_text: “Peace,” a word from the Lord of Mercy.

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 58. (It will be said to them): Salâm (peace be on you) - a Word from the Lord (Allâh), Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
translation_text: “Peace” shall be the word conveyed to them from their Merciful Lord.

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
translation_text: Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheem

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
translation_text: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
translation_text: "Peace!" - a word (of salutation) from a Lord Most Merciful!

text_uthmani: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: And (it will be said to the infidels,) “Get apart (from the believers) today O the guilty ones.

text_uthmani: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.1

text_uthmani: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: But step aside today, you guilty ones.

text_uthmani: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 59. (It will be said): "And O you Mujrimûn (criminals, polytheists, sinners, disbelievers in the Islâmic Monotheism, wicked evil ones)! Get you apart this Day (from the believers).

text_uthmani: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: “Criminals, separate yourselves from others today!1

text_uthmani: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: Wamtazoo alyawma ayyuhaalmujrimoon

text_uthmani: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!

text_uthmani: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: "And O ye in sin! Get ye apart this Day!

text_uthmani: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Did I not direct you, O children of ’Ādam (Adam), that you must not worship the Satan, (because) he is an open enemy for you,

text_uthmani: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

text_uthmani: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Children of Adam, did I not command you not to serve Satan, for he was your sworn enemy,

text_uthmani: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 60. Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, that you should not worship Shaitân (Satan). Verily, he is a plain enemy to you.

text_uthmani: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Children of Adam, did I not command you not to serve Satan � he is to you an open enemy

text_uthmani: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adamaan la taAAbudoo ashshaytana innahu lakumAAaduwwun mubeen

text_uthmani: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -

text_uthmani: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: "Did I not enjoin on you, O ye Children of Adam, that ye should not worship Satan; for that he was to you an enemy avowed?-

text_uthmani: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
translation_text: and that you must worship Me, (because) this is the straight path?

text_uthmani: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
translation_text: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

text_uthmani: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
translation_text: but to serve Me? This is the straight path.

text_uthmani: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And that you should worship Me [Alone - Islâmic Monotheism, and set up not rivals, associate-gods with Me]. That is the Straight Path.1

text_uthmani: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
translation_text: and serve Me alone: this is the Straight Way?1

text_uthmani: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
translation_text: Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratunmustaqeem

text_uthmani: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
translation_text: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path.

text_uthmani: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
translation_text: "And that ye should worship Me, (for that) this was the Straight Way?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: He had misguided lot many people from among you. So, did you not have sense?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: He has led great numbers of you astray. Did you not use your reason?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 62. And indeed he (Satan) did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did you not, then, understand?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: Still, he misguided a whole throng of you. Did you have no sense?1

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillankatheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloon

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: "But he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did ye not, then, understand?

text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: (Now) this is the Jahannam of which you were consistently warned.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: So this is the Fire that you were warned against.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 63. This is Hell which you were promised!

text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: Now this is the Hell of which you were warned.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntumtooAAadoon

text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).

text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: "This is the Hell of which ye were (repeatedly) warned!

text_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
translation_text: Enter it today, because you have been persistently denying (the truth).”

text_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
translation_text: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."1

text_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
translation_text: Enter it today, because you went on ignoring [my commands].’

text_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Burn therein this Day, for that you used to disbelieve.1

text_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
translation_text: Burn in it on account of your disbelieving.

text_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
translation_text: Islawha alyawma bimakuntum takfuroon

text_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
translation_text: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.

text_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
translation_text: "Embrace ye the (fire) this Day, for that ye (persistently) rejected (Truth)."

text_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: Today We will set a seal on their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness about what they used to do.

text_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.

text_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: On that Day We shall seal up their mouths, but their hands will speak to Us, and their feet bear witness to everything they have done.

text_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 65. This Day, We shall seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness to what they used to earn. (It is said that one’s left thigh will be the first to bear the witness). [Tafsir At-Tabarî,]

text_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: Today We shall put a seal on their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us and their feet shall bear witness to what they had been doing.1

text_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihimwatukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanooyaksiboon

text_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.

text_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: That Day shall We set a seal on their mouths. But their hands will speak to us, and their feet bear witness, to all that they did.

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: If We so will, We would wipe out their eyes (right here in this world), and they would be racing towards the way, but how would they see?

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?1

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: If it had been Our will, We could have taken away their sight. They would have struggled to find the way, but how could they have seen it?

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 66. And if it had been Our Will, We would surely have wiped out (blinded) their eyes, so that they would struggle for the Path, how then would they see?

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: If We so willed, We would have put out their eyes, then they would rush to see the Way, but how would they be able to see?

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: Walaw nashao latamasnaAAala aAAyunihim fastabaqoo assiratafaanna yubsiroon

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen?

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: If it had been our Will, We could surely have blotted out their eyes; then should they have run about groping for the Path, but how could they have seen?

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: And If We so will, We would disfigure them at their places, and they would not be able to move, nor would they return.

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.1

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: If it had been Our will, We could have paralysed them where they stood, so that they could not move forward or backward.

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (into animals or lifeless objects) in their places. Then they would have been unable to go forward (move about) nor they could have turned back.1

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: If We so willed, We would have transformed them where they were so that they would not go forward or backward.1

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahumAAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyanwala yarjiAAoon

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
translation_text: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (to remain) in their places; then should they have been unable to move about, nor could they have returned (after error).

text_uthmani: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: And whomsoever We give long life, we reverse him in creation. Then, do they have no sense?

text_uthmani: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation;1 so will they not understand?

text_uthmani: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: If We extend anyone’s life, We reverse his development. Do they not use their reason?

text_uthmani: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 68. And he whom We grant long life - We reverse him in creation (weakness after strength). Will they not then understand?

text_uthmani: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: Whomsoever We grant a long life, We reverse him in his constitution.1 Do they still not understand?

text_uthmani: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkis-hu fee alkhalqiafala yaAAqiloon

text_uthmani: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?

text_uthmani: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: If We grant long life to any, We cause him to be reversed in nature: Will they not then understand?

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: We did not teach him (the Holy Prophet) poetry, and it is not proper for him. It is nothing (of that sort,) but (it is) an advice and a readable book that explains (the Truth),

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: We have not taught the Prophet poetry, nor could he everhave been a poet.

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 69. And We have not taught him (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) poetry, nor is it suitable for him. This is only a Reminder and a plain Qur’ân.

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: We did not teach him (to wit, the Messenger) poetry and it does not behove him.1 This is none but an Admonition, and a Clear Book

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Wama AAallamnahu ashshiAArawama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrunwaqur-anun mubeen

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: We have not instructed the (Prophet) in Poetry, nor is it meet for him: this is no less than a Message and a Qur'an making things clear:

text_uthmani: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: so that it may warn him who is alive (to listen to the truth), and so that the word may prove true against the disbelievers.

text_uthmani: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: To warn whoever is alive1 and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.

text_uthmani: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: This is a revelation, an illuminating Quran to warn anyone who is truly alive, so that God’s verdict may be passed against the disbelievers.

text_uthmani: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 70. That he or it (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم or the Qur’ân) may give warning to him who is living (a healthy minded - the believer), and that Word (charge) may be justified against the disbelievers (dead, as they reject the warnings).

text_uthmani: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: that he may warn him who is alive1 and establish an argument against those that deny the Truth.

text_uthmani: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: Liyunthira man kana hayyanwayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireen

text_uthmani: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.

text_uthmani: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: That it may give admonition to any (who are) alive, and that the charge may be proved against those who reject (Truth).

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
translation_text: Did they not see that We have created for them cattle, among things made (directly) by Our hands, and then they become their owners?

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
translation_text: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands1 have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
translation_text: Can they not see how, among the things made by Our hands, We have created livestock they control,

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Do they not see that We have created for them of what Our Hands have created the cattle, so that they are their owners.

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
translation_text: Do they not see Our handiwork:1 We created for them cattle which they own?

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
translation_text: Awa lam yaraw anna khalaqnalahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahumlaha malikoon

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
translation_text: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
translation_text: See they not that it is We Who have created for them - among the things which Our hands have fashioned - cattle, which are under their dominion?-

text_uthmani: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: And We have brought them under their control, so as some of them are their means of transport, and some of them they eat.

text_uthmani: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.

text_uthmani: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: and made them obedient, so that some can be used for riding, some for food,

text_uthmani: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 72. And We have subdued them unto them so that some of them they have for riding and some they eat.

text_uthmani: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: We have subjected the cattle to them so that some of them they ride and eat the flesh of others.

text_uthmani: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: Wathallalnaha lahumfaminha rakoobuhum waminha ya/kuloon

text_uthmani: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?

text_uthmani: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: And that We have subjected them to their (use)? of them some do carry them and some they eat:

text_uthmani: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: And for them there are (other) benefits in them and things to drink. So, would they not be grateful?

text_uthmani: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?

text_uthmani: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: some for other benefits, and some for drink? Will they not give thanks?

text_uthmani: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 73. And they have (other) benefits from them, and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?

text_uthmani: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: They derive a variety of benefits and drinks from them. Will they, then, not give thanks?1

text_uthmani: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibuafala yashkuroon

text_uthmani: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks?

text_uthmani: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: And they have (other) profits from them (besides), and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: They have adopted gods other than Allah, so that they may be helped (by them).

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: Yet they have taken other gods besides God to help them,

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 74. And they have taken besides Allâh âlihah (gods), hoping that they might be helped (by those so-called gods).

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: They set up deities apart from Allah, hoping that they will receive help from them.

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: Wattakhathoo min dooni Allahialihatan laAAallahum yunsaroon

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.

text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: Yet they take (for worship) gods other than Allah, (hoping) that they might be helped!

text_uthmani: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: They cannot help them, rather they (the disbelievers themselves) are (like) an army brought forth for (protecting) them (the so-called co-gods)

text_uthmani: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.1

text_uthmani: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: though these could not do so even if they called a whole army of them together!

text_uthmani: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 75. They cannot help them, but they will be brought forward as a troop against those who worshipped them (at the time of Reckoning).

text_uthmani: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: Those deities can render them no help. Yet these devotees act as though they were an army in waiting for them.1

text_uthmani: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: La yastateeAAoona nasrahumwahum lahum jundun muhdaroon

text_uthmani: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.

text_uthmani: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: They have not the power to help them: but they will be brought up (before Our Judgment-seat) as a troop (to be condemned).

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
translation_text: So, their remarks must not grieve you. Surely We know what they conceal and what they disclose.

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
translation_text: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 76. So let not their speech, then, grieve you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). Verily, We know what they conceal and what they reveal.

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
translation_text: So [Prophet] do not be distressed at what they say: We know what they conceal and what they reveal.

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
translation_text: Let not their words grieve you. Surely We know all things about them, what they conceal and what they reveal.1

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
translation_text: Fala yahzunka qawluhum innanaAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoon

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
translation_text: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.

text_uthmani: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
translation_text: Let not their speech, then, grieve thee. Verily We know what they hide as well as what they disclose.

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Did man not see that We have created him from a drop of semen? Then suddenly he stood as an open adversary (to Us).

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once1 he is a clear adversary?

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Can man not see that We created him from a drop of fluid? Yet- lo and behold!- he disputes openly,

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 77. Does not man see that We have created him from Nutfah (mixed male and female sexual discharge - semen drops). Yet behold he (stands forth) as an open opponent.

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Does1 man not see that We created him of a sperm drop, and lo! he is flagrantly contentious?2

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Awa lam yara al-insanu annakhalaqnahu min nutfatin fa-itha huwa khaseemunmubeen

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.

text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Doth not man see that it is We Who created him from sperm? yet behold! he (stands forth) as an open adversary!

text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
translation_text: He has set up an argument about Us and forgot his creation. He said, “Who will give life to the bones when they are decayed?”

text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
translation_text: And he presents for Us an example1 and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"

text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
translation_text: producing arguments against Us, forgetting his own creation. He says, ‘Who can give life back to bones after they have decayed?’

text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 78. And he puts forth for Us a parable, and forgets his own creation. He says: "Who will give life to these bones after they are rotten and have become dust?"

text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
translation_text: He strikes for Us1 a similitude and forgot his own creation.2 He says: “Who will quicken the bones when they have decayed?”

text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
translation_text: Wadaraba lana mathalanwanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithamawahiya rameem

text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
translation_text: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?

text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
translation_text: And he makes comparisons for Us, and forgets his own (origin and) Creation: He says, "Who can give life to (dry) bones and decomposed ones (at that)?"

text_uthmani: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Say, “These will be revived by the same One who had created them for the first time, and who is fully aware of every creation,

text_uthmani: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

text_uthmani: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Say, ‘He who created them in the first place will give them life again: He has full knowledge of every act of creation.

text_uthmani: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 79. Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) "He will give life to them Who created them for the first time! And He is the All-Knower of every creation!"

text_uthmani: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Say: “He Who first brought them into being will quicken them; He knows well about every kind of creation;

text_uthmani: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Qul yuhyeeha allatheeanshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleem

text_uthmani: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,

text_uthmani: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Say, "He will give them life Who created them for the first time! for He is Well-versed in every kind of creation!-

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
translation_text: - the One who created for you fire from the green tree, and in no time you kindle from it.”

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
translation_text: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
translation_text: It is He who produces fire for you out of the green tree- lo and behold!- and from this you kindle fire.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 80. He Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold you kindle therewith.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
translation_text: He Who created from a green tree a fire for you, a fire to light your stoves with.”1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
translation_text: Allathee jaAAala lakum mina ashshajarial-akhdari naran fa-itha antum minhutooqidoon

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
translation_text: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
translation_text: "The same Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold! ye kindle therewith (your own fires)!

text_uthmani: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: Is it that the One who has created the heavens and the earth has no power to create ones like them? Why not? He is the Supreme Creator, the All-Knowing.

text_uthmani: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

text_uthmani: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: Is He who created the heavens and earth not able to create the likes of these people? Of course He is! He is the All Knowing Creator:

text_uthmani: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 81. Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, Able to create the like of them? Yes, indeed! He is the All-Knowing Supreme Creator.

text_uthmani: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: Has He Who created the heavens and the earth no power to create the likes of them? Yes, indeed, He is the Superb Creator.

text_uthmani: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: Awa laysa allathee khalaqa assamawatiwal-arda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqamithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleem

text_uthmani: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator,

text_uthmani: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: "Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like thereof?" - Yea, indeed! for He is the Creator Supreme, of skill and knowledge (infinite)!

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation_text: His practice, when He intends to do something, is no more than He says, “Be”, and it comes to be.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation_text: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 82. Verily, His Command, when He intends a thing, is only that He says to it, "Be!" - and it is!

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation_text: when He wills something to be, His way is to say, “Be”- and it is!

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation_text: Whenever He wills a thing, He just commands it “Be” and it is.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation_text: Innama amruhu itha aradashay-an an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoon

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation_text: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
translation_text: Verily, when He intends a thing, His Command is, "be", and it is!

text_uthmani: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_text: So, pure (from every fault) is the One in whose hand is the dominion of all things. And towards Him you are to be returned.

text_uthmani: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_text: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.

text_uthmani: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_text: So glory be to Him in whose Hand lies control over all things. It is to Him that you will all be brought back.’

text_uthmani: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 83. So glorified be He and exalted above all that they associate with Him, and in Whose Hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him you shall be returned.

text_uthmani: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_text: Holy is He Who has full control over everything, and to Him you shall all be recalled.

text_uthmani: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_text: Fasubhana allathee biyadihimalakootu kulli shay-in wa-ilayhi turjaAAoon

text_uthmani: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_text: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.

text_uthmani: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
translation_text: So glory to Him in Whose hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him will ye be all brought back.

text_uthmani: وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفًّا
وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفًّا
translation_text: (I swear) by those who stand in rows,

text_uthmani: وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفًّا
translation_text: By those [angels] lined up in rows

text_uthmani: وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفًّا
translation_text: By those [angels] ranged in rows,

text_uthmani: وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفًّا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. By those (angels) ranged in ranks (or rows).

text_uthmani: وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفًّا
translation_text: By those who range themselves in rows;

text_uthmani: وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفًّا
translation_text: Wassaffati saffa

text_uthmani: وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفًّا
translation_text: By those who set the ranks in battle order

text_uthmani: وَٱلصَّـٰٓفَّـٰتِ صَفًّا
translation_text: By those who range themselves in ranks,

text_uthmani: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا
فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا
translation_text: then by those who prevent firmly,

text_uthmani: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا
translation_text: And those who drive [the clouds]

text_uthmani: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا
translation_text: who rebuke reproachfully

text_uthmani: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. By those (angels) who drive the clouds in a good way.

text_uthmani: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا
translation_text: by those who reprove severely,

text_uthmani: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا
translation_text: Fazzajirati zajra

text_uthmani: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا
translation_text: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof

text_uthmani: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًا
translation_text: And so are strong in repelling (evil),

text_uthmani: فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: then by those who recite the dhikr,

text_uthmani: فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: And those who recite the message,1

text_uthmani: فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. By those (angels) who bring the Book and the Qur’ân from Allâh to mankind [Tafsir Ibn Kathîr].

text_uthmani: فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: and recite God’s word,

text_uthmani: فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: and those who recite the Exhortation;1

text_uthmani: فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: Fattaliyati thikra

text_uthmani: فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,

text_uthmani: فَٱلتَّـٰلِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: And thus proclaim the Message (of Allah)!

text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ
إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ
translation_text: surely your God is but One,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ
translation_text: Indeed, your God is One,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ
translation_text: truly your God is One,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. Verily your Ilâh (God) is indeed One (i.e. Allâh):

text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ
translation_text: surely your God is One,1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ
translation_text: Inna ilahakum lawahid

text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ
translation_text: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;

text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌ
translation_text: Verily, verily, your Allah is one!-

text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
translation_text: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, and Lord of the points of sunrise.

text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
translation_text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.1

text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
translation_text: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them, Lord of every sunrise.

text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and all that is between them, and Lord of every point of the sun’s risings.1

text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
translation_text: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever lies between the two, the Lord1 of the Easts.2

text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
translation_text: Rabbu assamawati wal-ardiwama baynahuma warabbu almashariq

text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
translation_text: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.

text_uthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
translation_text: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all between them, and Lord of every point at the rising of the sun!

text_uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
translation_text: Verily, We have decorated the nearest sky with an adornment, the stars,

text_uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
translation_text: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

text_uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
translation_text: We have adorned the lowest heaven with stars,

text_uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Verily We have adorned the near heaven with the stars (for beauty).1

text_uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
translation_text: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars1

text_uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
translation_text: Inna zayyanna assamaaaddunya bizeenatin alkawakib

text_uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
translation_text: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;

text_uthmani: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
translation_text: We have indeed decked the lower heaven with beauty (in) the stars,-

text_uthmani: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ
وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ
translation_text: and (have made them) a security against every rebellious devil.

text_uthmani: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ
translation_text: And as protection against every rebellious devil

text_uthmani: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. And to guard against every rebellious devil.

text_uthmani: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ
translation_text: and made them a safeguard against every rebellious devil:

text_uthmani: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ
translation_text: and have protected it from every rebellious satan.1

text_uthmani: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ
translation_text: Wahifthan min kulli shaytaninmarid

text_uthmani: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ
translation_text: With security from every froward devil.

text_uthmani: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ مَّارِدٍ
translation_text: (For beauty) and for guard against all obstinate rebellious evil spirits,

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
translation_text: They cannot listen to the Upper Realm and are hit from every side

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
translation_text: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,1

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
translation_text: they cannot eavesdrop on the Higher Assembly––pelted from every side,

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. They cannot listen to the higher group (angels) for they are pelted from every side.

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
translation_text: These satans cannot listen to what transpires in the High Council for they are pelted away from every side

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
translation_text: La yassammaAAoona ila almala-ial-aAAla wayuqthafoona min kulli janib

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
translation_text: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
translation_text: (So) they should not strain their ears in the direction of the Exalted Assembly but be cast away from every side,

text_uthmani: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
translation_text: to be driven off, and for them there is a lasting punishment;

text_uthmani: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
translation_text: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

text_uthmani: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
translation_text: driven away, they will have perpetual torment––

text_uthmani: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. Outcast, and theirs is a constant (or painful) torment.

text_uthmani: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
translation_text: and are repelled. Theirs is an unceasing chastisement.

text_uthmani: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
translation_text: Duhooran walahum AAathabun wasib

text_uthmani: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
translation_text: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;

text_uthmani: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ
translation_text: Repulsed, for they are under a perpetual penalty,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
translation_text: however, if one snatches a little bit, he is pursued by a bright flame.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
translation_text: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
translation_text: if any [of them] stealthily snatches away a fragment, he will be pursued by a piercing flame.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. Except such as snatch away something by stealing, and they are pursued by a flaming fire of piercing brightness.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
translation_text: And if any is able to snatch a fragment, he is pursued by a piercing flame.1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
translation_text: Illa man khatifa alkhatfatafaatbaAAahu shihabun thaqib

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
translation_text: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
translation_text: Except such as snatch away something by stealth, and they are pursued by a flaming fire, of piercing brightness.

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
translation_text: Now ask them, “Are they stronger in the formation of their bodies, or those (other beings) that We have created?” Certainly, We did create them from sticky clay.

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
translation_text: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
translation_text: So [Prophet], ask the disbelievers: is it harder to create them than other beings We have created? We created them from sticky clay.

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Then ask them (i.e. these polytheists, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Are they stronger as creation, or those (others like the heavens and the earth and the mountains) whom We have created?" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay.

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
translation_text: So ask them (that is, human beings): “Were they harder to create than the objects We created?”1 We created them from sticky clay.2

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
translation_text: Fastaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan amman khalaqna inna khalaqnahum min teeninlazib

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
translation_text: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
translation_text: Just ask their opinion: are they the more difficult to create, or the (other) beings We have created? Them have We created out of a sticky clay!

text_uthmani: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
translation_text: But you wonder (at their denial), and they mock (at the idea of an Hereafter).

text_uthmani: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
translation_text: But you wonder, while they mock,

text_uthmani: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
translation_text: You marvel as they scoff,

text_uthmani: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. Nay, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) wondered (at their insolence) while they mock (at you and at the Qur’ân).

text_uthmani: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
translation_text: You marvel (at the wondrous creations of Allah) and they scoff at it,

text_uthmani: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
translation_text: Bal AAajibta wayaskharoon

text_uthmani: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
translation_text: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock

text_uthmani: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
translation_text: Truly dost thou marvel, while they ridicule,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
translation_text: And when any advice is given to them, they pay no heed to it.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
translation_text: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
