text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
translation_text: take no heed when they are warned,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. And when they are reminded, they pay no attention.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
translation_text: and when they are admonished, they pay no heed;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
translation_text: Wa-itha thukkiroo la yathkuroon

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
translation_text: And heed not when they are reminded,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
translation_text: And, when they are admonished, pay no heed,-

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
translation_text: And when they see a sign, they make fun of it,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
translation_text: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. And when they see an Ayâh (a sign, or an evidence) from Allâh, they mock at it.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
translation_text: and resort to ridicule when they see a sign,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
translation_text: and if they see any Sign, they laugh it away

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
translation_text: Wa-itha raaw ayatanyastaskhiroon

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
translation_text: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
translation_text: And, when they see a Sign, turn it to mockery,

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: and say, “This is nothing but an open magic.

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: saying, ‘This is no more than blatant sorcery.’

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. And they say: "This is nothing but evident magic!

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: and say: “This is nothing but plain sorcery.1

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Waqaloo in hatha illasihrun mubeen

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: And say, "This is nothing but evident sorcery!

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: Is it when we have died and become dust and bones, that we shall be raised again,

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: ‘What! After we have died and become dust and bones, shall we really be raised up again,

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we (then) verily be resurrected?

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: Is it ever possible that after we die and are reduced to dust and (a skeleton of) bones, we will be raised to life?

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: A-itha mitna wakunnaturaban waAAithaman a-innalamabAAoothoon

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: "What! when we die, and become dust and bones, shall we (then) be raised up (again)

text_uthmani: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
translation_text: and even our fathers of aforetime?”

text_uthmani: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
translation_text: And our forefathers [as well]?"

text_uthmani: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
translation_text: along with our forefathers?’

text_uthmani: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. "And also our fathers of old?"

text_uthmani: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
translation_text: And so also shall our forefathers of yore be raised to life?”

text_uthmani: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
translation_text: Awa abaona al-awwaloon

text_uthmani: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
translation_text: And our forefathers?

text_uthmani: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
translation_text: "And also our fathers of old?"

text_uthmani: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
translation_text: Say, “Yes, and you shall be disgraced (too)!”

text_uthmani: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
translation_text: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

text_uthmani: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
translation_text: Say, ‘Yes indeed, and you will be humiliated.’

text_uthmani: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Yes, and you shall then be humiliated."

text_uthmani: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
translation_text: Tell them: “Yes; and you are utterly helpless (against Allah).”1

text_uthmani: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
translation_text: Qul naAAam waantum dakhiroon

text_uthmani: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
translation_text: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.

text_uthmani: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
translation_text: Say thou: "Yea, and ye shall then be humiliated (on account of your evil)."

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: So, it will be only a single castigating call, and all of a sudden they will begin to see.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: Just one blast and––lo and behold!––they will look

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. It will be a single Zajrah [shout (i.e. the second blowing of the Trumpet)], and behold, they will be staring!

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: There will be a single stern rebuff and lo, they will be observing with their own eyes (all that they had been warned against).1

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: Fa-innama hiya zajratun wahidatunfa-itha hum yanthuroon

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: Then it will be a single (compelling) cry; and behold, they will begin to see!

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: And they will be saying, “Woe to us; this is the Day of Retribution.”

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: and say, ‘Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgement.’

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. They will say: "Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense!"

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They will then say: “Woe for us. This is the Day of Judgement.”

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Waqaloo ya waylana hathayawmu addeen

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They will say, "Ah! Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!"

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: (It will be said to them,) “This is the Day of Judgment that you used to deny.”

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: [It will be said], ‘This is the Day of Decision, which you used to deny.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. (It will be said): "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: “Yes, this is the Day of Final Decision that you used to deny as a lie.”1

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: Hatha yawmu alfasli allatheekuntum bihi tukaththiboon

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: (A voice will say,) "This is the Day of Sorting Out, whose truth ye (once) denied!"

text_uthmani: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: (It will be said to the angels,) “Muster all those who were unjust, and their fellows, and whatever they used to worship

text_uthmani: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds,1 and what they used to worship

text_uthmani: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: [Angels], gather together those who did wrong, and others like them, as well as whatever they worshipped

text_uthmani: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. (It will be said to the angels): "Assemble those who did wrong, together with their companions (from the devils) and what they used to worship,

text_uthmani: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: (Then will the command be given): “Muster all the wrong-doers1 and their spouses2 and the deities whom they used to serve

text_uthmani: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: Ohshuroo allatheena thalamoowaazwajahum wama kanoo yaAAbudoon

text_uthmani: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship

text_uthmani: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: "Bring ye up", it shall be said, "The wrong-doers and their wives, and the things they worshipped-

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: other than Allah, and show them the way to Jahannam ,

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: beside God, lead them all to the path of Hell,

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. "Instead of Allâh, and lead them on to the way of flaming Fire (Hell);

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: apart from Allah,1 and direct them to the path of Hell,

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Min dooni Allahi fahdoohum ilasirati aljaheem

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;

text_uthmani: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: "Besides Allah, and lead them to the Way to the (Fierce) Fire!

text_uthmani: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
translation_text: and stop them (for a while,) for they are to be asked some questions.”

text_uthmani: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
translation_text: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."

text_uthmani: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
translation_text: and halt them for questioning:

text_uthmani: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. "But stop them, verily they are to be questioned.

text_uthmani: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
translation_text: and detain them there; they will be called to account.

text_uthmani: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
translation_text: Waqifoohum innahum masooloon

text_uthmani: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
translation_text: And stop them, for they must be questioned.

text_uthmani: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
translation_text: "But stop them, for they must be asked:

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
translation_text: (Then they will be asked, “What is wrong with you that you do not help each other?”

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
translation_text: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
translation_text: “Why do you not support each other now?” ’––

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. "What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another (as you used to do in the world)?"

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
translation_text: How is it that you are not helping one another?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
translation_text: Ma lakum la tanasaroon

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
translation_text: What aileth you that ye help not one another?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
translation_text: "'What is the matter with you that ye help not each other?'"

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
translation_text: On the contrary, that day all of them will have totally surrendered.

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
translation_text: But they, that Day, are in surrender.

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
translation_text: no indeed! They will be in complete submission on that Day––

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. Nay, but that Day they shall surrender.

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
translation_text: Indeed, today they are surrendering themselves completely.”1

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
translation_text: Bal humu alyawma mustaslimoon

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
translation_text: Nay, but this day they make full submission.

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
translation_text: Nay, but that day they shall submit (to Judgment);

text_uthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: And some of them (the followers of their chiefs) will turn to others (the chiefs), asking questions from one another.

text_uthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.

text_uthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: and they will turn on one another accusingly.

text_uthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. And they will turn to one another and question one another.

text_uthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: They will then turn towards each other (and start wrangling).

text_uthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdinyatasaaloon

text_uthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.

text_uthmani: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: And they will turn to one another, and question one another.

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: They (the followers) will say, “You were the ones who used to come to (mislead) us forcefully.”

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."1

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: They will say, ‘You came to us from a position of power.’

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. They will say: "It was you who used to come to us from the right side [i.e. from the right side of one of us and beautify for us every evil, enjoin on us polytheism, and stop us from the truth i.e. Islâmic Monotheism and from every good deed]."

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: (The followers will say to their leaders): “You used to come to us from the right hand.”1

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: Qaloo innakum kuntum ta/toonanaAAani alyameen

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: They will say: "It was ye who used to come to us from the right hand (of power and authority)!"

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: They (the chiefs) will say, “On the contrary, you yourselves were not believers.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: They will say, ‘No! It was you who would not believe-

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. They will reply: "Nay, you yourselves were not believers.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: They will say: “Nay, you yourselves were not the ones who would believe.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Qaloo bal lam takoonoo mu/mineen

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: They will reply: "Nay, ye yourselves had no Faith!

text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: We had no authority over you at all, but you yourselves were a transgressing people.

text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.

text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: we had no power over you- and you were already exceeding all limits.

text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. "And we had no authority over you. Nay! But you were Tâghûn (transgressing) people (polytheists, and disbelievers).

text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: We had no power over you. You were a rebellious people,

text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: Wama kana lanaAAalaykum min sultanin bal kuntum qawman tagheen

text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.

text_uthmani: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: "Nor had we any authority over you. Nay, it was ye who were a people in obstinate rebellion!

text_uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
translation_text: So, the word of our Lord has come true against us. Indeed, we have to taste (the punishment).

text_uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
translation_text: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].

text_uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
translation_text: Our Lord’s sentence on us is just and we must all taste the punishment.

text_uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. "So now the Word of our Lord has been justified against us, that we shall certainly (have to) taste (the torment).

text_uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
translation_text: and so we became deserving of the Word of our Lord that we shall be made to suffer chastisement.

text_uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
translation_text: Fahaqqa AAalayna qawlu rabbinainna latha-iqoon

text_uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
translation_text: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).

text_uthmani: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
translation_text: "So now has been proved true, against us, the word of our Lord that we shall indeed (have to) taste (the punishment of our sins).

text_uthmani: فَأَغْوَيْنَـٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَـٰوِينَ
فَأَغْوَيْنَـٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَـٰوِينَ
translation_text: We did misguide you, (because) we were ourselves erroneous”.

text_uthmani: فَأَغْوَيْنَـٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَـٰوِينَ
translation_text: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."

text_uthmani: فَأَغْوَيْنَـٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَـٰوِينَ
translation_text: We led you astray as we ourselves were astray.’

text_uthmani: فَأَغْوَيْنَـٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَـٰوِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. "So we led you astray because we were ourselves astray."

text_uthmani: فَأَغْوَيْنَـٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَـٰوِينَ
translation_text: So we led you astray; we ourselves were strayed.”1

text_uthmani: فَأَغْوَيْنَـٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَـٰوِينَ
translation_text: Faaghwaynakum inna kunnaghaween

text_uthmani: فَأَغْوَيْنَـٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَـٰوِينَ
translation_text: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.

text_uthmani: فَأَغْوَيْنَـٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَـٰوِينَ
translation_text: "We led you astray: for truly we were ourselves astray."

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
translation_text: So, that day, they will share each other in punishment.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
translation_text: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
translation_text: On that Day they will all share the torment:

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. Then verily, that Day, they will (all) share in the torment.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
translation_text: On that Day, they will all share the chastisement.1

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
translation_text: Fa-innahum yawma-ithin fee alAAathabimushtarikoon

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
translation_text: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
translation_text: Truly, that Day, they will (all) share in the Penalty.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: This is how We deal with the criminals.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: this is how We deal with the guilty.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 34. Certainly, that is how We deal with Al-Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, disbelievers, criminals, the disobedient to Allâh).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We treat the culprits.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Inna kathalika nafAAalu bilmujrimeen

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Verily that is how We shall deal with Sinners.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
translation_text: They were those to whom when it was said: “There is no god but Allah”, they waxed proud,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
translation_text: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Truly, when it was said to them: Lâ ilâha illallâh "(none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh)," they puffed themselves up with pride1 (i.e. denied it).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
translation_text: Whenever it was said to them, ‘There is no deity but God,’ they became arrogant,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
translation_text: Whenever it was said to them: “There is no true deity apart from Allah,” they waxed proud

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
translation_text: Innahum kanoo itha qeela lahumla ilaha illa Allahu yastakbiroon

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
translation_text: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
translation_text: For they, when they were told that there is no god except Allah, would puff themselves up with Pride,

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: and used to say, “Are we really to leave our gods because of an insane poet?”

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: and said, ‘Are we to forsake our gods for a mad poet?’

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. And (they) said: "Are we going to abandon our âlihah (gods) for the sake of a mad poet?"

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: and said: “Shall we forsake our deities for the sake of a distracted poet?”

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: Wayaqooloona a-inna latarikoo alihatinalishaAAirin majnoon

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: And say: "What! shall we give up our gods for the sake of a Poet possessed?"

text_uthmani: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: No, he has come with Truth and has confirmed all the messengers (of Allah).

text_uthmani: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.

text_uthmani: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: ‘No: he brought the truth and confirmed the earlier messengers;

text_uthmani: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. Nay! he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has come with the truth (i.e. Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism and this Qur’ân) and he confirms the Messengers (before him who brought Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism).

text_uthmani: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: (They say so although) he brought the Truth and confirmed the veracity of the Messengers.1

text_uthmani: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Bal jaa bilhaqqi wasaddaqaalmursaleen

text_uthmani: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).

text_uthmani: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Nay! he has come with the (very) Truth, and he confirms (the Message of) the messengers (before him).

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
translation_text: Surely you have to taste the painful punishment,-

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
translation_text: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. Verily, you (pagans of Makkah) are going to taste the painful torment;

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
translation_text: you will taste the painful torment,

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
translation_text: (They will be told): “You shall taste the grievous chastisement.

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
translation_text: Innakum latha-iqoo alAAathabial-aleem

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
translation_text: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
translation_text: Ye shall indeed taste of the Grievous Penalty;-

text_uthmani: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: And you will be recompensed for nothing but for what you used to do-

text_uthmani: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -

text_uthmani: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. And you will be requited nothing except for what you used to do (evil deeds, sins, and Allâh’s disobedience which you used to do in this world)

text_uthmani: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: and be repaid only according to your deeds.’

text_uthmani: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: You will only be recompensed according to your deeds.”

text_uthmani: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Wama tujzawna illa makuntum taAAmaloon

text_uthmani: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -

text_uthmani: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: But it will be no more than the retribution of (the Evil) that ye have wrought;-

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: unlike Allah’s chosen servants.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. Save the chosen slaves of Allâh (i.e. the true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Not so God’s true servants.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: But Allah's chosen servants (shall be spared this woeful end).

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Illa AAibada Allahialmukhlaseen

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Save single-minded slaves of Allah;

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: But the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah,-

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: Those are the people for whom there is a known provision,

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: Those will have a provision determined -

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. For them there will be a known provision (in Paradise),

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: They will have familiar provisions––

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: For them awaits a known provision,1

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: Ola-ika lahum rizqun maAAloom

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: For them there is a known provision,

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: For them is a Sustenance determined,

text_uthmani: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: the fruits; and they will be honored

text_uthmani: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: Fruits;1 and they will be honored

text_uthmani: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: fruits- and will be honoured

text_uthmani: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 42. Fruits; and they shall be honoured,

text_uthmani: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: a variety of delicious fruits; and they shall be honoured1

text_uthmani: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: Fawakihu wahum mukramoon

text_uthmani: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: Fruits. And they will be honoured

text_uthmani: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: Fruits (Delights); and they (shall enjoy) honour and dignity,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: in Gardens of Bliss

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: In gardens of pleasure

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. In the Gardens of delight (Paradise),

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: in gardens of delight;

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: in the Gardens of Bliss.

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: Fee jannati annaAAeem

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: In the Gardens of delight,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: In Gardens of Felicity,

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: facing each other on couches.

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: On thrones facing one another.

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. Facing one another on thrones.

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: seated on couches, facing one another.

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: They will be seated upon couches set face to face;

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: AAala sururin mutaqabileen

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: On couches facing one another;

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: Facing each other on Thrones (of Dignity):

text_uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: They will be served with a cup from a flowing drink,

text_uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,

text_uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 45. Round them will be passed a cup of pure wine -

text_uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: A drink will be passed round among them from a flowing spring:

text_uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: a cup filled with wine1 from its springs,2 will be passed around to them;3

text_uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: Yutafu AAalayhim bika/sin min maAAeen

text_uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,

text_uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: Round will be passed to them a Cup from a clear-flowing fountain,

text_uthmani: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
translation_text: (that will be) white (and) delicious for those who drink.

text_uthmani: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
translation_text: White and delicious to the drinkers;

text_uthmani: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
translation_text: white, delicious to those who taste it,

text_uthmani: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 46. White, delicious to the drinkers.

text_uthmani: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
translation_text: white, sparkling (wine), a delight to the drinkers.

text_uthmani: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
translation_text: Baydaa laththatin lishsharibeen

text_uthmani: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
translation_text: White, delicious to the drinkers,

text_uthmani: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
translation_text: Crystal-white, of a taste delicious to those who drink (thereof),

text_uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
translation_text: There will be no headache therein, nor will they be intoxicated with it,

text_uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
translation_text: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.

text_uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
translation_text: causing no headiness or intoxication.

text_uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 47. Neither will they have Ghoul (any kind of hurt, abdominal pain, headache, a sin) from that, nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.

text_uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
translation_text: There will neither be any harm in it for their body nor will it intoxicate their mind.1

text_uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
translation_text: La feeha ghawlun walahum AAanha yunzafoon

text_uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
translation_text: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.

text_uthmani: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
translation_text: Free from headiness; nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.

text_uthmani: وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
translation_text: and by their side there will be females restricting their gazes (to their husbands), having pretty big eyes,

text_uthmani: وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
translation_text: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances,1 with large, [beautiful] eyes,

text_uthmani: وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And beside them will be Qâsirât-at-Tarf [chaste females (wives), restraining their glances (desiring none except their husbands)], with wide and beautiful eyes.1

text_uthmani: وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
translation_text: With them will be spouses- modest of gaze and beautiful of eye-

text_uthmani: وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
translation_text: Theirs shall be wide-eyed maidens1 with bashful, restrained glances,2

text_uthmani: وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
translation_text: WaAAindahum qasiratu attarfiAAeen

text_uthmani: وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
translation_text: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,

text_uthmani: وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌ
translation_text: And besides them will be chaste women, restraining their glances, with big eyes (of wonder and beauty).

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
translation_text: as if they were eggs hidden (under feathers, protected from pollution).

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
translation_text: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
translation_text: like protected eggs.

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 49. (Delicate and pure) as if they were (hidden) eggs (well) preserved.

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
translation_text: so delicate as the hidden peel under an egg's shell.1

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
translation_text: Kaannahunna baydun maknoon

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
translation_text: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
translation_text: As if they were (delicate) eggs closely guarded.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: Then they will turn to each other asking questions mutually.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 50. Then they will turn to one another, mutually questioning.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: They will turn to one another with questions:

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: Then some of them will turn to others, and will ask each other.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdinyatasaaloon

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation_text: Then they will turn to one another and question one another.

text_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
translation_text: A speaker from them will say, “I had a companion (in the worldly life)

text_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
translation_text: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].

text_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 51. A speaker of them will say: "Verily, I had a companion (in the world),

text_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
translation_text: one will say, ‘I had a close companion on earth

text_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
translation_text: One of them will say: “I had a companion in the world

text_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
translation_text: Qala qa-ilun minhum innee kanalee qareen

text_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
translation_text: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade

text_uthmani: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
translation_text: One of them will start the talk and say: "I had an intimate companion (on the earth),

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
translation_text: who used to say (to me), “Are you one of those who believe?

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
translation_text: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
translation_text: who used to ask me, “Do you really believe that

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 52. Who used to say: "Are you among those who believe (in resurrection after death).

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
translation_text: who used to say: Are you also one of those who confirm the Truth (of life after death)?

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
translation_text: Yaqoolu a-innaka lamina almusaddiqeen

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
translation_text: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
translation_text: "Who used to say, 'what! art thou amongst those who bear witness to the Truth (of the Message)?

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
translation_text: Is it when we have died and become dust and bones? Is it true that we are going to be recompensed (for our deeds)?”

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
translation_text: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
translation_text: after we die and become dust and bone, we shall be brought for judgement?”’

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 53. "(That) when we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed (be raised up) to receive reward or punishment (according to our deeds)?"

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
translation_text: After we are dead and have become all dust and bones shall we still be requited?'1

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
translation_text: A-itha mitna wakunnaturaban waAAithaman a-innalamadeenoon

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
translation_text: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
translation_text: "'When we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed receive rewards and punishments?'"

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
translation_text: He (the speaker) will say (to other people in Paradise) “Would you like to have a look (at Jahannam to find out what happened to that companion of mine)?”

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
translation_text: He will say,1 "Would you [care to] look?"

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
translation_text: Then he will say, ‘Shall we look for him?’

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 54. (The speaker) said: "Will you look down?"

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
translation_text: He will say: Do you wish to know where he is now?'

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
translation_text: Qala hal antum muttaliAAoon

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
translation_text: He saith: Will ye look?

text_uthmani: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
translation_text: (A voice) said: "Would ye like to look down?"

text_uthmani: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: So he will look and will see him in the middle of Jahannam.

text_uthmani: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: And he will look and see him1 in the midst of the Hellfire.

text_uthmani: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 55. So he looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.

text_uthmani: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: He will look down and see him in the midst of the Fire,

text_uthmani: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Then he will look downwards, and will see him in the depths of Hell.

text_uthmani: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: FattalaAAa faraahu feesawa-i aljaheem

text_uthmani: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.

text_uthmani: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: He looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.

text_uthmani: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
translation_text: He (the speaker) will say (to his companion seen in Jahannam ), “By Allah, you were going almost to ruin me.

text_uthmani: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
translation_text: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.

text_uthmani: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 56. He said: "By Allâh! You have nearly ruined me.

text_uthmani: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
translation_text: and say to him, ‘By God, you almost brought me to ruin!

text_uthmani: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
translation_text: He will say to him: By Allah, you almost ruined me.

text_uthmani: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
translation_text: Qala tallahi in kidtalaturdeen

text_uthmani: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
translation_text: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,

text_uthmani: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
translation_text: He said: "By Allah! thou wast little short of bringing me to perdition!

text_uthmani: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
translation_text: But for the favor of my Lord, I would have been among those produced for punishment.”

text_uthmani: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
translation_text: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].

text_uthmani: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 57. "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I would certainly have been among those brought forth (to Hell)."

text_uthmani: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
translation_text: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I too would have been taken to Hell.’

text_uthmani: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
translation_text: But for Allah's favour, I should be one of those who have been mustered here.1

text_uthmani: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
translation_text: Walawla niAAmatu rabbee lakuntu minaalmuhdareen

text_uthmani: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
translation_text: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).

text_uthmani: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
translation_text: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I should certainly have been among those brought (there)!

text_uthmani: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
translation_text: (Then the speaker will address other people of Paradise in delight and wonder, saying,) “Are we not then to die anymore

text_uthmani: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
translation_text: Then, are we not to die

text_uthmani: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
translation_text: Then he will say [to his blessed companions], ‘Are we never to die again after our earlier death?

text_uthmani: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 58. (The dwellers of Paradise will say) "Are we then not to die (any more)?

text_uthmani: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
translation_text: So, are we not going to die,

text_uthmani: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
translation_text: Afama nahnu bimayyiteen

text_uthmani: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
translation_text: Are we then not to die

text_uthmani: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
translation_text: "Is it (the case) that we shall not die,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: beyond our first death, nor are we going to be punished?”

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: Shall we never suffer?

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 59. Except our first death, and we shall not be punished? (after we have entered Paradise)."

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: except for our first death? And shall we suffer no chastisement?'”1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: Illa mawtatana al-oolawama nahnu bimuAAaththabeen

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation_text: "Except our first death, and that we shall not be punished?"

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: This is, indeed, the great achievement.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: Indeed, this is the great attainment.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: This truly is the supreme triumph!’

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 60. Truly, this is the supreme success!

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: Surely this is the supreme triumph.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: Inna hatha lahuwa alfawzu alAAatheem

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: Lo! this is the supreme triumph.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: Verily this is the supreme achievement!

text_uthmani: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَـٰمِلُونَ
لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَـٰمِلُونَ
translation_text: For this kind (of achievement), all workers must work.

text_uthmani: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَـٰمِلُونَ
translation_text: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

text_uthmani: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَـٰمِلُونَ
translation_text: Everyone should strive to attain this.

text_uthmani: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَـٰمِلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 61. For the like of this let the workers work.

text_uthmani: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَـٰمِلُونَ
translation_text: For the like of it should the workers work.

text_uthmani: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَـٰمِلُونَ
translation_text: Limithli hatha falyaAAmali alAAamiloon

text_uthmani: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَـٰمِلُونَ
translation_text: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.

text_uthmani: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَـٰمِلُونَ
translation_text: For the like of this let all strive, who wish to strive.

text_uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_text: Is that (blissful Paradise) better for hospitality or the tree of zaqqūm ?

text_uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_text: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?

text_uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_text: Is this the better welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum,

text_uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 62. Is that (Paradise) better entertainment or the tree of Zaqqûm (a horrible tree in Hell)?

text_uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_text: Is this a better hospitality or the tree of al-Zaqqum?1

text_uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_text: Athalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratuazzaqqoom

text_uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_text: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum?

text_uthmani: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_text: Is that the better entertainment or the Tree of Zaqqum?

text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: We have made it a test for the unjust.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: which we have made a test for the evildoers?

text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 63. Truly We have made it (as) a trial for the Zâlimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, wrong-doers).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: We have made this tree a trial for the wrong-doers.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: Inna jaAAalnahafitnatan liththalimeen

text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: For We have truly made it (as) a trial for the wrong-doers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: It is a tree that comes forth in the bottom of Jahannam.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 64. Verily, it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-fire,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: This tree grows in the heart of the blazing Fire,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: It is a tree that grows in the nethermost part of Hell.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Innaha shajaratun takhruju fee aslialjaheem

text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: For it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-Fire:

text_uthmani: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
translation_text: Its fruits are like the heads of devils.

text_uthmani: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
translation_text: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

text_uthmani: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
translation_text: and its fruits are like devils’ heads.

text_uthmani: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 65. The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of Shayâtîn (devils);

text_uthmani: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
translation_text: Its spathes are like the heads of satans.1

text_uthmani: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
translation_text: TalAAuha kaannahu ruoosu ashshayateen

text_uthmani: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
translation_text: Its crop is as it were the heads of devils

text_uthmani: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
translation_text: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of devils:

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
translation_text: So, they have to eat from it and have to fill their bellies with it.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
translation_text: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
translation_text: They will fill their bellies eating from it;

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 66. Truly, they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
translation_text: (The people of Hell) will surely eat of it, filling their bellies with it.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
translation_text: Fa-innahum laakiloona minhafamali-oona minha albutoon

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
translation_text: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
translation_text: Truly they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: Then they will have, on top of it, a mixture made of boiling water.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 67. Then on the top of that they will be given boiling water to drink so that it becomes a mixture (of boiling water and Zaqqûm in their bellies).

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: then drink scalding water on top of it;

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: Then on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: Thumma inna lahum AAalayha lashawbanmin hameem

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
translation_text: Then on top of that they will be given a mixture made of boiling water.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Then, their final return is to the Fire.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: then return to the blazing Fire.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 68. Then thereafter, verily, their return is to the flaming fire of Hell.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Then their return will be to the same blazing Hell.1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Thumma inna marjiAAahum la-ila aljaheem

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Then shall their return be to the (Blazing) Fire.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
translation_text: They found their fathers on the wrong path.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
translation_text: Indeed they found their fathers astray.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
translation_text: They found their forefathers astray,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 69. Verily, they found their fathers on the wrong path;

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
translation_text: These are the ones who found their fathers steeped in error,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
translation_text: Innahum alfaw abaahum dalleen

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
translation_text: They indeed found their fathers astray,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
translation_text: Truly they found their fathers on the wrong Path;

text_uthmani: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
translation_text: So, they used to run in their footsteps.

text_uthmani: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
translation_text: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.

text_uthmani: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 70. So they (too) hastened in their footsteps!

text_uthmani: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
translation_text: and rushed to follow in their footsteps- before the disbelievers [of Mecca],

text_uthmani: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
translation_text: and they are running in their footsteps.

text_uthmani: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
translation_text: Fahum AAala atharihimyuhraAAoon

text_uthmani: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
translation_text: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.

text_uthmani: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
translation_text: So they (too) were rushed down on their footsteps!

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Most of the earlier ones (too) had gone astray before them.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: most men in the past went astray,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 71. And indeed most of the men of old went astray before them;

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Before them a multitude of people of olden times had erred,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Walaqad dalla qablahum aktharual-awwaleen

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: And truly before them, many of the ancients went astray;-

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
translation_text: We did send warners among them.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
translation_text: And We had already sent among them warners.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
translation_text: even though We sent messengers to warn them.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 72. And indeed We sent among them warners (Messengers);

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
translation_text: and We had sent among them Messengers to warn them.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
translation_text: Walaqad arsalna feehim munthireen

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
translation_text: And verily We sent among them warners.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
translation_text: But We sent aforetime, among them, (messengers) to admonish them;-

text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: So look, how was the end of those warned -

text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -

text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: See how those who were warned met their end!

text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 73. Then see what was the end of those who were warned (but heeded not).

text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: Observe, then, what was the end of those that had been warned,

text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: Fanthur kayfa kanaAAaqibatu almunthareen

text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned,

text_uthmani: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: Then see what was the end of those who were admonished (but heeded not),-

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: except Allah’s chosen servants.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 74. Except the chosen slaves of Allâh (faithful, obedient, and true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Not so the true servants of God.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: except for the chosen servants of Allah?1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Illa AAibada Allahialmukhlaseen

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Except the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
translation_text: And NūH did call Us (for help after he was disappointed with his people), so (We accepted his prayer, as) We are the best to respond.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
translation_text: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
translation_text: Noah cried to Us, and how excellent was Our response!

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 75. And indeed Nûh (Noah) invoked Us, and We are the Best of those who answer (the request).

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
translation_text: Noah1 had called upon Us (earlier).2 See, how excellent We were in answering him!

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
translation_text: Walaqad nadana noohunfalaniAAma almujeeboon

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
translation_text: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
translation_text: (In the days of old), Noah cried to Us, and We are the best to hear prayer.

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: And We delivered him and his family from the great agony,

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: We saved him and his people from great distress,

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 76. And We rescued him and his family from the great distress (i.e. drowning),

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: We delivered him and his household from the great calamity;1

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: Wanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbialAAatheem

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: And We saved him and his household from the great distress,

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: And We delivered him and his people from the Great Calamity,

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: and made his progeny the sole survivors (from the Deluge).

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And, his progeny, them We made the survivors (i.e. Shem, Ham and Japheth).
