text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: We let his offspring remain on the earth,

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: and made his offspring the only ones to survive,1

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: WajaAAalna thurriyyatahu humualbaqeen

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: And made his seed the survivors,

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
translation_text: And made his progeny to endure (on this earth);

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We left for him (a word of praise) among the later people, (that is):

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: We let him be praised by later generations:

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 78. And left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations:

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: and We established for him a good name among posterity.

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: Watarakna AAalayhi fee al-akhireen

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations to come in later times:

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Salām be on NūH among (the people of) all the worlds.

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: ‘Peace be upon Noah among all the nations!’

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 79. "Salâm (peace) be upon Nûh (Noah) (from Us) among the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)!"

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.1

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Salamun AAala noohinfee alAAalameen

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: "Peace and salutation to Noah among the nations!"

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Certainly, this is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: This is how We reward those who do good:

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 80. Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We reward all those who do good.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! thus do We reward the good.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus indeed do we reward those who do right.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: He was one of Our believing servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 81. Verily, he [Nûh (Noah)] was one of Our believing slaves.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: he was truly one of Our faithful servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely he was one of Our truly believing servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Innahu min AAibadinaalmu/mineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: For he was one of our believing Servants.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Then, we drowned others.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 82. Then We drowned the others (disbelievers and polytheists).

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: We drowned the rest.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Thereafter We caused the others to be drowned.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Thumma aghraqna al-akhareen

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Then We did drown the others.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Then the rest we overwhelmed in the Flood.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: And certainly one of his adherents was Ibrāhīm.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,

text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: Abraham was of the same faith:

text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 83. And, verily, among those who followed his [Nûh’s (Noah)] way (Islâmic Monotheism) was Ibrâhîm (Abraham).

text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: Abraham was on the self-same way (as Noah).

text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: Wa-inna min sheeAAatihi la-ibraheem

text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham

text_uthmani: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: Verily among those who followed his Way was Abraham.

text_uthmani: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: (Remember) when he came to his Lord with a pure heart,

text_uthmani: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

text_uthmani: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: he came to his Lord with a devoted heart.

text_uthmani: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 84. When he came to his Lord with a pure heart [attached to Allâh Alone and none else, worshipping none but Allâh Alone - true Islâmic Monotheism, pure from the filth of polytheism].

text_uthmani: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart,1

text_uthmani: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Ith jaa rabbahu biqalbinsaleem

text_uthmani: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;

text_uthmani: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Behold! he approached his Lord with a sound heart.

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: when he said to his father and his people, “What is that which you worship?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are you worshipping?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 85. When he said to his father and to his people: "What is it that which you worship?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: and said to his father and his people:1 “Whom do you worship?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: Ith qala li-abeehi waqawmihi mathataAAbudoon

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: Behold! he said to his father and to his people, "What is that which ye worship?

text_uthmani: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
translation_text: Do you wish (to have) fallacious gods other than Allah?

text_uthmani: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
translation_text: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?

text_uthmani: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
translation_text: How can you choose false gods instead of the true God?

text_uthmani: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 86. "Is it a falsehood - âlihah (gods) other than Allâh - that you desire?

text_uthmani: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
translation_text: Is it false deities that you want to serve rather than Allah?

text_uthmani: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
translation_text: A-ifkan alihatan doona Allahitureedoon

text_uthmani: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
translation_text: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?

text_uthmani: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
translation_text: "Is it a falsehood- gods other than Allah- that ye desire?

text_uthmani: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Then, what do you think about the Lord of the worlds?”

text_uthmani: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"

text_uthmani: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: So what is your opinion about the Lord of all the Worlds?’

text_uthmani: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 87. "Then what think you about the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists)?"

text_uthmani: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: What do you think of the Lord of the whole Universe?”1

text_uthmani: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Fama thannukum birabbialAAalameen

text_uthmani: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?

text_uthmani: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: "Then what is your idea about the Lord of the worlds?"

text_uthmani: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: Then, he cast a look at the stars,

text_uthmani: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: And he cast a look at the stars

text_uthmani: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: then he looked up to the stars.

text_uthmani: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 88. Then he cast a glance at the stars,

text_uthmani: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: Then1 he looked carefully at the stars2

text_uthmani: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: Fanathara nathratanfee annujoom

text_uthmani: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: And he glanced a glance at the stars

text_uthmani: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: Then did he cast a glance at the Stars.

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: and then said, “I feel indisposed”

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And he said: "Verily, I am sick1 (with plague). [He did this trick to remain in their temple of idols to destroy them and not to accompany them to the pagan feast)]."

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: He said, ‘I am sick,’

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: and said: “I am sick.”1

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: Faqala innee saqeem

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: And he said, "I am indeed sick (at heart)!"

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
translation_text: So they went away from him, turning their backs.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
translation_text: So they turned away from him, departing.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
translation_text: so [his people] turned away from him and left.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 90. So they turned away from him, and departed (for fear of the disease).

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
translation_text: So turning their backs, they went away from him.1

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
translation_text: Fatawallaw AAanhu mudbireen

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
translation_text: And they turned their backs and went away from him.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
translation_text: So they turned away from him, and departed.

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: And he made his way to their ‘gods’ and said to them, “Why would you not eat?

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?1

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 91. Then he turned to their âlihah (gods) and said: "Will you not eat (of the offering before you)?

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: He turned to their gods and said, ‘Do you not eat?

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: Then he went quietly to the (temple of the deities) and said: “What is the matter with you, why do you not eat?1

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: Faragha ila alihatihimfaqala ala ta/kuloon

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: Then did he turn to their gods and said, "will ye not eat (of the offerings before you)?...

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: What is wrong with you that you do not speak?”

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: Why do you not speak?’

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 92. "What is the matter with you that you speak not?"

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: What is the matter with you, why do you not speak?”

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: Ma lakum la tantiqoon

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: What aileth you that ye speak not?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: "What is the matter with you that ye speak not (intelligently)?"

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: Then he attacked them striking with his right hand.

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: then he turned and struck them with his right arm.

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 93. Then he turned upon them, striking (them) with (his) right hand.

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: Then he turned upon them, striking them with his right hand,

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: Faragha AAalayhim darban bilyameen

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: Then did he turn upon them, striking (them) with the right hand.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
translation_text: Then, they (the idolaters) came to him rushing.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
translation_text: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 94. Then they (the worshippers of idols) came, towards him, hastening.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
translation_text: His people hurried towards him,

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
translation_text: whereupon people came to him running.1

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
translation_text: Faaqbaloo ilayhi yaziffoon

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
translation_text: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
translation_text: Then came (the worshippers) with hurried steps, and faced (him).

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
translation_text: He said, “Do you worship what is carved by yourselves,

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
translation_text: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
translation_text: but he said, ‘How can you worship things you carve with your own hands,

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 95. He said: "Worship you that which you (yourselves) carve?

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
translation_text: Abraham said to them: “Do you worship what you yourselves have carved with your own hands

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
translation_text: Qala ataAAbudoona ma tanhitoon

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
translation_text: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
translation_text: He said: "Worship ye that which ye have (yourselves) carved?

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: while Allah has created you and what you make?”

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: when it is God who has created you and all your handiwork?’

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 96. "While Allâh has created you and what you make!"

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: while it is Allah Who has created you and all that you make?”

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Wallahu khalaqakum wamataAAmaloon

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: When Allah hath created you and what ye make?

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: "But Allah has created you and your handwork!"

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: They said, “Build for him a structure, and throw him into the blazing fire.”

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: They said, ‘Build a pyre and throw him into the blazing fire.’

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 97. They said: "Build for him a building (it is said that the building was like a furnace) and throw him into the blazing fire!"

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: They spoke among themselves: “Build him a pyre and then throw him into the furnace.”

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Qaloo ibnoo lahu bunyananfaalqoohu fee aljaheem

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: They said, "Build him a furnace, and throw him into the blazing fire!"

text_uthmani: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
translation_text: So, they intended to bring harm to him, but We made them the lowest (by frustrating their plan).

text_uthmani: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
translation_text: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.

text_uthmani: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
translation_text: They wanted to harm him, but We humiliated them.

text_uthmani: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 98. So they plotted a plot against him, but We made them the lowest.

text_uthmani: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
translation_text: They had contrived an evil plan against him, but We abased them all.1

text_uthmani: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
translation_text: Faaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumual-asfaleen

text_uthmani: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
translation_text: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.

text_uthmani: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
translation_text: (This failing), they then sought a stratagem against him, but We made them the ones most humiliated!

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: And he said, “I am going to my Lord. He will show me the way.

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: He said, ‘I will go to my Lord: He is sure to guide me.

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 99. And he said (after his rescue from the fire): "Verily, I am going to my Lord. He will guide me!"

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: Abraham said:1 “I am going to my Lord;2 He will guide me.

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: Waqala innee thahibun ilarabbee sayahdeen

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
translation_text: He said: "I will go to my Lord! He will surely guide me!

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: O my Lord, bless me with a righteous son.”

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: Lord, grant me a righteous son,’

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 100. "My Lord! Grant me (offspring) from the righteous."

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: Lord, grant me a righteous son.”1

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: Rabbi hablee mina assaliheen

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.

text_uthmani: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: "O my Lord! Grant me a righteous (son)!"

text_uthmani: فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
translation_text: So, We gave him the good news of a forbearing boy.

text_uthmani: فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
translation_text: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

text_uthmani: فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 101. So We gave him the glad tidings of a forbearing boy.

text_uthmani: فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
translation_text: so We gave him the good news that he would have a patient son.

text_uthmani: فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
translation_text: (In response to this prayer) We gave him the good news of a prudent boy;1

text_uthmani: فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Fabashsharnahu bighulamin haleem

text_uthmani: فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
translation_text: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.

text_uthmani: فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
translation_text: So We gave him the good news of a boy ready to suffer and forbear.

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ

فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: Thereafter, when he (the boy) reached an age in which he could work with him, he (Ibrāhīm) said, “O my little son, I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you, so consider, what is your opinion?” He said, “O my dear father, do what you have been ordered to do. You will find me, inshā’allah , (if Allah wills) one of those who endure patiently.”

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion,1 he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 102. And, when he (his son) was old enough to walk with him, he said: "O my son! I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you (offering you in sacrifice to Allâh). So look what you think!" He said: "O my father! Do that which you are commanded, Inshâ’ Allâh (if Allâh wills), you shall find me of As-Sâbirûn (the patient)."

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: When the boy was old enough to work with his father, Abraham said, ‘My son, I have seen myself sacrificing you in a dream. What do you think?’ He said, ‘Father, do as you are commanded and, God willing, you will find me steadfast.’

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: and when he was old enough to go about and work with him, (one day) Abraham said to him: “My son, I see in my dream that I am slaughtering you.1 So consider (and tell me) what you think.”2 He said: “Do as you are bidden.3 You will find me, if Allah so wills, among the steadfast.”

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: Falamma balagha maAAahu assaAAyaqala ya bunayya innee ara fee almanamiannee athbahuka fanthur mathatara qala ya abati ifAAal ma tu/marusatajidunee in shaa Allahu mina assabireen

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: Then, when (the son) reached (the age of) (serious) work with him, he said: "O my son! I see in vision that I offer thee in sacrifice: Now see what is thy view!" (The son) said: "O my father! Do as thou art commanded: thou will find me, if Allah so wills one practising Patience and Constancy!"

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
translation_text: So, (it was a great episode) when both of them submitted themselves (to Allah’s will), and he laid him on his forehead (to slaughter him),

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
translation_text: And when they had both submitted1 and he put him down upon his forehead,

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Then, when they had both submitted themselves (to the Will of Allâh), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (or on the side of his forehead for slaughtering);

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
translation_text: When they had both submitted to God, and he had laid his son down on the side of his face,

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
translation_text: When both surrendered (to Allah's command) and Abraham flung the son down on his forehead,1

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
translation_text: Falamma aslama watallahuliljabeen

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
translation_text: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face,

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
translation_text: So when they had both submitted their wills (to Allah), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (for sacrifice),

text_uthmani: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
translation_text: and then We called out to him, “O Ibrāhīm,

text_uthmani: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
translation_text: We called to him, "O Abraham,

text_uthmani: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
translation_text: We called out to him, ‘Abraham,

text_uthmani: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 104. We called out to him: "O Abraham!

text_uthmani: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
translation_text: We cried out:1 “O Abraham,

text_uthmani: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
translation_text: Wanadaynahu an ya ibraheem

text_uthmani: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
translation_text: We called unto him: O Abraham!

text_uthmani: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
translation_text: We called out to him "O Abraham!

text_uthmani: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: you did make the dream come true.” This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.

text_uthmani: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

text_uthmani: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 105. You have fulfilled the dream!" Verily thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See 2:112).

text_uthmani: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: you have fulfilled the dream.’ This is how We reward those who do good-

text_uthmani: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: you have indeed fulfilled your dream.1 Thus do We reward the good-doers.”2

text_uthmani: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Qad saddaqta arru/yainna kathalika najzee almuhsineen

text_uthmani: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.

text_uthmani: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: "Thou hast already fulfilled the vision!" - thus indeed do We reward those who do right.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_text: This was indeed a trial that clearly demonstrated (their obedience).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_text: Indeed, this was the clear trial.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 106. Verily, that indeed was a manifest trial.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_text: it was a test to prove [their true characters]-

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_text: This was indeed a plain trial.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_text: Inna hatha lahuwa albalaoalmubeen

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_text: Lo! that verily was a clear test.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation_text: For this was obviously a trial-

text_uthmani: وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,

text_uthmani: وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,1

text_uthmani: وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: We ransomed his son with a momentous sacrifice,

text_uthmani: وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 107. And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice (i.e. كبش - a ram);

text_uthmani: وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: And We ransomed him with a mighty sacrifice,1

text_uthmani: وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: Wafadaynahu bithibhinAAatheem

text_uthmani: وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim.

text_uthmani: وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: And We ransomed him with a momentous sacrifice:

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: and We left for him (a word of praise) among the later people,

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: and We let him be praised by succeeding generations:

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 108. And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: and We preserved for him a good name among posterity.

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: Watarakna AAalayhi fee al-akhireen

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: (that is,) “Salām be on Ibrāhīm!

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: "Peace upon Abraham."

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: ‘Peace be upon Abraham!’

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 109. "Salâm (peace) be upon Ibrâhîm (Abraham)!"

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: Peace be upon Abraham.

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: Salamun AAala ibraheem

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: Peace be unto Abraham!

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation_text: "Peace and salutation to Abraham!"

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 110. Thus indeed do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: This is how We reward those who do good:

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We reward the good-doers.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Kathalika najzee almuhsineen

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We reward the good.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely, he is among Our believing servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 111. Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely he was one of Our believing servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Innahu min AAibadinaalmu/mineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: For he was one of our believing Servants.

text_uthmani: وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: And We gave him the good news of IsHāq (Isaac), a prophet from among the righteous.

text_uthmani: وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.1

text_uthmani: وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 112. And We gave him the glad tidings of Ishâq (Isaac) - a Prophet from the righteous.

text_uthmani: وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: We gave Abraham the good news of Isaac- a prophet and a righteous man-

text_uthmani: وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: And We gave him the good news of Isaac,1 a Prophet and among the righteous ones.2

text_uthmani: وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: Wabashsharnahu bi-ishaqanabiyyan mina assaliheen

text_uthmani: وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous.

text_uthmani: وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: And We gave him the good news of Isaac - a prophet,- one of the Righteous.

text_uthmani: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
translation_text: And We did bless him, and IsHāq. And among the progeny of both of them, some are good and some are utterly unjust to their own selves.

text_uthmani: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
translation_text: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].

text_uthmani: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 113. We blessed him and Ishâq (Isaac). And of their progeny are (some) that do right, and some that plainly wrong themselves.

text_uthmani: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
translation_text: and blessed him and Isaac too: some of their offspring were good, but some clearly wronged themselves.

text_uthmani: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
translation_text: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among the offspring of the two some did good and some plainly wronged themselves.

text_uthmani: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
translation_text: Wabarakna AAalayhi waAAalaishaqa wamin thurriyyatihima muhsinunwathalimun linafsihi mubeen

text_uthmani: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
translation_text: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.

text_uthmani: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
translation_text: We blessed him and Isaac: but of their progeny are (some) that do right, and (some) that obviously do wrong, to their own souls.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: Certainly We bestowed favors upon Mūsā and Hārūn,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 114. And, indeed We gave Our Grace to Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron).

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: We also bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron:

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: Verily We bestowed Our favours on Moses and Aaron

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: Walaqad mananna AAala moosawaharoon

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: Again (of old) We bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron,

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: and We delivered them and their people from the great agony,

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 115. And We saved them and their people from the great distress,

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: We saved them and their people from great distress;

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: and We delivered both of them and their people from the great calamity.1

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: Wanajjaynahuma waqawmahumamina alkarbi alAAatheem

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: And saved them and their people from the great distress,

text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: And We delivered them and their people from (their) Great Calamity;

text_uthmani: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: and We helped them, so they became victors,

text_uthmani: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.

text_uthmani: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 116. And helped them, so that they became the victors;

text_uthmani: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: We helped them, so they were the ones to succeed;

text_uthmani: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: We succoured them, and they gained the upper hand (against their enemies).

text_uthmani: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: Wanasarnahum fakanoohumu alghalibeen

text_uthmani: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: And helped them so that they became the victors.

text_uthmani: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
translation_text: And We helped them, so they overcame (their troubles);

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
translation_text: and We gave them the clear book,

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
translation_text: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 117. And We gave them the clear Scripture;

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
translation_text: We gave them the Scripture that makes things clear;

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
translation_text: We granted them a Clear Book,

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
translation_text: Waataynahuma alkitabaalmustabeen

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
translation_text: And We gave them the clear Scripture

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
translation_text: And We gave them the Book which helps to make things clear;

text_uthmani: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: and guided them to the straight path.

text_uthmani: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: And We guided them on the straight path.

text_uthmani: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 118. And guided them to the Right Path.

text_uthmani: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: We guided them to the right path;

text_uthmani: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: and showed them the Straight Way,

text_uthmani: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: Wahadaynahuma assirataalmustaqeem

text_uthmani: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: And showed them the right path.

text_uthmani: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: And We guided them to the Straight Way.

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We left for them (a word of praise) among the later people,

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: We let them be praised by succeeding generations:

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 119. And We left for them (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: and preserved for them a good name among posterity.

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: Watarakna AAalayhima fee al-akhireen

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation):

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We left (this blessing) for them among generations (to come) in later times:

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: (that is,) Salām be on Mūsā and Hārūn!

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 120. "Salâm (peace) be upon Mûsa (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)!"

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: ‘Peace be upon Moses and Aaron!’

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: Salamun AAala moosawaharoon

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron!

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
translation_text: "Peace and salutation to Moses and Aaron!"

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 121. Verily, thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: This is how We reward those who do good:

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We reward the good-doers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! thus do We reward the good.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely, both of them were among Our believing servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 122. Verily, they were two of Our believing slaves.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: truly they were among Our faithful servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely both of them were among Our believing servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Innahuma min AAibadinaalmu/mineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: For they were two of our believing Servants.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And surely, Ilyās is one of the messengers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 123. And verily, Iliyâs (Elias) was one of the Messengers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Elijah too was one of the messengers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Surely, Elias too was among the Messengers.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Wa-inna ilyasa lamina almursaleen

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn),

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: So also was Elias among those sent (by Us).

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: (Remember) when he said to his people: “Do you not fear Allah?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 124. When he said to his people: "Will you not fear Allâh?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: He said to his people, ‘Have you no fear of God?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: (Call to mind) when he said to his people: “Will you not fear Allah?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Ith qala liqawmihi alatattaqoon

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)?

text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Behold, he said to his people, "Will ye not fear (Allah)?

text_uthmani: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
translation_text: Do you invoke Ba‘l, and ignore the Best of the creators,

text_uthmani: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
translation_text: Do you call upon Baʿl1 and leave the best of creators -

text_uthmani: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 125. "Will you call upon Ba‘l (a well known idol of his nation whom they used to worship) and forsake the Best of creators,

text_uthmani: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
translation_text: How can you invoke Baal and forsake the Most Gracious Creator,

text_uthmani: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
translation_text: Do you call upon Baal1 and forsake the Best of the Creators?

text_uthmani: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
translation_text: AtadAAoona baAAlan watatharoona ahsanaalkhaliqeen

text_uthmani: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
translation_text: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators,

text_uthmani: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
translation_text: "Will ye call upon Baal and forsake the Best of Creators,-

text_uthmani: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: that is, Allah who is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”

text_uthmani: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"

text_uthmani: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 126. "Allâh, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?"

text_uthmani: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: God, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?’

text_uthmani: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Allah is your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of yore.”

text_uthmani: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Allaha rabbakum warabba aba-ikumual-awwaleen

text_uthmani: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?

text_uthmani: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: "Allah, your Lord and Cherisher and the Lord and Cherisher of your fathers of old?"

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: Then they rejected him. Therefore, they will be arraigned -

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 127. But they denied him [Iliyâs (Elias)], so they will certainly be brought forth (to the punishment),

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: but they rejected him. They will be brought to punishment as a consequence;

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: But they denounced him as a liar, so they will surely be arraigned (for punishment),

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: Fakaththaboohu fa-innahum lamuhdaroon

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: But they rejected him, and they will certainly be called up (for punishment),-

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: except Allah’s chosen servants.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 128. Except the chosen slaves of Allâh.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: not so the true servants of God.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: except Allah's chosen servants.1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Illa AAibada Allahialmukhlaseen

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Except the sincere and devoted Servants of Allah (among them).

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We left for him (a word of praise) among the later people,

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 129. And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: We let him be praised by succeeding generations:

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: We preserved a good name for him among posterity.1

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: Watarakna AAalayhi fee al-akhireen

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation):

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
translation_text: (that is,) “Salām on Ilyāsīn (Ilyās).

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
translation_text: "Peace upon Elias."1

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 130. "Salâm (peace) be upon Ilyâsîn (Elias)!"

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
translation_text: ‘Peace be to Elijah!’

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
translation_text: Peace be upon Elias.1

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
translation_text: Salamun AAala il yaseen

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
translation_text: Peace be unto Elias!

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
translation_text: "Peace and salutation to such as Elias!"

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: This is how We reward those who are good in their deeds.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 131. Verily, thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers, who perform good deeds totally for Allâh’s sake only - See V.2:112).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: This is how We reward those who do good:

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We reward the good-doers.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! thus do We reward the good.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Surely, he was from among Our believing servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 132. Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: He was one of Our believing servants.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Innahu min AAibadinaalmu/mineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Lo! he is one of our believing slaves.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: For he was one of our believing Servants.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And surely, LūT is one of the messengers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Lot was also one of the messengers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 133. And verily, Lût (Lot) was one of the Messengers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And Lot too was one of the Messengers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Wa-inna lootan lamina almursaleen

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn).

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: So also was Lut among those sent (by Us).

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
إِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: (Remember) when We saved him and his family, all of them,

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: We saved him and all his family-

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 134. When We saved him and his family, all,

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: (Call to mind) when We delivered him and all his kinsfolk,

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: Ith najjaynahu waahlahuajmaAAeen

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: When We saved him and his household, every one,

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: Behold, We delivered him and his adherents, all

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: except an old woman among those remaining behind.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 135. Except an old woman (his wife) who was among those who remained behind.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: except for an old woman who stayed behind-

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: except for an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: Illa AAajoozan fee alghabireen

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
translation_text: Except an old woman who was among those who lagged behind:

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: After that, We destroyed others

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Then We destroyed the others.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: and We destroyed the rest.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 136. Then We destroyed the rest (the town of Sodom at the place of the Dead Sea now in Palestine).

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Then We utterly destroyed the rest of them.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Thumma dammarna al-akhareen

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Then We destroyed the others.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Then We destroyed the rest.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: and you do pass by them at daybreak

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: You [people] pass by their ruins morning

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 137. Verily, you pass by them in the morning

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: You pass by their desolate habitations in the morning1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: Wa-innakum latamurroona AAalayhim musbiheen

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: Verily, ye pass by their (sites), by day-

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: and by nightfall. Would you still not understand?

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: And at night. Then will you not use reason?

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: and night: will you not take heed?

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 138. And at night; will you not then reflect?

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: and at night. Do you still not understand?

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: Wabillayli afala taAAqiloon

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: And at night-time; have ye then no sense?

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
translation_text: And by night: will ye not understand?

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And surely, Yūnus (Jonah) is from among the messengers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 139. And, verily, Yûnus (Jonah) was one of the Messengers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Jonah too was one of the messengers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And Jonah too was one of the Messengers.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Wa-inna yoonusa lamina almursaleen

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: So also was Jonah among those sent (by Us).

text_uthmani: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: (Remember) when he ran away towards the boat that was already loaded.

text_uthmani: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

text_uthmani: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: He fled to the overloaded ship.

text_uthmani: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 140. When he ran to the laden ship:

text_uthmani: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: Call to mind when he fled to the laden ship,1

text_uthmani: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: Ith abaqa ila alfulki almashhoon

text_uthmani: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: When he fled unto the laden ship,

text_uthmani: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
translation_text: When he ran away (like a slave from captivity) to the ship (fully) laden,

text_uthmani: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
translation_text: Then he participated in drawing lots (to offload one of the passengers) and was the one who was defeated.

text_uthmani: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
translation_text: And he drew lots1 and was among the losers.

text_uthmani: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 141. Then he (agreed to) cast lots, and he was among the losers.

text_uthmani: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
translation_text: They cast lots, he suffered defeat,

text_uthmani: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
translation_text: cast lots, and was among the losers.

text_uthmani: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
translation_text: Fasahama fakana mina almudhadeen

text_uthmani: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
translation_text: And then drew lots and was of those rejected;

text_uthmani: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
translation_text: He (agreed to) cast lots, and he was condemned:

text_uthmani: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: Then the fish swallowed him while he was reproaching his own self.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.1

text_uthmani: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: and a great fish swallowed him, for he had committed blameworthy acts.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 142. Then a (big) fish swallowed him as he had done an act worthy of blame.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: Then a fish swallowed him, and he was blameworthy.1

text_uthmani: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: Faltaqamahu alhootu wahuwamuleem

text_uthmani: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;

text_uthmani: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: Then the big Fish did swallow him, and he had done acts worthy of blame.

text_uthmani: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
translation_text: Had he not been of those who proclaim Allah’s purity,

text_uthmani: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
translation_text: And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,

text_uthmani: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
translation_text: If he had not been one of those who glorified God,

text_uthmani: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 143. Had he not been of them who glorify Allâh,

text_uthmani: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
translation_text: Had he not been one of those who glorify Allah,1

text_uthmani: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
translation_text: Falawla annahu kana minaalmusabbiheen

text_uthmani: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
translation_text: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)

text_uthmani: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
translation_text: Had it not been that he (repented and) glorified Allah,

text_uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: he would have definitely lived in its belly till the day when the dead will be raised.

text_uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.1
