text_uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day when all are raised up,

text_uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 144. He would have indeed remained inside its belly (the fish) till the Day of Resurrection.

text_uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: he would certainly have remained in its belly till the Day of Resurrection.1

text_uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: Lalabitha fee batnihi ilayawmi yubAAathoon

text_uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised;

text_uthmani: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation_text: He would certainly have remained inside the Fish till the Day of Resurrection.

text_uthmani: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: Then We cast him ashore in the open while he was ill,

text_uthmani: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.

text_uthmani: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: but We cast him out, sick, on to a barren shore,

text_uthmani: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 145. But We cast him forth on the naked shore while he was sick,

text_uthmani: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: But We threw him on a wide bare tract of land while he was ill;1

text_uthmani: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: Fanabathnahu bilAAara-iwahuwa saqeem

text_uthmani: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;

text_uthmani: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
translation_text: But We cast him forth on the naked shore in a state of sickness,

text_uthmani: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
translation_text: and We caused a tree of gourds to grow over him.

text_uthmani: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
translation_text: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.1

text_uthmani: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
translation_text: and made a gourd tree grow above him.

text_uthmani: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 146. And We caused a plant of gourd to grow over him.

text_uthmani: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
translation_text: and caused a gourd tree1 to grow over him,

text_uthmani: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
translation_text: Waanbatna AAalayhi shajaratan minyaqteen

text_uthmani: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
translation_text: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;

text_uthmani: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
translation_text: And We caused to grow, over him, a spreading plant of the gourd kind.

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
translation_text: And We had sent him (as messenger) to one hundred thousand, or more.

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
translation_text: And We sent him1 to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
translation_text: We sent him to a hundred thousand people or more.

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 147. And We sent him to a hundred thousand (people) or even more.

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
translation_text: and We sent him forth to a nation of a hundred thousand or more,1

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
translation_text: Waarsalnahu ila mi-ati alfinaw yazeedoon

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
translation_text: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
translation_text: And We sent him (on a mission) to a hundred thousand (men) or more.

text_uthmani: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: So, they believed, then, We let them enjoy for a time.

text_uthmani: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.

text_uthmani: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: They believed, so We let them live out their lives.

text_uthmani: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 148. And they believed; so We gave them enjoyment for a while.

text_uthmani: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: and they believed. So We let them enjoy life for a while.1

text_uthmani: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: Faamanoo famattaAAnahum ilaheen

text_uthmani: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.

text_uthmani: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: And they believed; so We permitted them to enjoy (their life) for a while.

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
translation_text: So ask them, “Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?”

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
translation_text: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?1

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 149. Now ask them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them?"

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
translation_text: Now [Muhammad], ask the disbelievers: is it true that your Lord has daughters, while they choose sons for themselves?

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
translation_text: So ask their opinion:1 “(Are you convinced) that your Lord should have daughters and you should have sons?2

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
translation_text: Fastaftihim alirabbika albanatuwalahumu albanoon

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
translation_text: Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons?

text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
translation_text: Now ask them their opinion: Is it that thy Lord has (only) daughters, and they have sons?-

text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
translation_text: Or, had We created angels as females while they were witnessing?

text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
translation_text: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"

text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 150. Or did We create the angels female while they were witnesses?

text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
translation_text: Did We create the angels as females while they were watching?

text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
translation_text: Did We create the angels as females the while they witnessed?”

text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
translation_text: Am khalaqna almala-ikata inathanwahum shahidoon

text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
translation_text: Or created We the angels females while they were present?

text_uthmani: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
translation_text: Or that We created the angels female, and they are witnesses (thereto)?

text_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: Beware! They are the ones who, by way of a lie of theirs, (have the audacity to) say,

text_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,

text_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say,

text_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 151. Verily, it is of their falsehood that they (Quraish pagans) say:

text_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: Behold, it is one of their fabrications that they say:

text_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: Ala innahum min ifkihim layaqooloon

text_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:

text_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: Is it not that they say, from their own invention,

text_uthmani: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
translation_text: “Allah has children” - and they are absolute liars.

text_uthmani: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
translation_text: "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.

text_uthmani: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 152. "Allâh has begotten [offspring - the angels being the daughters of Allâh)?" And, verily, they are liars!

text_uthmani: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
translation_text: ‘God has begotten.’ How they lie!

text_uthmani: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
translation_text: “Allah has begotten.” They are liars!

text_uthmani: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
translation_text: Walada Allahu wa-innahum lakathiboon

text_uthmani: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
translation_text: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.

text_uthmani: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
translation_text: "Allah has begotten children"? but they are liars!

text_uthmani: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
translation_text: Is it that Allah has chosen daughters (for Himself) instead of sons?

text_uthmani: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
translation_text: Has He chosen daughters over sons?

text_uthmani: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 153. Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons?

text_uthmani: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
translation_text: Did He truly choose daughters in preference to sons?

text_uthmani: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
translation_text: Did He choose daughters rather than sons?

text_uthmani: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
translation_text: Astafa albanati AAalaalbaneen

text_uthmani: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
translation_text: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.

text_uthmani: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
translation_text: Did He (then) choose daughters rather than sons?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: What is the matter with you? How (arbitrarily) do you judge?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: What is the matter with you? How do you form your judgements?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 154. What is the matter with you? How do you decide?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: What is the matter with you that you make such strange judgements?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: Ma lakum kayfa tahkumoon

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: What aileth you? How judge ye?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Then, is it that you do not think about it?

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Then will you not be reminded?

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Do you not reflect?

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 155. Will you not then remember?

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Will you then not take heed?

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Afala tathakkaroon

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Will ye not then reflect?

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Will ye not then receive admonition?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Or, is it that there is some open authority with you?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Or do you have a clear authority?1

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Do you perhaps have clear authority?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 156. Or is there for you a plain authority?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Do you have any clear authority for such claims?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Am lakum sultanun mubeen

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Or have ye a clear warrant?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Or have ye an authority manifest?

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Then bring your book, if you are truthful.

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Bring your scriptures, if you are telling the truth.

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 157. Then bring your Book if you are truthful!

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Bring your Book, if you are truthful.1

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Fa/too bikitabikum in kuntum sadiqeen

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Then bring ye your Book (of authority) if ye be truthful!

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: And they have made up between Him (Allah) and the Jinns some kinship, while the Jinns already know that they are bound to be seized.-

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: They claim that He has kinship with the jinn, yet the jinn themselves know that they will be brought before Him.

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 158. And they have invented a kinship between Him and the jinn, but the jinn know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him) (i.e. they will be called to account).

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: They have established a kinship between Allah and the angels;1 and the angels know well that these people will be arraigned (as culprits).

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: WajaAAaloo baynahu wabayna aljinnatinasaban walaqad AAalimati aljinnatu innahum lamuhdaroon

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
translation_text: And they have invented a blood-relationship between Him and the Jinns: but the Jinns know (quite well) that they have indeed to appear (before his Judgment-Seat)!

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: -Pure is Allah from what they describe-

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 159. Glorified be Allâh! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: God is far above what they attribute to Him-

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: (They say): “Exalted be Allah above what they attribute to Him,

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: Subhana Allahi AAammayasifoon

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the things they ascribe (to Him)!

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: except Allah’s chosen servants.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: the true servants of God do not do such things-

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 160. Except the slaves of Allâh, whom He chooses (for His Mercy i.e. true believers of Islâmic Monotheism who do not attribute false things unto Allâh).

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: all of them except the chosen servants of Allah.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Illa AAibada Allahialmukhlaseen

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Not (so do) the Servants of Allah, sincere and devoted.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: So, you and those whom you worship,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: and neither you nor what you worship

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 161. So, verily you (pagans) and those whom you worship (idols)

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: So you and your deities

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: Fa-innakum wama taAAbudoon

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: For, verily, neither ye nor those ye worship-

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ
مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ
translation_text: none of you can make anyone turn away from Him (Allah),

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ
translation_text: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ
translation_text: can lure away from God any

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 162. Cannot lead astray [turn away from Him (Allâh) anyone of the believers],

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ
translation_text: shall not be able to tempt anyone away from Allah

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ
translation_text: Ma antum AAalayhi bifatineen

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ
translation_text: Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him.

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ
translation_text: Can lead (any) into temptation concerning Allah,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: except him who is to burn in Jahannam.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 163. Except those who are predestined to burn in Hell!

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: except those who will burn in Hell.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: except him who shall roast in the Blazing Fire.1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Illa man huwa sali aljaheem

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Save him who is to burn in hell.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Except such as are (themselves) going to the blazing Fire!

text_uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: And (the angels say,) “There is no one among us who does not have a known station,

text_uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: [The angels say],1 "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.2

text_uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 164. And there is not one of us (angels) but has his known place (or position);

text_uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: [The angels say], ‘Every single one of us has his appointed place:

text_uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: As for us, there is none but has an appointed station.1

text_uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: Wama minna illa lahumaqamun maAAloom

text_uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: There is not one of us but hath his known position.

text_uthmani: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: (Those ranged in ranks say): "Not one of us but has a place appointed;

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
translation_text: and We, surely We, are those who stand in rows

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
translation_text: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 165. And verily, we (angels), we stand in rows (for the prayers as you Muslims stand in rows for your prayers);

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
translation_text: we are ranged in ranks.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
translation_text: Verily we range ourselves in rows (as humble servants)

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
translation_text: Wa-inna lanahnu assaffoon

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
translation_text: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
translation_text: "And we are verily ranged in ranks (for service);

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: and We, surely We, are those who proclaim Allah’s purity.”

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 166. And verily, we (angels), indeed are those who glorify (Allâh’s Praises i.e. perform prayers).

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: We glorify God.’

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: and we are of those who glorify Allah.”

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: Wa-inna lanahnu almusabbihoon

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: "And we are verily those who declare (Allah's) glory!"

text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: And they (the pagans) used to say,

text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,1

text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 167. And indeed they (Arab pagans) used to say:

text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: [The disbelievers] used to say,

text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: They used to say before:

text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: Wa-in kanoo layaqooloon

text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: And indeed they used to say:

text_uthmani: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: And there were those who said,

text_uthmani: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: “Had there been a scripture with us like that of the former people,

text_uthmani: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,

text_uthmani: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 168. "If we had a reminder as had the men of old (before the coming of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم as a Messenger of Allâh),

text_uthmani: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: ‘If only we had a scripture like previous people,

text_uthmani: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: “If only we had the Reminder which had been granted to the people of yore

text_uthmani: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Law anna AAindana thikranmina al-awwaleen

text_uthmani: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: If we had but a reminder from the men of old

text_uthmani: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: "If only we had had before us a Message from those of old,

text_uthmani: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: we would have certainly been Allah’s chosen servants.”

text_uthmani: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."

text_uthmani: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 169. "We would have indeed been the chosen slaves of Allâh (true believers of Islâmic Monotheism)!"

text_uthmani: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: we would be true servants of God,’

text_uthmani: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: we would surely have been Allah's chosen servants.”1

text_uthmani: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: Lakunna AAibada Allahialmukhlaseen

text_uthmani: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.

text_uthmani: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation_text: "We should certainly have been Servants of Allah, sincere (and devoted)!"

text_uthmani: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Then (once the divine book came to them,) they disbelieved in it. So, very soon they will come to know.

text_uthmani: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: But they disbelieved in it,1 so they are going to know.

text_uthmani: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: But (now that the Qur’ân has come) they disbelieve therein (i.e. in the Qur’ân and in Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم , and all that he brought, - the Divine Revelation), so they will come to know!1

text_uthmani: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: yet now they reject [the Quran]. They will soon realize.

text_uthmani: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: But when it came to them, they rejected it. They shall soon come to know (the end of such an attitude).

text_uthmani: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Fakafaroo bihi fasawfa yaAAlamoon

text_uthmani: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.

text_uthmani: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: But (now that the Qur'an has come), they reject it: But soon will they know!

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And Our Word has already come to pass in favor of Our servants, the messengers

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 171. And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our slaves, the Messengers,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Our word has already been given to Our servants the messengers:

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: We have already given Our promise to Our Messengers

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Walaqad sabaqat kalimatuna liAAibadinaalmursaleen

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Already has Our Word been passed before (this) to our Servants sent (by Us),

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
translation_text: (that) they are the ones who will be supported,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
translation_text: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 172. That they verily would be made triumphant,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
translation_text: it is they who will be helped,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
translation_text: that they shall certainly be succoured,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
translation_text: Innahum lahumu almansooroon

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
translation_text: That they verily would be helped,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
translation_text: That they would certainly be assisted,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: and verily it is Our army (of chosen servants) that prevails.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 173. And that Our hosts! they verily would be the victors.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: and the ones who support Our cause will be the winners.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: and that Our hosts shall triumph.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: Wa-inna jundana lahumu alghaliboon

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
translation_text: And that Our forces,- they surely must conquer.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: So, withdraw your attention from them for some time.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 174. So turn away (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from them for a while,

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: So [Prophet] turn away from the disbelievers for a while.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: So, (O Prophet), leave them alone for a while,

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: Fatawalla AAanhum hatta heen

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: So turn thou away from them for a little while,

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: But, watch them. They shall soon see (the reality).

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: Watch them: they will soon see.

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 175. And watch them and they shall see (the punishment)!

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: and see, and soon they too shall see.1

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: Waabsirhum fasawfa yubsiroon

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And watch, for they will (soon) see.

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And watch them (how they fare), and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: Are they asking for Our punishment to come sooner?

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 176. Do they seek to hasten on Our Torment?

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: Do they really wish to hasten Our punishment?

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: Do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: AfabiAAathabina yastaAAjiloon

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: Would they hasten on Our doom?

text_uthmani: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: Do they wish (indeed) to hurry on our Punishment?

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: So, when it will descend in their courtyard, then, evil will be the morning of those warned.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 177. Then, when it descends in their courtyard (i.e. near to them), evil will be the morning for those who had been warned!

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: When it descends on their courtyards, how ter-rible that morning will be for those who were warned!

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: When that chastisement will descend upon their courtyard, evil shall that Day be for those who had been warned.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: Fa-itha nazala bisahatihimfasaa sabahu almunthareen

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
translation_text: But when it descends into the open space before them, evil will be the morning for those who were warned (and heeded not)!

text_uthmani: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: So, withdraw your attention from them for some time,

text_uthmani: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: And leave them for a time.

text_uthmani: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 178. So turn (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) away from them for a while,

text_uthmani: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: [Prophet], turn away from the disbelievers for a while.

text_uthmani: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: Leave them alone for a while,

text_uthmani: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: Watawalla AAanhum hatta heen

text_uthmani: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: Withdraw from them awhile

text_uthmani: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: So turn thou away from them for a little while,

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: and watch. They shall soon see (the reality).

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And see, for they are going to see.

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: Watch them: they will soon see.

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 179. And watch and they shall see (the torment)!

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: and see; and they too shall soon see.

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: Waabsir fasawfa yubsiroon

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And watch, for they will (soon) see.

text_uthmani: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And watch (how they fare) and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: Pure is your Lord, the Lord of all might and honor, from what they describe

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 180. Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: Your Lord, the Lord of Glory, is far above what they attribute to Him.

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: Exalted be your Lord, the Lord of Glory, above what they attribute to Him,

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: Subhana rabbika rabbi alAAizzatiAAamma yasifoon

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)

text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
translation_text: Glory to thy Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they ascribe (to Him)!

text_uthmani: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: and Salām be on the messengers

text_uthmani: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And peace upon the messengers.

text_uthmani: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 181. And peace be on the Messengers!

text_uthmani: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Peace be upon the messengers

text_uthmani: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: and peace be upon the Messengers,

text_uthmani: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: Wasalamun AAala almursaleen

text_uthmani: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).

text_uthmani: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation_text: And Peace on the messengers!

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: and praised is Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: and praise be to God the Lord of all the Worlds.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 182. And all the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: and all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Universe.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Walhamdu lillahirabbi alAAalameen

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And Praise to Allah, the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
translation_text: Sād . I swear by the Qur’ān, (the book) containing advice, (this is true,)

text_uthmani: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
translation_text: Ṣād.1 By the Qur’ān containing reminder...2

text_uthmani: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Sâd.[These letters (Sâd etc.) are one of the miracles of the Quran and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings]. By the Quran full of reminding.

text_uthmani: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
translation_text: Sad By the Quran with its reminding . . .!

text_uthmani: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
translation_text: Sad,1 and by the Qur'an full of exhortation!2

text_uthmani: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
translation_text: Sad walqur-ani theeaththikr

text_uthmani: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
translation_text: Sad. By the renowned Qur'an,

text_uthmani: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
translation_text: Sad: By the Qur'an, Full of Admonition: (This is the Truth).

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
translation_text: but those who disbelieve are (involved) in false pride and opposition.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
translation_text: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. Nay, those who disbelieve are in false pride and opposition.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
translation_text: Yet the disbelievers are steeped in arrogance and hostility.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
translation_text: Nay, but the unbelievers are steeped in arrogance and stubborn defiance.1

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
translation_text: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee AAizzatinwashiqaq

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
translation_text: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
translation_text: But the Unbelievers (are steeped) in self-glory and Separatism.

text_uthmani: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
translation_text: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, so they cried out (for mercy), while no time was left for having any refuge.

text_uthmani: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
translation_text: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.

text_uthmani: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. How many a generation have We destroyed before them! And they cried out when there was no longer time for escape.

text_uthmani: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
translation_text: How many generations We have destroyed before them! They all cried out, once it was too late, for escape.

text_uthmani: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
translation_text: How many a nation did We destroy before them! (When they approached their doom) they cried out (for deliverance), but the time for deliverance was already past.

text_uthmani: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
translation_text: Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarninfanadaw walata heena manas

text_uthmani: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
translation_text: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!

text_uthmani: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
translation_text: How many generations before them did We destroy? In the end they cried (for mercy)- when there was no longer time for being saved!

text_uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
translation_text: They (the pagans) wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a sheer liar.

text_uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
translation_text: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

text_uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And they (Arab pagans) wonder that a warner (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say: "This (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a sorcerer, a liar.

text_uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
translation_text: The disbelievers think it strange that a prophet of their own people has come to warn them: they say, ‘He is just a lying sorcerer.

text_uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
translation_text: They wondered that a warner had come to them from among themselves,1and the deniers of the Truth said: “This is a sorcerer,2 and a big liar.

text_uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
translation_text: WaAAajiboo an jaahum munthirunminhum waqala alkafiroona hatha sahirunkaththab

text_uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
translation_text: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.

text_uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
translation_text: So they wonder that a Warner has come to them from among themselves! and the Unbelievers say, "This is a sorcerer telling lies!

text_uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
translation_text: Has he (not) turned all the gods into a single God? It is a very strange thing indeed.”

text_uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
translation_text: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."

text_uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. "Has he made the âlihah (gods) (all) into One Ilâh (God - Allâh). Verily, this is a curious thing!"

text_uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
translation_text: How can he claim that all the gods are but one God? What an astonishing thing [to claim]!’

text_uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
translation_text: Has he made the gods one single God? This is truly astounding.”

text_uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
translation_text: AjaAAala al-alihata ilahan wahidaninna hatha lashay-on AAujab

text_uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
translation_text: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing.

text_uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
translation_text: "Has he made the gods (all) into one Allah? Truly this is a wonderful thing!"

text_uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
translation_text: And the leaders among them walked out saying (to their followers), “Walk away (from the Prophet,) and stay firm on (adhering to) your gods. This (call of the Prophet) is surely something designed (for his personal benefit).

text_uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
translation_text: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.1

text_uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. And the leaders among them went about (saying): "Go on, and remain constant to your âlihah (gods)! Verily, this is a thing designed (against you)!

text_uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
translation_text: Their leaders depart, saying, ‘Walk away! Stay faithful to your gods! That is what you must do.

text_uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
translation_text: And the elders among them went forth1 saying: “Go ahead and be steadfast in adhering to your deities.2 What is being said is with a design.”3

text_uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
translation_text: Wantalaqa almalao minhum aniimshoo wasbiroo AAala alihatikuminna hatha lashay-on yurad

text_uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
translation_text: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed.

text_uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
translation_text: And the leader among them go away (impatiently), (saying), "Walk ye away, and remain constant to your gods! For this is truly a thing designed (against you)!

text_uthmani: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
translation_text: We never heard of it in the classical faith (of ours). This is nothing but a false invention.

text_uthmani: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
translation_text: We have not heard of this in the latest religion.1 This is not but a fabrication.

text_uthmani: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. "We have not heard (the like) of this in the religion of these later days (i.e. Christianity). This is nothing but an invention! [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi]

text_uthmani: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
translation_text: We did not hear any such claim in the last religion: it is all an invention.

text_uthmani: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
translation_text: We have not heard this in the religious community close to our time.1 This is nothing but a fabrication.

text_uthmani: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
translation_text: Ma samiAAna bihatha feealmillati al-akhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaq

text_uthmani: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
translation_text: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention.

text_uthmani: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
translation_text: "We never heard (the like) of this among the people of these latter days: this is nothing but a made-up tale!"

text_uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
translation_text: Is it (believable) that the message of advice has been sent down to him (alone) from among all of us?” The fact is that they are in doubt about My message; rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

text_uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
translation_text: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

text_uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. "Has the Reminder been sent down to him (alone) from among us?" Nay, but they are in doubt about My Reminder (this Qur’ân)! Nay, but they have not tasted (My) Torment!

text_uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
translation_text: Was the message sent only to him out of all of us?’ In fact they doubt My warning; in fact they have not tasted My punishment yet.

text_uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
translation_text: Has this Exhortation been sent down among us only to him, to the exclusion of all others?” Nay, they are in doubt regarding My Exhortation,1 and are saying all this because they have not yet had any taste of My chastisement.

text_uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
translation_text: Aonzila AAalayhi aththikru minbaynina bal hum fee shakkin min thikree bal lammayathooqoo AAathab

text_uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
translation_text: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom.

text_uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
translation_text: "What! has the Message been sent to him - (Of all persons) among us?"... but they are in doubt concerning My (Own) Message! Nay, they have not yet tasted My Punishment!

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
translation_text: Do they have the treasures of the mercy of your Lord, the Mighty, the Bountiful?

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
translation_text: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?1

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. Or have they the treasures of the Mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Real Bestower?

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
translation_text: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord’s bounty, the Mighty, the All Giving?

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
translation_text: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord, the Most Mighty, the Great Bestower?

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
translation_text: Am AAindahum khaza-inu rahmatirabbika alAAazeezi alwahhab

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
translation_text: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower?

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
translation_text: Or have they the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord,- the Exalted in Power, the Grantor of Bounties without measure?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
translation_text: Or do they have the ownership of the heavens and the earth and what lies between them? Then let them ascend (to the sky) by ropes.

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
translation_text: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.1

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. Or is it that the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them is theirs? If so, let them ascend up with means (to the heavens)!

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
translation_text: Do they control the heavens and earth and everything between? Let them climb their ropes:

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
translation_text: Or do they possess the dominion of the heavens and the earth and of all that is in between them? If so, let them ascend the heights of the realm of causation and see!1

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
translation_text: Am lahum mulku assamawatiwal-ardi wama baynahuma falyartaqoofee al-asbab

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
translation_text: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes!

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
translation_text: Or have they the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all between? If so, let them mount up with the ropes and means (to reach that end)!

text_uthmani: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
translation_text: What is there (in Makkah) is just a host of the (opposing) groups that has to be defeated.

text_uthmani: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
translation_text: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].

text_uthmani: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. (As they denied Allâh’s Message) they will be a defeated host like the Confederates of the old times (who were defeated).

text_uthmani: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
translation_text: their armed alliance is weak and will be crushed.

text_uthmani: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
translation_text: This is only a small army out of the several armies that will suffer defeat here.1

text_uthmani: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
translation_text: Jundun ma hunalika mahzoomunmina al-ahzab

text_uthmani: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
translation_text: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there.

text_uthmani: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
translation_text: But there - will be put to flight even a host of confederates.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
translation_text: Even before them, the people of NūH and ‘Ād and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), the man of stakes,

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
translation_text: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,1

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. Before them (were many who) belied (Messengers) - the people of Nûh (Noah); and ‘Âd; and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) the man of stakes (with which he used to punish the people),

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
translation_text: The people of Noah, Ad, and firmly-supported Pharaoh rejected their prophets before them.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
translation_text: Before them the people of Noah, Ad, and Pharaoh of the tent-pegs gave the lie (to the Messengers)1

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
translation_text: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohinwaAAadun wafirAAawnu thoo al-awtad

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
translation_text: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted,

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
translation_text: Before them (were many who) rejected messengers,- the people of Noah, and 'Ad, and Pharaoh, the Lord of Stakes,

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
translation_text: and Thamūd and the people of LūT and the people of Aaikah have rejected (the messengers). They were the (strong) groups.

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
translation_text: And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.1

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. And Thamûd, and the people of Lût (Lot), and the Dwellers of the Wood: such were the Confederates.

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
translation_text: Thamud, the people of Lot, and the Forest-Dwellers each formed opposition [against theirs].

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
translation_text: and so did Thamud and the people of Lot and the people of Aykah. These were all leagued together.

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
translation_text: Wathamoodu waqawmu lootin waas-habual-aykati ola-ika al-ahzab

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
translation_text: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions.

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
translation_text: And Thamud, and the people of Lut, and the Companions of the Wood; - such were the Confederates.

text_uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
translation_text: All of them did nothing but declare the messengers as liars; hence, My punishment became due.

text_uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
translation_text: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.

text_uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
translation_text: They all rejected the mes-sengers and they were deservedly struck by My punishment:

text_uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. Not one of them but belied the Messengers; therefore My Torment was justified,

text_uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
translation_text: Each of them gave the lie to Messengers and My decree of chastisement came upon them.

text_uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
translation_text: In kullun illa kaththaba arrusulafahaqqa AAiqab

text_uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
translation_text: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified,

text_uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
translation_text: Not one (of them) but rejected the messengers, but My punishment came justly and inevitably (on them).

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
translation_text: And these people are waiting for nothing but for a single Cry (the sound of the Trumpet to be blown on Doomsday) that will have no pause.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
translation_text: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.1

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
translation_text: all the disbelievers here are waiting for is a single blast that cannot be postponed.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. And these only wait for a single Saihah [shout (i.e. the blowing of the Trumpet by the angel Isrâfil -)] there will be no pause or ending thereto [till everything will perish except Allâh (the only God full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour)].

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
translation_text: They are waiting for nothing except a single Cry, after which there will be no second Cry.1

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
translation_text: Wama yanthuru haola-iilla sayhatan wahidatan ma lahamin fawaq

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
translation_text: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
translation_text: These (today) only wait for a single mighty Blast, which (when it comes) will brook no delay.

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_text: And they say, “O our Lord, give us our share (of the punishment) sooner, before the Day of Reckoning.”

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_text: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. They say: "Our Lord! Hasten to us Qittanâ (i.e. our Record of good and bad deeds so that we may see it) before the Day of Reckoning!"

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_text: They say, ‘Our Lord! Advance us our share of punishment before the Day of Reckoning!’

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_text: They say: “Our Lord, hasten to us our share (of chastisement) before the Day of Reckoning.”1

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_text: Waqaloo rabbana AAajjil lanaqittana qabla yawmi alhisab

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_text: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning.

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
translation_text: They say: "Our Lord! hasten to us our sentence (even) before the Day of Account!"

text_uthmani: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_text: Bear patiently with what they say, and remember Our servant Dawūd, the man of might. Surely he was ever-turning to Allah.

text_uthmani: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_text: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].

text_uthmani: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. Be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of what they say, and remember Our slave Dâwûd (David), endued with power. Verily, he was ever oft-returning in all matters and in repentance (toward Allâh).

text_uthmani: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_text: Bear their words patiently [Prophet]. Remember Our servant David, a man of strength who always turned to Us:

text_uthmani: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_text: (O Prophet), bear with patience what they say,1 and call to mind Our servant David,2 who was endowed with great strength3 and who constantly turned (to Allah).

text_uthmani: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_text: Isbir AAala mayaqooloona wathkur AAabdana dawooda thaal-aydi innahu awwab

text_uthmani: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_text: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).

text_uthmani: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_text: Have patience at what they say, and remember our servant David, the man of strength: for he ever turned (to Allah).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
translation_text: We had subjugated the mountains to join him (in) making tasbīH (i.e. pronouncing Allah’s purity) at evening and sunrise,

text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
translation_text: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. Verily, We made the mountains to glorify Our Praises with him [Dâwûd (David)] in the ‘Ashî (i.e. after the mid-day till sunset) and Ishrâq (i.e. after the sunrise till mid-day).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
translation_text: We made the mountains join him in glorifying Us at sunset and sunrise;

text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
translation_text: With him We had subjected the mountains that they join him in celebrating Allah's glory, evening and morning,

text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
translation_text: Inna sakhkharna aljibalamaAAahu yusabbihna bilAAashiyyi wal-ishraq

text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
translation_text: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise,

text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
translation_text: It was We that made the hills declare, in unison with him, Our Praises, at eventide and at break of day,

text_uthmani: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_text: and the birds as well, mustered together. All were turning to Allah with him.

text_uthmani: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_text: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].

text_uthmani: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. And (so did) the birds assembled: all obedient to him [Dâwûd (David)] [i.e. they came and glorified Allâh’s Praises along with him]. (Tafsir Al-Qurtubi ).

text_uthmani: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_text: and the birds, too, in flocks, all echoed his praise.

text_uthmani: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_text: and the birds, too, in their flocks, and turn again and again to celebrating Allah's glory.1

text_uthmani: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
translation_text: Wattayra mahshooratankullun lahu awwab

text_uthmani: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
