text_uthmani: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_text: By the Scripture that maketh plain

text_uthmani: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_text: By the Book that makes things clear;-

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: We have sent it down in a blessed night, (because) We had to warn (people).

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night.1 Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: truly We sent it down on a blessed night––We have always sent warnings––

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. We sent it (this Qur’ân) down on a blessed night [(i.e. night of Al-Qadr, Sûrah No. 97) in the month of Ramadân - the 9th month of the Islâmic calendar]. Verily, We are ever warning [mankind that Our Torment will reach those who disbelieve in Our Oneness of Lordship and in Our Oneness of worship].

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: We revealed it on a Blessed Night, for We were intent on warning;1

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: Inna anzalnahu fee laylatin mubarakatininna kunna munthireen

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
translation_text: We sent it down during a Blessed Night: for We (ever) wish to warn (against Evil).

text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
translation_text: In that (night), every wise matter is allocated

text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
translation_text: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct1 every precise matter -

text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Therein (that night) is decreed every matter of ordainments.1

text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
translation_text: a night when every matter of wisdom was made distinct

text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
translation_text: (We revealed it on the Night) wherein every matter is wisely determined1

text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
translation_text: Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeem

text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
translation_text: Whereon every wise command is made clear

text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
translation_text: In the (Night) is made distinct every affair of wisdom,

text_uthmani: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
translation_text: through a command from Us. We were to send the Messenger

text_uthmani: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
translation_text: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

text_uthmani: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. As a Command (or this Qur’ân or the Decree of every matter) from Us. Verily, We are ever sending (the Messengers),

text_uthmani: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
translation_text: at Our command––We have always sent messages to man––

text_uthmani: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
translation_text: by Our command.1 Verily, We were set to send a Messenger

text_uthmani: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
translation_text: Amran min AAindina inna kunnamursileen

text_uthmani: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
translation_text: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -

text_uthmani: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
translation_text: By command, from Our Presence. For We (ever) send (revelations),

text_uthmani: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: as a mercy from your Lord, -Surely, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing-

text_uthmani: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,

text_uthmani: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. (As) a Mercy from your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.

text_uthmani: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: as a mercy [Prophet] from your Lord who sees and knows all,

text_uthmani: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: as a Mercy from your Lord.1 Surely He is All-Hearing, All-Seeing,2

text_uthmani: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: Rahmatan min rabbika innahu huwa assameeAAualAAaleem

text_uthmani: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,

text_uthmani: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: As Mercy from thy Lord: for He hears and knows (all things);

text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation_text: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever there is between them, if you are to believe.

text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation_text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if you (but) have a faith with certainty.

text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation_text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between––if only you people were firm believers––

text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation_text: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them: if you would only have sure faith.1

text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation_text: Rabbi assamawati wal-ardiwama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineen

text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation_text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.

text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation_text: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, if ye (but) have an assured faith.

text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: There is no god, but He. He gives life and brings death. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.

text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. Lâ ilaha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). It is He Who gives life and causes death - your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.

text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: there is no god but Him: He gives life and death––He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers––

text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: There is no god but He:1 He gives life and causes death.2 He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore.3

text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: La ilaha illa huwa yuhyeewayumeetu rabbukum warabbu aba-ikumu al-awwaleen

text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.

text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: There is no god but He: It is He Who gives life and gives death,- The Lord and Cherisher to you and your earliest ancestors.

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
translation_text: But they, being in doubt, are playing around.

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
translation_text: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. Nay! They play about in doubt.

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
translation_text: yet in [their state of] doubt they take nothing seriously.

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
translation_text: (But the fact is, they lack certainty) and frolic about in doubt.1

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
translation_text: Bal hum fee shakkin yalAAaboon

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
translation_text: Nay, but they play in doubt.

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
translation_text: Yet they play about in doubt.

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: So, wait for a day when the sky will come up with a visible smoke

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: [Prophet], watch out for the Day when the sky brings forth clouds of smoke for all to see.

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. Then wait you for the Day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke,

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: So watch for the Day when the sky will come down with a pall of smoke,

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Fartaqib yawma ta/tee assamaobidukhanin mubeen

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Then watch thou for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke (or mist) plainly visible,

text_uthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: that will envelop people. This is a painful punishment.

text_uthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

text_uthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: It will envelop the people. They will cry, ‘This is a terrible torment!

text_uthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Covering the people: this is a painful torment.

text_uthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: enveloping people. That will be a grievous scourge.

text_uthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Yaghsha annasa hathaAAathabun aleem

text_uthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.

text_uthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Enveloping the people: this will be a Penalty Grievous.

text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: (Then they will say,) “O our Lord, remove from us the punishment; we will truly believe.”

text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. (They will say): "Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we shall become believers!"

text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: Lord relieve us from this torment! We believe!’

text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: (People will then say): “Our Lord, remove this scourge from us; we shall believe.”

text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: Rabbana ikshif AAanna alAAathabainna mu/minoon

text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.

text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: (They will say:) "Our Lord! remove the Penalty from us, for we do really believe!"

text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: How will they take lesson, while there has already come to them a messenger making things clear?

text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: How will this [sudden] faith benefit them? When a prophet came to warn them plainly,

text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. How can there be for them an admonition (at the time when the torment has reached them), when a Messenger explaining things clearly has already come to them.

text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: But how will they take heed? Such are they that a Messenger1 came to them clearly expounding the Truth,

text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Anna lahumu aththikrawaqad jaahum rasoolun mubeen

text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,

text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: How shall the message be (effectual) for them, seeing that an Messenger explaining things clearly has (already) come to them,-

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
translation_text: Then they turned away from him, and said, “(He is) tutored, crazy.”

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
translation_text: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
translation_text: they turned their backs on him, saying, ‘He is tutored! He is possessed!’

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. Then they had turned away from him (Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) and said: (He is) one taught (by a human being), a madman!"

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
translation_text: yet they turned away from him and said: “This is a well-tutored madman.”1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
translation_text: Thumma tawallaw AAanhu waqaloomuAAallamun majnoon

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
translation_text: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
translation_text: Yet they turn away from him and say: "Tutored (by others), a man possessed!"

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
translation_text: (Well,) We are going to remove the punishment for a while, (but) you will certainly go back (to your original position).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
translation_text: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
translation_text: We shall hold the torment back for a while ––you are sure to return [to Us]––

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. Verily, We shall remove the torment for a while. Verily you will revert (to disbelief).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
translation_text: Yet We will hold the scourge back for a while, (but no sooner than We will do so) you will revert to your old ways.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
translation_text: Inna kashifoo alAAathabiqaleelan innakum AAa-idoon

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
translation_text: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
translation_text: We shall indeed remove the Penalty for a while, (but) truly ye will revert (to your ways).

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
translation_text: (Then,) the day We will seize (you) with the greatest seizure, We will take vengeance.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
translation_text: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
translation_text: and on the Day We seize [them] mightily We shall exact retribution.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. On the Day when We shall seize you with the greatest seizure (punishment). Verily, We will exact retribution.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
translation_text: The Day when We shall seize them with a mighty seizing, that will be the Day on which We shall inflict upon you full retribution.1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
translation_text: Yawma nabtishu albatshataalkubra inna muntaqimoon

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
translation_text: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
translation_text: One day We shall seize you with a mighty onslaught: We will indeed (then) exact Retribution!

text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
translation_text: And We tested the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) prior to them, and a noble messenger came to them

text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
translation_text: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],

text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
translation_text: We tested the people of Pharaoh before them: a noble messenger was sent to them,

text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. And indeed We tried before them Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people, when there came to them a noble Messenger [i.e. Mûsâ (Moses) عليه السلام],

text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
translation_text: Indeed before that We subjected the Pharaonites to the same test. A noble Messenger1 came to them

text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
translation_text: Walaqad fatanna qablahum qawmafirAAawna wajaahum rasoolun kareem

text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
translation_text: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,

text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
translation_text: We did, before them, try the people of Pharaoh: there came to them a messenger most honourable,

text_uthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: saying, “Deliver to me the servants of Allah. I am an honest messenger to you,”

text_uthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh.1 Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"

text_uthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: saying, ‘Hand the servants of God over to me! I am a faithful messenger who has been sent to you.

text_uthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. Saying: "Deliver to me the slaves of Allâh (i.e. the Children of Israel). Verily, I am to you a Messenger worthy of all trust.

text_uthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: (and said):1 “Deliver to me Allah's servants.2 I am a trustworthy Messenger to you,3

text_uthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: An addoo ilayya AAibada Allahiinnee lakum rasoolun ameen

text_uthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.

text_uthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
translation_text: Saying: "Restore to me the Servants of Allah: I am to you an messenger worthy of all trust;

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: and saying, “Do not be haughty against Allah. I bring to you a clear proof.

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Do not consider yourselves to be above God! I come to you with clear authority.

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: "And exalt not yourselves against Allâh. Truly, I have come to you with a manifest authority.

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: and do not exalt yourselves in defiance of Allah. I have come to you with a clear authority1 (as a Messenger).

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Waan la taAAloo AAala Allahiinnee ateekum bisultanin mubeen

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: "And be not arrogant as against Allah: for I come to you with authority manifest.

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
translation_text: And I have sought refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me to death.

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
translation_text: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
translation_text: I seek refuge in my Lord and yours against your insults!

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. "And truly, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me (or call me a sorcerer or kill me).

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
translation_text: I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord lest you should attack me with stones.

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
translation_text: Wa-innee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikuman tarjumoon

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
translation_text: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
translation_text: "For me, I have sought safety with my Lord and your Lord, against your injuring me.

text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
translation_text: And if you do not believe in me, then keep away from me.”

text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
translation_text: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
translation_text: If you do not believe me, just let me be.’

text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. "But if you believe me not, then keep away from me and leave me alone."

text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
translation_text: But if you do not believe what I say, leave me alone1 (and desist from laying hands on me).”

text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
translation_text: Wa-in lam tu/minoo lee faAAtaziloon

text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
translation_text: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.

text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
translation_text: "If ye believe me not, at least keep yourselves away from me."

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: Then he prayed to his Lord saying, “These are a guilty people.”

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: [Moses] cried to his Lord, ‘These people are evildoers!’

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. (But they were aggressive), so he [Mûsâ (Moses)] called upon his Lord (saying): "These are indeed the people who are Mujrimûn (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals)."

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: Then he called upon his Lord: “These are a criminal people.”1

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: FadaAAa rabbahu anna haola-iqawmun mujrimoon

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: (But they were aggressive:) then he cried to his Lord: "These are indeed a people given to sin."

text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: (So, Allah answered his prayer saying,) “Now, take away my servants at night. You will certainly be chased,

text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: [God replied], ‘Escape in the night with My servants, for you are sure to be pursued.

text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. (Allâh said): "Depart you with My slaves by night. Surely, you will be pursued.

text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: (He was told): “Set out with My servants by night1 for you will certainly be pursued.2

text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: Faasri biAAibadee laylan innakummuttabaAAoon

text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,

text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation_text: (The reply came:) "March forth with My Servants by night: for ye are sure to be pursued.

text_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
translation_text: and leave the sea in the state of stillness; they are an army that is sure to be drowned.”

text_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
translation_text: And leave the sea in stillness.1 Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."

text_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
translation_text: Leave the sea behind you parted and their army will be drowned.’

text_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. "And leave the sea as it is (quiet and divided). Verily, they are a host to be drowned."

text_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
translation_text: And leave the sea behind you as calm as ever. Surely they are an army that is doomed to be drowned.”1

text_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
translation_text: Watruki albahra rahwaninnahum jundun mughraqoon

text_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
translation_text: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.

text_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
translation_text: "And leave the sea as a furrow (divided): for they are a host (destined) to be drowned."

text_uthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: How many gardens and fountains have they left behind-

text_uthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

text_uthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Many a garden and spring they left behind,

text_uthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. How many of gardens and springs that they [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people] left behind,

text_uthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: How many gardens did they leave behind, and how many fountains

text_uthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Kam tarakoo min jannatin waAAuyoon

text_uthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,

text_uthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: How many were the gardens and springs they left behind,

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: - and how many fields and noble sites,

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: And crops and noble sites

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: many a cornfield and noble building,

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. And green crops (fields) and goodly places,

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: and sown fields and splendid mansions,

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: WazurooAAin wamaqamin kareem

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: And the cornlands and the goodly sites

text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: And corn-fields and noble buildings,

text_uthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
translation_text: and how many a luxury they used to rejoice in!

text_uthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
translation_text: And comfort wherein they were amused.

text_uthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. And comforts of life wherein they used to take delight!

text_uthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
translation_text: many a thing in which they had delighted:

text_uthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
translation_text: and the life of ease in which they took delight!

text_uthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
translation_text: WanaAAmatin kanoo feeha fakiheen

text_uthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
translation_text: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!

text_uthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
translation_text: And wealth (and conveniences of life), wherein they had taken such delight!

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation_text: This is how it happened. And We made other people inherit all this.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation_text: We gave these to another people to inherit.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. Thus (it was)! And We made other people inherit them (i.e. We made the Children of Israel to inherit the kingdom of Egypt).

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Thus it was; and We made another people inherit all that.1

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Kathalika waawrathnahaqawman akhareen

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation_text: Thus (was their end)! And We made other people inherit (those things)!

text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
translation_text: So, neither the sky and earth wept over them, nor were they given a respite.

text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
translation_text: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And the heavens and the earth wept not for them,1 nor were they given a respite.

text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
translation_text: Neither heavens nor earth shed a tear for them, nor were they given any time.

text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
translation_text: Then neither the sky shed tears over them nor the earth.1 They were granted no respite.

text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
translation_text: Fama bakat AAalayhimu assamaowal-ardu wama kanoo munthareen

text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
translation_text: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
translation_text: And neither heaven nor earth shed a tear over them: nor were they given a respite (again).

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
translation_text: And We delivered the children of Isrā’īl from the humiliating punishment,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
translation_text: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
translation_text: We saved the Children of Israel from their degrading suffering

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. And indeed We saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment:

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
translation_text: Thus did We deliver the Children of Israel from the humiliating chastisement,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
translation_text: Walaqad najjayna banee isra-eelamina alAAathabi almuheen

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
translation_text: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
translation_text: We did deliver aforetime the Children of Israel from humiliating Punishment,

text_uthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: from Fir‘aun. Indeed, he was haughty, one of the transgressors.

text_uthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

text_uthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. From Fir‘aun (Pharaoh); verily he was arrogant and was of the Musrifûn (those who transgress beyond bound in spending and other things and commit great sins).

text_uthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: at the hands of Pharaoh: he was a tyrant who exceeded all bounds.

text_uthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: from Pharaoh1 who was most prominent among the prodigals.2

text_uthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: Min firAAawna innahu kana AAaliyanmina almusrifeen

text_uthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.

text_uthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: Inflicted by Pharaoh, for he was arrogant (even) among inordinate transgressors.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And We chose them, with knowledge, above all the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: We chose them knowingly above others:

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. And We chose them (the Children of Israel) above the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn) [during the time of Mûsâ (Moses)] with knowledge,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: We knowingly exalted them (i.e., the Children of Israel) above other peoples of the world1

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Walaqadi ikhtarnahum AAalaAAilmin AAala alAAalameen

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And We chose them aforetime above the nations, knowingly,

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: And We gave them the clear signs in which there was a manifest blessing.

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. And granted them signs in which there was a plain trial.

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: We gave them revelations in which there was a clear test.

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: and bestowed upon them the Signs wherein lay an evident test for them.1

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Waataynahum mina al-ayatima feehi balaon mubeen

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.

text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: And granted them Signs in which there was a manifest trial

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: These people say,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: These people here assert,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 34. Verily, these (Quraish) people are saying:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: Indeed these people say:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: Inna haola-i layaqooloon

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation_text: As to these (Quraish), they say forsooth:

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
translation_text: “There is nothing more than our first death, and we are not going to be resurrected.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
translation_text: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
translation_text: ‘There is nothing beyond our one death: we will not be resurrected.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 35. "There is nothing but our first death, and we shall not be resurrected.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
translation_text: “This is our first and only death, and we shall never be raised again.1

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
translation_text: In hiya illa mawtatuna al-oolawama nahnu bimunshareen

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
translation_text: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
translation_text: "There is nothing beyond our first death, and we shall not be raised again.

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: So, (O believers,) bring our fathers, if you are true (in your belief in resurrection.)”

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Bring back our forefathers, if what you say is true.’

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. "Then bring back our forefathers, if you speak the truth!"

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Bring back to us our fathers if you are truthful.”1

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Fa/too bi-aba-ina inkuntum sadiqeen

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!

text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: "Then bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"

text_uthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those who were before them? We have destroyed them. They were guilty indeed.

text_uthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ1 and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.

text_uthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who flourished before them? We destroyed them all- they were guilty.

text_uthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those before them? We destroyed them because they were indeed Mujrimûn (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals).

text_uthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Are these better or the people of Tubba1 and those who went before them? We destroyed them for they were a criminal people.2

text_uthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaAAin wallatheenamin qablihim ahlaknahum innahum kanoo mujrimeen

text_uthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.

text_uthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: What! Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who were before them? We destroyed them because they were guilty of sin.

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
translation_text: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them just as players.

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
translation_text: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
translation_text: We were not playing a pointless game when We created the heavens and earth and everything in between;

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, for mere play.

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
translation_text: It was not in idle sport that We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them.

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
translation_text: Wama khalaqna assamawatiwal-arda wama baynahuma laAAibeen

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
translation_text: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
translation_text: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, merely in (idle) sport:

text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: We did not create them but with true purpose, but most of them do not know.

text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: We created them for a true purpose, but most people do not comprehend.

text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. We created them not except with truth (i.e. to examine and test those who are obedient and those who are disobedient and then reward the obedient ones and punish the disobedient ones), but most of them know not.

text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: We did not create them except in Truth. But most of them do not know.1

text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Ma khalaqnahuma illabilhaqqi walakinna aktharahum layaAAlamoon

text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.

text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: We created them not except for just ends: but most of them do not understand.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: The Day of Decision is the appointed time for all of them-

text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: The Day of Decision is the time appointed for all;

text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. Verily, the Day of Judgement (when Allâh will judge between the creatures) is the time appointed for all of them -

text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: The Day of Final Decision is the appointed time for all;1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: Inna yawma alfasli meeqatuhumajmaAAeen

text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation_text: Verily the Day of sorting out is the time appointed for all of them,-

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: the day when no close relation will be of any use to any close relation, nor will they be helped,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: The Day when no relation1 will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: a Day when no friend can take another’s place.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. The Day when a Maulâ (a near relative) cannot avail a Maulâ (a near relative) in aught, and no help can they receive,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: the Day when a friend shall be of no avail to his friend1 nor shall they be helped,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: Yawma la yughnee mawlan AAan mawlanshay-an wala hum yunsaroon

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: The Day when no protector can avail his client in aught, and no help can they receive,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: except the One on whom Allah has mercy. Of course, He is the All-Mighty, the Very-Merciful.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: No one will receive any help except for those to whom God shows mercy: He is the Mighty, the Merciful Lord.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 42. Except him on whom Allâh has Mercy. Verily, He is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: except those to whom Allah shows mercy. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Compassionate.1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Illa man rahima Allahuinnahu huwa alAAazeezu arraheem

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Except such as receive Allah's Mercy: for He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.

إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_text: Indeed the tree of zaqqūm

text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_text: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm

text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation_text: The tree of Zaqqum

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. Verily, the tree of Zaqqûm

translation_text: The tree of al-Zaqqum1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
translation_text: is the food of the sinful,

text_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
translation_text: Is food for the sinful.

text_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
translation_text: will be food for the sinners:

text_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. Will be the food of the sinners.

text_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
translation_text: shall be the food of the sinful.

text_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
translation_text: TaAAamu al-atheem

text_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
translation_text: The food of the sinner!

text_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
translation_text: Will be the food of the Sinful,-

كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
translation_text: like dregs of oil. It will boil in the bellies

text_uthmani: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
translation_text: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

text_uthmani: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
translation_text: [hot] as molten metal, it boils in their bellies

text_uthmani: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 45. Like boiling oil, it will boil in the bellies,

text_uthmani: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
translation_text: Like dregs of oil,1 it will boil in their bellies

text_uthmani: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ

translation_text: like seething water.

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 46. Like the boiling of scalding water.

text_uthmani: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_text: like boiling water.

translation_text: Kaghalyi alhameem

text_uthmani: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_text: As the seething of boiling water.

text_uthmani: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_text: Like the boiling of scalding water.

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: (It will be said to angels,) “Seize him, and drag him into the midst of the Hell.

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: ‘Take him! Thrust him into the depths of Hell!

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 47. (It will be said) "Seize him and drag him into the midst of blazing Fire,

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: “Seize him and drag him to the middle of the Blazing Fire,

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Khuthoohu faAAtiloohu ilasawa-i aljaheem

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: (A voice will cry: "Seize ye him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire!

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_text: Then pour on his head some torment of boiling water.”

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_text: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 48. "Then pour over his head the torment of boiling water.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_text: Pour scalding water over his head as punishment!’

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_text: then pour boiling water over his head as chastisement.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_text: Thumma subboo fawqa ra/sihi min AAathabialhameem

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_text: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
translation_text: "Then pour over his head the Penalty of Boiling Water,

text_uthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
translation_text: “Have a taste! You are the ‘man of might’, the ‘man of honour’.

text_uthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
translation_text: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!1

text_uthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 49. "Taste you (this)! Verily, you were (pretending to be) the mighty, the generous!

text_uthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
translation_text: ‘Taste this, you powerful, respected man!

text_uthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
translation_text: Taste this, you are a person mighty and noble!

text_uthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
translation_text: Thuq innaka anta alAAazeezu alkareem

text_uthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
translation_text: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!

text_uthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
translation_text: "Taste thou (this)! Truly wast thou mighty, full of honour!

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
translation_text: This is the thing about which you used to be skeptic.”

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
translation_text: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 50. "Verily, this is that whereof you used to doubt!"

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
translation_text: This is what you doubted.’

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
translation_text: This is what you used to doubt.”

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
translation_text: Inna hatha ma kuntum bihitamtaroon

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
translation_text: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
translation_text: "Truly this is what ye used to doubt!"

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: Indeed the God-fearing will be in a place free from fear,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 51. Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2), will be in place of Security (Paradise).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: But those mindful of God will be in a safe place

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: Verily the God-fearing shall be in a secure place1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: Inna almuttaqeena fee maqamin ameen

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: As to the Righteous (they will be) in a position of Security,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: in gardens and fountains.

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Within gardens and springs,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 52. Among Gardens and Springs,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: amid Gardens and springs,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: amidst gardens and springs.

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Fee jannatin waAAuyoon

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Amid gardens and watersprings,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Among Gardens and Springs;

text_uthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: They will be dressed in fine silk and thick silk, facing each other.

text_uthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

text_uthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: clothed in silk and fine brocade, facing one another:

text_uthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 53. Dressed in fine silk and (also) in thick silk, facing each other,

text_uthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: Attired in silk and brocade,1 they shall be arrayed face to face.

text_uthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: Yalbasoona min sundusin wa-istabraqin mutaqabileen

text_uthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.

text_uthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation_text: Dressed in fine silk and in rich brocade, they will face each other;

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
translation_text: Thus (it will happen,) and We will marry them with houris having big dark eyes.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
translation_text: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
translation_text: so it will be. We shall wed them to maidens with large, dark eyes.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: So (it will be). And We shall marry them to Hûr1 (fair female) with wide, lovely eyes.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
translation_text: Thus shall it be: and We shall espouse them to fair, wide-eyed maidens.1

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
translation_text: Kathalika wazawwajnahum bihoorinAAeen

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
translation_text: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
translation_text: So; and We shall join them to fair women with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes.

text_uthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: They will call therein for every fruit peacefully.

text_uthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

text_uthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: Secure and contented, they will call for every kind of fruit.

text_uthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 55. They will call therein for every kind of fruit in peace and security;

text_uthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: While resting in security, they shall call for all kinds of fruit.1

text_uthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: YadAAoona feeha bikulli fakihatinamineen

text_uthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: They call therein for every fruit in safety.

text_uthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation_text: There can they call for every kind of fruit in peace and security;

text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: They will not taste death therein beyond the first death (they faced in the world). And He (Allah) will save them from the torment of Hell,

text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: After the one death they will taste death no more. God will guard them from the torment of Hell,

text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 56. They will never taste death therein except the first death (of this world), and He will save them from the torment of the blazing Fire,

text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: They shall not taste death except the death in this world. And Allah will save them from the chastisement of Hell1

text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: La yathooqoona feehaalmawta illa almawtata al-oola wawaqahum AAathabaaljaheem

text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,

text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Nor will they there taste Death, except the first death; and He will preserve them from the Penalty of the Blazing Fire,-

text_uthmani: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great achievement.

text_uthmani: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

text_uthmani: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: a bounty from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

text_uthmani: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 57. As a Bounty from your Lord! That will be the supreme success!

text_uthmani: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: as a favour from your Lord. That is the great triumph.

text_uthmani: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: Fadlan min rabbika thalikahuwa alfawzu alAAatheem

text_uthmani: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.

text_uthmani: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: As a Bounty from thy Lord! that will be the supreme achievement!

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: So, We had made it (the Qur’ān) easy in your tongue, so that they may take lesson.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: We have made this Quran easy to understand- in your own language [Prophet]- so that they may take heed.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 58. Certainly, We have made this (Qur’an) easy in your tongue, in order that they may remember.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: (O Prophet), We have made this Book easy in your tongue so that they may take heed.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Fa-innama yassarnahu bilisanikalaAAallahum yatathakkaroon

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Verily, We have made this (Qur'an) easy, in thy tongue, in order that they may give heed.

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
translation_text: Now wait. They too are waiting.

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
translation_text: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 59. Wait then (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم); verily, they (too) are waiting.

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
translation_text: So wait; the disbelievers too are waiting.

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
translation_text: Wait, then; they too are waiting.1

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
translation_text: Fartaqib innahum murtaqiboon

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
translation_text: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.

text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
translation_text: So wait thou and watch; for they (too) are waiting.

text_uthmani: حمٓ
حمٓ
translation_text: Hā Mīm .

text_uthmani: حمٓ
translation_text: Ḥā, Meem.1

text_uthmani: حمٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. Hâ-Mîm.

text_uthmani: حمٓ
translation_text: Ha Mim

text_uthmani: حمٓ
translation_text: Ha'. Mim.

text_uthmani: حمٓ
translation_text: Ha-meem

text_uthmani: حمٓ
translation_text: Ha. Mim.

text_uthmani: حمٓ
translation_text: Ha-Mim.

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
translation_text: This is revelation of the Book from Allah, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
translation_text: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. The revelation of the Book (this Qur’ân) is from Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
translation_text: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Mighty, the Wise.

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
translation_text: This Book is a revelation from the Most Mighty, the Most Wise.1

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
translation_text: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina AllahialAAazeezi alhakeem
