text_uthmani: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
translation_text: Therein they shall get whatever they desire; and with Us there is even more.1

text_uthmani: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
translation_text: Lahum ma yashaoona feehawaladayna mazeed

text_uthmani: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
translation_text: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.

text_uthmani: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
translation_text: There will be for them therein all that they wish,- and more besides in Our Presence.

text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
translation_text: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger than these in their grip on power, and they searched out the cities. Was there any place (for them) to escape?

text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
translation_text: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?

text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
translation_text: We have destroyed even mightier generations before these disbelievers, who travelled through [many] lands- was there any escape?

text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger in power than they. And (when Our Torment came), they ran for a refuge in the land! Could they find any place of refuge (for them to save themselves from destruction)?

text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
translation_text: How many a nation did We destroy before them that were stronger in prowess than these. They searched about the lands of the world.1 But could they find a refuge?2

text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
translation_text: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin humashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fee albiladi halmin mahees

text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
translation_text: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?

text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
translation_text: But how many generations before them did We destroy (for their sins),- stronger in power than they? Then did they wander through the land: was there any place of escape (for them)?

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: Indeed, there is a lesson in all this for him who has a heart and gives ear (to the truth) attentively.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. Verily, therein is indeed a reminder for him who has a heart or gives ear while he is heedful.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: There truly is a reminder in this for whoever has a heart, whoever listens attentively.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: Verily there is a lesson in this for everyone who has a (sound) heart and who listens with an attentive mind.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: Inna fee thalika lathikraliman kana lahu qalbun aw alqa assamAAawahuwa shaheed

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: Verily in this is a Message for any that has a heart and understanding or who gives ear and earnestly witnesses (the truth).

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
translation_text: We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days, and no weariness even touched Us.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
translation_text: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. And indeed We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six Days and nothing of fatigue touched Us.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
translation_text: We created the heavens, the earth, and everything between, in six Days without tiring.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
translation_text: We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days,1 and weariness did not even touch Us.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
translation_text: Walaqad khalaqna assamawatiwal-arda wama baynahuma fee sittatiayyamin wama massana min lughoob

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
translation_text: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
translation_text: We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in Six Days, nor did any sense of weariness touch Us.

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
translation_text: So, (O Prophet,) endure with patience what they say, and proclaim His purity, along with your Lord’s praise, before sunrise and before sunset.

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
translation_text: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
translation_text: So [Prophet], bear everything they say with patience; celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising and setting of the sun;

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: So bear with patience (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) all that they say, and glorify the Praises of your Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting (i.e. the Fajr, Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers)1.

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
translation_text: Hence bear with patience whatever they say,1 and celebrate your Lord's glory before the rising of the sun and before its setting;

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
translation_text: Fasbir AAala mayaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAiashshamsi waqabla alghuroob

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
translation_text: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
translation_text: Bear, then, with patience, all that they say, and celebrate the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
translation_text: And in hours of night, proclaim His purity, and at the ends of prostration.

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
translation_text: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
translation_text: proclaim His praise in the night and at the end of every prayer;

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. And during a part of the night (also) glorify His praises (i.e. Maghrib and ‘Isha prayers) and (so likewise) after the prayers [As-Sunnah, Nawâfil - optional and additional prayers. And also glorify, praise and magnify Allâh - Subhân Allâh, Alhamdu lillâh, Allâhu-Akbar].

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
translation_text: and in the night, too, celebrate His glory, in the wake of prostration.1

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
translation_text: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waadbaraassujood

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
translation_text: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
translation_text: And during part of the night, (also,) celebrate His praises, and (so likewise) after the postures of adoration.

text_uthmani: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
translation_text: And listen: The Day when the caller will call out from a near place,

text_uthmani: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
translation_text: And listen on the Day when the Caller1 will call out from a place that is near -

text_uthmani: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. And listen on the Day when the caller will call from a near place.

text_uthmani: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
translation_text: listen out for the Day when the caller will call from a nearby place.

text_uthmani: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
translation_text: Hearken on the Day when the caller will call from a place nearby,1

text_uthmani: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
translation_text: WastamiAA yawma yunadi almunadimin makanin qareeb

text_uthmani: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
translation_text: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,

text_uthmani: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
translation_text: And listen for the Day when the Caller will call out from a place quiet near,-

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
translation_text: the Day they will hear the Cry in reality- that will be the Day of Resurrection.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
translation_text: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
translation_text: They will come out [from their graves] on that Day, the Day when they hear the mighty blast in reality.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 42. The Day when they will hear As-Saihah (shout) in truth: that will be the Day of coming out (from the graves, i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
translation_text: the Day when they shall hear the Blast in truth. That will be the Day (for the dead) to come forth.1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
translation_text: Yawma yasmaAAoona assayhatabilhaqqi thalika yawmu alkhurooj

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
translation_text: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
translation_text: The Day when they will hear a (mighty) Blast in (very) truth: that will be the Day of Resurrection.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_text: Surely We alone give life and bring death, and to Us is the final return

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_text: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_text: It is We who give life and death; the final return will be to Us

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. Verily, We it is Who give life and cause death; and to Us is the final return.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_text: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death, and to Us shall all return

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_text: Inna nahnu nuhyeewanumeetu wa-ilayna almaseer

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_text: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
translation_text: Verily it is We Who give Life and Death; and to Us is the Final Goal-

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
translation_text: on the Day when the earth will burst apart exposing them, while they will be hurrying up (to come out). That is an assembly, so easy for Us (to muster).

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
translation_text: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
translation_text: on the Day when the earth will be torn apart, letting them rush out- that gathering will be easy for Us.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. On the Day when the earth shall be cleft, from off them, (they will come out) hastening forth. That will be a gathering, quite easy for Us.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
translation_text: on the Day when the earth will be rent asunder and people, rising from it, will hasten forth. To assemble them all will be easy for Us.1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
translation_text: Yawma tashaqqaqu al-ardu AAanhum siraAAanthalika hashrun AAalayna yaseer

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
translation_text: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
translation_text: The Day when the Earth will be rent asunder, from (men) hurrying out: that will be a gathering together,- quite easy for Us.

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
translation_text: We know well what they say, and you are not (sent) as one who compels them. So exhort, through the Qur’ān, the one who fears My warning.

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
translation_text: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant.1 But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 45. We know best what they say. And you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are not the one to force them (to Belief). But warn by the Qur’an; him who fears My Threat.

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
translation_text: We know best what the disbelievers say. You [Prophet] are not there to force them, so remind, with this Quran, those who fear My warning.

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
translation_text: (O Prophet), We are well aware of what they say;1 and you are not required to force things on them. So exhort with the Qur'an all those who fear My warning.2

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
translation_text: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloonawama anta AAalayhim bijabbarin fathakkir bilqur-animan yakhafu waAAeed

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
translation_text: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
translation_text: We know best what they say; and thou art not one to overawe them by force. So admonish with the Qur'an such as fear My Warning!

text_uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
translation_text: By those (winds) that scatter dust,

text_uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
translation_text: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]

text_uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
translation_text: By those [winds] that scatter far and wide,

text_uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: By (the winds) that scatter dust.

text_uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
translation_text: By the winds which scatter dust,

text_uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
translation_text: Waththariyati tharwa

text_uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
translation_text: By those that winnow with a winnowing

text_uthmani: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
translation_text: By the (Winds) that scatter broadcast;

text_uthmani: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
translation_text: then those that bear load (of clouds),

text_uthmani: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
translation_text: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

text_uthmani: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
translation_text: and those that are heavily laden,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. And (the clouds) that bear heavy weight of water.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
translation_text: which carry clouds laden with water,1

text_uthmani: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
translation_text: Falhamilati wiqra

text_uthmani: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
translation_text: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)

text_uthmani: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
translation_text: And those that lift and bear away heavy weights;

text_uthmani: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: then those that float with ease,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: And the ships sailing with ease

text_uthmani: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And (the ships) that float with ease and gentleness.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: that speed freely,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: which then smoothly speed along,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: Faljariyati yusra

text_uthmani: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)

text_uthmani: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: And those that flow with ease and gentleness;

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: then those who distribute things,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: that distribute [rain] as ordained!

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And those (angels) who distribute (provisions, rain, and other blessings) by (Allâh’s) Command.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: and execute the great task of apportioning (rainfall):1

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: Falmuqassimati amra

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: And those that distribute and apportion by Command;-

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
translation_text: whatever you are being promised is surely true,

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
translation_text: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
translation_text: What you [people] are promised is true:

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. Verily, that which you are promised (i.e. Resurrection in the Hereafter and receiving the reward or punishment of good or bad deeds) is surely true.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
translation_text: surely what you are being warned against1 is true,

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
translation_text: Innama tooAAadoona lasadiq

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
translation_text: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
translation_text: Verily that which ye are promised is true;

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: and Recompense (of deeds) is sure to happen.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: the Judgement will come––

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. And verily, the Recompense is sure to happen.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: and the Judgement shall doubtlessly take place.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: Wa-inna addeena lawaqiAA

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: And verily Judgment and Justice must indeed come to pass.

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
translation_text: By the sky, having paths,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
translation_text: By the heaven containing pathways,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. By the heaven full of paths,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
translation_text: by the sky with its pathways,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
translation_text: By the heaven with its numerous forms:1

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
translation_text: Wassama-i thati alhubuk

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
translation_text: By the heaven full of paths,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
translation_text: By the Sky with (its) numerous Paths,

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
translation_text: you are (involved) in a contradictory discussion.

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
translation_text: Indeed, you are in differing speech.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
translation_text: you differ in what you say––

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. Certainly, you have different ideas (about Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân).

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
translation_text: surely you are at variance (about the Hereafter);1

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
translation_text: Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalif

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
translation_text: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).

text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
translation_text: Truly ye are in a doctrine discordant,

text_uthmani: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
translation_text: Turned away from this (Qur’ān) is the one who is turned away (totally from the truth.)

text_uthmani: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
translation_text: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.

text_uthmani: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
translation_text: those who turn away from it are [truly] deceived.

text_uthmani: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. Turned aside therefrom (i.e. from Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân) is he who is turned aside (by the Decree and Preordainment القضاء والقدر of Allâh).

text_uthmani: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
translation_text: though only those who are averse to the Truth will turn away from (believing in it).1

text_uthmani: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
translation_text: Yu/faku AAanhu man ofik

text_uthmani: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
translation_text: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.

text_uthmani: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
translation_text: Through which are deluded (away from the Truth) such as would be deluded.

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
translation_text: Death upon those who make conjectures (against the true faith),

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
translation_text: Destroyed are the misinformers1

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
translation_text: Perish the liars,

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. Cursed be the liars

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
translation_text: Doomed are the conjecturers1

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
translation_text: Qutila alkharrasoon

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
translation_text: Accursed be the conjecturers

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
translation_text: Woe to the falsehood-mongers,-

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
translation_text: - those who are drowned in ignorance, forgetful!

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
translation_text: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
translation_text: those steeped in error and unaware!

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Who are under a cover of heedlessness (think not about the gravity of the Hereafter),

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
translation_text: who are steeped in ignorance and heedlessness.1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
translation_text: Allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoon

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
translation_text: Who are careless in an abyss!

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
translation_text: Those who (flounder) heedless in a flood of confusion:

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They ask, “When shall be the Day of Recompense?”

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They ask, ‘When is this Judgement Day coming?’

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. They ask: "When will be the Day of Recompense?"

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They ask: “When will the Day of Judgement be?”

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Yas-aloona ayyana yawmu addeen

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They ask, "When will be the Day of Judgment and Justice?"

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
translation_text: (It will be) the Day when they will be heated on the Fire,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
translation_text: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
translation_text: On a Day when they will be punished by the Fire,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (punished i.e. burnt) over the Fire!

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
translation_text: It will be the Day when they shall be scourged by the Fire1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
translation_text: Yawma hum AAala annariyuftanoon

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
translation_text: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
translation_text: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (and tested) over the Fire!

text_uthmani: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: (and it will be said to them,) “Taste (the punishment of) your mischief. This is what you have been asking to be brought sooner.”

text_uthmani: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

text_uthmani: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: ‘Taste the punishment! This is what you wished to hasten.’

text_uthmani: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. "Taste you your trial (punishment i.e. burning)! This is what you used to ask to be hastened!"

text_uthmani: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: (and be told): “Taste your ordeal!1 This is what you were seeking to hasten.”2

text_uthmani: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: Thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allatheekuntum bihi tastaAAjiloon

text_uthmani: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.

text_uthmani: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation_text: "Taste ye your trial! This is what ye used to ask to be hastened!"

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: The God-fearing (on the other hand) will be in gardens and springs,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: The righteous will be in Gardens with [flowing] springs.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs (in the Paradise),

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: As for the God-fearing,1 they shall be in the midst of gardens and fountains,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatinwaAAuyoon

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,

text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: receiving what their Lord will have given to them. Indeed, prior to this, they were good in their deeds.

text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: They will receive their Lord’s gifts because of the good they did before:

text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this Muhsinûn (good-doers. See V.2:112).

text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: joyously receiving what their Lord will have granted them.1 Verily they did good works before (the coming of this Day):

text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Akhitheena ma atahumrabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineen

text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;

text_uthmani: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.

text_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
translation_text: They used to sleep little in the night;

text_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
translation_text: They used to sleep but little of the night,1

text_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
translation_text: sleeping only little at night,

text_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. They used to sleep but little by night [invoking their Lord (Allâh) and praying, with fear and hope].

text_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
translation_text: they used to sleep but little by night,1

text_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
translation_text: Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli mayahjaAAoon

text_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
translation_text: They used to sleep but little of the night,

text_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
translation_text: They were in the habit of sleeping but little by night,

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
translation_text: and in the hours before dawn they used to pray for forgiveness,

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
translation_text: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
translation_text: praying at dawn for God’s forgiveness,

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. And in the hours before dawn, they were (found) asking (Allâh) for forgiveness.

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
translation_text: and would ask for forgiveness at dawn,1

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
translation_text: Wabil-ashari humyastaghfiroon

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
translation_text: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,

text_uthmani: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
translation_text: And in the hour of early dawn, they (were found) praying for Forgiveness;

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: and in their wealth, there was a right for one who asks and for one who is deprived.

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: giving a rightful share of their wealth to the beggar and the deprived.

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And in their properties there was the right of the Sâ’il (the beggar who asks) and the Mahrûm (the poor who does not ask others)1.

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: and in their wealth there was a rightful share for him who would ask and for the destitute.1

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: Wafee amwalihim haqqun lissa-iliwalmahroom

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: And in their wealth and possessions (was remembered) the right of the (needy,) him who asked, and him who (for some reason) was prevented (from asking).

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
translation_text: In the earth, there are signs for those who (seek truth to) believe,

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
translation_text: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
translation_text: On earth there are signs for those with sure faith––

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. And on the earth are signs for those who have Faith with certainty.

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
translation_text: There are many Signs on earth for those of sure faith,1

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
translation_text: Wafee al-ardi ayatunlilmooqineen

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
translation_text: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
translation_text: On the earth are signs for those of assured Faith,

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: and in your own selves! So, do you not perceive?

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: and in yourselves too, do you not see?––

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. And also in your ownselves. Will you not then see?

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: and also in your own selves.1 Do you not see?

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroon

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?

text_uthmani: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: As also in your own selves: Will ye not then see?

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: And in the heavens, there is your sustenance and all that you have been promised.

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: in the sky is your sustenance and all that you are promised.

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. And in the heaven is your provision, and that which you are promised.

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: And in heaven is your provision and also what you are being promised.1

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: Wafee assama-i rizqukum wamatooAAadoon

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;

text_uthmani: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: And in heaven is your Sustenance, as (also) that which ye are promised.

text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: So, by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it (the Day of Recompense) is a reality, as sure as the fact that you (can) speak.

text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: By the Lord of the heavens and earth! All this is as real as your speaking.

text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. Then by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is the truth (i.e. what has been promised to you), just as it is the truth that you can speak.

text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: So, by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, this is certainly true, as true as the fact of your speaking.

text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: Fawarabbi assama-i wal-ardiinnahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoon

text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.

text_uthmani: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
translation_text: Then, by the Lord of heaven and earth, this is the very Truth, as much as the fact that ye can speak intelligently to each other.

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
translation_text: Has there come to you the story of the honoured guests of Ibrāhīm?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
translation_text: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham?1 -

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
translation_text: [Muhammad], have you heard the story of the honoured guests of Abraham?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. Has the story reached you, of the honoured guests [three angels; Jibrîl (Gabriel) along with another two] of Ibrâhîm (Abraham)?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
translation_text: (O Prophet), did1 the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reach you?2

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
translation_text: Hal ataka hadeethu dayfiibraheema almukrameen

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
translation_text: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
translation_text: Has the story reached thee, of the honoured guests of Abraham?

text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation_text: When they (the angels in human form) entered unto him and said, “We greet you with Salām .” He said, “Salām on you.” (And he said to himself,) “(They are) unknown people.”

text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation_text: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."

text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation_text: They went in to see him and said, ‘Peace.’ ‘Peace,’ he said, [adding to himself] ‘These people are strangers.’

text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. When they came in to him and said: "Salâm, (peace be upon you)!" He answered: "Salâm, (peace be upon you)," and said: "You are a people unknown to me."

text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation_text: When they came to him, they said: “Peace”; he said: “Peace also be to you; (you seem to be) a group of strangers.”1

text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation_text: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloosalaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroon

text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation_text: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).

text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation_text: Behold, they entered his presence, and said: "Peace!" He said, "Peace!" (and thought, "These seem) unusual people."

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
translation_text: Then he slipped off to his home and fetched a fattened calf.

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
translation_text: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
translation_text: He turned quickly to his household, brought out a fat calf,

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. Then he turned to his household, and brought out a roasted calf [as the property of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) was mainly cows].

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
translation_text: Then he went back to his family1 and brought a fat roasted calf2

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
translation_text: Faragha ila ahlihi fajaabiAAijlin sameen

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
translation_text: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;

text_uthmani: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
translation_text: Then he turned quickly to his household, brought out a fatted calf,

text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: So he presented it before them (to eat, but being angels, they refrained.) He said, “Would you not eat?”

text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: and placed it before them. ‘Will you not eat?’ he said,

text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. And placed it before them, (saying): "Will you not eat?"

text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: and laid it before them, saying: “Will you not eat?”

text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala alata/kuloon

text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?

text_uthmani: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation_text: And placed it before them.. he said, "Will ye not eat?"

text_uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: So he felt some fear in his heart. They said, “Be not scared.” And they gave him the good news of (the birth of) a knowledgeable boy.

text_uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: And he felt from them apprehension.1 They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

text_uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: beginning to be afraid of them, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid.’ They gave him good news of a son who would be gifted with knowledge.

text_uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Then he conceived fear of them (when they ate not). They said: "Fear not."1 And they gave him glad tidings of a son having knowledge (about Allâh and His religion of True Monotheism).

text_uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Then he became afraid of them.1 They said: “Fear not,” and announced to him the good news of (the birth of) a boy endowed with knowledge.2

text_uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo latakhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleem

text_uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.

text_uthmani: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation_text: (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, "Fear not," and they gave him glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
translation_text: So his wife came forward with a clamor, and slapped her own face and said, “(How can I have a child when I am) a barren old woman?”

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
translation_text: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
translation_text: His wife then entered with a loud cry, struck her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman?’

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Then his wife came forward with a loud voice: she smote her face, and said: "A barren old woman!"1

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
translation_text: So hearing his wife went forth shouting. She struck her face and exclaimed: “A barren old woman am I.”1

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
translation_text: Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkatwajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeem

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
translation_text: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
translation_text: But his wife came forward (laughing) aloud: she smote her forehead and said: "A barren old woman!"

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: They said, “This is how your Lord has said. Surely, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.”

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: but they said, ‘It will be so. This is what your Lord said, and He is the Wise, the All Knowing.’

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: They said: "Even so says your Lord.1 Verily, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: They said: “So has your Lord said (that you shall have a boy). Surely He is Most Wise, All-Knowing.”1

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: Qaloo kathaliki qalarabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleem

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: They said, "Even so has thy Lord spoken: and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge."

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: He (Ibrāhīm) said (to the angels), “Then, what is your mission O messengers?”

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: Abraham said, ‘What is your errand, messengers?’

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Then for what purpose you have come, O Messengers?"

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: Abraham said: “Envoys (of Allah), what is your errand?”1

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: Qala fama khatbukumayyuha almursaloon

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?

text_uthmani: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation_text: (Abraham) said: "And what, O ye Messengers, is your errand (now)?"

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: They said, “We are sent to a guilty people, (i.e. the people of Sodom)

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals1

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: They said, ‘We are sent to a people lost in sin,

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. They said: "We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, criminals, disbelievers in Allâh)

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: They replied: “Behold, we have been sent to a wicked people1

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Qaloo inna orsilna ilaqawmin mujrimeen

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,

text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: They said, "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin;-

text_uthmani: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
translation_text: so that we may send down upon them stones of clay,

text_uthmani: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
translation_text: To send down upon them stones of clay,

text_uthmani: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. To send down upon them stones of baked clay.

text_uthmani: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
translation_text: to bring down rocks of clay,

text_uthmani: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
translation_text: that we may unleash a shower of clay-stones

text_uthmani: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
translation_text: Linursila AAalayhim hijaratanmin teen

text_uthmani: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
translation_text: That we may send upon them stones of clay,

text_uthmani: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
translation_text: "To bring on, on them, (a shower of) stones of clay (brimstone),

text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: marked by your Lord for those who exceed all bounds.’

text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 34. Marked by your Lord for the Musrifûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners - those who trespass Allâh’s set limits in evil-doings by committing great sins).

text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: marked by your Lord upon those who go beyond the limits.”1

text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeen

text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.

text_uthmani: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation_text: "Marked as from thy Lord for those who trespass beyond bounds."

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: So, We let the believers who were there to come out (from danger),

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: We brought out such believers as were there-

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 35. So We brought out from therein the believers.

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Then1 We evacuated there from all the believers

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Faakhrajna man kana feehamina almu/mineen

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.

text_uthmani: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation_text: Then We evacuated those of the Believers who were there,

text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_text: but We did not find in it any Muslims, except one house.

text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_text: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.1

text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_text: We found only one household devoted to God-

text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. But We found not there any household of the Muslims except one [of Lût (Lot) and his two daughters].

text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_text: – and We did not find there any, apart from a single house of Muslims1 –

text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_text: Fama wajadna feehaghayra baytin mina almuslimeen

text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_text: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).

text_uthmani: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation_text: But We found not there any just (Muslim) persons except in one house:

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: And We left in this (event) a sign (of deterrence) for those who fear the painful punishment.

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: and left the town to be a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And We have left there a sign (i.e. the place of the Dead Sea1 in Palestine) for those who fear the painful torment.

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: and We left therein a Sign for those who fear the grievous chastisement.1

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: Watarakna feeha ayatanlillatheena yakhafoona alAAathaba al-aleem

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.

text_uthmani: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation_text: And We left there a Sign for such as fear the Grievous Penalty.

text_uthmani: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: And (We left a similar sign) in (the story of) Mūsā, when We sent him to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) with a clear proof.

text_uthmani: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.1

text_uthmani: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. And in Mûsâ (Moses) (too, there is a sign), when We sent him to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) with a manifest authority.

text_uthmani: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: There is another sign in Moses: We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.

text_uthmani: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: There is also a Sign for you in the story of Moses when We sent him with a clear authority to Pharaoh.1

text_uthmani: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Wafee moosa ith arsanahuila firAAawna bisultanin mubeen

text_uthmani: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,

text_uthmani: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: And in Moses (was another Sign): Behold, We sent him to Pharaoh, with authority manifest.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: So he turned away along with his chiefs and said, “ (Mūsā is) a magician or a madman!”

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: Pharaoh turned away with his supporters, saying, ‘This is a sorcerer, or maybe a madman,’

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. But [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] turned away (from Belief in might) along with his hosts, and said: "A sorcerer, or a madman."

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: But Pharaoh turned away, showing arrogance on account of his power, and said (about Moses): “He is either a sorcerer or a madman.”1

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirunaw majnoon

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: But (Pharaoh) turned back with his Chiefs, and said, "A sorcerer, or one possessed!"

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: So We seized him and his army, and cast them into the sea, as he was of culpable behaviour.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: so We seized him and his forces and threw them into the sea: he was to blame.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. So We took him and his hosts, and dumped them into the sea, for he was blameworthy.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: So We seized him and his hosts, and cast them into the sea. He became an object of much blame.1

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahufanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleem

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation_text: So We took him and his forces, and threw them into the sea; and his was the blame.

text_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
translation_text: And (a similar sign was left) in (the story of) ‘Ād, when We sent upon them the wind that was barren (from any benefit);

text_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
translation_text: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.1

text_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
translation_text: There is another sign in the Ad: We sent the life-destroying wind against them

text_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. And in ‘Âd (there is also a sign) when We sent against them the barren wind;

text_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
translation_text: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Ad, when We let loose upon them an ominous wind

text_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
translation_text: Wafee AAadin ith arsalnaAAalayhimu arreeha alAAaqeem

text_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
translation_text: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.

text_uthmani: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
translation_text: And in the 'Ad (people) (was another Sign): Behold, We sent against them the devastating Wind:

text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
translation_text: it spared nothing it came upon, but rendered it like a stuff smashed by decay.

text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
translation_text: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
translation_text: and it reduced everything it came up against to shreds.

text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 42. It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins.

text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
translation_text: that left nothing that it came upon without reducing it to rubble.1

text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
translation_text: Ma tatharu min shay-in atatAAalayhi illa jaAAalat-hu karrameem

text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
translation_text: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.

text_uthmani: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
translation_text: It left nothing whatever that it came up against, but reduced it to ruin and rottenness.

text_uthmani: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: And (a similar sign was left) in (the story of) Thamūd, when it was said to them, “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”

text_uthmani: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

text_uthmani: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. And in Thamûd (there is also a sign), when they were told: "Enjoy yourselves for a while!"

text_uthmani: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: And also in the Thamud: it was said to them, ‘Make the most of your lives for a while,’

text_uthmani: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: There is also a Sign for you in (the story of) Thamud. They were told: “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”1

text_uthmani: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: Wafee thamooda ith qeela lahumtamattaAAoo hatta heen

text_uthmani: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.

text_uthmani: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation_text: And in the Thamud (was another Sign): Behold, they were told, "Enjoy (your brief day) for a little while!"

text_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: Then they rebelled against the command of your Lord; so the thunderbolt (of divine punishment) seized them, while they were looking on.

text_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

text_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: but they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the blast took them. They looked on helplessly:

text_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord, so the Sâ‘iqah1 overtook them while they were looking.

text_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: But they brazenly disobeyed their Lord’s command, and then a sudden chastisement1 overtook them while they looked on.

text_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: FaAAataw AAan amri rabbihim faakhathat-humuassaAAiqatu wahum yanthuroon

text_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;

text_uthmani: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
