translation_text: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
translation_text: Or that the Unseen in it their hands, and they write it down?

text_uthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
translation_text: Or do they intend to plan to do harm (to the prophet)? Then the disbelievers themselves shall be harmed by the plan.

text_uthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
translation_text: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

text_uthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
translation_text: Do they think they can ensnare you? It is the disbelievers who have been ensnared.

text_uthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 42. Or do they intend a plot (against you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)? But those who disbelieve (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) are themselves plotted against!

text_uthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
translation_text: Or are they contriving a stratagem against you?1 If so, that stratagem will rebound against the unbelievers.2

text_uthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
translation_text: Am yureedoona kaydan fallatheenakafaroo humu almakeedoon

text_uthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
translation_text: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!

text_uthmani: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
translation_text: Or do they intend a plot (against thee)? But those who defy Allah are themselves involved in a Plot!

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_text: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Pure is Allah from what they associate with Him.

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_text: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_text: Do they really have another god besides God? God is far above anything they set alongside Him.

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Or have they an ilâh (a god) other than Allâh? Glorified be Allâh from all that they ascribe as partners (to Him)1

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_text: Do they have any god other than Allah? Exalted be Allah above whatever they associate (with Him in His Divinity).1

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_text: Am lahum ilahun ghayru Allahisubhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoon

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_text: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
translation_text: Or have they a god other than Allah? Exalted is Allah far above the things they associate with Him!

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
translation_text: Even if they see a piece falling down from the sky, they would say, “It is a cumulated cloud.”

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
translation_text: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling,1 they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
translation_text: Even if they saw a piece of heaven falling down on them, they would say, ‘Just a heap of clouds,’

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. And if they were to see a piece of the heaven falling down, they would say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
translation_text: (So obstinate are they that) even if they were to see some fragments of the sky falling down they would still say: “It is only a mass of cloud.”1

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
translation_text: Wa-in yaraw kisfan mina assama-isaqitan yaqooloo sahabun markoom

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
translation_text: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
translation_text: Were they to see a piece of the sky falling (on them), they would (only) say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
translation_text: So, leave them alone until they face their Day, in which they will be turned unconscious,

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
translation_text: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
translation_text: so leave them, Prophet, until they face the Day when they will be thunderstruck,

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 45. So leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting (with horror).

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
translation_text: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs when they shall be struck down,

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
translation_text: Fatharhum hatta yulaqooyawmahumu allathee feehi yusAAaqoon

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
translation_text: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
translation_text: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs, wherein they shall (perforce) swoon (with terror),-

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: the Day their planning will not benefit them in the least, nor will they be helped.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: the Day when their snares will be of no use to them, when they will get no help.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 46. The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all nor will they be helped (i.e. they will receive their torment in Hell).

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: when their stratagem shall be of no avail to them, nor shall they be succoured.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: Yawma la yughnee AAanhum kayduhumshay-an wala hum yunsaroon

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
translation_text: The Day when their plotting will avail them nothing and no help shall be given them.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: And for those who did wrong there is another punishment before that, but most of them do not know.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment1 before that, but most of them do not know.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Another punishment awaits the evildoers, though most of them do not realize it.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment (i.e. the torment in this world and in their graves)1 before this; but most of them know not. (Tafsir At-Tabarî).

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Surely a chastisement awaits the wrong-doers even before the coming of that Day; but most of them do not know.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Wa-inna lillatheena thalamooAAathaban doona thalika walakinna aktharahumla yaAAlamoon

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment besides this: But most of them understand not.

text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: And (O Prophet) be patient about the decision of your Lord, because you are in front of Our Eyes. And proclaim the purity of your Lord along with His praise when you stand (in Prayer),

text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise

text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: you are under Our watchful eye. Celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise.

text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: So wait patiently (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) for the Decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes1; and glorify the Praises of your Lord when you get up from sleep.

text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: Be patient, then, (O Prophet), until the judgement of your Lord comes.1 For surely you are before Our eyes.2 And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise,3

text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: Wasbir lihukmi rabbikafa-innaka bi-aAAyunina wasabbih bihamdirabbika heena taqoom

text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,

text_uthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation_text: Now await in patience the command of thy Lord: for verily thou art in Our eyes: and celebrate the praises of thy Lord the while thou standest forth,

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: And, in parts of night too, proclaim His purity, and at the time of setting of the stars.

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And in the nighttime also glorify His Praises - and at the setting of the stars.1

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: Glorify Him at night and at the fading of the stars.

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: and also celebrate His praise at night,1 and at the retreat of the stars.2

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu wa-idbaraannujoom

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation_text: And for part of the night also praise thou Him,- and at the retreat of the stars!

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
translation_text: By the star when it goes down to set,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
translation_text: By the star when it descends,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
translation_text: By the star when it sets!

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: By the star when it goes down (or vanishes).

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
translation_text: By the star when it sets:1

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
translation_text: Wannajmi itha hawa

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
translation_text: By the Star when it setteth,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
translation_text: By the Star when it goes down,-

text_uthmani: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
translation_text: your fellow (the Holy Prophet) has neither missed the way, nor did he deviate.

text_uthmani: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
translation_text: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,

text_uthmani: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
translation_text: Your companion has not strayed; he is not deluded;

text_uthmani: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. Your companion (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has neither gone astray nor has erred.

text_uthmani: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
translation_text: your companion1 has neither strayed nor is he deluded;2

text_uthmani: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
translation_text: Ma dalla sahibukum wamaghawa

text_uthmani: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
translation_text: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;

text_uthmani: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
translation_text: Your Companion is neither astray nor being misled.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
translation_text: He does not speak out of (his own) desire.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
translation_text: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
translation_text: he does not speak from his own desire.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. Nor does he speak of (his own) desire.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
translation_text: nor does he speak out of his desire.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
translation_text: Wama yantiqu AAani alhawa

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
translation_text: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
translation_text: Nor does he say (aught) of (his own) Desire.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
translation_text: It is but revelation revealed (to him).

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
translation_text: It is not but a revelation revealed,

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
translation_text: The Quran is nothing less than a revelation that is sent to him.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. It is only a Revelation revealed.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
translation_text: This is nothing but a revelation that is conveyed to him,1

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
translation_text: In huwa illa wahyun yooha

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
translation_text: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
translation_text: It is no less than inspiration sent down to him:

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
translation_text: It is taught to him by one (angel) of strong faculties,

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
translation_text: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
translation_text: It was taught to him by [an angel] with mighty powers

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. He has been taught (this Qur’ân) by one mighty in power [Jibrîl (Gabriel)]

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
translation_text: something that a very powerful one has imparted to him,1

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
translation_text: AAallamahu shadeedu alquwa

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
translation_text: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
translation_text: He was taught by one Mighty in Power,

text_uthmani: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
translation_text: the one of vigour. So he stood poised,

text_uthmani: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
translation_text: One of soundness.1 And he rose to [his] true form2

text_uthmani: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
translation_text: and great strength, who stood

text_uthmani: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. One free from any defect in body and mind then he (Jibrîl - Gabriel in his real shape as created by Allah) rose and became stable.

text_uthmani: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
translation_text: one endowed with immense wisdom.1 He came forth and stood poised,

text_uthmani: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
translation_text: Thoo mirratin fastawa

text_uthmani: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
translation_text: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view

text_uthmani: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
translation_text: Endued with Wisdom: for he appeared (in stately form);

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: while he was on the upper horizon.

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.1

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: on the highest horizon

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. While he [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] was in the highest part of the horizon, (Tafsir Ibn Kathir)

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: being on the higher horizon.1

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: Wahuwa bil-ofuqi al-aAAla

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: When he was on the uppermost horizon.

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: While he was in the highest part of the horizon:

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Then he drew near, and came down,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Then he approached and descended

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
translation_text: and then approached––coming down

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. Then he [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] approached and came closer,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Then he drew near and hung above suspended,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Thumma dana fatadalla

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Then he drew nigh and came down

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Then he approached and came closer,

text_uthmani: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
translation_text: so as he was at a distance like that of two bows (joined together), rather even nearer.

text_uthmani: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
translation_text: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

text_uthmani: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
translation_text: until he was two bow-lengths away or even closer––

text_uthmani: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. And was at a distance of two bows’ length or (even) nearer.

text_uthmani: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
translation_text: until he was two bows' length away, or nearer.1

text_uthmani: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
translation_text: Fakana qaba qawsayni aw adna

text_uthmani: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
translation_text: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer,

text_uthmani: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
translation_text: And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer;

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
translation_text: Thus He (Allah) revealed to His slave what He revealed.

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
translation_text: And he revealed to His Servant1 what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
translation_text: and revealed to God’s servant what He revealed.

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. So (Allâh) revealed to His slave [Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم through Jibrîl (Gabriel) عليه السلام] whatever He revealed.

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
translation_text: Then he revealed to Allah's servant whatever he had to reveal.1

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
translation_text: Faawha ila AAabdihi maawha

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
translation_text: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.

text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
translation_text: So did (Allah) convey the inspiration to His Servant- (conveyed) what He (meant) to convey.

text_uthmani: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
translation_text: The heart did not err in what he saw.

text_uthmani: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
translation_text: The heart1 did not lie [about] what it saw.

text_uthmani: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. The (Prophet’s) heart lied not in what he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw.

text_uthmani: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
translation_text: [The Prophet’s] own heart did not distort what he saw.

text_uthmani: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
translation_text: His heart added no untruth to what he saw.1

text_uthmani: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
translation_text: Ma kathaba alfu-adu maraa

text_uthmani: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
translation_text: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.

text_uthmani: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
translation_text: The (Prophet's) (mind and) heart in no way falsified that which he saw.

text_uthmani: أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
translation_text: Do you quarrel with him in what he sees?

text_uthmani: أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
translation_text: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

text_uthmani: أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
translation_text: Are you going to dispute with him what he saw with his own eyes?

text_uthmani: أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Will you then dispute with him (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) about what he saw [during the Mi‘râj: (Ascent of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم to the seven heavens)]1

text_uthmani: أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
translation_text: Are you, then, going to contend with him regarding what he sees with his eyes?

text_uthmani: أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
translation_text: Afatumaroonahu AAala mayara

text_uthmani: أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
translation_text: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth?

text_uthmani: أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
translation_text: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he saw?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: Indeed he saw him another time

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: And he certainly saw him in another descent1

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. And indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw him [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] at a second descent (i.e. another time).

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: A second time he saw him:

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: Indeed he saw him a second time,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: Walaqad raahu nazlatan okhra

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: And verily he saw him yet another time

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: For indeed he saw him at a second descent,

text_uthmani: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: by Sidrat-ul-Muntahā (the lote-tree in the upper realm),

text_uthmani: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -

text_uthmani: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: by the lote tree beyond which none may pass

text_uthmani: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. Near Sidrat-ul-Muntaha (a lote-tree of the utmost boundary over the seventh heaven beyond which none can pass).

text_uthmani: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: by the lote-tree at the farthest boundary,

text_uthmani: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: AAinda sidrati almuntaha

text_uthmani: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,

text_uthmani: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: Near the Lote-tree beyond which none may pass:

عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
translation_text: near which there is Jannat-ul-Ma’wā (the Paradise of Abode),

text_uthmani: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
translation_text: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -

text_uthmani: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
translation_text: near the Garden of Restfulness,

text_uthmani: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. Near it is the Paradise of Abode.

text_uthmani: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
translation_text: near which is the Garden of Abode.1

text_uthmani: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
translation_text: AAindaha jannatu alma/wa

text_uthmani: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
translation_text: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.

text_uthmani: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
translation_text: Near it is the Garden of Abode.

text_uthmani: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: when the lote-tree was covered by that which covered it.

text_uthmani: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].1

text_uthmani: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: when the tree was covered in nameless [splendour].

text_uthmani: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: When that covered the lote-tree which did cover it!1

text_uthmani: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: (This was) when the lote-tree was covered with that which covered it. 1

text_uthmani: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: Ith yaghsha assidratama yaghsha

text_uthmani: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,

text_uthmani: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: Behold, the Lote-tree was shrouded (in mystery unspeakable!)

مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
translation_text: The eye neither went wrong, nor did exceed the limit.

text_uthmani: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
translation_text: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

text_uthmani: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
translation_text: His sight never wavered, nor was it too bold,

text_uthmani: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. The sight (of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) turned not aside (right or left), nor it transgressed beyond the limit (ordained for it).

text_uthmani: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
translation_text: His eye did not waver, nor did it stray,1

text_uthmani: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
translation_text: Ma zagha albasaru wamatagha

text_uthmani: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
translation_text: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.

text_uthmani: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
translation_text: (His) sight never swerved, nor did it go wrong!

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: He has indeed seen a part of the biggest signs of your Lord.

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: and he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord.

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. Indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) did see of the Greatest Signs, of his Lord (Allâh).

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: and he certainly saw some of the greatest Signs of His Lord.1

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: Laqad raa min ayatirabbihi alkubra

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: For truly did he see, of the Signs of his Lord, the Greatest!

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
translation_text: Have you ever considered about the (idols of) Lāt and ‘Uzzā,

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
translation_text: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
translation_text: [Disbelievers], consider al-Lat and al-Uzza,

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Have you then considered Al-Lât, and Al-‘Uzzâ (two idols of the pagan Arabs)1

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
translation_text: Have you ever thought about al-Lat and al-Uzza,1

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
translation_text: Afaraaytumu allata walAAuzza

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
translation_text: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
translation_text: Have ye seen Lat. and 'Uzza,

text_uthmani: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: and about the other, the third (idol), namely, Manāt,?

text_uthmani: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: And Manāt, the third - the other one?1

text_uthmani: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: and the third one, Manat––

text_uthmani: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. And Manât (another idol of the pagan Arabs), the other third?

text_uthmani: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: and about the third deity, al-Manat?

text_uthmani: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: Wamanata aththalithataal-okhra

text_uthmani: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: And Manat, the third, the other?

text_uthmani: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: And another, the third (goddess), Manat?

أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Is it that you have males and He (Allah) has females?

text_uthmani: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

text_uthmani: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: are you to have the male and He the female?

text_uthmani: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. Is it for you the males and for Him the females?

text_uthmani: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Shall you have the male issues, and He the female issues?1

text_uthmani: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Alakumu aththakaru walahual-ontha

text_uthmani: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Are yours the males and His the females?

text_uthmani: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: What! for you the male sex, and for Him, the female?

تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ
translation_text: If so, it is a bizarre division.

text_uthmani: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ
translation_text: That, then, is an unjust division.1

text_uthmani: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. That indeed is a division most unfair!

text_uthmani: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ
translation_text: That would be a most unjust distribution!––

text_uthmani: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ
translation_text: That is indeed an unfair division!

text_uthmani: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ
translation_text: Tilka ithan qismatun deeza

text_uthmani: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ
translation_text: That indeed were an unfair division!

text_uthmani: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ
translation_text: Behold, such would be indeed a division most unfair!

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ

إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation_text: These are nothing but names you and your fathers have invented; Allah has sent down no authority attached to them. They are following nothing but conjecture and what their own souls desire, while guidance from their Lord has surely reached them.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation_text: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation_text: these are nothing but names you have invented yourselves, you and your forefathers. God has sent no authority for them. These people merely follow guesswork and the whims of their souls, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. They are but names which you have named - you and your fathers - for which Allâh has sent down no authority. They follow but a guess and that which they themselves desire, whereas there has surely come to them the Guidance from their Lord!

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation_text: These are nothing but names that you and your forefathers have invented, for which Allah has sent down no authority.1 They are merely following their conjectures and their carnal desires2 although guidance has come to them from their Lord.3

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation_text: In hiya illa asmaonsammaytumooha antum waabaokum maanzala Allahu biha min sultanin inyattabiAAoona illa aththanna wamatahwa al-anfusu walaqad jaahum min rabbihimu alhuda

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation_text: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
translation_text: These are nothing but names which ye have devised,- ye and your fathers,- for which Allah has sent down no authority (whatever). They follow nothing but conjecture and what their own souls desire!- Even though there has already come to them Guidance from their Lord!

text_uthmani: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
translation_text: Is it that man can get whatever he wishes?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
translation_text: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. Or shall man have what he wishes?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
translation_text: Is man to have everything he wishes for,

text_uthmani: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
translation_text: Does man imagine that whatever he wishes for is right for him?1

text_uthmani: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
translation_text: Am lil-insani ma tamanna

text_uthmani: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
translation_text: Or shall man have what he coveteth?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
translation_text: Nay, shall man have (just) anything he hankers after?

text_uthmani: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: (No,) because to Allah alone belongs the (good of) the Hereafter and the former life (of this world).

text_uthmani: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

text_uthmani: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: when the present life and the life to come belong only to God?

text_uthmani: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. But to Allâh belongs the last (Hereafter) and the first (the world).

text_uthmani: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: To Allah belong both the Next World and the present.

text_uthmani: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: Falillahi al-akhiratu wal-oola

text_uthmani: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.

text_uthmani: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: But it is to Allah that the End and the Beginning (of all things) belong.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: How many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession cannot benefit (any one) at all, but after Allah allows (it) for whomsoever He wills and pleases.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: There are many angels in heaven whose intercession will be of no use until God gives permission to those He will, whose words He will accept.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. And there are many angels in the heavens, whose intercession will avail nothing except after Allâh has given leave for whom He wills and is pleased with.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: Numerous are the angels in the heavens; yet their intercession shall be of no avail, except in regard to those whom He grants the leave of intercession and whose plea He is pleased to accept.1

text_uthmani: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: Wakam min malakin fee assamawatila tughnee shafaAAatuhum shay-an illa minbaAAdi an ya/thana Allahu liman yashao wayarda

text_uthmani: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: How many-so-ever be the angels in the heavens, their intercession will avail nothing except after Allah has given leave for whom He pleases and that he is acceptable to Him.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter call the angels by names of females.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Those who deny the life to come give the angels female names.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter give angels the names of females,1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Inna allatheena la yu/minoonabil-akhirati layusammoona almala-ikatatasmiyata al-ontha

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
translation_text: They do not have knowledge about it. They follow nothing but conjecture, and conjecture is of no avail in (the matter of) Truth.

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
translation_text: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
translation_text: They have no knowledge to base this on: they merely follow guesswork. Guesswork is of no value against the Truth.

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. But they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and verily, guess is no substitute for the truth.

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
translation_text: although they have no knowledge regarding that. They only follow their conjecture1 and conjecture can never take the place of the Truth.

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
translation_text: Wama lahum bihi min AAilmin inyattabiAAoona illa aththanna wa-innaaththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqishay-a

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
translation_text: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
translation_text: But they have no knowledge therein. They follow nothing but conjecture; and conjecture avails nothing against Truth.

text_uthmani: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: So, turn away from him who turns away from Our advice, and seeks nothing but (pleasure of) the worldly life.

text_uthmani: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.

text_uthmani: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: So [Prophet] ignore those who turn away from Our revelation, who want only the life of this world.

text_uthmani: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. Therefore withdraw (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from him who turns away from Our Reminder (this Qur’ân) and desires nothing but the life of this world.

text_uthmani: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: So leave alone those who turn away from the remembrance of Us1 and who seek nothing but the life of the world2 –

text_uthmani: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: FaaAArid AAan man tawalla AAanthikrina walam yurid illa alhayataaddunya

text_uthmani: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.

text_uthmani: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: Therefore shun those who turn away from Our Message and desire nothing but the life of this world.

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
translation_text: That is the limit of their access to knowledge. Indeed only your Lord knows well about the one who has gone astray from his way, and He knows well about the one who has adopted the right path.

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
translation_text: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
translation_text: Their knowledge does not go beyond that. Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who follows guidance.

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. That is what they could reach of knowledge. Verily, your Lord it is He Who knows best him who goes astray from His Path, and He knows best him who receives guidance.

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
translation_text: that1 being the utmost of their knowledge.2 Surely your Lord fully knows those who have strayed away from His Path and He also fully knows those who are rightly guided.

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
translation_text: Thalika mablaghuhum mina alAAilmiinna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihiwahuwa aAAlamu bimani ihtada

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
translation_text: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
translation_text: That is as far as knowledge will reach them. Verily thy Lord knoweth best those who stray from His Path, and He knoweth best those who receive guidance.

text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
translation_text: To Allah belongs whatever there is in the heavens and whatever there is in the earth, so that He gives punishment to evildoers for what they did, and gives good reward to those who did good

text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
translation_text: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -

text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
translation_text: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God. He will repay those who do evil according to their deeds, and reward, with what is best, those who do good.

text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. And to Allâh belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, that He may requite those who do evil with that which they have done (i.e. punish them in Hell), and reward those who do good, with what is best (i.e. Paradise).

text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
translation_text: To Allah alone belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth.1 He will2 requite the evil-doers for their deeds and bestow a goodly reward on those who have done good,

text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
translation_text: Walillahi ma fee assamawatiwama fee al-ardi liyajziya allatheena asaoobima AAamiloo wayajziya allatheena ahsanoobilhusna

text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
translation_text: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.

text_uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
translation_text: Yea, to Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and on earth: so that He rewards those who do evil, according to their deeds, and He rewards those who do good, with what is best.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ

ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
translation_text: -those who abstain from the major sins and from shameful acts, except minor involvements. Indeed your Lord is extensive in forgiveness. He knows you more than anyone else (from a time) when He created you from the earth and when you were embryos in the wombs of your mothers. So, do not claim purity (from faults) for your selves. He knows best who is God-fearing.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
translation_text: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
translation_text: As for those who avoid grave sins and foul acts, though they may commit small sins, your Lord is ample in forgiveness. He has been aware of you from the time He produced you from the earth and from your hiding places in your mothers’ wombs, so do not assert your own goodness:He knows best who is mindful of Him.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. Those who avoid great sins (See the Qur’ân, Verses: 6:152,153) and Al-Fawâhish (illegal sexual intercourse) except the small faults, - verily, your Lord is of Vast Forgiveness. He knows you well when He created you from the earth (Adam), and when you were fetuses in your mothers’ wombs. So ascribe not purity to yourselves. He knows best him who fears Allâh and keeps his duty to Him [i.e. those who are Al-Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2)].

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
translation_text: on those who avoid grave sins1 and shameful deeds,2 even if they may sometimes stumble into lesser offences.3 Surely your Lord is abounding in His Forgiveness.4 Very well is He aware of you since He produced you from the earth, and while you were still in your mothers' wombs and not yet born. So do not boastfully claim yourselves to be purified. He fully knows those that are truly Godfearing.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
translation_text: Allatheena yajtaniboona kaba-iraal-ithmi walfawahisha illa allamama innarabbaka wasiAAu almaghfirati huwa aAAlamu bikum ithanshaakum mina al-ardi wa-ith antum ajinnatun feebutooni ommahatikum fala tuzakkoo anfusakumhuwa aAAlamu bimani ittaqa

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
translation_text: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
translation_text: Those who avoid great sins and shameful deeds, only (falling into) small faults,- verily thy Lord is ample in forgiveness. He knows you well when He brings you out of the earth, And when ye are hidden in your mothers' wombs. Therefore justify not yourselves: He knows best who it is that guards against evil.

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Did you see the one who turned away,

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Have you seen the one who turned away

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: [Prophet], consider that man who turned away:

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. Did you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) observe him who turned away (from Islâm).

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: (O Prophet), did you see him who turned away (from the Path of Allah),

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Afaraayta allathee tawalla

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,

text_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Seest thou one who turns back,

text_uthmani: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
translation_text: and gave a little, and stopped?

text_uthmani: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
translation_text: And gave a little and [then] refrained?

text_uthmani: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
translation_text: he only gave a little and then he stopped.

text_uthmani: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 34. And gave a little, then stopped (giving)?

text_uthmani: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
translation_text: who gave a little, and then stopped?1

text_uthmani: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
translation_text: WaaAAta qaleelan waakda

text_uthmani: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
translation_text: And gave a little, then was grudging?

text_uthmani: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
translation_text: Gives a little, then hardens (his heart)?

text_uthmani: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
translation_text: Does he have knowledge of the Unseen whereby he sees (what he believes)?

text_uthmani: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
translation_text: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?1

text_uthmani: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
translation_text: Does he have knowledge of the Unseen? Can he see [the Hereafter]?

text_uthmani: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 35. Is with him the knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees?

text_uthmani: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
translation_text: Does he have any knowledge of the world beyond the ken of sense-perception, and therefore, clearly sees (the Truth)?1

text_uthmani: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
translation_text: aAAindahu AAilmu alghaybi fahuwa yara

text_uthmani: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
translation_text: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth?

text_uthmani: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
translation_text: What! Has he knowledge of the Unseen so that he can see?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
translation_text: Has he not been told of what was (revealed) in the scriptures of Mūsā

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
translation_text: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
translation_text: Has he not been told what was written in the Scriptures of Moses

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. Or is he not informed with what is in the Pages (Scripture) of Mûsâ (Moses),

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
translation_text: Has he not been informed of what is in the Scrolls of Moses,

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
translation_text: Am lam yunabba/ bima fee suhufimoosa

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
translation_text: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
translation_text: Nay, is he not acquainted with what is in the Books of Moses-

text_uthmani: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
translation_text: and of Ibrāhīm who fulfilled (his duties)?

text_uthmani: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
translation_text: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -

text_uthmani: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
translation_text: and of Abraham, who fulfilled his duty:

text_uthmani: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. And of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) who fulfilled (or conveyed) all that (Allâh ordered him to do or convey):

text_uthmani: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
translation_text: and of Abraham, who lived up to the trust?1

text_uthmani: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
translation_text: Wa-ibraheema allathee waffa

text_uthmani: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
translation_text: And Abraham who paid his debt:

text_uthmani: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
translation_text: And of Abraham who fulfilled his engagements?-

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: (It was) that no bearer of burden shall bear the burden of the other,

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: that no soul shall bear the burden of another;

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. That no burdened person (with sins) shall bear the burden (sins) of another.

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: “That no bearer of a burden shall bear the burden of another,1

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: Alla taziru waziratun wizraokhra

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: That no laden one shall bear another's load,

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: Namely, that no bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another;

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: and that a man shall not deserve but (the reward of) his own effort,

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: that man will only have what he has worked towards;

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And that man can have nothing but what he does (good or bad).1

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: and that man shall have nothing but what he has striven for,1

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: Waan laysa lil-insani illa masaAAa

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,

text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: That man can have nothing but what he strives for;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
translation_text: and that his effort will soon be seen,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
translation_text: And that his effort is going to be seen -

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
translation_text: that his labour will be seen

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. And that his deeds will be seen.

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
translation_text: and that (the result of) his striving shall soon be seen,1

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
translation_text: Waanna saAAyahu sawfa yura

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
translation_text: And that his effort will be seen.

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
translation_text: That (the fruit of) his striving will soon come in sight:

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
translation_text: then he will be recompensed for it in full,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
translation_text: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
translation_text: and that in the end he will be repaid in full for it;

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Then he will be recompensed with a full and the best recompense.1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
translation_text: and that he shall then be fully recompensed,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
translation_text: Thumma yujzahu aljazaa al-awfa

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
translation_text: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
translation_text: Then will he be rewarded with a reward complete;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: and that to your Lord is the end (of every one),

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: And that to your Lord is the finality

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: that the final goal is your Lord;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 42. And that to your Lord (Allâh) is the End (Return of everything).

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: and that the final end is with your Lord,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: Waanna ila rabbika almuntaha

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
translation_text: That to thy Lord is the final Goal;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
translation_text: and that He is the One who makes (one) laugh and makes (him) weep,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
translation_text: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
translation_text: that it is He who makes people laugh and weep;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. And that it is He (Allâh) Who makes (whom He wills) laugh, and makes (whom He wills) weep.

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
translation_text: and that He it is Who causes people to laugh and to cry,1

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
translation_text: Waannahu huwa adhaka waabka

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
translation_text: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
translation_text: That it is He Who granteth Laughter and Tears;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
translation_text: and that He is the One who gives death and gives life,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
translation_text: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
translation_text: that it is He who gives death and life;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. And that it is He (Allâh) Who causes death and gives life.

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
translation_text: and that He it is Who causes death and grants life,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
translation_text: Waannahu huwa amata waahya

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
translation_text: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
translation_text: That it is He Who granteth Death and Life;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: and that He creates the pairs, male and female,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And that He (Allâh) creates the pairs, male and female,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: that He Himself created the two sexes, male and female,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: and He it is Who created the two kinds, the male and the female,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: Waannahu khalaqa azzawjayni aththakarawal-ontha

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
translation_text: That He did create in pairs,- male and female,

text_uthmani: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: from a sperm-drop when it is poured (into a womb),

text_uthmani: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

text_uthmani: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: from an ejected drop of sperm;

text_uthmani: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 46. From Nutfah (drops of semen - male and female discharges) when it is emitted.

text_uthmani: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: from a drop of sperm when it was emitted,1

text_uthmani: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: Min nutfatin itha tumna

text_uthmani: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;

text_uthmani: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: From a seed when lodged (in its place);

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: and that the second creation is undertaken by Him,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
