translation_text: that He will undertake the second Creation;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 47. And that upon Him (Allâh) is another bringing forth (Resurrection).

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: and that it is for Him to grant the second life,1

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: Waanna AAalayhi annash-ata al-okhra

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
translation_text: That He hath promised a Second Creation (Raising of the Dead);

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
translation_text: and that He is the One who gives wealth and preserves (it),

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
translation_text: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
translation_text: that it is He who gives wealth and possessions;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 48. And that it is He (Allâh) Who gives much or a little (of wealth and contentment)

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
translation_text: that He it is Who bestowed wealth and riches,1

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
translation_text: Waannahu huwa aghna waaqna

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
translation_text: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
translation_text: That it is He Who giveth wealth and satisfaction;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
translation_text: and that He is the One who is the Lord of Sirius (the star worshipped by pagans),

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
translation_text: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius1

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 49. And that He (Allâh) is the Lord of Sirius (the star which the pagan Arabs used to worship).

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
translation_text: that He is the Lord of Sirius;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
translation_text: that He is the Lord of Sirius,1

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
translation_text: Waannahu huwa rabbu ashshiAAra

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
translation_text: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
translation_text: That He is the Lord of Sirius (the Mighty Star);

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: and that He has destroyed the earlier ‘Ād,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: that it was He who destroyed, in their entirety, ancient 'Ad

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 50. And that it is He (Allâh) Who destroyed the former ‘Âd (people),

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: that He it is Who destroyed the ancient 'Ad,1

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: Waannahu ahlaka AAadan al-oola

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad,

text_uthmani: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: And that it is He Who destroyed the (powerful) ancient 'Ad (people),

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
translation_text: and Thamūd, so spared none,

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
translation_text: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 51. And Thamûd (people): He spared none of them.

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
translation_text: and Thamud,

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
translation_text: and Thamud, leaving no trace of them,

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
translation_text: Wathamooda fama abqa

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
translation_text: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;

text_uthmani: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
translation_text: And the Thamud nor gave them a lease of perpetual life.

text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
translation_text: and (destroyed) the people of NūH even earlier. Surely they were more unjust and more rebellious.

text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
translation_text: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 52. And the people of Nûh (Noah) aforetime. Verily, they were more unjust and more rebellious and transgressing [in disobeying Allâh and His Messenger Nûh (Noah) عليه السلام].

text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
translation_text: and before them the people of Noah who were even more unjust and insolent;

text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
translation_text: and that He it is Who destroyed the people of Noah before for they were much given to iniquity and transgression.

text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
translation_text: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoohum athlama waatgha

text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
translation_text: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;

text_uthmani: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
translation_text: And before them, the people of Noah, for that they were (all) most unjust and most insolent transgressors,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
translation_text: And He destroyed the overturned towns (of the people of LūT) also,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
translation_text: And the overturned towns1 He hurled down

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
translation_text: that it was He who brought down the ruined cities

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 53. And He destroyed the overthrown cities [of Sodom to which Prophet Lût (Lot) was sent].

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
translation_text: And He brought perdition upon the subverted cities

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
translation_text: Walmu/tafikata ahwa

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
translation_text: And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
translation_text: And He destroyed the Overthrown Cities (of Sodom and Gomorrah).

text_uthmani: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
translation_text: so enveloped they were by that which enveloped.

text_uthmani: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
translation_text: And covered them by that which He covered.1

text_uthmani: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
translation_text: and enveloped them in the punishment He ordained for them?

text_uthmani: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 54. So there covered them that which did cover (i.e. torment with stones).

text_uthmani: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
translation_text: and caused them to be covered with that which He covered them with.1

text_uthmani: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
translation_text: Faghashshaha ma ghashsha

text_uthmani: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
translation_text: So that there covered them that which did cover.

text_uthmani: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
translation_text: So that (ruins unknown) have covered them up.

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
translation_text: Then concerning which of your Lord’s bounties would you remain in doubt?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
translation_text: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
translation_text: Which then of your Lord’s blessings do you deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 55. Then which of the Graces of your Lord (O man!) will you doubt?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
translation_text: So,1 which of your Lord's bounties will you doubt?”2

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
translation_text: Fabi-ayyi ala-i rabbika tatamara

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
translation_text: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
translation_text: Then which of the gifts of thy Lord, (O man,) wilt thou dispute about?

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: This (Prophet) is a warner from the (genus of the) previous warners.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: This is a warning just like the warnings sent in former times.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: This (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a warner (Messenger) of the (series of) warners (Messengers) of old.1

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: This is a warning among the warnings of yore.1

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: Hatha natheerun mina annuthurial-oola

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: This is a warner of the warners of old.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: This is a Warner, of the (series of) Warners of old!

text_uthmani: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ
أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ
translation_text: The Imminent (Hour of Judgment) has approached.

text_uthmani: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ
translation_text: The Approaching Day has approached.

text_uthmani: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 57. The Day of Resurrection draws near.

text_uthmani: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ
translation_text: The imminent Hour draws near

text_uthmani: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ
translation_text: The imminent Hour has drawn near,1

text_uthmani: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ
translation_text: Azifati al-azifat

text_uthmani: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ
translation_text: The threatened Hour is nigh.

text_uthmani: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ
translation_text: The (Judgment) ever approaching draws nigh:

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
translation_text: There is no one, beside Allah, to remove it.

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
translation_text: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 58. None besides Allâh can avert it (or advance it or delay it).

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
translation_text: and only God can disclose it.

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
translation_text: and none but Allah can avert it.1

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
translation_text: Laysa laha min dooni Allahi kashifat

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
translation_text: None beside Allah can disclose it.

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
translation_text: No (soul) but Allah can lay it bare.

text_uthmani: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
translation_text: Do you then wonder at this discourse,

text_uthmani: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
translation_text: Then at this statement do you wonder?

text_uthmani: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
translation_text: Do you [people] marvel at this?

text_uthmani: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 59. Do you then wonder at this recitation (the Qur’ân)?

text_uthmani: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
translation_text: Will you, then, wonder at this?1

text_uthmani: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
translation_text: Afamin hatha alhadeethitaAAjaboon

text_uthmani: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
translation_text: Marvel ye then at this statement,

text_uthmani: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
translation_text: Do ye then wonder at this recital?

text_uthmani: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
translation_text: and laugh (at it), and not weep,

text_uthmani: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
translation_text: And you laugh and do not weep

text_uthmani: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
translation_text: Why do you laugh instead of weeping?

text_uthmani: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 60. And you laugh at it and weep not,

text_uthmani: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
translation_text: Will you laugh at it rather than weep?1

text_uthmani: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
translation_text: Watadhakoona wala tabkoon

text_uthmani: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
translation_text: And laugh and not weep,

text_uthmani: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
translation_text: And will ye laugh and not weep,-

text_uthmani: وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ
وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ
translation_text: while you are engaged in vain play?

text_uthmani: وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ
translation_text: While you are proudly sporting?1

text_uthmani: وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ
translation_text: Why do you pay no heed?

text_uthmani: وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 61. Wasting your (precious) lifetime in pastime and amusements (singing, etc.).

text_uthmani: وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ
translation_text: Will you occupy yourselves simply in merriment?1

text_uthmani: وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ
translation_text: Waantum samidoon

text_uthmani: وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ
translation_text: While ye amuse yourselves?

text_uthmani: وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ
translation_text: Wasting your time in vanities?

text_uthmani: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
translation_text: Now, fall down in prostration and worship (Allah).

text_uthmani: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
translation_text: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].

text_uthmani: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 62. So fall you down in prostration to Allâh and worship Him (Alone).

text_uthmani: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
translation_text: Bow down before God and worship.

text_uthmani: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
translation_text: Prostrate yourselves before Allah, and serve Him.1

text_uthmani: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
translation_text: Fasjudoo lillahi waAAbudoo

text_uthmani: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
translation_text: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.

text_uthmani: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
translation_text: But fall ye down in prostration to Allah, and adore (Him)!

text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: The Hour (of doom) has drawn near, and the moon has split asunder.

text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].1

text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: The Hour draws near; the moon is split in two.

text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has been cleft asunder (the people of Makkah requested Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to show them a miracle, so he showed them the splitting of the moon).1

text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: The Hour of Resurrection drew near and the moon split asunder.1

text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: Iqtarabati assaAAatu wanshaqqaalqamar

text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.

text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: The Hour (of Judgment) is nigh, and the moon is cleft asunder.

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
translation_text: When these people see a sign, they turn away and say, “(This is) a transient magic.”

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
translation_text: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."1

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. And if they see a sign, they turn away, and say: "This is continuous magic."

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
translation_text: Whenever the disbelievers see a sign, they turn away and say, ‘Same old sorcery!’

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
translation_text: (Regardless of any Signs these people see), they turn away and say: “This is an ongoing sorcery.”1

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
translation_text: Wa-in yaraw ayatan yuAAridoowayaqooloo sihrun mustamirr

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
translation_text: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
translation_text: But if they see a Sign, they turn away, and say, "This is (but) transient magic."

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: They have rejected (the Truth) and followed their desires, while every matter has to settle (at some time).

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. They belied (the Verses of Allâh - this Qur’ân), and followed their own lusts. And every matter will be settled (according to the kind of deeds: good deeds will take their doers to Paradise, and similarly evil deeds will take their doers to Hell).

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: They reject the truth and follow their own desires––everything is recorded––

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: They also gave the lie to (the splitting asunder of the moon) and only followed their desires.1 Yet everything is destined to reach an end. 2

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: Wakaththaboo wattabaAAoo ahwaahumwakullu amrin mustaqirr

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: They reject (the warning) and follow their (own) lusts but every matter has its appointed time.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
translation_text: And there has come to them as much news (of the earlier communities) as it is enough to deter,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
translation_text: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
translation_text: although warning tales that should have restrained them have come down to them––

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And indeed there has come to them news (in this Qur’ân) wherein there is (enough warning) to check (them from evil),

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
translation_text: Surely there came to them narratives (of the ancient nations) that should suffice to deter (them from transgression),

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
translation_text: Walaqad jaahum mina al-anba-i mafeehi muzdajar

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
translation_text: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
translation_text: There have already come to them Recitals wherein there is (enough) to check (them),

text_uthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: (containing) a perfect wisdom. But the warnings are of no avail (to them).

text_uthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

text_uthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: farreaching wisdom––but these warnings do not help:

text_uthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. Perfect wisdom (this Qur’ân), but (the preaching of) warners benefit them not.

text_uthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: narratives that are full of consummate wisdom. But warnings do not avail them.

text_uthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: Hikmatun balighatun famatughnee annuthur

text_uthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.

text_uthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: Mature wisdom;- but (the preaching of) Warners profits them not.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
translation_text: Therefore, turn aside (O Prophet,) from them. (They will see the reality) on the day in which the caller will call (them) to a gruesome object.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
translation_text: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller1 calls to something forbidding,

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. So (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) withdraw from them. The Day that the caller will call (them) to a terrible thing.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
translation_text: so [Prophet] turn away from them. On the Day the Summoner will summon them to a horrific event,

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
translation_text: So turn away from them, (O Prophet).1 On the Day when a caller shall call them to a thing most terrible,2

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
translation_text: Fatawalla AAanhum yawma yadAAu addaAAiila shay-in nukur

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
translation_text: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.

text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
translation_text: Therefore, (O Prophet,) turn away from them. The Day that the Caller will call (them) to a terrible affair,

text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
translation_text: With their eyes humbled, they will come out of the graves like locusts spread all over,

text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
translation_text: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
translation_text: eyes downcast, they will come out of their graves like swarming locusts

text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: They will come forth, with humbled eyes from (their) graves as if they were locusts spread abroad,

text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
translation_text: with down-cast eyes1 they shall go forth from their graves,2 as though they were scattered locusts.

text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
translation_text: KhushshaAAan absaruhum yakhrujoonamina al-ajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashir

text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
translation_text: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,

text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
translation_text: They will come forth,- their eyes humbled - from (their) graves, (torpid) like locusts scattered abroad,

text_uthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
translation_text: rushing quickly towards the caller. (On that Day) the disbelievers will say, “This is a hard day.”

text_uthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
translation_text: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

text_uthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. Hastening towards the caller. The disbelievers will say: "This is a hard Day."

text_uthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
translation_text: rushing towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will cry, ‘This is a stern day!’

text_uthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
translation_text: They shall be hurrying forth towards the caller, and the unbelievers (who had once denied this Day), will say: “This is a woeful Day.”

text_uthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
translation_text: MuhtiAAeena ila addaAAiyaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun AAasir

text_uthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
translation_text: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.

text_uthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
translation_text: Hastening, with eyes transfixed, towards the Caller!- "Hard is this Day!", the Unbelievers will say.

text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
translation_text: The people of NūH denied (the truth) before them. So they rejected Our servant, and said, “(He is) a madman”, and he was (also) threatened (by them).

text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
translation_text: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
translation_text: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them: they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is mad!’ Noah was rebuked,

text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. The people of Nûh (Noah) denied (their Messenger) before them. They rejected Our slave, and said: "A madman!" and he was insolently rebuked and threatened.

text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
translation_text: Before them Noah's people also gave the lie (to his Message).1 They rejected Our servant as a liar, saying: “He is a madman”; and he was rebuffed.2

text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
translation_text: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohinfakaththaboo AAabdana waqaloo majnoonun wazdujir

text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
translation_text: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.

text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
translation_text: Before them the People of Noah rejected (their messenger): they rejected Our servant, and said, "Here is one possessed!", and he was driven out.

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
translation_text: So he prayed to his Lord saying, “I am overpowered, so defend (me).”

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
translation_text: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. Then he invoked his Lord (saying): "I have been overcome, so help (me)!"

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
translation_text: and so he called upon his Lord, ‘I am defeated: help me!’

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
translation_text: Then he called upon His Lord: “Verily I am vanquished; so come You to my aid.”

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
translation_text: FadaAAa rabbahu annee maghloobun fantasir

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
translation_text: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.

text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
translation_text: Then he called on his Lord: "I am one overcome: do Thou then help (me)!"

text_uthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
translation_text: So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring forth profusely,

text_uthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
translation_text: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

text_uthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
translation_text: So We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water,

text_uthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. So We opened the gates of the heaven with water pouring forth.

text_uthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
translation_text: Thereupon We opened the gates of the sky for water to pour down,

text_uthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
translation_text: Fafatahna abwaba assama-ibima-in munhamir

text_uthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
translation_text: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water

text_uthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
translation_text: So We opened the gates of heaven, with water pouring forth.

text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
translation_text: and We caused the earth to gush forth as springs; so the water (of both kinds) met together for a destined event.

text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
translation_text: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
translation_text: burst the earth with gushing springs: the waters met for a preordained purpose.

text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. And We caused springs to gush forth from the earth. So the waters (of the heaven and the earth) met for a matter predestined.

text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
translation_text: and We made the earth burst forth with springs,1 and all this water converged to fulfil that which had been decreed.

text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
translation_text: Wafajjarna al-arda AAuyoonanfaltaqa almao AAala amrin qad qudir

text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
translation_text: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.

text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
translation_text: And We caused the earth to gush forth with springs, so the waters met (and rose) to the extent decreed.

text_uthmani: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
translation_text: And We caused him (NūH) to board that (ship) which had planks and nails,

text_uthmani: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
translation_text: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

text_uthmani: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. And We carried him on a (ship) made of planks and nails,

text_uthmani: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
translation_text: We carried him along on a vessel of planks and nails

text_uthmani: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
translation_text: And We bore Noah on the vessel built of planks and nails,1

text_uthmani: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
translation_text: Wahamalnahu AAala thatialwahin wadusur

text_uthmani: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
translation_text: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,

text_uthmani: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
translation_text: But We bore him on an (Ark) made of broad planks and caulked with palm-fibre:

text_uthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
translation_text: which sailed under Our Eyes, as a reward for the one who was rejected (by the infidels).

text_uthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
translation_text: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

text_uthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. Floating under Our Eyes: a reward for him who had been rejected!

text_uthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
translation_text: that floated under Our watchful eye, a reward for the one who had been rejected.

text_uthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
translation_text: which sailed on under Our supervision: a reward for him who had been shown ingratitude.1

text_uthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
translation_text: Tajree bi-aAAyunina jazaanliman kana kufir

text_uthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
translation_text: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.

text_uthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
translation_text: She floats under our eyes (and care): a recompense to one who had been rejected (with scorn)!

text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And We left it (the ship) as a sign. So, is there one to take lesson?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: We have left this as a sign: will anyone take heed?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. And indeed, We have left this as a sign. Then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And We left the Ark as a Sign.1 Is there, then, any who will take heed?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: Walaqad taraknaha ayatanfahal min muddakir

text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And We have left this as a Sign (for all time): then is there any that will receive admonition?

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Then how was My torment and My warnings?

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.1

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. Then how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthur

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: But how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. And We have indeed made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any one who will remember (or receive admonition)?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder.1 Is there, then, any who will take heed?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: Walaqad yassarna alqur-ana liththikrifahal min muddakir

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: (The people of) ‘Ād rejected (their prophet). So how was My torment and My warnings?

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. ‘Âd (people) belied (their Prophet, Hûd); then how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: The people of 'Ad also rejected the truth. How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: 'Ad also gave the lie (to Hud). So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Kaththabat AAadun fakayfa kanaAAathabee wanuthur

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: The 'Ad (people) (too) rejected (Truth): then how terrible was My Penalty and My Warning?

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
translation_text: We did send to them a furious wind in a day of continuous misfortune,

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
translation_text: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
translation_text: We released a howling wind against them on a day of terrible disaster;

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. Verily, We sent against them a furious wind of harsh voice on a day of evil omen and continuous calamity.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
translation_text: We sent a tumultuous wind against them on a day of unremitting misfortune,1

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
translation_text: Inna arsalna AAalayhim reehansarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirr

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
translation_text: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
translation_text: For We sent against them a furious wind, on a Day of violent Disaster,

text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
translation_text: plucking people away, as if they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.

text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
translation_text: Extracting the people1 as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. Plucking out men as if they were uprooted stems of date-palms.

text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
translation_text: it swept people away like uprooted palm trunks.

text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
translation_text: which tore people away and hurled them as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.

text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
translation_text: TanziAAu annasa kaannahumaAAjazu nakhlin munqaAAir

text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
translation_text: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.

text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
translation_text: Plucking out men as if they were roots of palm-trees torn up (from the ground).

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: So how was My torment and My warnings?

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. Then, how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthur

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Yea, how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. And We have indeed made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: We have made the Qur'an easy to derive lessons from. Is there, then, any who will take heed?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: Walaqad yassarna alqur-ana liththikrifahal min muddakir

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: But We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: (The people of) Thamūd rejected the warners.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: Thamūd denied the warning.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. Thamûd (people also) belied the warnings.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: The people of Thamud also rejected the warnings:

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: Thamud gave the lie to the warnings,

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: Kaththabat thamoodu binnuthur

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: The Thamud (also) rejected (their) Warners.

text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: So they said, “Shall we follow a single human being from among us? Then we will be in error and insanity.

text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: And said, "Is it one human being1 among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. And they said: "A man, alone among us - shall we follow him? Truly then we should be in error and distress (or madness)!"

text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: they said, ‘What? A man? Why should we follow a lone man from amongst ourselves? That would be misguided; quite insane!

text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: saying: “Are we to follow a single mortal,1 one from among ourselves? If we do that, we shall surely be in error and folly.

text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: Faqaloo abasharan minna wahidannattabiAAuhu inna ithan lafee dalalinwasuAAur

text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.

text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: For they said: "What! a man! a Solitary one from among ourselves! shall we follow such a one? Truly should we then be straying in mind, and mad!

text_uthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
translation_text: Is it that the advice has been cast upon him alone out of all of us? No, but he is a bragging liar.”

text_uthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
translation_text: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

text_uthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. "Is it that the Reminder is sent to him [Prophet Sâlih عليه السلام] alone from among us? Nay, he is an insolent liar!"

text_uthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
translation_text: Would a mes-sage be given to him alone out of all of us? No, he is an insolent liar!’

text_uthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
translation_text: Was there none but he to whom the Reminder could be vouchsafed excluding all others? Nay; he is an insolent liar.”1

text_uthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
translation_text: Aolqiya aththikru AAalayhimin baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashir

text_uthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
translation_text: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.

text_uthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
translation_text: "Is it that the Message is sent to him, of all people amongst us? Nay, he is a liar, an insolent one!"

text_uthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
translation_text: Tomorrow they will know who the bragging liar is!

text_uthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
translation_text: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

text_uthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. Tomorrow they will come to know who is the liar, the insolent one!

text_uthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
translation_text: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is the insolent liar,

text_uthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
translation_text: (We told Our Messenger): “Tomorrow they shall know who is the insolent liar.

text_uthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
translation_text: SayaAAlamoona ghadan mani alkaththabual-ashir

text_uthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
translation_text: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.

text_uthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
translation_text: Ah! they will know on the morrow, which is the liar, the insolent one!

text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
translation_text: We are going to send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch them (O SāliH,) and keep patience,

text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
translation_text: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. Verily, We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them [O Sâlih عليه السلام], and be patient!

text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
translation_text: for We shall send them a she-camel to test them: so watch them [Salih] and be patient.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
translation_text: We shall send the she-camel as a trial for them; so watch their end with patience.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
translation_text: Inna mursiloo annaqatifitnatan lahum fartaqibhum wastabir

text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
translation_text: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;

text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
translation_text: For We will send the she-camel by way of trial for them. So watch them, (O Salih), and possess thyself in patience!

text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
translation_text: and tell them that water (of the well) is to be shared between them (and the she-camel), so as the right of having water shall be attended by each (alternatively).

text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
translation_text: And inform them that the water is shared between them,1 each [day of] drink attended [by turn].

text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them, each one’s right to drink being established (by turns).

text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
translation_text: Tell them the water is to be shared between them: each one should drink in turn.’

text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
translation_text: Let them know that the water should be divided between them and the she-camel, each availing their turn.”1

text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
translation_text: Wanabbi/hum anna almaa qismatunbaynahum kullu shirbin muhtadar

text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
translation_text: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.

text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
translation_text: And tell them that the water is to be divided between them: Each one's right to drink being brought forward (by suitable turns).

text_uthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
translation_text: Then they called their man (to kill the she-camel,) so he undertook (the task) and killed (the she-camel).

text_uthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
translation_text: But they called their companion,1 and he dared2 and hamstrung [her].

text_uthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. But they called their comrade and he took (a sword) and killed (her).

text_uthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
translation_text: But they called their companion, who took a sword and hamstrung the camel.

text_uthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
translation_text: Eventually, they summoned their companion, and he undertook the (outrageous) task and hamstrung the she-camel.1

text_uthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
translation_text: Fanadaw sahibahum fataAAatafaAAaqar

text_uthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
translation_text: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).

text_uthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
translation_text: But they called to their companion, and he took a sword in hand, and hamstrung (her).

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: So how was My torment and My warnings?

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. Then, how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: So how awesome were My chastisement and My warnings!

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthur

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Ah! how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
translation_text: We sent upon them a single Cry, and they were like crushed leafs of a hedge-builder.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
translation_text: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. Verily, We sent against them a single Saihah (torment - awful cry), and they became like the stubble of a fold-builder.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
translation_text: We released a single mighty blast against them and they ended up like a fencemaker’s dry sticks.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
translation_text: Behold, We sent a single Blast against them, and they became like the trampled twigs of a sheep pen-builder.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
translation_text: Inna arsalna AAalayhim sayhatanwahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathir

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
translation_text: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
translation_text: For We sent against them a single Mighty Blast, and they became like the dry stubble used by one who pens cattle.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. And indeed, We have made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: Surely We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: Walaqad yassarna alqur-ana liththikrifahal min muddakir

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: The people of LūT rejected the warners.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: The people of Lot denied the warning.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. The people of Lût (Lot) belied the warnings.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: Lot's people also gave the lie to the warnings,

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: Kaththabat qawmu lootin binnuthur

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: The people of Lut rejected (his) warning.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
translation_text: We sent upon them a rain of stones, except the family of LūT whom We saved in the last hours of night,

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
translation_text: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 34. Verily, We sent against them a violent storm of stones (which destroyed them all), except the family of Lût (Lot), them We saved in the last hour of the night,

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
translation_text: We released a stonebearing wind against them, all except the family of Lot. We saved them before dawn

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
translation_text: and behold, We let loose upon them a tempest which rained stones upon them, except upon Lot's household whom We rescued in the last hours of the night

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
translation_text: Inna arsalna AAalayhim hasibanilla ala lootin najjaynahum bisahar

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
translation_text: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
translation_text: We sent against them a violent Tornado with showers of stones, (which destroyed them), except Lut's household: them We delivered by early Dawn,-

text_uthmani: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
translation_text: as a grace from Us. This is how We reward the one who offers gratitude.

text_uthmani: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
translation_text: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

text_uthmani: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 35. As a Favour from Us. Thus do We reward him who gives thanks (by obeying Us).

text_uthmani: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
translation_text: as a favour from Us: this is how We reward the thankful.

text_uthmani: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
translation_text: as a favour from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.

text_uthmani: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
translation_text: NiAAmatan min AAindina kathalikanajzee man shakar

text_uthmani: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
translation_text: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.

text_uthmani: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
translation_text: As a Grace from Us: thus do We reward those who give thanks.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: And he (LūT) had certainly warned them of Our grasp, but they disputed the warnings.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: He warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warning-

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. And he [Lût (Lot)] indeed had warned them of Our Seizure (punishment), but they did doubt the warnings!

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: Surely Lot warned his people that We shall seize them (with Our chastisement), but they doubted the warnings.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: Walaqad antharahum batshatanafatamaraw binnuthur

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
translation_text: And (Lut) did warn them of Our Punishment, but they disputed about the Warning.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: And they had even tried to tempt him against his guests (so that they may snatch them away for bad purpose,) but We blinded their eyes: “Now taste My torment and My warnings!”

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. And they indeed sought to shame his guest (by asking to commit sodomy with them). So We blinded their eyes, (saying) "Then taste you My Torment and My Warnings."

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: they even demanded his guests from him- so We sealed their eyes- ‘ Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’-

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Then they even solicited his guests from him, whereupon We blotted out their eyes, (telling them): “Now have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.” 1

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Walaqad rawadoohu AAan dayfihifatamasna aAAyunahum fathooqoo AAathabeewanuthur

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: And they even sought to snatch away his guests from him, but We blinded their eyes. (They heard:) "Now taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: And on the next morning, a lasting torment overtook them:

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. And verily, an abiding torment seized them early in the morning.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: and early in the morning a punishment seized them that still remains-

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: Indeed an abiding chastisement came upon them in the morning.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: Walaqad sabbahahum bukratanAAathabun mustaqirr

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
translation_text: Early on the morrow an abiding Punishment seized them:

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: “Now taste My torment and My warnings.”

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: So taste My punishment and warning.

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. "Then taste you My Torment and My Warnings."

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: ‘Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: So have a taste of My chastisement and My warnings.

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthur

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
translation_text: "So taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: Indeed We have made the Qur’ān easy for seeking advice. So, is there one to heed to the advice?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. And indeed, We have made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: Surely We have made this Qur'an easy as a reminder. Is there, then, any who will take heed?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: Walaqad yassarna alqur-ana liththikrifahal min muddakir

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: And the warners came to the family of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. And indeed, warnings came to the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) [through Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)].

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: The people of Pharaoh also received warnings.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: Warnings also came to the Pharaonites,

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: Walaqad jaa ala firAAawna annuthur

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
translation_text: To the People of Pharaoh, too, aforetime, came Warners (from Allah).

text_uthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
translation_text: (But) they rejected all Our signs; so We seized them- a seizure by One Mighty, Powerful.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
translation_text: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
