translation_text: 42. (They) belied all Our Signs, so We seized them with a Seizure of the All-Mighty, All-Capable (Omnipotent).

text_uthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
translation_text: They rejected all Our signs so We seized them with all Our might and power.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
translation_text: but they gave the lie to Our Signs, to all of them. Thereupon We seized them with the seizing of the Most Mighty, the Most Powerful.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
translation_text: Kaththaboo bi-ayatinakulliha faakhathnahum akhthaAAazeezin muqtadir

text_uthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
translation_text: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
translation_text: The (people) rejected all Our Signs; but We seized them with such Penalty (as comes) from One Exalted in Power, able to carry out His Will.

text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: Are the disbelievers among you in a better position than all of the aforesaid (punished people), or do you have immunity (recorded) in the sacred books?

text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?

text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. Are your disbelievers (O Quraish!) better than these [nations of Nûh (Noah), Lût (Lot), Sâlih, and the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) who were destroyed)? Or have you an immunity (against Our Torment) in the Divine Scriptures?

text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: ‘Are your disbelievers any better than these? Were you given an exemption in the Scripture?’

text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: Are your unbelievers (of Makkah) any better than they?1 Or have you been granted any immunity in the Scriptures?

text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: Akuffarukum khayrun min ola-ikumam lakum baraatun fee azzubur

text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?

text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: Are your Unbelievers, (O Quraish), better than they? Or have ye an immunity in the Sacred Books?

text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
translation_text: Or do they say, “We are a large group, well-defended.”?

text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
translation_text: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. Or say they: "We are a great multitude, victorious?"

text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
translation_text: Do they perhaps say, ‘We are a great army and we shall be victorious’?

text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
translation_text: Or do they say: “We are a strong legion, strong enough for victory?”

text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
translation_text: Am yaqooloona nahnu jameeAAun muntasir

text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
translation_text: Or say they: We are a host victorious?

text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
translation_text: Or do they say: "We acting together can defend ourselves"?

text_uthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
translation_text: Soon this ‘large group’ shall be defeated, and all of them will turn their backs.

text_uthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
translation_text: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].1

text_uthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
translation_text: Their forces will be routed and they will turn tail and flee.

text_uthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 45. Their multitude will be put to flight, and they will show their backs.

text_uthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
translation_text: Soon shall this legion be routed and shall turn their backs and flee.1

text_uthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
translation_text: Sayuhzamu aljamAAu wayuwalloona addubur

text_uthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
translation_text: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.

text_uthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
translation_text: Soon will their multitude be put to flight, and they will show their backs.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
translation_text: Rather the Hour (of judgment) is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour is more calamitous and much more bitter.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
translation_text: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
translation_text: But the Hour is their appointed time- the Hour is more severe and bitter:

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 46. Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour will be more grievous and more bitter.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
translation_text: Nay; the Hour of Doom is their appointed time, and the Hour shall be more calamitous and bitter.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
translation_text: Bali assaAAatu mawAAiduhum wassaAAatuadha waamar

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
translation_text: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
translation_text: Nay, the Hour (of Judgment) is the time promised them (for their full recompense): And that Hour will be most grievous and most bitter.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: Surely the guilty ones are in error and madness.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.1.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 47. Verily the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals) are in error (in this world) and will burn (in the Hell-fire in the Hereafter).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: truly the wicked are misguided and quite insane––

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: The evil-doers are victims of error and madness.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: Inna almujrimeena fee dalalinwasuAAur

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
translation_text: Truly those in sin are the ones straying in mind, and mad.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
translation_text: On the Day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, (it will be said to them,) “Taste the touch of Hell.”

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
translation_text: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
translation_text: on the Day when they are dragged on their faces in Hell. ‘Feel the touch of Hell.’

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: The Day they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire (it will be said to them): "Taste you the touch of Hell!"1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
translation_text: There shall come a Day when they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire and will be told: “Now taste the flame of Hell.”

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
translation_text: Yawma yushaboona fee annariAAala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqar

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
translation_text: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
translation_text: The Day they will be dragged through the Fire on their faces, (they will hear:) "Taste ye the touch of Hell!"

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
translation_text: Verily, We have created every thing according to (Our) predestination.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
translation_text: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
translation_text: We have created all things in due measure;

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 49. Verily, We have created all things with Qadar (Divine Preordainments of all things before their creation as written in the Book of Decrees Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
translation_text: We have created everything in a determined measure.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
translation_text: Inna kulla shay-in khalaqnahubiqadar

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
translation_text: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
translation_text: Verily, all things have We created in proportion and measure.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
translation_text: And (implementation of) Our command is no more than a single act like the twinkling of an eye.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
translation_text: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
translation_text: when We ordain something it happens at once, in the blink of an eye;

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And Our Commandment is but one as the twinkling of an eye.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
translation_text: Our command consists of only one Word which is carried out in the twinkling of an eye.1

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
translation_text: Wama amruna illa wahidatunkalamhin bilbasar

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
translation_text: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
translation_text: And Our Command is but a single (Act),- like the twinkling of an eye.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: We have destroyed people like you; so, is there one to take lesson?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And We have already destroyed your kinds,1 so is there any who will remember?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 51. And indeed, We have destroyed your likes; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past. Will anyone take heed?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: We did indeed destroy many like you.1 Is there, then, any who will heed?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: Walaqad ahlakna ashyaAAakumfahal min muddakir

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
translation_text: And (oft) in the past, have We destroyed gangs like unto you: then is there any that will receive admonition?

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: And every thing they have done is recorded in the books (of deeds).

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: And everything they did is in written records.

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: Everything they do is noted in their records:

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 52. And everything they have done is noted in (their) Records (of deeds).

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: All their deeds are recorded in the Scrolls;

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: Wakullu shay-in faAAaloohu fee azzubur

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
translation_text: All that they do is noted in (their) Books (of Deeds):

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
translation_text: And every thing, small and big, is written down.

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
translation_text: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 53. And everything, small and big, is written down (in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz already beforehand i.e. before it befalls, or is done by its doer: الإيمان بالقدر) (See the Qur’ân V.57:22 and its footnote).

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
translation_text: every action, great or small, is recorded.

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
translation_text: everything large or small, is duly inscribed.1

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
translation_text: Wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatar

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
translation_text: And every small and great thing is recorded.

text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
translation_text: Every matter, small and great, is on record.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
translation_text: Of course, the God-fearing will be in gardens and rivers,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
translation_text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
translation_text: The righteous will live securely among Gardens and rivers,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 54. Verily, The Muttaqûn (the pious - see V.2:2), will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers (Paradise).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
translation_text: Surely those who shun disobedience will dwell amidst Gardens and running streams

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
translation_text: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatinwanahar

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
translation_text: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
translation_text: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers,

text_uthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
translation_text: in a seat of Truth, near to the Omnipotent Sovereign.

text_uthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
translation_text: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.1

text_uthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 55. In a seat of truth (i.e. Paradise), near the Omnipotent King (Allâh, the One, the All-Blessed, the Most High, the Owner of Majesty and Honour).

text_uthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
translation_text: secure in the presence of an all-powerful Sovereign.

text_uthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
translation_text: where they will be honourably seated in the presence of a King, Mighty in Power.

text_uthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
translation_text: Fee maqAAadi sidqin AAinda maleekinmuqtadir

text_uthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
translation_text: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.

text_uthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
translation_text: In an Assembly of Truth, in the Presence of a Sovereign Omnipotent.

text_uthmani: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
translation_text: The RaHmān (The All-Merciful Allah)

text_uthmani: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
translation_text: The Most Merciful

text_uthmani: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
translation_text: It is the Lord of Mercy

text_uthmani: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: The Most Gracious (Allâh)!

text_uthmani: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
translation_text: The Merciful One

text_uthmani: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
translation_text: Arrahman

text_uthmani: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
translation_text: The Beneficent

text_uthmani: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
translation_text: (Allah) Most Gracious!

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
translation_text: has taught the Qur’ān.

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
translation_text: Taught the Qur’ān,

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. He has taught (you mankind) the Qur’ân (by His Mercy).

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
translation_text: who taught the Quran.

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
translation_text: has taught the Qur'an,1

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
translation_text: AAallama alqur-an

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
translation_text: Hath made known the Qur'an.

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
translation_text: It is He Who has taught the Qur'an.

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
translation_text: He has created man.

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
translation_text: Created man,

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
translation_text: He created man

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. He created man.

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
translation_text: has created man,1

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
translation_text: Khalaqa al-insan

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
translation_text: He hath created man.

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
translation_text: He has created man:

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
translation_text: He has taught him (how) to express himself.

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
translation_text: [And] taught him eloquence.

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. He taught him eloquent speech.

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
translation_text: and taught him to communicate.

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
translation_text: and has taught him articulate speech.1

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
translation_text: AAallamahu albayan

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
translation_text: He hath taught him utterance.

text_uthmani: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
translation_text: He has taught him speech (and intelligence).

text_uthmani: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
translation_text: The sun and the moon are (bound) by a (fixed) calculation.

text_uthmani: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
translation_text: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

text_uthmani: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. The sun and the moon run on their fixed courses (exactly) calculated with measured out stages for each (for reckoning).

text_uthmani: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
translation_text: The sun and the moon follow their calculated courses;

text_uthmani: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
translation_text: The sun and the moon follow a reckoning,1

text_uthmani: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
translation_text: Ashshamsu walqamaru bihusban

text_uthmani: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
translation_text: The sun and the moon are made punctual.

text_uthmani: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
translation_text: The sun and the moon follow courses (exactly) computed;

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
translation_text: And the vine and the tree both prostrate (to Allah).

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
translation_text: And the stars and trees prostrate.1

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. And the herbs (or stars) and the trees both prostrate themselves (to Allah - See V.22:18) (Tafsir Ibn Kathir)

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
translation_text: the plants and the trees submit to His designs;

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
translation_text: and the stars1 and the trees all prostrate themselves,2

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
translation_text: Wannajmu washshajaru yasjudan

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
translation_text: The stars and the trees prostrate.

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
translation_text: And the herbs and the trees - both (alike) prostrate in adoration.

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: He raised the sky high, and has placed the scale,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. And the heaven: He has raised it high, and He has set up the Balance.

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: He has raised up the sky. He has set the balance

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: and He has raised up the heaven and has set a balance1

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: Wassamaa rafaAAahawawadaAAa almeezan

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: And the Firmament has He raised high, and He has set up the Balance (of Justice),

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
translation_text: so that you should not be wrongful in weighing.

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
translation_text: That you not transgress within the balance.

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
translation_text: so that you may not exceed in the balance:

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. In order that you may not transgress (due) balance.

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
translation_text: that you may not transgress in the balance,

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
translation_text: Alla tatghaw fee almeezan

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
translation_text: That ye exceed not the measure,

text_uthmani: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
translation_text: In order that ye may not transgress (due) balance.

text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: Observe the correct weight with fairness, and do not make weighing deficient.

text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: weigh with justice and do not fall short in the balance.

text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. And observe the weight with equity and do not make the balance deficient.

text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: but weigh things equitably and skimp not in the balance.1

text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: Waaqeemoo alwazna bilqisti walatukhsiroo almeezan

text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.

text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: So establish weight with justice and fall not short in the balance.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
translation_text: As for the earth, He has placed it for creatures,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
translation_text: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. And the earth: He has put down (laid) for the creatures.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
translation_text: He set down the Earth for His creatures,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
translation_text: And He1 has set up the earth for all beings.2

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
translation_text: Wal-arda wadaAAahalil-anam

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
translation_text: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
translation_text: It is He Who has spread out the earth for (His) creatures:

text_uthmani: فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
translation_text: in which there are fruits and date palms having sheaths,

text_uthmani: فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
translation_text: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

text_uthmani: فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
translation_text: with its fruits, its palm trees with sheathed clusters,

text_uthmani: فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Therein are fruits and date-palms producing sheathed fruit-stalks (enclosing dates).

text_uthmani: فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
translation_text: Therein are fruit and palm-trees with their dates in sheaths,

text_uthmani: فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
translation_text: Feeha fakihatun wannakhluthatu al-akmam

text_uthmani: فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
translation_text: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,

text_uthmani: فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
translation_text: Therein is fruit and date-palms, producing spathes (enclosing dates);

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
translation_text: and the grain having chaff, and fragrant flowers.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
translation_text: And grain having husks and scented plants.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. And also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-scented plants.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
translation_text: its husked grain, its fragrant plants.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
translation_text: and a variety of corn with both husk and grain.1

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
translation_text: Walhabbu thoo alAAasfiwarrayhan

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
translation_text: Husked grain and scented herb.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
translation_text: Also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-smelling plants.

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So, (O mankind and Jinn,) which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?1

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which of the bounties of your Lord1 will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?2

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Fabi-ayyi ala-i rabbikumatukaththiban

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
translation_text: He has created man from dry clay, ringing like pottery,

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
translation_text: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
translation_text: He created mankind out of dried clay, like pottery,

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. He created man (Adam) from sounding clay like the clay of pottery.

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
translation_text: He has created man from dry, rotten clay like the potter's,1

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
translation_text: Khalaqa al-insana min salsalinkalfakhkhar

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
translation_text: He created man of clay like the potter's,

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
translation_text: He created man from sounding clay like unto pottery,

text_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
translation_text: and created Jann (father of the Jinn) from a smokeless flame of fire.

text_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
translation_text: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

text_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
translation_text: the jinn out of smokeless fire.

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. And the jinn: He created from a smokeless flame of fire.

text_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
translation_text: and has created the jinn from the flame of fire.1

text_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ

text_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
translation_text: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.

text_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
translation_text: And He created Jinns from fire free of smoke:

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So, (O mankind and Jinn,) which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translation_text: 16. Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?

text_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
translation_text: He is the Lord of both points of sunrise and both points of sunset.

text_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
translation_text: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.1

text_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
translation_text: He is Lord of the two risings and Lord of the two settings.

text_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: (He is) the Lord of the two easts (places of sunrise during early summer and early winter) and the Lord of the two wests (places of sunset during early summer and early winter).

text_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
translation_text: Lord of the two easts and of the two wests is He.1

text_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
translation_text: Rabbu almashriqayni warabbu almaghribayn

text_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
translation_text: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!

text_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
translation_text: (He is) Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests:

translation_text: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

text_uthmani: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
translation_text: He let forth the two seas to meet together,

text_uthmani: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
translation_text: He released the two seas,1 meeting [one another];

text_uthmani: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
translation_text: He released the two bodies of [fresh and salt] water. They meet,

text_uthmani: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. He has let loose the two seas (the salt and fresh water) meeting together.

text_uthmani: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
translation_text: He unleashed the two seas so that they merge together,

text_uthmani: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
translation_text: Maraja albahrayni yaltaqiyan

text_uthmani: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
translation_text: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.

text_uthmani: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
translation_text: He has let free the two bodies of flowing water, meeting together:

text_uthmani: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
translation_text: while there is a barrier between them; they do not encroach (upon one another).

text_uthmani: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
translation_text: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.

text_uthmani: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
translation_text: yet there is a barrier between them they do not cross.

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. Between them is a barrier which none of them can transgress.

text_uthmani: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ

يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
translation_text: From both of them come forth the pearl and the coral.

text_uthmani: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
translation_text: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

text_uthmani: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. Out of them both come out pearl and coral.

translation_text: Pearls come forth from them: large ones, and small, brilliant ones.

text_uthmani: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ

translation_text: And His are the sailing ships raised up in the sea like mountains.

text_uthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ
translation_text: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.

translation_text: His are the moving ships that float, high as mountains, on the sea.

text_uthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. And His are the ships going and coming in the seas, like mountains.

translation_text: His are the ships,1 towering on the sea like mountains.

text_uthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ

translation_text: Every one who is on it (the earth) has to perish.

text_uthmani: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
translation_text: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,

text_uthmani: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
translation_text: Everyone on earth perishes;

text_uthmani: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. Whatsoever is on it (the earth) will perish.

text_uthmani: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
translation_text: All1 that is on earth will perish,

text_uthmani: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
translation_text: Kullu man AAalayha fan

text_uthmani: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
translation_text: Everyone that is thereon will pass away;

text_uthmani: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
translation_text: All that is on earth will perish:

text_uthmani: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: And your Lord’s Countenance will remain, full of majesty, full of honour.

text_uthmani: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: And there will remain the Face1 of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

text_uthmani: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. And the Face of your Lord full of Majesty and Honour will remain forever.

text_uthmani: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: all that remains is the Face of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.

text_uthmani: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: only the Person of your Lord, full of majesty and splendour, will endure.

text_uthmani: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: Wayabqa wajhu rabbika thooaljalali wal-ikram

text_uthmani: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.

text_uthmani: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: But will abide (for ever) the Face of thy Lord,- full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So which of the wonders of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?1

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Fabi-ayyi ala-i rabbikumatukaththiban

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
translation_text: All those in the heavens and the earth beseech Him (for their needs.) Every day He is in a state of action.

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
translation_text: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.1

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
translation_text: Everyone in heaven and earth entreats Him; every day He is at work.

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. Whosoever is in the heavens and on earth begs of Him (its needs from Him). Every day He is (engaged) in some affair (such as giving honour or disgrace to some, life or death to some, etc.)!

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
translation_text: All in the heavens and the earth entreat Him for their needs; a new, mighty task engages Him each day.1

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
translation_text: Yas-aluhu man fee assamawatiwal-ardi kulla yawmin huwa fee sha/n

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
translation_text: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
translation_text: Of Him seeks (its need) every creature in the heavens and on earth: every day in (new) Splendour doth He (shine)!

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which of your Lord's laudable attributes will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?1

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Fabi-ayyi ala-i rabbikumatukaththiban

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?

text_uthmani: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
translation_text: Soon We are going to spare Ourselves for you (to reckon your deeds), O two heavy species (of Jinn and mankind)!

text_uthmani: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
translation_text: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.1

text_uthmani: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
translation_text: We shall attend to you two huge armies [of jinn and mankind].

text_uthmani: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. We shall attend to you, O you two classes (jinn and men)!

text_uthmani: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
translation_text: O you twain, who are a burden (on the earth),1 We shall attend to you and call you to account.2

text_uthmani: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
translation_text: Sanafrughu lakum ayyuha aththaqalan

text_uthmani: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
translation_text: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).

text_uthmani: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
translation_text: Soon shall We settle your affairs, O both ye worlds!

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: (We shall then see), which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?1

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Fabi-ayyi ala-i rabbikumatukaththiban

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?

text_uthmani: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
translation_text: O genera of Jinn and mankind, If you are able to penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate. You cannot penetrate without power.

text_uthmani: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
translation_text: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].

text_uthmani: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
translation_text: Jinn and mankind, if you can pass beyond the regions of heaven and earth, then do so: you will not pass without Our authority.

text_uthmani: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. O assembly of jinn and men! If you have power to pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, then pass beyond (them)! But you will never be able to pass them, except with authority (from Allâh)!

text_uthmani: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
translation_text: O company of jinn and men, if you have the power to go beyond the bounds of the heavens and the earth, go beyond them! Yet you will be unable to go beyond them for that requires infinite power.1

text_uthmani: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
translation_text: Ya maAAshara aljinni wal-insiini istataAAtum an tanfuthoo min aqtari assamawatiwal-ardi fanfuthoo la tanfuthoonailla bisultan

text_uthmani: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
translation_text: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.

text_uthmani: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
translation_text: O ye assembly of Jinns and men! If it be ye can pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, pass ye! not without authority shall ye be able to pass!

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So, which of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 34. Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

translation_text: Which of your Lord's powers will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?

translation_text: A flame of fire and a smoke will be loosed against you, and you will not (be able) to defend.

text_uthmani: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
translation_text: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke,1 and you will not defend yourselves.

translation_text: A flash of fire and smoke will be released upon you and no one will come to your aid.

translation_text: 35. There will be sent against you both, smokeless flames of fire and (molten) brass, and you will not be able to defend yourselves.

text_uthmani: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
translation_text: (If you so venture) a flame of fire and smoke1 shall be lashed at you, which you shall be unable to withstand.

translation_text: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.

translation_text: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
translation_text: So, (it will be a terrible event) when the sky will be split apart and will become rosy, like (red) hides.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
translation_text: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil1 -

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
translation_text: When the sky is torn apart and turns crimson, like red hide.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. Then when the heaven is rent asunder, and it becomes rosy or red like red-oil, or red hide - [See V.70:8]

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
translation_text: (What will happen) when the heaven will be split asunder and will become crimson like leather?1

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
translation_text: Fa-itha inshaqqati assamaofakanat wardatan kaddihan

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
translation_text: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide -

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
translation_text: When the sky is rent asunder, and it becomes red like ointment:

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ

translation_text: On that day, neither a man will be questioned about his sin, nor a Jinn.

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
translation_text: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.1

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
translation_text: On that Day neither mankind nor jinn will be asked about their sins.

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. So on that Day no question will be asked of man or jinns as to his sin, [because they have already been known from their faces either white (dwellers of Paradise - true believers of Islamic Monotheism) or black (dwellers of Hell - polytheists; disbelievers, criminals)].

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
translation_text: On that Day there will be no need to ask either men or jinn about their sins.1

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
translation_text: Fayawma-ithin la yus-alu AAan thanbihiinsun wala jan

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
translation_text: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin.

translation_text: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?

text_uthmani: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
translation_text: The guilty ones will be recognized (by angels) through their marks and will be seized by foreheads and feet.

text_uthmani: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
translation_text: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

text_uthmani: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. The Mujrimûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners) will be known by their marks (black faces), and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.

text_uthmani: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
translation_text: The guilty will be known by their mark and will be seized by their foreheads and their feet.

text_uthmani: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
translation_text: The culprits shall be known by their marks, and shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet.

text_uthmani: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
translation_text: YuAArafu almujrimoona biseemahumfayu/khathu binnawasee wal-aqdam

text_uthmani: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
translation_text: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.

text_uthmani: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
translation_text: (For) the sinners will be known by their marks: and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.

translation_text: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?

translation_text: This is Jahannam (Hell) that the guilty people deny.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. This is the Hell which the Mujrimûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners) denied.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: This is the Hell the guilty deny,

text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

translation_text: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 77. Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which of the favours of your Lord will you twain – you men and jinn – then deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Fabi-ayyi ala-i rabbikumatukaththiban

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?

text_uthmani: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
translation_text: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?

text_uthmani: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: Glorious is the name of your Lord, the Lord of Majesty, the Lord of Honour.

text_uthmani: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

text_uthmani: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 78. Blessed be the Name of your Lord (Allâh), the Owner of Majesty and Honour.

text_uthmani: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: Blessed is the name of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.

text_uthmani: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: Blessed be the name of your Lord, the Lord of Majesty and Glory.

text_uthmani: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: Tabaraka ismu rabbika theealjalali wal-ikram

text_uthmani: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!

text_uthmani: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
translation_text: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.

text_uthmani: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: When the Imminent Event (of Doom) will occur,

text_uthmani: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: When the Occurrence occurs,

text_uthmani: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: When the Event (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) befalls.

text_uthmani: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: When that which is coming arrives,

text_uthmani: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: When the Event will come to pass

text_uthmani: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: Itha waqaAAati alwaqiAAat

text_uthmani: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: When the event befalleth -

text_uthmani: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: When the Event inevitable cometh to pass,

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
translation_text: there will be no one to deny its occurrence.

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
translation_text: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
translation_text: no one will be able to deny it has come,

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. And there can be no denial of its befalling.

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
translation_text: – and then there will be no one to deny its occurrence1 –

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
translation_text: Laysa liwaqAAatiha kathiba

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
translation_text: There is no denying that it will befall -

text_uthmani: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
translation_text: Then will no (soul) entertain falsehood concerning its coming.

text_uthmani: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
translation_text: It will be abasing (some), exalting (others)

text_uthmani: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
translation_text: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].1

text_uthmani: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. Bringing low (some - those who will enter Hell) Exalting (others - those who will enter Paradise). [Tafsir Ibn Kathir]

text_uthmani: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
translation_text: bringing low and raising high.

text_uthmani: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
translation_text: (a calamitous Event) that shall turn things upside down:1

text_uthmani: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
translation_text: Khafidatun rafiAAa

text_uthmani: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
translation_text: Abasing (some), exalting (others);

text_uthmani: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
translation_text: (Many) will it bring low; (many) will it exalt;

text_uthmani: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا
إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا
translation_text: when the earth will be jolted with a terrible jolt,

text_uthmani: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا
translation_text: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

text_uthmani: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا
translation_text: When the earth is shaken violently

text_uthmani: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. When the earth will be shaken with a terrible shake.

text_uthmani: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا
translation_text: when the earth will suddenly shake with a terrible shaking,1

text_uthmani: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا
translation_text: Itha rujjati al-ardu rajja

text_uthmani: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا
translation_text: When the earth is shaken with a shock

text_uthmani: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا
translation_text: When the earth shall be shaken to its depths,

text_uthmani: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا
وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا
translation_text: and the mountains will be crumbled a thorough crumbling,

text_uthmani: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا
translation_text: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

text_uthmani: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. And the mountains will be powdered to dust,

text_uthmani: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا
translation_text: and the mountains are ground to powder

text_uthmani: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا
translation_text: and the mountains will crumble

text_uthmani: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا
translation_text: Wabussati aljibalu bassa

text_uthmani: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا
translation_text: And the hills are ground to powder

text_uthmani: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا
translation_text: And the mountains shall be crumbled to atoms,

text_uthmani: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا
فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا
translation_text: until they will become dust, scattered in the air,

text_uthmani: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا
translation_text: And become dust dispersing,

text_uthmani: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا
translation_text: and turn to scattered dust,

text_uthmani: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. So that they will become floating dust particles.

text_uthmani: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا
translation_text: and will scatter abroad into fine dust.

text_uthmani: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا
translation_text: Fakanat habaan munbaththa

text_uthmani: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا
translation_text: So that they become a scattered dust,

text_uthmani: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا
translation_text: Becoming dust scattered abroad,

text_uthmani: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَـٰثَةً
وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَـٰثَةً
translation_text: and you will be (divided into) three categories.

text_uthmani: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَـٰثَةً
translation_text: And you become [of] three kinds:

text_uthmani: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَـٰثَةً
translation_text: then you will be sorted into three classes.

text_uthmani: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَـٰثَةً
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. And you (all) will be in three groups.

text_uthmani: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَـٰثَةً
translation_text: You shall then become three groups.1

text_uthmani: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَـٰثَةً
translation_text: Wakuntum azwajan thalatha

text_uthmani: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَـٰثَةً
translation_text: And ye will be three kinds:

text_uthmani: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَـٰثَةً
translation_text: And ye shall be sorted out into three classes.

text_uthmani: فَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
فَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_text: As for the People of the Right, how (lucky) are the People of the Right!

text_uthmani: فَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_text: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?1

text_uthmani: فَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_text: Those on the Right––what people they are!

text_uthmani: فَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. So those on the Right Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Records in their right hands) - how (fortunate) will be those on the Right Hand! (As a respect for them, because they will enter Paradise).

text_uthmani: فَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_text: The People on the Right:1 and how fortunate will be the People on the Right!

text_uthmani: فَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_text: Faas-habu almaymanati maas-habu almaymanat

text_uthmani: فَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_text: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?

text_uthmani: فَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_text: Then (there will be) the Companions of the Right Hand;- What will be the Companions of the Right Hand?

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: And the People of the Left ? How (wretched) are the People of the Left!

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?1

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: Those on the Left––what people they are!

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. And those on the Left Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Record in their left hands) - how (unfortunate) will be those on the Left Hand! (As a disgrace for them, because they will enter Hell).

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: And the People on the Left:1 and how miserable will be the People on the Left!

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: Waas-habu almash-amati maas-habu almash-amat

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand?

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: And the Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
translation_text: And the Foremost are the foremost.

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
translation_text: And the forerunners, the forerunners1 -

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
translation_text: And those in front––ahead indeed!

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. And those foremost [(in Islâmic Faith of Monotheism and in performing righteous deeds) in the life of this world on the very first call for to embrace Islâm] will be foremost (in Paradise).

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
translation_text: As for the Foremost, they will be the foremost!1

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
translation_text: Wassabiqoona assabiqoon

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
translation_text: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
translation_text: And those Foremost (in Faith) will be Foremost (in the Hereafter).

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: Those are the ones blessed with nearness (to Allah)

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: For these will be the ones brought nearest to God

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. These will be the nearest (to Allâh).

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: They shall be near-stationed (to their Lord),

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ

translation_text: And the People of the Left? How (wretched) are the People of the Left!

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
translation_text: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. And those on the Left Hand - how (unfortunate) will be those on the Left Hand?

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
translation_text: But those on the Left, what people they are!

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
translation_text: As for the People on the Left: how miserable will be the People on the Left!

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
translation_text: Waas-habu ashshimalima as-habu ashshimal

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
translation_text: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?

text_uthmani: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
translation_text: The Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?

text_uthmani: فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
translation_text: (They will be) in scorching wind and boiling water,

text_uthmani: فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
translation_text: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

text_uthmani: فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
translation_text: They will dwell amid scorching wind and scalding water

text_uthmani: فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 42. In fierce hot wind and boiling water,

text_uthmani: فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
translation_text: They will be in the midst of scorching wind and boiling water,

text_uthmani: فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
translation_text: Fee samoomin wahameem

text_uthmani: فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
translation_text: In scorching wind and scalding water

text_uthmani: فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
translation_text: (They will be) in the midst of a Fierce Blast of Fire and in Boiling Water,

text_uthmani: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ
وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ
translation_text: and in a shade of black smoke,

text_uthmani: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ
translation_text: And a shade of black smoke,

text_uthmani: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ
translation_text: in the shadow of black smoke,

text_uthmani: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. And shadow of black smoke,

text_uthmani: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ
translation_text: and a shade of thick, pitch-black smoke,

text_uthmani: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ
translation_text: Wathillin min yahmoom

text_uthmani: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ
translation_text: And shadow of black smoke,

text_uthmani: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ
translation_text: And in the shades of Black Smoke:

text_uthmani: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: neither cool nor graceful.

text_uthmani: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: Neither cool nor beneficial.

text_uthmani: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: neither cool nor refreshing.

text_uthmani: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. (That shadow) neither cool, nor (even) pleasant,

text_uthmani: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: which will neither be cool nor soothing.

text_uthmani: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: La baridin wala kareem

text_uthmani: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: Neither cool nor refreshing.

text_uthmani: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: Nothing (will there be) to refresh, nor to please:

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
translation_text: They were earlier in luxuries,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
translation_text: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
translation_text: Before, they overindulged in luxury

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 45. Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
translation_text: Surely they had lived before in luxury,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
translation_text: Innahum kanoo qabla thalikamutrafeen

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
translation_text: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
translation_text: For that they were wont to be indulged, before that, in wealth (and luxury),

text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: and used to persist in major sins,

text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: And they used to persist in the great violation,1

text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: and persisted in great sin,

text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And were persisting in great sin (joining partners in worship along with Allâh, committing murder and other crimes)1

text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: and had persisted in the Great Sin.1

text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: Wakanoo yusirroona AAalaalhinthi alAAatheem

text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: And used to persist in the awful sin.

text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: And persisted obstinately in wickedness supreme!

text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: and used to say, “Is it that when we die and become dust-is it that we will be raised again,

text_uthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
