translation_text: 22. Is he who walks prone (without seeing) on his face, more rightly guided, or he who (sees and) walks upright on the Straight Way (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism)?

text_uthmani: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
translation_text: Who is better guided: he who walks grovelling on his face,1 or he who walks upright on a Straight Path?

text_uthmani: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
translation_text: Afaman yamshee mukibban AAala wajhihiahda amman yamshee sawiyyan AAala siratinmustaqeem

text_uthmani: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
translation_text: Is he who goeth groping on his face more rightly guided, or he who walketh upright on a straight road?

text_uthmani: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
translation_text: Is then one who walks headlong, with his face grovelling, better guided,- or one who walks evenly on a Straight Way?

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: Say, “He is the One who has originated you, and made for you ears and eyes and hearts. How little you pay gratitude!”

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: Say [Prophet], ‘It is He who brought you into being, He who endowed you with hearing, sight, and understanding- what small thanks you give!’

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. Say it is He Who has created you, and endowed you with hearing (ears) and seeing (eyes), and hearts. Little thanks you give.

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: Say: “He it is Who has brought you into being, and has given you hearing and sight, and has given you hearts to think and understand. How seldom do you give thanks!”1

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: Qul huwa allathee anshaakum wajaAAalalakumu assamAAa wal-absara wal-af-idataqaleelan ma tashkuroon

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He it is who gave you being, and hath assigned unto you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
translation_text: Say: "It is He Who has created you (and made you grow), and made for you the faculties of hearing, seeing, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give.

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
translation_text: Say, “He is the One who has scattered you on the earth, and to Him you will be assembled.”

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
translation_text: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
translation_text: Say, ‘It is He who scattered you throughout the earth, He to whom you will be gathered.’

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. Say: "It is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him shall you be gathered (in the Hereafter)."

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
translation_text: Say: “Allah it is Who multiplied you in the earth and to Him you will be mustered.”1

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
translation_text: Qul huwa allathee tharaakumfee al-ardi wa-ilayhi tuhsharoon

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
translation_text: Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be gathered.

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
translation_text: Say: "It is He Who has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered together."

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: And they say, “When will this promise (of the Day of Judgment) be fulfilled, if you are true?”

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: They say, ‘If what you say is true, when will this promise be fulfilled?’

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. They say: "When will this promise (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) come to pass if you are telling the truth.?"

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: They say: “If you are truthful, tell us when will this promise (of the Hereafter) be fulfilled?”1

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Wayaqooloona mata hathaalwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeen

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?

text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: They ask: When will this promise be (fulfilled)? - If ye are telling the truth.

text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Say, “The knowledge (of that Day) is only with Allah, and I am only a plain warner.

text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."

text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Say, ‘God alone has knowledge of this: my only duty is to give clear warning.’

text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "The knowledge (of its exact time) is with Allâh only, and I am only a plain warner."

text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Say: “Allah alone knows about that; and I am no more than a plain warner.”1

text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Qul innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahiwa-innama ana natheerun mubeen

text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Say: The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner;

text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Say: "As to the knowledge of the time, it is with Allah alone: I am (sent) only to warn plainly in public."

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: Then, once they will see it approaching, the faces of the disbelievers will be turned awkward, and it will be said, “This is what you were calling for!”

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: But when they see it1 approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."2

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: When they see it close at hand, the disbelievers’ faces will be gloomy, and it will be said, ‘This is what you were calling for.’

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: But when they will see it (the torment on the Day of Resurrection) approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will change and turn black with sadness and in grief and it will be said (to them): "This is (the promise) which you were calling for!"

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: When they will see it near at hand, the faces of all those who had denied it will be distraught,1 and then they will be told: “This is the doom which you used to ask for.”

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: Falamma raawhu zulfatan see-atwujoohu allatheena kafaroo waqeela hatha allatheekuntum bihi taddaAAoon

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: But when they see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve will be awry, and it will be said (unto them): This is that for which ye used to call.

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
translation_text: At length, when they see it close at hand, grieved will be the faces of the Unbelievers, and it will be said (to them): "This is (the promise fulfilled), which ye were calling for!"

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Say, “Tell me, if Allah destroys me and those who are with me (as you wish), or has mercy on us (as we wish), who can (in either case) save the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered:1 whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Say, ‘Just think- regardless of whether God destroys me and my followers or has mercy on us- who will protect the disbelievers from an agonizing torment?’

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Tell me! If Allâh destroys me, and those with me, or He bestows His Mercy on us - who can save the disbelievers from a painful torment?"

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Say to them: “Did you ever consider: whether Allah destroys me and those that are with me, or shows mercy to us, who can protect the unbelievers from a grievous chastisement?”1

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Qul araaytum in ahlakaniya Allahuwaman maAAiya aw rahimana faman yujeeru alkafireenamin AAathabin aleem

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Say (O Muhammad): Have ye thought: Whether Allah causeth me (Muhammad) and those with me to perish or hath mercy on us, still, who will protect the disbelievers from a painful doom?

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Say: "See ye?- If Allah were to destroy me, and those with me, or if He bestows His Mercy on us,- yet who can deliver the Unbelievers from a grievous Penalty?"

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Say, “He is the RaHmān; we have believed in Him, and in Him we placed our trust. So, you will soon come to know who is in open error.”

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Say, ‘He is the Lord of Mercy; we believe in Him; we put our trust in Him. You will come to know in time who is in obvious error.’

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. Say: "He is the Most Gracious (Allâh), in Him we believe, and in Him we put our trust. So you will come to know who it is that is in manifest error."

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Say to them: “He is Merciful, and it is in Him that we believe, and it is in Him that we put all our trust.1 Soon will you know who is in manifest error.”

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Qul huwa arrahmanu amannabihi waAAalayhi tawakkalna fasataAAlamoona man huwa fee dalalinmubeen

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Say: He is the Beneficent. In Him we believe and in Him we put our trust. And ye will soon know who it is that is in error manifest.

text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation_text: Say: "He is (Allah) Most Gracious: We have believed in Him, and on Him have we put our trust: So, soon will ye know which (of us) it is that is in manifest error."

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: Say, “Tell me, Should your water vanish into the earth, who will bring you a flowing (stream of) water?

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Tell me! If (all) your water were to sink away, who then can supply you with flowing (spring) water?"

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: Say, ‘Just think: if all your water were to sink deep into the earth who could give you flowing water in its place?’

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: Say to them: “Did you even consider: if all the water that you have (in the wells) were to sink down into the depths of the earth, who will produce for you clear, flowing water?”1

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: Qul araaytum in asbaha maokumghawran faman ya/teekum bima-in maAAeen

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: Say: Have ye thought: If (all) your water were to disappear into the earth, who then could bring you gushing water?

text_uthmani: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
translation_text: Say: "See ye?- If your stream be some morning lost (in the underground earth), who then can supply you with clear-flowing water?"

text_uthmani: نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
translation_text: Nūn , by the pen and what they write,

text_uthmani: نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
translation_text: Nūn.1 By the pen and what they inscribe,

text_uthmani: نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
translation_text: Nun By the pen! By all they write!

text_uthmani: نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Nûn.[These letters (Nun, etc.) are one of the miracles of the Qur’an, and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings].By the pen and by what they (the angels) write (in the Records of men).

text_uthmani: نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
translation_text: Nun. By the pen and what the scribes write.1

text_uthmani: نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
translation_text: Noon walqalami wama yasturoon

text_uthmani: نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
translation_text: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith),

text_uthmani: نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
translation_text: Nun. By the Pen and the (Record) which (men) write,-

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: with the grace of your Lord, you are not insane.

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: Your Lord’s grace does not make you [Prophet] a madman:

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. You (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), by the Grace of your Lord, are not mad.

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: By your Lord's Grace, you are not afflicted with madness,1

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: Ma anta biniAAmati rabbika bimajnoon

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman.

text_uthmani: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: Thou art not, by the Grace of thy Lord, mad or possessed.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: And you will definitely have a reward that will never end.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And Verily, for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) will be an endless reward.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: you will have a never-ending reward––

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: and surely yours shall be a never-ending reward,1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: Wa-inna laka laajran ghayra mamnoon

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: Nay, verily for thee is a Reward unfailing:

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: And you are surely on an excellent standard of character.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: truly you have a strong character––

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And Verily, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are on an exalted (standard of) character.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: and you are certainly on the most exalted standard of moral excellence.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: Wa-innaka laAAala khuluqin AAatheem

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: And thou (standest) on an exalted standard of character.

text_uthmani: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: So, you will see, and they will see

text_uthmani: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: So you will see and they will see

text_uthmani: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. You will see, and they will see,

text_uthmani: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: and soon you will see, as will they,

text_uthmani: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: So you will soon see, and they too will see,

text_uthmani: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: Fasatubsiru wayubsiroon

text_uthmani: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And thou wilt see and they will see

text_uthmani: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: Soon wilt thou see, and they will see,

text_uthmani: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
translation_text: which of you is demented.

text_uthmani: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
translation_text: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].

text_uthmani: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
translation_text: which of you is afflicted with madness.

text_uthmani: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. Which of you is afflicted with madness.

text_uthmani: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
translation_text: which of you is afflicted with madness.

text_uthmani: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
translation_text: Bi-ayyikumu almaftoon

text_uthmani: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
translation_text: Which of you is the demented.

text_uthmani: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
translation_text: Which of you is afflicted with madness.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
translation_text: Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from his way, and He is well aware of those who are on the right path.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. Verily, your Lord is the Best Knower of him who has gone astray from His Path, and He is the Best Knower of those who are guided.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
translation_text: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is rightly guided.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
translation_text: Surely your Lord knows well those who have strayed from His Way just as He knows well those who are on the Right Way.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
translation_text: Inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dallaAAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bilmuhtadeen

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
translation_text: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
translation_text: Verily it is thy Lord that knoweth best, which (among men) hath strayed from His Path: and He knoweth best those who receive (true) Guidance.

text_uthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: So, do not obey those who reject (the true faith.)

text_uthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Then do not obey the deniers.

text_uthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: So do not yield to those who deny the truth––

text_uthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: So (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) obey you not the deniers [(of Islâmic Monotheism - those who belie the Verses of Allâh), the Oneness of Allâh, and the Messengership of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم]1

text_uthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Do not, then, yield to those who reject the Truth, decrying it as false;

text_uthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Fala tutiAAi almukaththibeen

text_uthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Therefor obey not thou the rejecters

text_uthmani: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: So hearken not to those who deny (the Truth).

text_uthmani: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
translation_text: They wish that you become flexible (in your faith), so that they should become flexible (in their hostile attitude.)

text_uthmani: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
translation_text: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].

text_uthmani: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
translation_text: they want you to compromise with them and then they will compromise with you––

text_uthmani: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. They wish that you should compromise (in religion out of courtesy) with them: so they (too) would compromise with you.

text_uthmani: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
translation_text: they would wish you to be pliant so that they too may be pliant.1

text_uthmani: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
translation_text: Waddoo law tudhinu fayudhinoon

text_uthmani: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
translation_text: Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise.

text_uthmani: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
translation_text: Their desire is that thou shouldst be pliant: so would they be pliant.

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: And do not obey any contemptible one who swears much,

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: do not yield to any contemptible swearer,

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. And (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) obey you not everyone Hallaf Mahîn (the one who swears much and is a liar or is worthless). [Tafsir At-Tabari]

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: And do not yield to any contemptible swearer,1

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: Wala tutiAA kulla hallafinmaheen

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger,

text_uthmani: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: Heed not the type of despicable men,- ready with oaths,

text_uthmani: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
translation_text: a slanderer who goes about with calumnies,

text_uthmani: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
translation_text: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -

text_uthmani: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. A slanderer, going about with calumnies,

text_uthmani: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
translation_text: to any backbiter, slander-monger,

text_uthmani: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
translation_text: the fault-finder who goes around slandering,

text_uthmani: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
translation_text: Hammazin mashsha-in binameem

text_uthmani: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
translation_text: Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders,

text_uthmani: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
translation_text: A slanderer, going about with calumnies,

text_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: one who prevents good, (and who is) transgressor, sinful,

text_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,

text_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. Hinderer of the good, transgressor, sinful,

text_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: or hinderer of good, to anyone who is sinful, aggressive,

text_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: the hinderer of good,1 the transgressor, the sinful;2

text_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin atheem

text_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor

text_uthmani: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: (Habitually) hindering (all) good, transgressing beyond bounds, deep in sin,

text_uthmani: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
translation_text: harsh, (and) after all that, notorious,

text_uthmani: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
translation_text: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.1

text_uthmani: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
translation_text: coarse, and on top of all that, an imposter.

text_uthmani: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. Cruel, and moreover base-born (of illegitimate birth).

text_uthmani: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
translation_text: the coarse-grained, and above all mean and ignoble;1

text_uthmani: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
translation_text: AAutullin baAAda thalika zaneem

text_uthmani: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
translation_text: Greedy therewithal, intrusive.

text_uthmani: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
translation_text: Violent (and cruel),- with all that, base-born,-

text_uthmani: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: (do not obey such a person merely) because he is a man of wealth and sons.

text_uthmani: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,

text_uthmani: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: Just because he has wealth and sons,

text_uthmani: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. (He was so) because he had wealth and children.

text_uthmani: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: (who so acts) simply because he has wealth and sons,1

text_uthmani: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: An kana tha malinwabaneen

text_uthmani: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: It is because he is possessed of wealth and children

text_uthmani: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
translation_text: Because he possesses wealth and (numerous) sons.

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “(These are) the tales of the ancient.”

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. When Our Verses (of the Qur’ân) are recited to him, he says: "Tales of the men of old!"

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: when our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘These are just ancient fables.’

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: and whenever Our verses are rehearsed to him, he says: “These are fairy- tales of times gone by.”

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatunaqala asateeru al-awwaleen

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: When to him are rehearsed Our Signs, "Tales of the ancients", he cries!

text_uthmani: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
translation_text: We will soon brand him on the snout.

text_uthmani: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
translation_text: We will brand him upon the snout.1

text_uthmani: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
translation_text: We shall brand him on the snout!

text_uthmani: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: We shall brand him on the snout (nose)!

text_uthmani: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
translation_text: Soon shall We brand him on his snout.1

text_uthmani: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
translation_text: Sanasimuhu AAala alkhurtoom

text_uthmani: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
translation_text: We shall brand him on the nose.

text_uthmani: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
translation_text: Soon shall We brand (the beast) on the snout!

text_uthmani: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: We have tested them as We had tested the Owners of the Garden, when they had sworn an oath that they would pluck its fruits on the next morning,

text_uthmani: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning

text_uthmani: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. Verily, We have tried them as We tried the people of the garden, when they swore to pluck the fruits of the (garden) in the morning,

text_uthmani: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: We have tried them as We tried the owners of a certain garden, who swore that they would harvest its fruits in the morning

text_uthmani: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: We have put them [i.e., the Makkans] to test even as We put to test the owners of the orchard1 when they vowed that they would gather the fruit of their orchard in the morning,

text_uthmani: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: Inna balawnahum kamabalawna as-haba aljannati ith aqsamoolayasrimunnaha musbiheen

text_uthmani: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning,

text_uthmani: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: Verily We have tried them as We tried the People of the Garden, when they resolved to gather the fruits of the (garden) in the morning.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
translation_text: and did not make any exception (by saying inshā’allāh ).

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
translation_text: Without making exception.1

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
translation_text: and made no allowance [for the Will of God]:

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. Without saying: Inshâ’ Allâh (If Allâh wills).

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
translation_text: without making any allowance (for the will of Allah).1

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
translation_text: Wala yastathnoon

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
translation_text: And made no exception (for the Will of Allah);

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
translation_text: But made no reservation, ("If it be Allah's Will").

text_uthmani: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: Then, there whirled around it a whirl (of calamity) from your Lord, while they were asleep.

text_uthmani: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.

text_uthmani: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. Then there passed by on the (garden) a visitation (fire) from your Lord at night and burnt it while they were asleep.

text_uthmani: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: a disaster from your Lord struck the garden as they slept

text_uthmani: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: Thereupon a calamity from your Lord passed over it while they were asleep,

text_uthmani: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: Fatafa AAalayha ta-ifunmin rabbika wahum na-imoon

text_uthmani: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept

text_uthmani: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: Then there came on the (garden) a visitation from thy Lord, (which swept away) all around, while they were asleep.

text_uthmani: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
translation_text: Thus, on the next morning, it was like a harvested field.

text_uthmani: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
translation_text: And it became as though reaped.

text_uthmani: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. So the (garden) became black by the morning, like a pitch dark night (in complete ruins).

text_uthmani: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
translation_text: and by morning it was stripped bare, a desolate land.

text_uthmani: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
translation_text: and so by morning the orchard lay as though it had been fully harvested.

text_uthmani: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
translation_text: Faasbahat kassareem

text_uthmani: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
translation_text: And in the morning it was as if plucked.

text_uthmani: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
translation_text: So the (garden) became, by the morning, like a dark and desolate spot, (whose fruit had been gathered).

text_uthmani: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: So, they called out each other as the morning broke,

text_uthmani: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: And they called one another at morning,

text_uthmani: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. Then they called out one to another as soon as the morning broke.

text_uthmani: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: Still they called each other at daybreak,

text_uthmani: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: At daybreak they called out to one another:

text_uthmani: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: Fatanadaw musbiheen

text_uthmani: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: And they cried out one unto another in the morning,

text_uthmani: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
translation_text: As the morning broke, they called out, one to another,-

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
translation_text: saying, “Set out early, if you are going to pluck (the fruits).”

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
translation_text: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
translation_text: ‘Go early to your field if you wish to gather all its fruits,’

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. Saying: "Go to your tilth in the morning, if you would pluck the fruits."

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
translation_text: “Hurry to your orchard1 if you would gather its fruit.”

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
translation_text: Ani ighdoo AAala harthikum inkuntum sarimeen

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
translation_text: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit).

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
translation_text: "Go ye to your tilth (betimes) in the morning, if ye would gather the fruits."

text_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ
فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ
translation_text: So they set out while they were whispering to each other,

text_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ
translation_text: So they set out, while lowering their voices,

text_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ
translation_text: and went off, whispering,

text_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. So they departed, conversing in secret low tones (saying):

text_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ
translation_text: So off they went, whispering to one another:

text_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ
translation_text: Fantalaqoo wahum yatakhafatoon

text_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ
translation_text: So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones:

text_uthmani: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ
translation_text: So they departed, conversing in secret low tones, (saying)-

text_uthmani: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
translation_text: saying, “Let no poor man enter into it upon you today.”

text_uthmani: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
translation_text: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."

text_uthmani: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
translation_text: ‘Make sure no poor person enters the garden today!’––

text_uthmani: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. "No Miskîn (poor man) shall enter upon you into it today."

text_uthmani: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
translation_text: “No destitute person shall enter it today.”

text_uthmani: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
translation_text: An la yadkhulannaha alyawmaAAalaykum miskeen

text_uthmani: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
translation_text: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you.

text_uthmani: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
translation_text: "Let not a single indigent person break in upon you into the (garden) this day."

text_uthmani: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ
وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ
translation_text: And in early hours they rushed quickly, while they were (assuming themselves) powerful (to pluck the fruits and prevent the poor.)

text_uthmani: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ
translation_text: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.1

text_uthmani: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ
translation_text: they left early, bent on their purpose-

text_uthmani: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. And they went in the morning with strong intention, thinking that they have power (to prevent the poor taking anything of the fruits therefrom).

text_uthmani: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ
translation_text: They went forth early, believing that they had the power (to gather the fruit).1

text_uthmani: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ
translation_text: Waghadaw AAala hardin qadireen

text_uthmani: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ
translation_text: They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose.

text_uthmani: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ
translation_text: And they opened the morning, strong in an (unjust) resolve.

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: But when they saw it (the place of the ruined garden), they said, “We have missed the way.”

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. But when they saw the (garden), they said: "Verily, we have gone astray."

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: but when they saw the garden, they said, ‘We must have lost our way!

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: But as soon as they beheld the orchard, (they cried out): “We have certainly lost the way;

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: Falamma raawha qalooinna ladalloon

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error!

text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: But when they saw the (garden), they said: "We have surely lost our way:

text_uthmani: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
translation_text: (Then, once they realized that the garden is the same, but it has been destroyed, they said,) “No, but we are deprived (of the fruits).”

text_uthmani: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
translation_text: Rather, we have been deprived."

text_uthmani: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. (Then they said): "Nay! Indeed we are deprived of (the fruits)!"

text_uthmani: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
translation_text: No- we are ruined!’

text_uthmani: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
translation_text: rather, we are utterly ruined.”1

text_uthmani: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
translation_text: Bal nahnu mahroomoon

text_uthmani: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
translation_text: Nay, but we are desolate!

text_uthmani: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
translation_text: "Indeed we are shut out (of the fruits of our labour)!"

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: Said he who was the best among them, “Did I not say to you, ‘Why do you not pronounce tasbīH (Allah’s purity)?”

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"1

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. The best among them said: "Did I not tell you: why say you not: Inshâ’ Allâh (If Allâh wills)."

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: The wisest of them said, ‘Did I not say to you, “Will you not glorify God?”’-

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: The best among them said: “Did I not say to you: why do you not give glory to (your Lord)?”1

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: Qala awsatuhum alam aqul lakumlawla tusabbihoon

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?

text_uthmani: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
translation_text: Said one of them, more just (than the rest): "Did I not say to you, 'Why not glorify (Allah)?'"

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: They said, “We pronounce the purity of our Lord. No doubt, we were wrongdoers.”

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. They said: "Glory to Our Lord! Verily, we have been Zâlimûn (wrong-doers)."

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: they said, ‘Glory be to God, Our Lord! Truly, we were doing wrong!’-

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: They cried out: “Glory be to our Lord! Certainly we were sinners.”

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: Qaloo subhana rabbinainna kunna thalimeen

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation_text: They said: "Glory to our Lord! Verily we have been doing wrong!"

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ
فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ
translation_text: Then, (at the beginning,) they started reproaching one another;

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ
translation_text: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. Then they turned one against another, blaming.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ
translation_text: and then they turned to each other in mutual reproach.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ
translation_text: Then they began to reproach one another.1

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ
translation_text: Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdinyatalawamoon

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ
translation_text: Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching.

text_uthmani: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ
translation_text: Then they turned, one against another, in reproach.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ
قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: (and at last,) they said, “Woe to us! In fact, we (all) were outrageous.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: They said, ‘Alas for us! We have done terrible wrong,

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. They said: "Woe to us! Verily, we were Tâghûn (transgressors and disobedient)

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: They said: “Woe to us! We had indeed transgressed.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: Qaloo ya waylana innakunna tagheen

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ
translation_text: They said: "Alas for us! We have indeed transgressed!

text_uthmani: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
translation_text: We hope that our Lord will give us in exchange something better than this. Truly we turn to Allah.”

text_uthmani: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
translation_text: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."1

text_uthmani: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. We hope that our Lord will give us in exchange a better (garden) than this. Truly, we turn to our Lord (wishing for good that He may forgive our sins and reward us in the Hereafter).

text_uthmani: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
translation_text: but maybe our Lord will give us something better in its place: we truly turn to Him in hope.’

text_uthmani: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
translation_text: Maybe our Lord will give us a better orchard in its place; to our Lord do we penitently turn.”

text_uthmani: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
translation_text: AAasa rabbuna an yubdilanakhayran minha inna ila rabbina raghiboon

text_uthmani: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
translation_text: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord.

text_uthmani: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
translation_text: "It may be that our Lord will give us in exchange a better (garden) than this: for we do turn to Him (in repentance)!"

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: In this way the punishment comes. And, of course, the punishment of the Hereafter is even greater, if they but realize!

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. Such is the punishment (in this life), but truly, the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they but knew.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Such is the punishment [in this life], but greater still is the punishment in the Hereafter, if only they knew.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Such is the chastisement; and the chastisement of the Hereafter is assuredly even greater, if only they knew.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Kathalika alAAathabu walaAAathabual-akhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoon

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Such is the Punishment (in this life); but greater is the Punishment in the Hereafter,- if only they knew!

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: Surely, for the God-fearing there are gardens of bliss.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: There will be Gardens of bliss for those who are mindful of God.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 34. Verily, for the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) are Gardens of delight (Paradise) with their Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: Surely1 the God-fearing shall have Gardens of bliss with their Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: Inna lilmuttaqeena AAinda rabbihim jannatiannaAAeem

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: Verily, for the Righteous, are Gardens of Delight, in the Presence of their Lord.

text_uthmani: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Otherwise, shall We make the obedient like the sinners?

text_uthmani: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

text_uthmani: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 35. Shall We then treat the Muslims (believers of Islamic Monotheism, doers of righteous deeds) like the Mujrimûn (criminals, polytheists and disbelievers, etc.)?

text_uthmani: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Should We treat those who submit to Us as We treat those who do evil?

text_uthmani: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: What! Shall We treat those who have submitted (to Our command) like those who have acted as criminals?

text_uthmani: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: AfanajAAalu almuslimeena kalmujrimeen

text_uthmani: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty?

text_uthmani: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Shall We then treat the People of Faith like the People of Sin?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: What has happened to you? How do you judge?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: What is the matter with you? On what basis do you judge?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. What is the matter with you? How judge you?

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: What is the matter with you? How ill do you judge!1

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: Ma lakum kayfa tahkumoon

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge!

text_uthmani: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
translation_text: Do you have a book in which you read

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
translation_text: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
translation_text: Do you have a Scripture that tells you

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. Or have you a Book wherein you learn,

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
translation_text: Or do you have a Book1 wherein you read

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
translation_text: Am lakum kitabun feehi tadrusoon

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
translation_text: Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
translation_text: Or have ye a book through which ye learn-

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
translation_text: that for you there is what you choose?

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
translation_text: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
translation_text: that you will be granted whatever you choose?

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. That you shall therein have all that you choose?

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
translation_text: that (in the Hereafter) you shall have all that you choose for yourselves?

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
translation_text: Inna lakum feehi lama takhayyaroon

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
translation_text: That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose?

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
translation_text: That ye shall have, through it whatever ye choose?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: Or do you have oaths sworn by Us, remaining effective up to the Day of Judgment, that you will get what you decide?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. Or have you oaths from Us, reaching to the Day of Resurrection, that yours will be what you judge?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: Have you received from Us solemn oaths, binding to the Day of Resurrection, that you will get whatever you yourselves decide?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: Or have We sworn a covenant with you which We are bound to keep till the Day of Resurrection, (a covenant requiring that whatever you ordain for yourselves shall be yours)?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: Am lakum aymanun AAalayna balighatunila yawmi alqiyamati inna lakum lama tahkumoon

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain?

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
translation_text: Or have ye Covenants with Us to oath, reaching to the Day of Judgment, (providing) that ye shall have whatever ye shall demand?

text_uthmani: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
translation_text: Ask them which of them stands surety for that.

text_uthmani: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
translation_text: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.

text_uthmani: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
translation_text: Ask them [Prophet] which of them will guarantee this.

text_uthmani: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. Ask them, which of them will stand surety for that!

text_uthmani: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
translation_text: Ask them: “Which of them can guarantee that?1

text_uthmani: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
translation_text: Salhum ayyuhum bithalika zaAAeem

text_uthmani: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
translation_text: Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that!

text_uthmani: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
translation_text: Ask thou of them, which of them will stand surety for that!

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Or do they have associate-gods (who have guaranteed safety for them)? Then, let them bring their associate-gods, if they are true.

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Or do they have partners?1 Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. Or have they "partners"? Then let them bring their "partners" if they are truthful!

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Do they have ‘partners’ [besides God]? Let them produce their ‘partners’, if what they say is true.

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Or has something been guaranteed by any of those whom they associate with Allah in His Divinity?” If so, let them bring forth their associates, if they are truthful.1

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Am lahum shurakao falya/too bishuraka-ihimin kanoo sadiqeen

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful

text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
translation_text: Or have they some “ Partners ” (in Godhead)? Then let them produce Their “ partners ”,  If they are truthful !

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: On the Day when the Shin will be exposed, and they will be called upon to prostrate themselves, they will not be able to.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: The Day the shin will be uncovered1 and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: (Remember) the Day when the Shin1 shall be laid bare (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) and they shall be called to prostrate themselves (to Allâh), but they (hypocrites) shall not be able to do so.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: On the Day when matters become dire, they will be invited to prostrate themselves but will be prevented from doing so,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: On the Day when the dreadful calamity will unfold,1 when people will be summoned to prostrate themselves, and yet they will not be able to prostrate.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: Yawma yukshafu AAan saqin wayudAAawnaila assujoodi fala yastateeAAoon

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
translation_text: The Day that the shin shall be laid bare, and they shall be summoned to bow in adoration, but they shall not be able,-

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
translation_text: With their eyes downcast, they will be enveloped by ignominy. They used to be called upon to prostrate when they were healthy (but they did not.)

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
translation_text: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.1

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
translation_text: and their eyes will be downcast and they will be overwhelmed with shame: they were invited to prostrate themselves when they were safe [but refused].

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Their eyes will be cast down and ignominy will cover them; they used to be called to prostrate themselves (offer prayers), while they were healthy and good (in the life of the world, but they did not).

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
translation_text: Their eyes shall be downcast and ignominy shall overwhelm them. For when they were safe and sound, they were summoned to prostrate themselves, (and they refused).1

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
translation_text: KhashiAAatan absaruhumtarhaquhum thillatun waqad kanoo yudAAawna ilaassujoodi wahum salimoon

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
translation_text: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt.

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
translation_text: Their eyes will be cast down,- ignominy will cover them; seeing that they had been summoned aforetime to bow in adoration, while they were whole, (and had refused).

text_uthmani: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: So, leave Me alone with those who reject this discourse. We will draw them on little by little (towards Hell) from a way they do not know.

text_uthmani: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.1

text_uthmani: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: So [Prophet] leave those who reject this revelation to Me: We shall lead them on, step by step, in ways beyond their knowledge;

text_uthmani: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. Then leave Me Alone with such as belie this Qur’ân. We shall punish them gradually from directions they perceive not.

text_uthmani: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: So leave Me, (O Prophet), to deal with him who gives the lie to this Discourse.1 We shall draw them little by little (to their undoing) in a way that they will not know.2

text_uthmani: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Fatharnee waman yukaththibubihatha alhadeethi sanastadrijuhum min haythula yaAAlamoon

text_uthmani: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not.

text_uthmani: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Then leave Me alone with such as reject this Message: by degrees shall We punish them from directions they perceive not.

text_uthmani: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
translation_text: And I give them respite. Indeed, My plan is firm.

text_uthmani: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
translation_text: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.

text_uthmani: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
translation_text: I will allow them more time, for My plan is powerful.

text_uthmani: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 45. And I will grant them a respite. Verily, My Plan is strong.

text_uthmani: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
translation_text: I am giving them a respite. Great is My scheme!1

text_uthmani: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
translation_text: Waomlee lahum inna kaydee mateen

text_uthmani: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
translation_text: Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm.

text_uthmani: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
translation_text: A (long) respite will I grant them: truly powerful is My Plan.

text_uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
translation_text: Is it that you ask them for a fee, due to which they are burdened with debt?

text_uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
translation_text: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

text_uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 46. Or is it that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) ask them a wage, so that they are heavily burdened with debt?

text_uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
