translation_text: Do you demand some reward from them that would burden them with debt?

text_uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
translation_text: Or are you asking them for some compensation so that they feel burdened with debt?1

text_uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
translation_text: Am tas-aluhum ajran fahum min maghraminmuthqaloon

text_uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
translation_text: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed?

text_uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
translation_text: Or is it that thou dost ask them for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
translation_text: Or do they have the (knowledge of the) Unseen, and they write it down?

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
translation_text: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 47. Or that the Ghaib (the Unseen - here in this Verse it means Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz) is in their hands, so that they can write it down?

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
translation_text: Do they have knowledge of the unseen that enables them to write it down?

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
translation_text: Or do they have any knowledge of the Unseen which they are now writing down?1

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
translation_text: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboon

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
translation_text: Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)?

text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
translation_text: Or that the Unseen is in their hands, so that they can write it down?

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
translation_text: So, remain patient with your Lord’s judgment, and be not like the Man of the Fish, he cried out while he was in anguish.

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
translation_text: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muḥammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 48. So wait with patience for the Decision of your Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish - when he cried out (to Us) while he was in deep sorrow. (See the Qur’ân, Verse 21:87).

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
translation_text: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: do not be like the man in the whale who called out in distress:

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
translation_text: So bear with patience until the Judgement of your Lord1 comes, and do not belike the man in the fish (i.e., Jonah)2 who called out, choking with grief:3

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
translation_text: Fasbir lihukmi rabbikawala takun kasahibi alhooti ith nadawahuwa makthoom

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
translation_text: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair.

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
translation_text: So wait with patience for the Command of thy Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish,- when he cried out in agony.

text_uthmani: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
translation_text: Had not a favour from His Lord come to his help, he would have been cast in the wilderness in a reproachable state.

text_uthmani: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
translation_text: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.1

text_uthmani: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
translation_text: if his Lord’s grace had not reached him, he would have been left, abandoned and blameworthy, on the barren shore,

text_uthmani: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 49. Had not a Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been (left in the stomach of the fish, but We forgave him): so he was cast off on the naked shore, while he was to be blamed.

text_uthmani: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
translation_text: had his Lord not bestowed His favour upon him, he would have been cast upon that barren shore (and would have remained there) in disgrace.1

text_uthmani: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
translation_text: Lawla an tadarakahu niAAmatunmin rabbihi lanubitha bilAAara-i wahuwa mathmoom

text_uthmani: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
translation_text: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.

text_uthmani: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
translation_text: Had not Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been cast off on the naked shore, in disgrace.

text_uthmani: فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: Then his Lord chose him, and made him one of the righteous.

text_uthmani: فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

text_uthmani: فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: but his Lord chose him and made him one of the Righteous.

text_uthmani: فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 50. Then his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

text_uthmani: فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: But his Lord exalted him, and included him among His righteous servants.

text_uthmani: فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: Fajtabahu rabbuhu fajaAAalahumina assaliheen

text_uthmani: فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous.

text_uthmani: فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
translation_text: Thus did his Lord choose him and make him of the Company of the Righteous.

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: And indeed the disbelievers seem to trip you up with their glances when they hear the Reminder, and say, “He is a madman indeed.”

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: The disbelievers almost strike you down with their looks when they hear the Quran. They say, ‘He must be mad!’

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 51. And verily, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes (through hatred) when they hear the Reminder (the Qur’ân), and they say: "Verily, he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a madman!"

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: When the unbelievers hear this Exhortation, they look at you as though they would knock you off your feet with their (hostile) glances.1 They say: “Surely he is afflicted with madness”;

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: Wa-in yakadu allatheenakafaroo layuzliqoonaka bi-absarihim lamma samiAAooaththikra wayaqooloona innahu lamajnoon

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;

text_uthmani: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
translation_text: And the Unbelievers would almost trip thee up with their eyes when they hear the Message; and they say: "Surely he is possessed!"

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And it is nothing else but a Reminder for all the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 52. But it is nothing else than a Reminder to all the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, and jinn).

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: but truly it is nothing other than a Reminder for all peoples.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: although this is nothing but an Exhortation (to goodness) for everyone in the world.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Wama huwa illa thikrunlilAAalameen

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: But it is nothing less than a Message to all the worlds.

text_uthmani: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: The Imminent Happening!

text_uthmani: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: The Inevitable Reality -

text_uthmani: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: The Inevitable Hour!

text_uthmani: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. The Inevitable (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)!

text_uthmani: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: The indubitable event!1

text_uthmani: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: Alhaqqa

text_uthmani: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: The Reality!

text_uthmani: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: The Sure Reality!

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: What is the Imminent Happening?

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: What is the Inevitable Reality?

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: What is the Inevitable Hour?

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. What is the Inevitable?

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: And what is that indubitable event?

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: Ma alhaqqa

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: What is the Reality?

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: What is the Sure Reality?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: And what can let you know what the Imminent happening is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And what will make you know what the Inevitable is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: What will explain to you what the Inevitable Hour is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: And what do you know what that indubitable event is?1

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: Wama adraka ma alhaqqa

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
translation_text: And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is?

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
translation_text: Thamūd and ‘Ād had denied (the happening of) the Shocking Event (the Day of Judgment).

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
translation_text: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. Thamûd and ‘Âd people denied the Qâri‘ah (the striking Hour of Judgement)!

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
translation_text: The people of Thamud and 'Ad denied that the crashing blow would come:

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
translation_text: The Thamud1 and the Ad denied the (possibility of a) sudden calamity,2 calling it false.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
translation_text: Kaththabat thamoodu waAAadun bilqariAAa

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
translation_text: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
translation_text: The Thamud and the 'Ad People (branded) as false the Stunning Calamity!

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
translation_text: As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by that (dreadful cry), which exceeded all limits.

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
translation_text: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
translation_text: Thamud was destroyed by a deafening blast;

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by the awful cry!

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
translation_text: Then the Thamud were destroyed by an awesome upheaval;1

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
translation_text: Faamma thamoodu faohlikoo bittaghiya

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
translation_text: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning.

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
translation_text: But the Thamud,- they were destroyed by a terrible Storm of thunder and lightning!

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
translation_text: And as for ‘Ād, they were destroyed by a violent windstorm

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
translation_text: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming,1 violent wind

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
translation_text: Ad was destroyed by a furious wind

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. And as for ‘Âd, they were destroyed by a furious violent wind!

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
translation_text: and the Ad were destroyed by a furiously raging wind-storm

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
translation_text: Waamma AAadun faohlikoo bireehinsarsarin AAatiya

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
translation_text: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
translation_text: And the 'Ad, they were destroyed by a furious Wind, exceedingly violent;

text_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
translation_text: that He imposed on them for seven nights and eight consecutive days; so you could see them thrown on the ground, as if they were trunks of hollow palm-trees.

text_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
translation_text: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

text_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
translation_text: that God let loose against them for seven consecutive nights, eight consecutive days, so that you could have seen its people lying dead like hollow palm-trunks.

text_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. Which Allâh imposed on them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so that you could see men lying overthrown (destroyed), as if they were hollow trunks of date-palms!

text_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
translation_text: which He let loose upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession; so that (if you had been there) you might have seen people lying prostrate, as though they were uprooted trunks of hollowed palm trees.

text_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
translation_text: Sakhkharaha AAalayhim sabAAa layalinwathamaniyata ayyamin husooman fataraalqawma feeha sarAAa kaannahum aAAjazunakhlin khawiya

text_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
translation_text: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.

text_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
translation_text: He made it rage against them seven nights and eight days in succession: so that thou couldst see the (whole) people lying prostrate in its (path), as they had been roots of hollow palm-trees tumbled down!

text_uthmani: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
translation_text: Now, do you see any remnant of them?

text_uthmani: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
translation_text: Then do you see of them any remains?

text_uthmani: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
translation_text: Can you see any trace of them now?

text_uthmani: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. Do you see any remnants of them?

text_uthmani: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
translation_text: Do you now see any trace of them?

text_uthmani: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
translation_text: Fahal tara lahum min baqiya

text_uthmani: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
translation_text: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?

text_uthmani: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
translation_text: Then seest thou any of them left surviving?

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
translation_text: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and those before him and the overthrown towns came up with evil,

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
translation_text: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities1 with sin.

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
translation_text: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), and those before him, and the cities overthrown [the towns of the people of [Lût (Lot)] committed sin.

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
translation_text: Pharaoh and those before him and the people of the overturned habitations1 all engaged in the same great sin.

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
translation_text: Wajaa firAAawnu waman qablahu walmu/tafikatubilkhati-a

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
translation_text: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
translation_text: And Pharaoh, and those before him, and the Cities Overthrown, committed habitual Sin.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
translation_text: and they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an extremely severe seizure.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
translation_text: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].

text_uthmani: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
translation_text: these people committed grave sins and disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an ever-tightening grip.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. And they disobeyed their Lord’s Messenger, so He seized them with a strong punishment.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
translation_text: They did not follow the Messenger of their Lord, and so He seized them with a severe grip.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
translation_text: FaAAasaw rasoola rabbihim faakhathahumakhthatan rabiya

text_uthmani: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
translation_text: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
translation_text: And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
translation_text: When the water overflowed (in the Deluge of NūH), We let you (O mankind,) board the floating ship,

text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
translation_text: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship1

text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
translation_text: But when the Flood rose high, We saved you in the floating ship,

text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Verily, when the water rose beyond its limits [Nûh’s (Noah) Flood], We carried you (mankind) in the floating [ship that was constructed by Nûh (Noah)]

text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
translation_text: Verily when the water rose to great heights,1 We bore you upon a floating vessel (i.e. the Ark)2

text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
translation_text: Inna lamma taghaalmao hamalnakum fee aljariya

text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
translation_text: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship

text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
translation_text: We, when the water (of Noah's Flood) overflowed beyond its limits, carried you (mankind), in the floating (Ark),

text_uthmani: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
translation_text: so that We make it a reminder for you, and so that a preserving ear (that hears their story) may preserve it.

text_uthmani: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
translation_text: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

text_uthmani: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. That We might make it (Noah’s ship) an admonition for you and that it might be retained by the retaining ears.

text_uthmani: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
translation_text: making that event a reminder for you: attentive ears may take heed.

text_uthmani: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
translation_text: so that We might make it an instructive event for you, and retentive ears might preserve its memory.1

text_uthmani: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
translation_text: LinajAAalaha lakum tathkiratanwataAAiyaha othunun waAAiya

text_uthmani: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
translation_text: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.

text_uthmani: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
translation_text: That We might make it a Message unto you, and that ears (that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: Then, once the Trumpet will be blown for the first time,

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: When the Trumpet is sounded a single time,

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. Then when the Trumpet will be blown with one blowing (the first one).

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: So1 when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: Fa-itha nufikha fee assoorinafkhatun wahida

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: Then, when one blast is sounded on the Trumpet,

text_uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
translation_text: and the earth and the mountains will be lifted and crushed into pieces with a single blow,

text_uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
translation_text: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -

text_uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
translation_text: when the earth and its mountains are raised high and then crushed with a single blow,

text_uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. And the earth and the mountains shall be removed from their places, and crushed with a single crushing.

text_uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
translation_text: and the earth and the mountains are carried aloft and are crushed to bits at one stroke,

text_uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
translation_text: Wahumilati al-ardu waljibalufadukkata dakkatan wahida

text_uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
translation_text: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,

text_uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
translation_text: And the earth is moved, and its mountains, and they are crushed to powder at one stroke,-

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: then on that Day the Happening will happen,

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. Then on that Day shall the (Great) Event befall.

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: on that Day the Great Event will come to pass.

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: on that Day shall that indubitable event come to pass;

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: Fayawma-ithin waqaAAati alwaqiAAa

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: Then, on that day will the Event befall.

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
translation_text: On that Day shall the (Great) Event come to pass.

text_uthmani: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
translation_text: and the sky will burst apart, while it will have become frail on that day.

text_uthmani: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
translation_text: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.1

text_uthmani: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
translation_text: The sky will be torn apart on that Day, it will be so frail.

text_uthmani: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. And the heaven will be rent asunder, for that Day it (the heaven) will be frail and torn up.

text_uthmani: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
translation_text: when the sky will be rent asunder, the grip holding it together having loosened on that Day,

text_uthmani: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
translation_text: Wanshaqqati assamaofahiya yawma-ithin wahiya

text_uthmani: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
translation_text: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.

text_uthmani: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
translation_text: And the sky will be rent asunder, for it will that Day be flimsy,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
translation_text: And the angels will be on its borders. And on that Day, the Throne of your Lord will be carried above them by eight (angels).

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
translation_text: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
translation_text: The angels will be on all sides of it and, on that Day, eight of them will bear the throne of your Lord above them.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. And the angels will be on its sides, and eight angels will, that Day, bear the Throne of your Lord above them.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
translation_text: and the angels will stand on the sides, with eight of them bearing aloft the Throne1 of your Lord on that Day.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
translation_text: Walmalaku AAala arja-ihawayahmilu AAarsha rabbika fawqahum yawma-ithin thamaniya

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
translation_text: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
translation_text: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight will, that Day, bear the Throne of thy Lord above them.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
translation_text: On that day, you will be brought forward in a way that no secret of yours will remain secret.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
translation_text: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
translation_text: On that Day you will be brought to judgement and none of your secrets will remain hidden.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. That Day shall you be brought to Judgement, not a secret of you will be hidden.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
translation_text: That will be the Day when you shall be brought forth (before Allah) and no secret of yours shall remain hidden.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
translation_text: Yawma-ithin tuAAradoona latakhfa minkum khafiya

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
translation_text: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
translation_text: That Day shall ye be brought to Judgment: not an act of yours that ye hide will be hidden.

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: Now, as for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say (to his colleagues), “Come here, read my book.

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: Anyone who is given his Record in his right hand will say, ‘Here is my Record, read it.

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Here! read my Record!

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: On that Day, he whose Record is given to him in his right hand1 will say: “Lo! Read my Record!2

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: Faamma man ootiya kitabahubiyameenihi fayaqoolu haomu iqraoo kitabiyah

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record!

text_uthmani: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: I was sure that I would encounter my reckoning.”

text_uthmani: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."

text_uthmani: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: I knew I would meet my Reckoning,’

text_uthmani: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. "Surely, I did believe that I shall meet my Account!"

text_uthmani: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: Verily I was sure that I would be handed over my account.”1

text_uthmani: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: Innee thanantu annee mulaqinhisabiyah

text_uthmani: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning.

text_uthmani: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: "I did really understand that my Account would (One Day) reach me!"

text_uthmani: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
translation_text: So he will be in a well-pleasing life

text_uthmani: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
translation_text: So he will be in a pleasant life -

text_uthmani: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
translation_text: and so he will have a pleasant life

text_uthmani: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. So he shall be in a life, well-pleasing.

text_uthmani: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
translation_text: Then he shall find himself in a life of bliss;

text_uthmani: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
translation_text: Fahuwa fee AAeeshatin radiya

text_uthmani: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
translation_text: Then he will be in blissful state

text_uthmani: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
translation_text: And he will be in a life of Bliss,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
translation_text: in a lofty garden,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
translation_text: In an elevated garden,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
translation_text: in a lofty Garden,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. In a lofty Paradise,

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
translation_text: in a lofty Garden

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
translation_text: Fee jannatin AAaliya

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
translation_text: In a high garden

text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
translation_text: In a Garden on high,

text_uthmani: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
translation_text: the fruits of which will be close at hand.

text_uthmani: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
translation_text: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.

text_uthmani: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
translation_text: with clustered fruit within his reach.

text_uthmani: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. The fruits in bunches whereof will be low and near at hand.

text_uthmani: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
translation_text: the clusters of whose fruit will be hanging low to be within reach (of the inmates of Paradise).

text_uthmani: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
translation_text: Qutoofuha daniya

text_uthmani: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
translation_text: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach.

text_uthmani: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
translation_text: The Fruits whereof (will hang in bunches) low and near.

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
translation_text: (It will be said to such people,) “Eat and drink with pleasure, as a reward for what you did in advance during past days.”

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
translation_text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth1 in the days past."

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
translation_text: It will be said, ‘Eat and drink to your heart’s content as a reward for what you have done in days gone by.’

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. Eat and drink at ease for that which you have sent on before you in days past!

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
translation_text: (They will be told): “Eat and drink with good cheer as a reward for the good deeds you did in the days that have passed by.”

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
translation_text: Kuloo washraboo hanee-an bimaaslaftum fee al-ayyami alkhaliya

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
translation_text: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
translation_text: "Eat ye and drink ye, with full satisfaction; because of the (good) that ye sent before you, in the days that are gone!"

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: As for him who will be given his book in his left hand, he will say, “ Oh, would that I had not been given my book,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: But anyone who is given his Record in his left hand will say, ‘If only I had never been given any Record

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. But as for him who will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "I wish that I had not been given my Record!

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: As for him whose Record will be given to him in his left hand,1 he will exclaim: “Would that I had never been given my Record,2

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: Waamma man ootiya kitabahubishimalihi fayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oota kitabiyah

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
translation_text: And he that will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "Ah! Would that my Record had not been given to me!

text_uthmani: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: and I had never known what my account is!

text_uthmani: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: And had not known what is my account.

text_uthmani: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: and knew nothing of my Reckoning.

text_uthmani: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. "And that I had never known how my Account is!

text_uthmani: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: and had not known my account.1

text_uthmani: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: Walam adri ma hisabiyah

text_uthmani: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: And knew not what my reckoning!

text_uthmani: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
translation_text: "And that I had never realised how my account (stood)!

text_uthmani: يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
translation_text: Oh, would that it (death) had been the end of the matter!

text_uthmani: يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
translation_text: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.1

text_uthmani: يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
translation_text: How I wish death had been the end of me.

text_uthmani: يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. "Would that it had been my end (death)!

text_uthmani: يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
translation_text: Oh! Would that the death that came to me in the world had made an end of me!1

text_uthmani: يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
translation_text: Ya laytaha kanati alqadiya

text_uthmani: يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
translation_text: Oh, would that it had been death!

text_uthmani: يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
translation_text: "Ah! Would that (Death) had made an end of me!

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
translation_text: My wealth has not been of any use to me.

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
translation_text: My wealth has not availed me.

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
translation_text: My wealth has been no use to me,

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. "My wealth has not availed me;

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
translation_text: My riches have not availed me,

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
translation_text: Ma aghna AAannee maliyah

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
translation_text: My wealth hath not availed me,

text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
translation_text: "Of no profit to me has been my wealth!

text_uthmani: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ
هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ
translation_text: My power has gone from me for good.”

text_uthmani: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ
translation_text: Gone from me is my authority."1

text_uthmani: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ
translation_text: and my power has vanished.’

text_uthmani: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. "My power (and arguments to defend myself) have gone from me!"

text_uthmani: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ
translation_text: and my authority has vanished.”1

text_uthmani: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ
translation_text: Halaka AAannee sultaniyah

text_uthmani: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ
translation_text: My power hath gone from me.

text_uthmani: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ
translation_text: "My power has perished from me!"...

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
translation_text: (Then it will be said to angels,) “Seize him, then put a collar around his neck,

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
translation_text: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
translation_text: ‘Take him, put a collar on him,

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. (It will be said): "Seize him and fetter him;

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
translation_text: (A command will be issued): “Seize him and shackle him,

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
translation_text: Khuthoohu faghullooh

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
translation_text: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him

text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
translation_text: (The stern command will say): "Seize ye him, and bind ye him,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
translation_text: and then, let him burn in the blazing fire.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
translation_text: Then into Hellfire drive him.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. Then throw him in the blazing Fire.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
translation_text: lead him to burn in the blazing Fire,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
translation_text: then cast him in the Fire,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
translation_text: Thumma aljaheema sallooh

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
translation_text: And then expose him to hell-fire

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
translation_text: "And burn ye him in the Blazing Fire.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
translation_text: Thereafter, fasten him with a chain the measure of which is seventy hands.”

translation_text: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
translation_text: and [bind him] in a chain seventy metres long:

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. "Then fasten him with a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits!"

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
translation_text: then fasten him with a chain, seventy cubits long.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
translation_text: Thumma fee silsilatin tharAAuhasabAAoona thiraAAan faslukooh

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
translation_text: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
translation_text: "Further, make him march in a chain, whereof the length is seventy cubits!

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

translation_text: Indeed, he did not believe in Allah, the Almighty,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. Verily, he used not to believe in Allâh, the Most Great,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: he would not believe in Almighty God,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: He would not believe in Allah, the Most Great;

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: Innahu kana la yu/minu billahialAAatheem

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: "This was he that would not believe in Allah Most High.

translation_text: and did not persuade (others) to feed the needy.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And urged not on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor).1

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: he never encouraged feeding the hungry,

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: nor would he urge the feeding of the poor.1

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: Wala yahuddu AAalataAAami almiskeen

translation_text: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.

translation_text: So, he has no friend here today,

text_uthmani: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَـٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
translation_text: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

text_uthmani: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَـٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 35. So no friend has he here this Day,

text_uthmani: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَـٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
translation_text: so today he has no real friend here,

text_uthmani: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَـٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
translation_text: Today he has been left here friendless;

text_uthmani: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَـٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
translation_text: Falaysa lahu alyawma hahuna hameem

text_uthmani: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَـٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
translation_text: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,

text_uthmani: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَـٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
translation_text: "So no friend hath he here this Day.

text_uthmani: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
translation_text: nor any food except that which comes out from wounds when washing,

text_uthmani: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
translation_text: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;

text_uthmani: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
translation_text: and the only food he has is the filth

text_uthmani: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. Nor any food except filth from the washing of wounds.

text_uthmani: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
translation_text: and has no food except the filth from the washing of wounds,

text_uthmani: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
translation_text: Wala taAAamun illamin ghisleen

text_uthmani: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
translation_text: Nor any food save filth

text_uthmani: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
translation_text: "Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds,

text_uthmani: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ
لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ
translation_text: which is eaten by none but the sinners.

text_uthmani: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ
translation_text: None will eat it except the sinners.

text_uthmani: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. None will eat it except the Khâti’ûn (sinners, disbelievers, polytheists).

text_uthmani: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ
translation_text: that only sinners eat.’

text_uthmani: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ
translation_text: which only the sinners will eat.”

text_uthmani: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ
translation_text: La ya/kuluhu illa alkhati-oon

text_uthmani: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ
translation_text: Which none but sinners eat.

text_uthmani: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ
translation_text: "Which none do eat but those in sin."

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: I swear by what you see,

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: So I swear by what you see

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. So I swear by whatsoever you see,

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: So I swear by what you can see

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: But no;1 I swear by what you see,

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: Fala oqsimu bima tubsiroon

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: But nay! I swear by all that ye see

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: So I do call to witness what ye see,

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: and what you do not see,

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And what you do not see

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: and by what you cannot see:

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. And by whatsoever you see not,

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: and by what you do not see,

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: Wama la tubsiroon

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And all that ye see not

text_uthmani: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation_text: And what ye see not,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: it is surely the speech of a noble Messenger, (that he conveys from Allah).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: this [Quran] is the speech of an honoured messenger,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. That this is verily, the word of an honoured Messenger [i.e. Jibrîl (Gabriel) or Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم which he has brought from Allâh].

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: that this is the speech of an honourable Messenger,1

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareem

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: That this is verily the word of an honoured messenger;

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: and it is not the speech of a poet, (but) little you believe,

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: not the words of a poet- how little you believe!-

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. It is not the word of a poet: little is that you believe!

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: not the speech of a poet. Little do you believe!1

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: Wama huwa biqawli shaAAirinqaleelan ma tu/minoon

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: It is not the word of a poet: little it is ye believe!

text_uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: nor is it the speech of a soothsayer, (but) little you heed to the advice.

text_uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.

text_uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: nor the words of a soothsayer- how little you reflect!

text_uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 42. Nor is it the word of a soothsayer (or a foreteller): little is that you remember!

text_uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Nor is this the speech of a soothsayer. Little do you reflect!

text_uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Wala biqawli kahinin qaleelanma tathakkaroon

text_uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!

text_uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation_text: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer: little admonition it is ye receive.

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. This is the Revelation sent down from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: This [Quran] is a message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds:

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: It has been revealed by the Lord of the Universe.1

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Tanzeelun min rabbi alAAalameen

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: (This is) a Message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
translation_text: Had he (the prophet) forged some statements in Our name,

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
translation_text: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
translation_text: if [the Prophet] had attributed some fabrication to Us,

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. And if he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) had forged a false saying concerning Us (Allâh جل جلاله),

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
translation_text: And if he [i.e., the Prophets] had forged this Discourse and thereafter ascribed it to Us,

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
translation_text: Walaw taqawwala AAalayna baAAdaal-aqaweel

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
translation_text: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us,

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
translation_text: And if the messenger were to invent any sayings in Our name,

text_uthmani: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: We would have certainly seized him by the right hand,

text_uthmani: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: We would have seized him by the right hand;1

text_uthmani: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 45. We surely would have seized him by his right hand (or with power and might),

text_uthmani: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: We would certainly have seized his right hand

text_uthmani: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: We would surely have seized him by the right hand,

text_uthmani: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: Laakhathna minhu bilyameen

text_uthmani: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand

text_uthmani: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
translation_text: We should certainly seize him by his right hand,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
translation_text: and then severed his life-artery,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
translation_text: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 46. And then We certainly would have cut off his life artery (aorta),

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
translation_text: and cut off his lifeblood,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
translation_text: and then severed his life vein;

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
translation_text: Thumma laqataAAna minhualwateen

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
translation_text: And then severed his life-artery,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
translation_text: And We should certainly then cut off the artery of his heart:

text_uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
translation_text: and none of you could have saved him from it.

text_uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
translation_text: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.

text_uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 47. And none of you could have withheld Us from (punishing) him.

text_uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
translation_text: and none of you could have defended him.

text_uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
translation_text: and not one of you would have been able to withhold Us from doing so.1

text_uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
translation_text: Fama minkum min ahadin AAanhu hajizeen

text_uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
translation_text: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.

text_uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
translation_text: Nor could any of you withhold him (from Our wrath).

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: It is infact a Reminder for the God-fearing.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: This [Quran] is a reminder for those who are aware of God.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 48. And verily, this (Qur’an) is a Reminder for the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2).

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: Surely it is a Good Counsel for the God-fearing.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: Wa-innahu latathkiratun lilmuttaqeen

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation_text: But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: And, of course, We know that among you there are deniers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: We know that some of you consider it to be lies-

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 49. And verily, We know that there are some among you that belie (this Qur’ân). (Tafsir At-Tabarî)

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: We certainly know that some among you will give the lie to it,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Wa-inna lanaAAlamu anna minkum mukaththibeen

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it).

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: And We certainly know that there are amongst you those that reject (it).

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: And surely, it is a cause of remorse for the disbelievers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: this will be a source of bitter regret for the disbelievers-

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And indeed it (this Qur’ân) will be an anguish for the disbelievers (on the Day of Resurrection).1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: and surely it will be a cause of regret for the unbelievers.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: Wa-innahu lahasratun AAala alkafireen

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
translation_text: But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation_text: And it is surely an absolute truth.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation_text: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And verily, it (this Qur’ân) is an absolute truth with certainty.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation_text: but it is in fact the certain Truth.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation_text: Certainly it is a Truth of absolute certainty.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation_text: Wa-innahu lahaqqu alyaqeen

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation_text: And lo! it is absolute truth.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
translation_text: But verily it is Truth of assured certainty.

text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: So, pronounce the purity of the name of your magnificent Lord.

text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: So [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Almighty.

text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.1

text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: So glorify the name of your Lord Most Great.

text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: Fasabbih bismi rabbika alAAatheem

text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.

text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
translation_text: So glorify the name of thy Lord Most High.

سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
translation_text: A demanding person has asked for the punishment that is going to befall

text_uthmani: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
translation_text: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen1

text_uthmani: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
translation_text: A man [mockingly] demanded the punishment.

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: A questioner asked concerning a torment about to befall

translation_text: A beseecher besought the visitation of chastisement,1

text_uthmani: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
translation_text: A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall

translation_text: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall-

translation_text: the disbelievers; there is no one to avert it,

text_uthmani: لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ
translation_text: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.

text_uthmani: لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ
translation_text: It will fall on the disbelievers––none can deflect it––

text_uthmani: لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. Upon the disbelievers, which none can avert,

text_uthmani: لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ
translation_text: (a chastisement meant) for the unbelievers, one which none can avert;

text_uthmani: لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ
translation_text: Lilkafireena laysa lahu dafiAA

text_uthmani: لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ
translation_text: Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel,

text_uthmani: لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ
translation_text: The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off,-

مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ

text_uthmani: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
translation_text: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.

text_uthmani: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
translation_text: from God, the Lord of the Ways of Ascent,

text_uthmani: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. From Allâh, the Lord of the ways of ascent.

text_uthmani: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
translation_text: a chastisement from Allah, the Lord of the ascending steps,1

text_uthmani: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
translation_text: Mina Allahi thee almaAAarij

text_uthmani: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
translation_text: From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways

text_uthmani: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
translation_text: (A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.

تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
translation_text: to whom ascend the angels and the Spirit in a day the length of which is fifty thousand years.

translation_text: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.

text_uthmani: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
translation_text: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him, on a Day whose length is fifty thousand years.

text_uthmani: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ

translation_text: 4. The angels and the Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] ascend to Him in a Day the measure whereof is fifty thousand years.

text_uthmani: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ

text_uthmani: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ

translation_text: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.

text_uthmani: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
translation_text: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years:

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا
translation_text: So be patient, [Prophet], as befits you.

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا
translation_text: Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment).

translation_text: (This punishment will befall) on the Day when the sky will be like dregs of oil,

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. The Day that the sky will be like the boiling filth of oil, (or molten copper or silver or lead).

translation_text: It shall befall on a Day1 whereon the sky will become like molten brass,2
