translation_text: The day when the sky will become as molten copper,

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. And the mountains will be like flakes of wool.

translation_text: and the mountains will become like dyed tufts of wool,1

translation_text: And the mountains will be like wool,

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا
translation_text: when no friend will ask about his friend,

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. And no friend will ask a friend (about his condition),

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا
translation_text: and no bosom friend will enquire about any of his bosom friends

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا
translation_text: And no friend will ask after a friend,

text_uthmani: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
translation_text: (though) they will be made to see each other. A guilty person will desire that he may be able to ransom himself from the torment of that day even by his sons,

text_uthmani: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
translation_text: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children

text_uthmani: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
translation_text: even when they are within sight of one another. The guilty person will wish he could save himself from the suffering of that Day by sacrificing his sons,

text_uthmani: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Though they shall be made to see one another [(i.e. on the Day of Resurrection), there will be none but see his father, children and relatives, but he will neither speak to them nor will ask them for any help]. The Mujrim, (criminal, sinner, disbeliever) would desire to ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by his children,

text_uthmani: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
translation_text: although they shall be within sight of one another.1 The guilty one would fain ransom himself from the torment of that Day by offering his children,

text_uthmani: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
translation_text: Yubassaroonahum yawaddu almujrimu lawyaftadee min AAathabi yawmi-ithin bibaneeh

text_uthmani: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
translation_text: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children

text_uthmani: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
translation_text: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children,

text_uthmani: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
translation_text: and his wife and his brother,

text_uthmani: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
translation_text: And his wife and his brother

text_uthmani: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
translation_text: his spouse, his brother,

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. And his wife and his brother,

translation_text: and his spouse and his brother,

translation_text: And his spouse and his brother

translation_text: His wife and his brother,

translation_text: and his kindred that sheltered him,

translation_text: the kinsfolk who gave him shelter,

text_uthmani: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. And his kindred who sheltered him,

text_uthmani: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
translation_text: and his kinsfolk who had stood by him,

text_uthmani: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
translation_text: Wafaseelatihi allatee tu/weeh

text_uthmani: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
translation_text: And his kin that harboured him

text_uthmani: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
translation_text: His kindred who sheltered him,

text_uthmani: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
translation_text: and all those on earth, then he may redeem himself.

text_uthmani: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
translation_text: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.

text_uthmani: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
translation_text: and everyone on earth, if it could save him.

text_uthmani: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And all that are in the earth, so that it might save him.1

text_uthmani: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
translation_text: and all persons of the earth, if only he could thus save himself.

text_uthmani: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
translation_text: Waman fee al-ardi jameeAAan thummayunjeeh

text_uthmani: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
translation_text: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.

text_uthmani: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
translation_text: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him:

كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
translation_text: By no means! It is the flaming fire

translation_text: But no! There is a raging flame

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. By no means! Verily, it will be the Fire of Hell,

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
translation_text: By no means! It will be the fierce flame

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
translation_text: But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
translation_text: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell!-

text_uthmani: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. Taking away (burning completely) the head skin!

text_uthmani: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ
translation_text: that will strip off the scalp.

text_uthmani: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ
translation_text: NazzaAAatan lishshawa

text_uthmani: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ
translation_text: Eager to roast;

text_uthmani: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ
translation_text: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull!-

text_uthmani: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: It will call him who had turned his back and fled away (from the truth)

text_uthmani: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]

text_uthmani: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: and it will claim everyone who rejects the truth, turns away,

text_uthmani: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Calling1 (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from Faith) [picking and swallowing them up from that great gathering of mankind on the Day of Resurrection just as a bird picks up a food-grain from the earth with its beak and swallows it up] (Tafsir Al-Qurtubî)

text_uthmani: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: It shall insistently summon him who turned his back and retreated,

text_uthmani: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: TadAAoo man adbara watawalla

text_uthmani: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth),

text_uthmani: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right).

text_uthmani: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ

text_uthmani: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ
translation_text: WajamaAAa faawAAa

translation_text: And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it.

text_uthmani: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ

translation_text: Indeed man is created weak in courage,

translation_text: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:

text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
translation_text: Man was truly created anxious:

text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. Verily, man (disbeliever) was created very impatient;

text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
translation_text: Verily man is impatient by nature:1

text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
translation_text: Inna al-insana khuliqa halooAAa

text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
translation_text: Lo! man was created anxious,

text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
translation_text: Truly man was created very impatient;-

إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
translation_text: very upset when touched by evil,

text_uthmani: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
translation_text: When evil touches him, impatient,

translation_text: he is fretful when misfortune touches him,

text_uthmani: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. Irritable (discontented) when evil touches him;

text_uthmani: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
translation_text: bewailing when evil befalls him,

text_uthmani: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
translation_text: Itha massahu ashsharrujazooAAa

text_uthmani: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
translation_text: Fretful when evil befalleth him

text_uthmani: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
translation_text: Fretful when evil touches him;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
translation_text: and very niggard when visited by good (fortune),

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
translation_text: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
translation_text: but tight-fisted when good fortune comes his way.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. And niggardly when good touches him.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
translation_text: and tight-fisted when good fortune visits him,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
translation_text: Wa-itha massahu alkhayru manooAAa

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
translation_text: And, when good befalleth him, grudging;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
translation_text: And niggardly when good reaches him;-

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_text: except the performers of Salāh,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_text: Except the observers of prayer -

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_text: Not so those who pray

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Except those who are devoted to Salât (prayers).1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_text: except those that pray,1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_text: Illa almusalleen

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_text: Save worshippers.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_text: Not so those devoted to Prayer;-

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: who are regular in their Salāh,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: Those who are constant in their prayer

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. Those who remain constant in their Salât (prayers);

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: and are constant in their prayers;

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: and are constant in their Prayer;1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: Allatheena hum AAala salatihimda-imoon

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: Who are constant at their worship

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: and those in whose riches there is a specified right

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: And those within whose wealth is a known right1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: who give a due share of their wealth

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. And those in whose wealth there is a recognised right

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: and those in whose wealth there is a known right

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: Wallatheena fee amwalihimhaqqun maAAloom

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation_text: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.

text_uthmani: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: for the one who asks and the one who is deprived,

text_uthmani: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: For the petitioner and the deprived -

text_uthmani: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: to beggars and the deprived;

text_uthmani: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. For the beggar who asks, and for the unlucky who has lost his property and wealth, (and his means of living has been straitened).

text_uthmani: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: for those that ask and those that are dispossessed,1

text_uthmani: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: Lissa-ili walmahroom

text_uthmani: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: For the beggar and the destitute;

text_uthmani: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation_text: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking);

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: and those who believe in the Day of Judgment as true,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: who believe in the Day of Judgement

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. And those who believe in the Day of Recompense.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: those who firmly believe in the Day of Recompense,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Wallatheena yusaddiqoonabiyawmi addeen

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
translation_text: and those who are fearful of the torment of their Lord-

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
translation_text: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
translation_text: and fear the punishment of their Lord––

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. And those who fear the torment of their Lord.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
translation_text: and fear the chastisement of their Lord1–

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
translation_text: Wallatheena hum min AAathabirabbihim mushfiqoon

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
translation_text: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom -

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
translation_text: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord,-

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
translation_text: -Indeed the torment of their Lord is not something to be fearless from.-

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
translation_text: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
translation_text: none may feel wholly secure from it––

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. Verily, the torment of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure. -

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
translation_text: surely the chastisement of their Lord is a thing none can feel secure from –

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
translation_text: Inna AAathaba rabbihim ghayru ma/moon

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
translation_text: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
translation_text: For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
translation_text: and those who guard their private parts,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
translation_text: And those who guard their private parts

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
translation_text: who guard their chastity

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And those who guard their chastity (i.e. private parts from illegal sexual acts).1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
translation_text: and those who guard their private parts,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
translation_text: Wallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoon

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
translation_text: And those who preserve their chastity

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
translation_text: And those who guard their chastity,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
translation_text: except from their wives and those (slave-girls) owned by their hands,- because they are not to be blamed,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
translation_text: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,1 for indeed, they are not to be blamed -

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
translation_text: from all but their spouses or their slave-girls––there is no blame attached to [relations with] these,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. Except from their wives or the (women slaves) whom their right hands possess - for (then) they are not blameworthy.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
translation_text: except in regard to their spouses and those whom their right hands possess, for in regard to them they are not reproachable,1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
translation_text: Illa AAala azwajihim awma malakat aymanuhum fa-innahum ghayru maloomeen

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
translation_text: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy;

text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
translation_text: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed,

text_uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
translation_text: but the one who seeks (sexual gratification) beyond that, then such people are the transgressors,-

text_uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
translation_text: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -

text_uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
translation_text: but those whose desires exceed this limit are truly transgressors––

text_uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: But whosoever seeks beyond that, then it is those who are trespassers.1

text_uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
translation_text: but any who seeks to go beyond that, it is indeed they who are the transgressors,

text_uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
translation_text: Famani ibtagha waraa thalikafaola-ika humu alAAadoon

text_uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
translation_text: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors;

text_uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
translation_text: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors;-

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
translation_text: and those who are careful about their trusts and covenants,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
translation_text: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
translation_text: who are faithful to their trusts and their pledges;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. And those who keep their trusts and covenants.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
translation_text: and those who fulfil their trusts and their covenants,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
translation_text: Wallatheena hum li-amanatihimwaAAahdihim raAAoon

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
translation_text: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
translation_text: And those who respect their trusts and covenants;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: and those who are upright in their testimonies,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: And those who are in their testimonies upright

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: who give honest testimony

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. And those who stand firm in their testimonies.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: and those who are upright in their testimonies;1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: Wallatheena hum bishahadatihimqa-imoon

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: And those who stand by their testimony

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
translation_text: And those who stand firm in their testimonies;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
translation_text: and those who take due care of their Salāh .

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
translation_text: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
translation_text: and are steadfast in their prayers.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And those who guard their Salât (prayers) well.1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
translation_text: and who take due care of their Prayer:1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
translation_text: Wallatheena hum AAala salatihimyuhafithoon

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
translation_text: And those who are attentive at their worship.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
translation_text: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship;-

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: Those will be honoured in gardens (of Jannah ).

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: They will be in gardens,1 honored.

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: They will be honoured in Gardens of bliss.

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 35. Such shall dwell in the Gardens (i.e. Paradise), honoured.

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: all these shall live honourably in the Gardens.

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: Ola-ika fee jannatin mukramoon

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: These will dwell in Gardens, honoured.

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
translation_text: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss).

text_uthmani: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
translation_text: So what has happened to those who disbelieve that they are rushing towards you

text_uthmani: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
translation_text: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],

text_uthmani: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
translation_text: What is wrong with the disbelievers? Why do they rush to peer at you [Prophet],

text_uthmani: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. So what is the matter with those who disbelieve that they hasten to listen from you [O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), in order to belie you and to mock at you, and at Allâh’s Book (this Qur’ân)].

text_uthmani: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
translation_text: But what is the matter with the unbelievers who are hurrying towards you

text_uthmani: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
translation_text: Famali allatheena kafarooqibalaka muhtiAAeen

text_uthmani: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
translation_text: What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed,

text_uthmani: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
translation_text: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee-

text_uthmani: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
translation_text: from the right and from the left, in groups?

text_uthmani: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
translation_text: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?1

text_uthmani: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
translation_text: from right and left, in crowds?

text_uthmani: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. (Sitting) in groups on the right and on the left (of you, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)?

text_uthmani: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
translation_text: in crowds, both on the right and on the left?1

text_uthmani: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
translation_text: AAani alyameeni waAAani ashshimaliAAizeen

text_uthmani: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
translation_text: On the right and on the left, in groups?

text_uthmani: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
translation_text: From the right and from the left, in crowds?

text_uthmani: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Does every one of them aspire to be admitted to the garden of bliss?

text_uthmani: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?

text_uthmani: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Does every one of them expect to enter a Garden of bliss?

text_uthmani: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. Does every man of them hope to enter the Paradise of Delight?

text_uthmani: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Does everyone of them wish to enter the Garden of Bliss?1

text_uthmani: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: AyatmaAAu kullu imri-in minhum anyudkhala jannata naAAeem

text_uthmani: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?

text_uthmani: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: By no means! We have created them from what they know.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.1

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: No! We created them from the substance they know,

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. No, that is not like that! Verily, We have created them out of that which they know!

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: By no means! They know that which We have created them from.1

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Kalla inna khalaqnahummimma yaAAlamoon

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know!

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: So, I swear by the Lord of the points of sunrise and those of sunset, We are powerful

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings1 that indeed We are able

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: and, by the Lord of every sunrise and sunset, We have the power

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: So I swear by the Lord of all the [three hundred and sixty-five (365)] points of sunrise and sunset in the east and the west that surely We are Able

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: I swear1 by the Lord of the easts and the wests2 that We have the power

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: Fala oqsimu birabbi almashariqiwalmagharibi inna laqadiroon

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly-

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
translation_text: to bring those better than them in their place, and We are not to be frustrated.

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
translation_text: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
translation_text: to substitute for them others better than they are- nothing can prevent Us from doing this.

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. To replace them by (others) better than them; and We are not to be outrun.

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
translation_text: to replace them by others who would be better than they; and We shall certainly not be overpowered.1

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
translation_text: AAala an nubaddila khayran minhum wamanahnu bimasbooqeen

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
translation_text: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun.

text_uthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
translation_text: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan).

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: So, leave them involved in pastime and play until they encounter their Day, which they are promised,

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: So leave them to wallow in idle talk, until they come face to face with their promised Day,

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: So leave them to plunge in vain talk1 and play about, until they meet their Day which they are promised -

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: So leave them to engage in vain talk and to amuse themselves until they come face to face with the Day which they are promised,

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: Fatharhum yakhoodoowayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allatheeyooAAadoon

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,

text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised!-

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
translation_text: the Day they will come out of the graves quickly, as if they were rushing toward idols,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
translation_text: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. The Day when they will come out of the graves quickly as racing to a goal,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
translation_text: the Day they will rush out of their graves as if rallying to a flag,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
translation_text: the Day on which they will hastily come forth from their graves, as though they were hurrying on to the altars of their deities.1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
translation_text: Yawma yakhrujoona mina al-ajdathi siraAAankaannahum ila nusubin yoofidoon

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
translation_text: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
translation_text: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them),-

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: with their eyes downcast, enveloped by ignominy. That is the Day, which they were being promised.

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. With their eyes lowered in fear and humility, ignominy covering them (all over)! That is the Day which they were promised!

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: eyes downcast and covered in shame: that is the Day of which they were warned.

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: Their eyes will be downcast and disgrace will overwhelm them. Such is the Day that they were promised.

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: KhashiAAatan absaruhumtarhaquhum thillatun thalika alyawmu allatheekanoo yooAAadoon

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised.

text_uthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
translation_text: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised!

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: We sent NūH to his people (and said to him): “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: We sent Noah to his people: ‘Warn your people, before a painful punishment comes to them.’

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Verily, We sent Nûh (Noah) to his people (saying): "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful torment."

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: We sent Noah to his people (and directed him): “Warn your people before a grievous chastisement1 comes upon them.”

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Inna arsalna noohan ilaqawmihi an anthir qawmaka min qabli an ya/tiyahum AAathabunaleem

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
translation_text: We sent Noah to his People (with the Command): "Do thou warn thy People before there comes to them a grievous Penalty."

text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: He said, “O my people, I openly warn you

text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -

text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: And so he said, ‘My people, I am here to warn you plainly.

text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. He said: "O my people! Verily, I am a plain warner to you,

text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Noah said: “My people, I have certainly been sent as a clear warner to you,

text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: Qala ya qawmi innee lakum natheerunmubeen

text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you

text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation_text: He said: "O my People! I am to you a Warner, clear and open:

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: that you must worship Allah, and fear Him, and obey me,

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. "That you should worship Allâh (Alone), fear (be dutiful to) Him, and obey me,

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Serve God, be mindful of Him and obey me.

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: that you serve Allah and fear Him, and follow me;1

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: Ani oAAbudoo Allaha wattaqoohuwaateeAAoon

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me,

text_uthmani: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
translation_text: "That ye should worship Allah, fear Him and obey me:

text_uthmani: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: and Allah will forgive you your sins, and will respite you to an appointed term. Indeed when Allah’s term comes, it is not deferred, if you only know!”

text_uthmani: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."

text_uthmani: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: He will forgive you your sins and spare you until your appointed time––when God’s appointed time arrives it cannot be postponed. If only you understood!’

text_uthmani: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. "He (Allâh) will forgive you of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Verily, the term of Allâh when it comes, cannot be delayed, if you but knew."

text_uthmani: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: He will forgive your sins1 and will grant you respite until an appointed term.2 Indeed when Allah's appointed term comes, it cannot be deferred;3 if you only knew!”4

text_uthmani: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: Yaghfir lakum min thunoobikumwayu-akhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala Allahiitha jaa la yu-akhkharu law kuntumtaAAlamoon

text_uthmani: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew.

text_uthmani: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
translation_text: "So He may forgive you your sins and give you respite for a stated Term: for when the Term given by Allah is accomplished, it cannot be put forward: if ye only knew."

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
translation_text: He said, “My Lord, I have called my people night and day,

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
translation_text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
translation_text: He said, ‘My Lord, I have called my people night and day,

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: He said: "O my Lord! Verily, I have called to my people night and day (i.e. secretly and openly to accept the doctrine of Islâmic Monotheism),1

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
translation_text: He said:1 “My Lord, I called my people by night and by day,

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
translation_text: Qala rabbi innee daAAawtu qawmeelaylan wanahara

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
translation_text: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day

text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
translation_text: He said: "O my Lord! I have called to my People night and day:

text_uthmani: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
translation_text: but my call added only to their flight (from the truth).

text_uthmani: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
translation_text: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].

text_uthmani: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
translation_text: but the more I call them, the further they run away:

text_uthmani: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. "But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight (from the truth).

text_uthmani: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
translation_text: but the more I called, the farther they fled.1

text_uthmani: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
translation_text: Falam yazidhum duAAa-ee illafirara

text_uthmani: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
translation_text: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance;

text_uthmani: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
translation_text: "But my call only increases (their) flight (from the Right).

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
translation_text: Whenever I called them, so that You might forgive them, they put their fingers into their ears, and wrapped their clothes around themselves, and grew obstinate, and waxed proud in extreme arrogance.

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
translation_text: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments,1 persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
translation_text: every time I call them, so that You may forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, cover their heads with their garments, persist in their rejection, and grow more insolent and arrogant.

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. And verily, every time I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted (in their refusal), and magnified themselves in pride.

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
translation_text: And every time I called them so that You might forgive them,1 they thrust their fingers into their ears and wrapped up their faces with their garments2 and obstinately clung to their attitude, and waxed very proud.3

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
translation_text: Wa-innee kullama daAAawtuhumlitaghfira lahum jaAAaloo asabiAAahum fee athanihimwastaghshaw thiyabahum waasarroo wastakbarooistikbara

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
translation_text: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.

text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
translation_text: "And every time I have called to them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they have (only) thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
translation_text: Then I called them loudly,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
translation_text: Then I invited them publicly.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
translation_text: I have tried calling them openly.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. "Then verily, I called to them openly (aloud).

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
translation_text: Then I summoned them openly,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
translation_text: Thumma innee daAAawtuhum jihara

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
translation_text: And lo! I have called unto them aloud,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
translation_text: "So I have called to them aloud;

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
translation_text: and then I spoke to them in public and spoke to them in private.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
translation_text: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
translation_text: I have tried preaching to them in public and speaking to them in private.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. "Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
translation_text: and preached to them in public, and also addressed them in secret.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
translation_text: Thumma innee aAAlantu lahum waasrartu lahumisrara

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
translation_text: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
translation_text: "Further I have spoken to them in public and secretly in private,

text_uthmani: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
translation_text: So I said, ‘Pray to your Lord for your forgiveness,- Indeed He is Very-Forgiving, -

text_uthmani: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
translation_text: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

text_uthmani: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. "I said (to them): ‘Ask forgiveness from your Lord, verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;

text_uthmani: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
translation_text: I said, “Ask forgiveness of your Lord: He is ever forgiving.

text_uthmani: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
translation_text: I said to them: “Ask forgiveness from your Lord; surely He is Most Forgiving.

text_uthmani: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
translation_text: Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kanaghaffara

text_uthmani: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
translation_text: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.

text_uthmani: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
translation_text: "Saying, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;

text_uthmani: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
translation_text: and He will cause the heavens to rain upon you in abundance,

text_uthmani: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
translation_text: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

text_uthmani: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
translation_text: He will send down abundant rain from the sky for you;

text_uthmani: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. ‘He will send rain to you in abundance,

text_uthmani: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
translation_text: He will shower upon you torrents from heaven,

text_uthmani: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
translation_text: Yursili assamaa AAalaykummidrara

text_uthmani: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
translation_text: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,

text_uthmani: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
translation_text: "'He will send rain to you in abundance;

text_uthmani: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
translation_text: and will help you with riches and sons, and will cause gardens to grow for you, and cause rivers to flow for you.

text_uthmani: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
translation_text: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

text_uthmani: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
translation_text: He will give you wealth and sons; He will provide you with gardens and rivers.

text_uthmani: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. ‘And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers.’"

text_uthmani: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
translation_text: and will provide you with wealth and children, and will bestow upon you gardens and rivers.1

text_uthmani: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
translation_text: Wayumdidkum bi-amwalin wabaneenawayajAAal lakum jannatin wayajAAal lakum anhara

text_uthmani: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
translation_text: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.

text_uthmani: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
translation_text: "'Give you increase in wealth and sons; and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers (of flowing water).

text_uthmani: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
translation_text: What has happened to you that you do not appreciate the Majesty of Allah,

text_uthmani: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
translation_text: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur

text_uthmani: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
translation_text: What is the matter with you? Why will you not fear God’s majesty,

text_uthmani: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. What is the matter with you, that [you fear not Allâh (His punishment), and] you hope not for reward (from Allâh or you believe not in His Oneness).

text_uthmani: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
translation_text: What is amiss with you that you do not look forward to the majesty of Allah1

text_uthmani: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
translation_text: Ma lakum la tarjoona lillahiwaqara

text_uthmani: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
translation_text: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity

text_uthmani: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
translation_text: "'What is the matter with you, that ye place not your hope for kindness and long-suffering in Allah,-

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
translation_text: while He has created you in different phases?

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
translation_text: While He has created you in stages?1

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
translation_text: when He has created you stage by stage?

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. While He has created you in (different) stages [i.e. first Nutfah, then ‘Alaqah and then Mudghah, see (V.23:13,14)].

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
translation_text: when He has created you in stages?1

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
translation_text: Waqad khalaqakum atwara

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
translation_text: When He created you by (divers) stages?

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
translation_text: "'Seeing that it is He that has created you in diverse stages?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
translation_text: Did you not see how Allah has created seven heavens one upon another,

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
translation_text: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers1

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
translation_text: Have you ever wondered how God created seven heavens, one above the other,

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. See you not how Allâh has created the seven heavens one above another?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
translation_text: Do you not see how Allah has created seven heavens, one upon the other,

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
translation_text: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa AllahusabAAa samawatin tibaqa

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
translation_text: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
translation_text: "'See ye not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another,

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
translation_text: and has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
translation_text: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
translation_text: placed the moon as a light in them and the sun as a lamp,

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. And has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
translation_text: and has placed the moon in them as a light, and the sun as a radiant lamp?

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
translation_text: WajaAAala alqamara feehinna nooran wajaAAalaashshamsa siraja

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
translation_text: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
translation_text: "'And made the moon a light in their midst, and made the sun as a (Glorious) Lamp?

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
translation_text: And Allah has caused you to grow well out of the earth,

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
translation_text: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
translation_text: how God made you spring forth from the earth like a plant,

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. And Allâh has brought you forth from the (dust of) earth? (Tafsir At-Tabarî)

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
translation_text: And Allah has caused you to grow out of the earth so wondrously,1

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
translation_text: Wallahu anbatakum mina al-ardinabata

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
translation_text: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth,

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
translation_text: "'And Allah has produced you from the earth growing (gradually),

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
translation_text: then He will send you back into it, and will bring you forth once again.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
translation_text: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. Afterwards He will return you into it (the earth), and bring you forth (again on the Day of Resurrection)?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
translation_text: how He will return you into it and then bring you out again,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
translation_text: and He will later cause you to return to it and will then again bring you out of it.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
translation_text: Thumma yuAAeedukum feehawayukhrijukum ikhraja

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
translation_text: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
translation_text: "'And in the End He will return you into the (earth), and raise you forth (again at the Resurrection)?

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
translation_text: And Allah has made the earth a spread for you,

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
translation_text: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. And Allâh has made for you the earth a wide expanse.

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
translation_text: and how He has spread the Earth out for you

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
translation_text: Allah has made the earth a wide expanse for you

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
translation_text: Wallahu jaAAala lakumu al-ardabisata

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
translation_text: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
translation_text: "'And Allah has made the earth for you as a carpet (spread out),

text_uthmani: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
translation_text: so that you may go about its broad ways.’”

text_uthmani: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
translation_text: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"

text_uthmani: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. That you may go about therein in broad roads.

text_uthmani: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
translation_text: to walk along its spacious paths?” ’

text_uthmani: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
translation_text: so that you may tread its spacious paths.”

text_uthmani: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
translation_text: Litaslukoo minha subulan fijaja

text_uthmani: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
translation_text: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof.

text_uthmani: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
translation_text: "'That ye may go about therein, in spacious roads.'"

text_uthmani: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
translation_text: And said NūH, “My Lord, they disobeyed me, and followed him whose wealth and children added nothing to him but loss,

text_uthmani: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
translation_text: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

text_uthmani: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. Nûh (Noah) said: "My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but loss.

text_uthmani: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
translation_text: Noah said, ‘My Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed those whose riches and children only increase their ruin;

text_uthmani: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
translation_text: Noah said: “My Lord, they did not pay heed to what I said, and followed those (nobles) whose possession of wealth and children has led them to an even greater loss.

text_uthmani: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
translation_text: Qala noohun rabbi innahum AAasawneewattabaAAoo man lam yazidhu maluhu wawaladuhu illakhasara

text_uthmani: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
translation_text: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;

text_uthmani: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
translation_text: Noah said: "O my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but they follow (men) whose wealth and children give them no increase but only Loss.

text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
translation_text: and they devised a mighty plot,

text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
translation_text: And they conspired an immense conspiracy

text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. "And they have plotted a mighty plot.

text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
translation_text: who have made a grand plan,

text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
translation_text: They contrived a plot of great magnitude.1

text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
translation_text: Wamakaroo makran kubbara

text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
translation_text: And they have plotted a mighty plot,

text_uthmani: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
translation_text: "And they have devised a tremendous Plot.

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
translation_text: and said (to their people), “Never forsake your gods, and never forsake Wadd, nor Suwā‘, nor Yaghūth and Ya‘ūq and Nasr.

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
translation_text: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'1

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
translation_text: saying, “Do not renounce your gods! Do not renounce Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yauq, or Nasr!”

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. "And they have said: ‘You shall not leave your gods: nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwâ‘, nor Yaghûth, nor Ya‘ûq nor Nasr’ (these are the names of their idols).

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
translation_text: They said: “Do not abandon your deities; do not abandon Wadd, nor Suwa, nor Yaghuth, nor Yauq, nor Nasr.1

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
translation_text: Waqaloo la tatharunna alihatakumwala tatharunna waddan wala suwaAAanwala yaghootha wayaAAooqa wanasra

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
translation_text: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.

text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
translation_text: "And they have said (to each other), 'Abandon not your gods: Abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', neither Yaguth nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr';-

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
translation_text: And they have led many astray. And (O my Lord,) let not the wrongdoers progress in anything but deviation from the right path.”

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
translation_text: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. "And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allâh): ‘Grant no increase to the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) save error.’"

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
translation_text: They have led many astray. Lord, bring nothing but destruction down on the evildoers!’

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
translation_text: They have misled many. So do not enable these evildoers to increase in anything except straying (from the Right Way).”1

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
translation_text: Waqad adalloo katheeran walatazidi aththalimeena illa dalala

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
