translation_text: And leave Me alone (to deal) with the deniers, the people of luxury, and give them respite for a while.

text_uthmani: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
translation_text: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.

text_uthmani: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
translation_text: and leave to Me those who deny the truth and live in luxury. Bear with them for a little while;

text_uthmani: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. And leave Me Alone to deal with the beliers (those who deny My Verses), those who are in possession of good things of life. And give them respite for a little while.

text_uthmani: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
translation_text: Leave it to Me to deal with the affluent ones who give the lie1 (to the Truth), and bear with them for a while.

text_uthmani: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
translation_text: Watharnee walmukaththibeenaolee annaAAmati wamahhilhum qaleela

text_uthmani: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
translation_text: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.

text_uthmani: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
translation_text: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
translation_text: Surely with Us are fetters and flaming fire,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
translation_text: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
translation_text: We have fetters, a blazing fire,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. Verily, with Us are fetters (to bind them), and a raging Fire.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
translation_text: We have heavy fetters1 and a blazing Fire in store for them;

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
translation_text: Inna ladayna ankalan wajaheema

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
translation_text: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
translation_text: With Us are Fetters (to bind them), and a Fire (to burn them),

text_uthmani: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
translation_text: and food that chokes, and a painful punishment

text_uthmani: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
translation_text: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -

text_uthmani: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
translation_text: food that chokes, and agonizing torment in store for them

text_uthmani: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. And a food that chokes, and a painful torment.

text_uthmani: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
translation_text: and a food that chokes, and a grievous chastisement.

text_uthmani: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
translation_text: WataAAaman tha ghussatinwaAAathaban aleema

text_uthmani: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
translation_text: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom

text_uthmani: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
translation_text: And a Food that chokes, and a Penalty Grievous.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
translation_text: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will quake, and the mountains will turn into a slipping heap of sand.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
translation_text: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
translation_text: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will shake. The mountains will become a heap of loose sand.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. On the Day when the earth and the mountains will be in violent shake, and the mountains will be a heap of sand poured out.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
translation_text: (They will come across all this) on the Day when the earth and the mountains shall tremble violently and the mountains shall crumble into heaps of scattered sand.1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
translation_text: Yawma tarjufu al-ardu waljibaluwakanati aljibalu katheeban maheela

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
translation_text: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
translation_text: One Day the earth and the mountains will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be as a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
translation_text: (O people,) We have sent to you a messenger, as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
translation_text: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
translation_text: We have sent a messenger to you [people] to be your witness, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh,

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Verily, We have sent to you (O men) a Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to be a witness over you, as We did send a Messenger [Mûsâ (Moses)] to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).1

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
translation_text: Surely1 We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness over you,2 just as We had sent a Messenger to Pharaoh.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
translation_text: Inna arsalna ilaykum rasoolanshahidan AAalaykum kama arsalna ilafirAAawna rasoola

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
translation_text: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
translation_text: We have sent to you, (O men!) a messenger, to be a witness concerning you, even as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
translation_text: Then, Fir‘aun disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a severe seizure.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
translation_text: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
translation_text: but Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger and so We inflicted a heavy punishment on him.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. But Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) disobeyed the Messenger [Mûsâ (Moses)]; so We seized him with a severe punishment.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
translation_text: But Pharaoh disobeyed Our Messenger, so We seized him with a terrible seizing.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
translation_text: FaAAasa firAAawnu arrasoolafaakhathnahu akhthan wabeela

text_uthmani: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
translation_text: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip.

text_uthmani: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
translation_text: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a heavy Punishment.

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
translation_text: So, if you disbelieve, how will you save yourself from a day that will turn the small boys into grey-headed old men,

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
translation_text: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?1

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
translation_text: So if you disbelieve, how can you guard yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair grey,

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. Then how can you avoid the punishment, if you disbelieve, on a Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) that will make the children grey-headed?

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
translation_text: If you persist in disbelieving, how will you guard yourself against the (woe of the) Day that will turn children grey-haired,1

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
translation_text: Fakayfa tattaqoona in kafartum yawmanyajAAalu alwildana sheeba

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
translation_text: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,

text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
translation_text: Then how shall ye, if ye deny (Allah), guard yourselves against a Day that will make children hoary-headed?-

text_uthmani: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
translation_text: whereby the sky will burst apart. His promise has to be fulfilled.

text_uthmani: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
translation_text: The heaven will break apart therefrom;1 ever is His promise fulfilled.

text_uthmani: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
translation_text: a Day when the sky will be torn apart? God’s promise will certainly be fulfilled.

text_uthmani: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. Whereon the heaven will be cleft asunder? His Promise is certainly to be accomplished.

text_uthmani: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
translation_text: the Day whose severity shall cause the heaven to split asunder? Allah's promise is ever bound to be fulfilled.

text_uthmani: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
translation_text: Assamao munfatirunbihi kana waAAduhu mafAAoola

text_uthmani: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
translation_text: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.

text_uthmani: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
translation_text: Whereon the sky will be cleft asunder? His Promise needs must be accomplished.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who so wishes, adopt a way to his Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes take the way to his Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. Verily, this is an admonition: therefore whosoever will, let him take a Path to His Lord!

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: Indeed this is nothing but a Good Counsel; so let him who will take a way leading to his Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: Inna hathihi tathkiratun famanshaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeela

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: Verily this is an Admonition: therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) path to his Lord!

text_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ

۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
translation_text: Your Lord knows that you stand (in prayer) for nearly two thirds of the night, and (at times) for half of it, and (at times) for one third of it, and (so do) a group of those who are with you. And Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you (O Muslims,) cannot do it in regular way; therefore He turned to you in mercy.Now, recite as much of the Qur’ān as is easy (for you). He knows that some of you may be sick, and others traveling in the land, seeking the grace of Allah, and yet others fighting in Allah’s way. Therefore, recite as much of it as is easy. And establish Salāh, and pay Zakāh, and advance to Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you will send ahead for your own-selves, you will find it with Allah much better in condition, and much greater in reward. And seek forgiveness from Allah. Indeed Allah is Most-Forgiving, Very-Merciful.

translation_text: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it1 and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan.2 And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

translation_text: Verily, your Lord knows that you do stand (to pray at night) a little less than two thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and also a party of those with you. And Allâh measures the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to pray the whole night, so He has turned to you (in mercy). So, recite you of the Qur’ân as much as may be easy for you. He knows that there will be some among you sick, others travelling through the land, seeking of Allâh’s Bounty, yet others fighting in Allâh’s Cause. So recite as much of the Qur’ân as may be easy (for you), and perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât ) and give Zakât, and lend to Allâh a goodly loan. And whatever good you send before you for yourselves (i.e. Nawâfil non-obligatory acts of worship: prayers, charity, fasting, Hajj and ‘Umrah), you will certainly find it with Allâh, better and greater in reward. And seek Forgiveness of Allâh. Verily, Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful1.

translation_text: [Prophet], your Lord is well aware that you sometimes spend nearly two-thirds of the night at prayer––sometimes half, sometimes a third––as do some of your followers. God determines the division of night and day. He knows that you will not be able to keep a measure of it and He has relented towards all of you, so recite as much of the Quran as is easy for you. He knows that some of you will be sick, some of you travelling through the land seeking God’s bounty, some of you fighting in God’s way: recite as much as is easy for you, keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and make God a good loan. Whatever good you store up for yourselves will be improved and increased for you. Ask God for His forgiveness, He is most forgiving, most merciful.

translation_text: (O Prophet),1 your Lord knows that you sometimes stand up in Prayer nearly two-thirds of the night, and sometimes half or one-third of it, 2 and so does a party of those with you;3 Allah measures the night and the day. He knows that you cannot keep an accurate count of it, so He has shown mercy to you. So now recite as much of the Qur'an as you can.4 He knows that there are among you those who are sick and others who are journeying in the land in quest of Allah's bounty,5 and still others who are fighting in the cause of Allah.6 So recite as much of the Qur'an as you easily can, and establish Prayer, and pay Zakah,7 and give Allah a goodly loan.8 Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you shall find it with Allah. That is better and its reward is greater.9 And ask for Allah's forgiveness; surely He is Most Forgiving, Most Compassionate.

translation_text: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

translation_text: Thy Lord doth know that thou standest forth (to prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so doth a party of those with thee. But Allah doth appoint night and day in due measure He knoweth that ye are unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (in mercy): read ye, therefore, of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knoweth that there may be (some) among you in ill-health; others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty; yet others fighting in Allah's Cause, read ye, therefore, as much of the Qur'an as may be easy (for you); and establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan. And whatever good ye send forth for your souls ye shall find it in Allah's Presence,- yea, better and greater, in Reward and seek ye the Grace of Allah: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

translation_text: Leave me alone (to deal) with the one whom I created lonely,

translation_text: Leave Me with the one I created alone1

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Leave Me Alone (to deal) with whom I created lonely (without any wealth or children etc, i.e. Al-Walîd bin Al-Mughîrah Al-Makhzûmî)!

text_uthmani: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
translation_text: [Prophet], leave Me to deal with the one I created helpless,

text_uthmani: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
translation_text: Leave Me with him1 whom I alone have created,2

text_uthmani: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
translation_text: Tharnee waman khalaqtu waheeda

text_uthmani: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
translation_text: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,

text_uthmani: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
translation_text: Leave Me alone, (to deal) with the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone!-

وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
translation_text: and gave him extensive wealth,

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
translation_text: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. And then granted him resources in abundance.

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
translation_text: then gave vast wealth,

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
translation_text: whom I have endowed with abundant riches,

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
translation_text: WajaAAaltu lahu malan mamdooda

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
translation_text: And then bestowed upon him ample means,

text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
translation_text: To whom I granted resources in abundance,

text_uthmani: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
translation_text: and sons present before (his) eyes,

translation_text: And children present [with him]

text_uthmani: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. And children to be by his side.

text_uthmani: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
translation_text: and sons by his side,

text_uthmani: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
translation_text: and sons ever present with him,1

text_uthmani: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
translation_text: Wabaneena shuhooda

text_uthmani: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
translation_text: And sons abiding in his presence

text_uthmani: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
translation_text: And sons to be by his side!-

وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
translation_text: and extended (power and honour) to him pretty well.

text_uthmani: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
translation_text: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].

text_uthmani: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. And made life smooth and comfortable for him.

text_uthmani: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
translation_text: making everything easy for him––

text_uthmani: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
translation_text: and for whom I have smoothed the way (to power and riches),

text_uthmani: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
translation_text: Wamahhadtu lahu tamheeda

text_uthmani: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
translation_text: And made (life) smooth for him.

text_uthmani: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
translation_text: To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
translation_text: Still, he aspires that I should give him more.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
translation_text: Then he desires that I should add more.

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. After all that he desires that I should give more;

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
translation_text: yet he still hopes I will give him more.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
translation_text: and who still greedily desires that I should bestow upon him more.1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
translation_text: Yet he desireth that I should give more.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
translation_text: Yet is he greedy-that I should add (yet more);-

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
translation_text: Never! He is inimical towards Our verses.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
translation_text: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
translation_text: No! He has been stubbornly hostile to Our revelation:

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. Nay! Verily, he has been opposing Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations).

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
translation_text: By no means; he is stubbornly opposed to Our Signs.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
translation_text: Kalla innahu kana li-ayatinaAAaneeda

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
translation_text: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
translation_text: By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!

text_uthmani: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
translation_text: I will force him to climb the mountain Sa‘ūd.

text_uthmani: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
translation_text: I will cover him with arduous torment.

text_uthmani: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. I shall oblige him to (climb a slippery mountain in the Hell-fire called As-Sa‘ûd, or) face a severe torment!

text_uthmani: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
translation_text: I will inflict a spiralling torment on him.

text_uthmani: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
translation_text: I shall soon constrain him to a hard ascent.

text_uthmani: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
translation_text: Saorhiquhu saAAooda

text_uthmani: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
translation_text: On him I shall impose a fearful doom.

text_uthmani: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
translation_text: Soon will I visit him with a mount of calamities!

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ

translation_text: He pondered and surmised.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
translation_text: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
translation_text: He planned and plotted––

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. Verily, he thought and plotted.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
translation_text: He reflected and then hatched a scheme.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
translation_text: Innahu fakkara waqaddar

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
translation_text: For lo! he did consider; then he planned -

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
translation_text: For he thought and he plotted;-

فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: Death onto him! How (bad) is the surmise he put forward!

text_uthmani: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

text_uthmani: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: devilishly he plotted!

text_uthmani: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. So let him be cursed: how he plotted!

text_uthmani: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: Ruin seize him, how did he hatch a scheme?

text_uthmani: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: Faqutila kayfa qaddar

text_uthmani: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!

text_uthmani: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: And woe to him! How he plotted!-

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: Again, death unto him! How (bad) is the surmise he put forward!

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: ferociously he plotted!––

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. And once more let him be cursed: how he plotted!

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: Again, ruin seize him, how did he hatch a scheme?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: Thumma qutila kayfa qaddar

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! -

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
translation_text: Yea, Woe to him; How he plotted!-

translation_text: Then he looked (to those around him,)

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
translation_text: Then he considered [again];

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
translation_text: and looked

translation_text: 21. Then he thought.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
translation_text: He looked (at others);

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
translation_text: Thumma nathar

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
translation_text: Then looked he,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
translation_text: Then he looked round;

translation_text: then he frowned and scowled,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
translation_text: Then he frowned and scowled;

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. Then he frowned and he looked in a bad tempered way;

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
translation_text: and frowned and scowled

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
translation_text: then frowned and scowled;

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
translation_text: Thumma AAabasa wabasar

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
translation_text: Then frowned he and showed displeasure.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
translation_text: Then he frowned and he scowled;

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
translation_text: then turned his back, and waxed proud,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
translation_text: Then he turned back and was arrogant

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. Then he turned back, and was proud.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
translation_text: and turned away and behaved arrogantly

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
translation_text: then he retreated and waxed proud,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
translation_text: Thumma adbara wastakbar

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
translation_text: Then turned he away in pride

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
translation_text: Then he turned back and was haughty;

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ

translation_text: then said, “This is nothing but traditional magic;

translation_text: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
translation_text: and said, ‘This is just old sorcery,

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. Then he said: "This is nothing but magic from that of old,

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
translation_text: and said: “This (Qur'an) is merely a sorcery of yore;

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
translation_text: Faqala in hatha illa sihrunyu/thar

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
translation_text: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
translation_text: Then said he: "This is nothing but magic, derived from of old;

translation_text: This is not but the word of a human being."

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
translation_text: just the talk of a mortal!’

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. "This is nothing but the word of a human being!"

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
translation_text: this is nothing but the word of a mere mortal!”1

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
translation_text: This is naught else than speech of mortal man.

text_uthmani: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
translation_text: "This is nothing but the word of a mortal!"

سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
translation_text: I will put him into Saqar (Hell).

text_uthmani: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: I will cast him into Hell-fire.1

text_uthmani: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
translation_text: I will throw him into the scorching Fire.

text_uthmani: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
translation_text: Him shall I soon roast in Hell.

text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ

وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
translation_text: And We did not make wardens of the Fire but (from) angels, and did not fix their number but as a test for those who disbelieve, so that those who are given the Book may come to believe, and those who believe may improve in belief, and so that those who are given the Book and those who believe may not doubt (its correctness), and so that those having malady in their hearts and the disbelievers say, “What has Allah meant by this strange statement?” Thus Allah lets go astray whomever He wills, and leads to the right path whomever He wills. And no one knows the hosts of your Lord but He. And this is nothing else but a reminder for mankind.

text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
translation_text: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.

text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. And We have set none but angels as guardians of the Fire. And We have fixed their number (19) only as a trial for the disbelievers, in order that the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) may arrive at a certainty [that this Qur’ân is the truth as it agrees with their Books regarding the number (19) which is written in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] and that the believers may increase in Faith (as this Qur’ân is the truth), and that no doubt may be left for the people of the Scripture and the believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease (of hypocrisy) and the disbelievers may say: "What Allâh intends by this (curious) example ?" Thus Allâh leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none can know the hosts of your Lord but He. And this (Hell) is nothing else than a (warning) reminder to mankind.

text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
translation_text: none other than angels appointed by Us to guard Hellfire- and We have made their number a test for the disbelievers. So those who have been given the Scripture will be certain and those who believe will have their faith increased: neither those who have been given the Scripture nor the believers will have any doubts, but the sick at heart and the disbelievers will say, ‘What could God mean by this description?’ God leaves whoever He will to stray and guides whoever He will- no one knows your Lord’s forces except Him- this [description] is a warning to mortals.

text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
translation_text: We1 have appointed none but angels as the keepers of the Fire,2 and We have not made their number but as a trial for the unbelievers3 so that those who have been endowed with the Book will be convinced4 and the believers' faith will increase, 5 and neither those who have been endowed with the Book nor the believers will fall into any doubt. As for those in whose hearts there is a sickness6 as well as the unbelievers, they will say: “What did Allah aim at by this strange parable?”7 Thus does Allah let whomsoever He pleases to go astray, and directs whomsoever He pleases8 to the Right Way. And none knows the hosts of your Lord but He.9 (And Hell has only been mentioned here) that people may take heed.10

text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
translation_text: Wama jaAAalna as-habaannari illa mala-ikatan wamajaAAalna AAiddatahum illa fitnatan lillatheenakafaroo liyastayqina allatheena ootoo alkitabawayazdada allatheena amanoo eemananwala yartaba allatheena ootoo alkitabawalmu/minoona waliyaqoola allatheena feequloobihim maradun walkafiroona mathaarada Allahu bihatha mathalan kathalikayudillu Allahu man yashao wayahdee man yashaowama yaAAlamu junooda rabbika illa huwa wamahiya illa thikra lilbashar

text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
translation_text: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.

text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
translation_text: And We have set none but angels as Guardians of the Fire; and We have fixed their number only as a trial for Unbelievers,- in order that the People of the Book may arrive at certainty, and the Believers may increase in Faith,- and that no doubts may be left for the People of the Book and the Believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the Unbelievers may say, "What symbol doth Allah intend by this?" Thus doth Allah leave to stray whom He pleaseth, and guide whom He pleaseth: and none can know the forces of thy Lord, except He and this is no other than a warning to mankind.

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: "And we used to talk falsehood (all that which Allâh hated) with vain talkers.1

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
translation_text: and we indulged in vain talk with those who indulged in vain talk,

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
translation_text: Wakunna nakhoodu maAAa alkha-ideen

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
translation_text: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
translation_text: "But we used to talk vanities with vain talkers;

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: and we used to deny the Day of Requital,

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: we denied the Day of Judgement

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And we used to belie the Day of Recompense,1

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: and we gave the lie to the Day of Judgement

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Wakunna nukaththibu biyawmi addeen

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,

text_uthmani: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,

text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
translation_text: until when we were overtaken by that which is certain.”

text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
translation_text: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."

text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 47. "Until there came to us (the death) that is certain."

text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
translation_text: until the Certain End came upon us.’

text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
translation_text: until the inevitable event overtook us.”1

text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
translation_text: Hatta atanaalyaqeen

text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
translation_text: Till the Inevitable came unto us.

text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
translation_text: "Until there came to us (the Hour) that is certain."

text_uthmani: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: Then intercession of intercessors will not benefit them.

text_uthmani: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

text_uthmani: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: No intercessor’s plea will benefit them now.

text_uthmani: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: So no intercession of intercessors will be of any use to them.

text_uthmani: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: The intercession of the intercessors shall then be of no avail to them.1

text_uthmani: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: Fama tanfaAAuhum shafaAAatu ashshafiAAeen

text_uthmani: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.

text_uthmani: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
translation_text: Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
translation_text: So what has happened to them that they are turning away from the Reminder,

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
translation_text: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 49. Then what is wrong with them (i.e. the polytheists, the disbelievers) that they turn away from (receiving) admonition?

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
translation_text: What is the matter with them? Why do they turn away from the warning,

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
translation_text: What is the matter with people that they are turning away from this Exhortation,

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
translation_text: Fama lahum AAani attathkiratimuAArideen

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
translation_text: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
translation_text: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from admonition?-

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
translation_text: as if they were wild donkeys,

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
translation_text: As if they were alarmed donkeys

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 50. As if they were (frightened) wild donkeys.

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
translation_text: like frightened asses

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
translation_text: as though they were frightened wild asses,

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
translation_text: Kaannahum humurun mustanfira

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
translation_text: As they were frightened asses

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
translation_text: As if they were affrighted asses,

text_uthmani: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
translation_text: fleeing from a lion?

text_uthmani: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
translation_text: Fleeing from a lion?

text_uthmani: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
translation_text: fleeing from a lion?

text_uthmani: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 51. Fleeing from a hunter, or a lion, or a beast of prey.

text_uthmani: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
translation_text: fleeing from a lion?1

text_uthmani: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
translation_text: Farrat min qaswara

text_uthmani: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
translation_text: Fleeing from a lion?

text_uthmani: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
translation_text: Fleeing from a lion!

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
translation_text: Rather, every one of them wishes that he should be given unrolled (divine) scriptures.

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
translation_text: Rather, every person among them desires that he1 would be given scriptures spread about.2

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
translation_text: Each one of them demands that a scripture be sent down to him and unrolled before his very eyes-

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 52. Nay, everyone of them desires that he should be given pages spread out (coming from Allâh with a writing that Islâm is the right religion, and Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم has come with the truth from Allâh, the Lord of the heavens and earth).

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
translation_text: No indeed; each one of them desires that open letters be sent to each of them.1

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
translation_text: Bal yureedu kullu imri-in minhum an yu/tasuhufan munashshara

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
translation_text: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
translation_text: Forsooth, each one of them wants to be given scrolls (of revelation) spread out!

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: Never! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 53. Nay! But they fear not the Hereafter (from Allâh’s punishment).

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: No! Truly they have no fear of the life to come-

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: No indeed; the truth is that they have no fear of the Hereafter.1

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: Kalla bal la yakhafoonaal-akhira

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: By no means! But they fear not the Hereafter,

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: Never! Indeed, this is a Reminder.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 54. Nay, verily, this (Qur’an) is an admonition,

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: but truly this is a reminder.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: Nay;1 this is an Exhortation.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: Kalla innahu tathkira

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: Nay, this surely is an admonition:

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: So, whoever so wishes may take advice from it.

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: Then whoever wills will remember it.

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: Let whoever wishes to take heed do so:

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 55. So whosoever will (let him read it), and receive admonition (from it)!

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: So, whoever wills may benefit from it.

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: Faman shaa thakarah

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: So whosoever will may heed.

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: Let any who will, keep it in remembrance!

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
translation_text: And they will not take advice unless Allah so wills. He is worthy to be feared, and worthy to forgive.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
translation_text: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
translation_text: they will only take heed if God so wishes. He is the Lord who should be heeded, the Lord of forgiveness.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 56. And they will not receive admonition unless Allâh wills; He (Allâh) is the One, deserving that mankind should be afraid of, and should be dutiful to Him, and should not take any Ilâh (god) along with Him, and He is the One Who forgives (sins).

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
translation_text: But they will not benefit from it unless Allah Himself so wills.1 He is worthy to be feared;2 and He is worthy to forgive (those that fear Him).3

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
translation_text: Wama yathkuroona illaan yashaa Allahu huwa ahlu attaqwawaahlu almaghfirat

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
translation_text: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
translation_text: But none will keep it in remembrance except as Allah wills: He is the Lord of Righteousness, and the Lord of Forgiveness.

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: I swear by the Day of Resurrection,

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. I swear by the Day of Resurrection.

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: By the Day of Resurrection

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: Nay,1 I swear by the Day of Resurrection;

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: La oqsimu biyawmi alqiyamat

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: I do call to witness the Resurrection Day;

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
translation_text: and I swear by the self-reproaching conscience, (that Resurrection is a reality.)

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
translation_text: And I swear by the reproaching soul1 [to the certainty of resurrection].

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
translation_text: and by the self-reproaching soul!

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. And I swear by the self-reproaching person (a believer).

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
translation_text: and nay, I swear by the self-reproaching soul!1

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
translation_text: Wala oqsimu binnafsi allawwamat

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
translation_text: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
translation_text: And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil).

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
translation_text: Does man think that We will never reassemble his bones?

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
translation_text: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
translation_text: Does man think We shall not put his bones back together?

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. Does man (a disbeliever) think that We shall not assemble his bones?

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
translation_text: Does man imagine that We will not be able to bring his bones together again?1

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
translation_text: Ayahsabu al-insanu allannajmaAAa AAithamah

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
translation_text: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
translation_text: Does man think that We cannot assemble his bones?

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Why (can We) not (do so), while We are able to reset (even) his fingertips perfectly?

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
translation_text: In fact, We can reshape his very fingertips.

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Yes, We are Able to put together in perfect order the tips of his fingers.1

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Yes indeed; We have the power to remould even his finger-tips.1

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Bala qadireena AAala annusawwiya bananah

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Nay, We are able to put together in perfect order the very tips of his fingers.

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
translation_text: But man wishes to go on violating Allah’s injunctions (even in future) ahead of him.

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
translation_text: But man desires to continue in sin.1

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
translation_text: Yet man wants to deny what is ahead of him:

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. Nay! Man (denies Resurrection and Reckoning. So he) desires to continue committing sins.

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
translation_text: But man desires to persist in his evil ways.1

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
translation_text: Bal yureedu al-insanu liyafjura amamah

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
translation_text: But man would fain deny what is before him.

text_uthmani: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
translation_text: But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him.

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: He asks, “When will be this Day of Resurrection?”

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: he says, ‘So, when will this Day of Resurrection be?’

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. He asks: "When will be this Day of Resurrection?"

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: He asks: “When will the Day of Resurrection be?”1

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: Yas-alu ayyana yawmu alqiyama

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
translation_text: He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
translation_text: So, when the eyes will be dazzled,

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
translation_text: So when vision is dazzled

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. So, when the sight shall be dazed.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
translation_text: When eyes are dazzled

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
translation_text: When the sight is dazed,1

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
translation_text: Fa-itha bariqa albasar

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
translation_text: But when sight is confounded

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
translation_text: At length, when the sight is dazed,

text_uthmani: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: and the moon will lose its light,

text_uthmani: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: And the moon darkens

text_uthmani: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: and the moon eclipsed,

text_uthmani: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. And the moon will be eclipsed.

text_uthmani: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: and the moon is eclipsed,

text_uthmani: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: Wakhasafa alqamar

text_uthmani: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: And the moon is eclipsed

text_uthmani: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: And the moon is buried in darkness.

text_uthmani: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: and the sun and the moon will be joined together,

text_uthmani: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: And the sun and the moon are joined,

text_uthmani: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: when the sun and the moon are brought together,

text_uthmani: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And the sun and moon will be joined together (by going one into the other or folded up or deprived of their light).1

text_uthmani: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: and the sun and the moon are joined together,1

text_uthmani: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: WajumiAAa ashshamsu walqamar

text_uthmani: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: And sun and moon are united,

text_uthmani: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
translation_text: And the sun and moon are joined together,-

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
translation_text: on that day man will say, “Where to escape?”

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
translation_text: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
translation_text: on that Day man will say, ‘Where can I escape?’

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. On that Day man will say: "Where (is the refuge) to flee?"

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
translation_text: on that Day will man say: “Whither the refuge?”

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
translation_text: Yaqoolu al-insanu yawma-ithinayna almafar

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
translation_text: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
translation_text: That Day will Man say: "Where is the refuge?"

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
translation_text: Never! There will be no refuge at all.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
translation_text: No! There is no refuge.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
translation_text: Truly, there is no refuge:

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. No! There is no refuge!

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
translation_text: No, there is no refuge.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
translation_text: Kalla la wazar

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
translation_text: Alas! No refuge!

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
translation_text: By no means! No place of safety!

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
translation_text: On that day, towards your Lord will be the destination (of everyone.)

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
translation_text: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
translation_text: they will all return to your Lord on that Day.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. Unto your Lord (Alone) will be the place of rest that Day.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
translation_text: With your Lord alone will be the retreat that Day.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
translation_text: Ila rabbika yawma-ithinalmustaqar

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
translation_text: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
translation_text: Before thy Lord (alone), that Day will be the place of rest.

text_uthmani: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
translation_text: Man will be informed of what he sent ahead and what he left behind.

text_uthmani: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
translation_text: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead1 and kept back.2

text_uthmani: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
translation_text: On that Day, man will be told what he put first and what he put last.

text_uthmani: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. On that Day man will be informed of what he sent forward (of his evil good deeds), and what he left behind (of his good or evil traditions).

text_uthmani: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
translation_text: On that Day will man be apprised of his deeds, both the earlier and the later.1

text_uthmani: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
translation_text: Yunabbao al-insanu yawma-ithinbima qaddama waakhkhar

text_uthmani: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
translation_text: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.

text_uthmani: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
translation_text: That Day will Man be told (all) that he put forward, and all that he put back.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
translation_text: Rather, man will be a witness against himself,

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
translation_text: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,1

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
translation_text: Truly, man is a clear witness against himself,

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. Nay! Man will be a witness against himself [as his body parts (skin, hands, legs, etc.) will speak about his deeds],

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
translation_text: But lo, man is well aware of himself,

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
translation_text: Bali al-insanu AAala nafsihibaseera

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
translation_text: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
translation_text: Nay, man will be evidence against himself,

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
translation_text: even though he may offer his excuses.

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
translation_text: Even if he presents his excuses.

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
translation_text: despite all the excuses he may put forward.

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. Though he may put forth his excuses (to cover his evil deeds).

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
translation_text: even though he might make up excuses.1

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
translation_text: Walaw alqa maAAatheerah

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
translation_text: Although he tender his excuses.

text_uthmani: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
translation_text: Even though he were to put up his excuses.

text_uthmani: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
translation_text: (O Prophet,) do not move your tongue (during revelation) for (reciting) it (the Qur’ān) to receive it in hurry.

text_uthmani: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
translation_text: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].

text_uthmani: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
translation_text: [Prophet], do not rush your tongue in an attempt to hasten [your memorization of] the Revelation:

text_uthmani: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur’ân, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to make haste therewith.

text_uthmani: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
translation_text: (O Prophet),1 do not stir your tongue hastily (to commit the Revelation to memory).

text_uthmani: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
translation_text: La tuharrik bihi lisanakalitaAAjala bih

text_uthmani: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
translation_text: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.

text_uthmani: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
translation_text: Move not thy tongue concerning the (Qur'an) to make haste therewith.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: It is surely undertaken by Us to store it (in your heart), and to let it be recited (by you after revelation is completed).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: We shall make sure of its safe collection and recitation.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. It is for Us to collect it and to give you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the ability to recite it (the Qur’ân).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Surely it is for Us to have you commit it to memory and to recite it.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Inna AAalayna jamAAahu waqur-anah

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it:

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Therefore, when it is recited by Us (through the angel), follow its recitation (by concentration of your heart).

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: When We have recited it, repeat the recitation

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. And when We have recited it to you [O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم through Jibrîl (Gabriel)], then follow its (the Qur’an’s) recital.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: And so when We recite it,1 follow its recitation attentively;

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Fa-itha qara/nahu fattabiAAqur-anah

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
translation_text: But when We have promulgated it, follow thou its recital (as promulgated):
