text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Then, it is undertaken by Us to explain it.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
translation_text: and We shall make it clear.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. Then it is for Us (Allâh) to make it clear (to you).

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
translation_text: then it will be for Us to explain it.1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Thumma inna AAalayna bayanah

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
translation_text: Nay more, it is for Us to explain it (and make it clear):

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
translation_text: Never, (your denial of Resurrection is never based on any sound reason!) Instead, you love that which is immediate,

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
translation_text: No! But you [i.e., mankind] love the immediate

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
translation_text: Truly you [people] love this fleeting world

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. Not [as you think, that you (mankind) will not be resurrected and recompensed for your deeds], but you (men) love the present life of this world,

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
translation_text: Nay;1 the truth is that you love ardently (the good of this world) that can be obtained hastily,

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
translation_text: Kalla bal tuhibboona alAAajila

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
translation_text: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
translation_text: Nay, (ye men!) but ye love the fleeting life,

text_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: and neglect the Hereafter.

text_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: And leave [i.e., neglect] the Hereafter.

text_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: and neglect the life to come.

text_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. And neglect the Hereafter.

text_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: and are oblivious of the Hereafter.1

text_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: Watatharoona al-akhira

text_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: And neglect the Hereafter.

text_uthmani: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
translation_text: And leave alone the Hereafter.

text_uthmani: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
translation_text: Many faces, that day, will be glowing,

text_uthmani: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
translation_text: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,

text_uthmani: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
translation_text: On that Day there will be radiant faces,

text_uthmani: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. Some faces that Day shall be Nâdirah (shining and radiant).

text_uthmani: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
translation_text: Some faces on that Day will be fresh and resplendent,1

text_uthmani: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
translation_text: Wujoohun yawma-ithin nadira

text_uthmani: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
translation_text: That day will faces be resplendent,

text_uthmani: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
translation_text: Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty);-

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
translation_text: looking towards their Lord,

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
translation_text: Looking at their Lord.1

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. Looking at their Lord (Allâh).

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
translation_text: looking towards their Lord,

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
translation_text: and will be looking towards their Lord;1

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
translation_text: Ila rabbiha nathira

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
translation_text: Looking toward their Lord;

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
translation_text: Looking towards their Lord;

text_uthmani: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: and many faces, that day, will be gloomy,

text_uthmani: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,

text_uthmani: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: and on that Day there will be the sad and despairing faces

text_uthmani: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. And some faces, that Day, will be Bâsirah (dark, gloomy, frowning, and sad),

text_uthmani: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: and some faces on that Day will be gloomy,

text_uthmani: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: Wawujoohun yawma-ithin basira

text_uthmani: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: And that day will other faces be despondent,

text_uthmani: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: And some faces, that Day, will be sad and dismal,

text_uthmani: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
translation_text: realizing that a back-breaking calamity is going to be afflicted on them.

text_uthmani: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
translation_text: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.

text_uthmani: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
translation_text: of those who realize that a great calamity is about to befall them.

text_uthmani: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. Thinking that some calamity is about to fall on them.

text_uthmani: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
translation_text: believing that a crushing calamity is about to strike them.

text_uthmani: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
translation_text: Tathunnu an yufAAala bihafaqira

text_uthmani: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
translation_text: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.

text_uthmani: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
translation_text: In the thought that some back-breaking calamity was about to be inflicted on them;

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
translation_text: Never, (you will never remain in this world forever!) When the soul (of a patient) reaches the clavicles,

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
translation_text: No! When it [i.e., the soul] has reached the collar bones1

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
translation_text: Truly, when the soul reaches the collarbone;

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. Nay, when (the soul) reaches to the collar bone (i.e. up to the throat in its exit),

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
translation_text: Nay;1 when a man's soul reaches up to the throat,

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
translation_text: Kalla itha balaghati attaraqiy

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
translation_text: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
translation_text: Yea, when (the soul) reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit),

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
translation_text: and it is said, “Who is an enchanter (that can save him?)”

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
translation_text: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
translation_text: when it is said, ‘Could any charm-healer save him now?’;

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. And it will be said: "Who can cure him (and save him from death)?"

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
translation_text: and it is said: “Is there any enchanter who can step forward and help (by his chanting)?”1

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
translation_text: Waqeela man raq

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
translation_text: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?

text_uthmani: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
translation_text: And there will be a cry, "Who is a magician (to restore him)?"

text_uthmani: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
translation_text: and he realizes that it is (the time of) departure (from the world,)

text_uthmani: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
translation_text: And he [i.e., the dying one] is certain that it is the [time of] separation

text_uthmani: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
translation_text: when he knows it is the final parting;

text_uthmani: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. And he (the dying person) will conclude that it was (the time) of parting (death);

text_uthmani: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
translation_text: and he realises that the hour of parting is come,

text_uthmani: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
translation_text: Wathanna annahu alfiraq

text_uthmani: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
translation_text: And he knoweth that it is the parting;

text_uthmani: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
translation_text: And he will conclude that it was (the Time) of Parting;

text_uthmani: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
translation_text: and one shank is intertwined with the other shank,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
translation_text: And the leg is wound about the leg,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
translation_text: when his legs are brought together:

text_uthmani: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And one leg will be joined with another leg (shrouded).1

text_uthmani: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
translation_text: and calf is inter-twined with calf.1

text_uthmani: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
translation_text: Waltaffati assaqu bilssaq

text_uthmani: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
translation_text: And agony is heaped on agony;

text_uthmani: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
translation_text: And one leg will be joined with another:

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
translation_text: then on that day, it is to your Lord that one has to be driven.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
translation_text: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.1

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. The drive will be, on that Day, to your Lord (Allâh)!

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
translation_text: on that day he will be driven towards your Lord.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
translation_text: On that Day you will be driven to your Lord.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
translation_text: Ila rabbika yawma-ithin almasaq

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
translation_text: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
translation_text: That Day the Drive will be (all) to thy Lord!

text_uthmani: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
translation_text: So (the denier of the Hereafter) neither believed, nor prayed,

text_uthmani: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
translation_text: And he [i.e., the disbeliever] had not believed, nor had he prayed.

text_uthmani: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
translation_text: He neither believed nor prayed,

text_uthmani: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. So he (the disbeliever) neither believed (in this Qur’ân and in the Message of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) nor prayed!

text_uthmani: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
translation_text: But he did not verify the Truth, nor did he observe Prayer;

text_uthmani: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Fala saddaqa wala salla

text_uthmani: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
translation_text: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.

text_uthmani: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
translation_text: So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray!-

text_uthmani: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: but rejected the truth and turned away (from it),

text_uthmani: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: But [instead], he denied and turned away.

text_uthmani: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: but denied the truth and turned away,

text_uthmani: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. But on the contrary, he belied (this Qur’ân and the Message of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) and turned away!

text_uthmani: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: on the contrary, he gave the lie to the Truth and turned his back upon it,

text_uthmani: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Walakin kaththaba watawalla

text_uthmani: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: But he denied and flouted.

text_uthmani: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: But on the contrary, he rejected Truth and turned away!

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
translation_text: then he went to his home, puffed up with pride.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
translation_text: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
translation_text: walking back to his people with a conceited swagger.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. Then he walked in conceit (full pride) to his family admiring himself!

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
translation_text: then he went back to his kinsfolk, elated with pride.1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
translation_text: Thumma thahaba ila ahlihiyatamatta

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
translation_text: Then went he to his folk with glee.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
translation_text: Then did he stalk to his family in full conceit!

text_uthmani: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
translation_text: (It will be said to such a man,) Woe to you, then woe to you!

text_uthmani: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
translation_text: Woe to you, and woe!

text_uthmani: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
translation_text: Closer and closer it comes to you.

text_uthmani: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 34. Woe to you [O man (disbeliever)]! And then (again) woe to you!

text_uthmani: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
translation_text: This (attitude) is worthy of you, altogether worthy;

text_uthmani: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
translation_text: Awla laka faawla

text_uthmani: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
translation_text: Nearer unto thee and nearer,

text_uthmani: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
translation_text: Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
translation_text: Again, woe to you, then woe to you!

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
translation_text: Then woe to you, and woe!

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
translation_text: Closer and closer still.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 35. Again, woe to you [O man (disbeliever)]! And then (again) woe to you!

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
translation_text: again, it is worthy of you, altogether worthy.1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
translation_text: Thumma awla laka faawla

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
translation_text: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
translation_text: Again, Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
translation_text: Does man presume that he will be left unchecked?

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
translation_text: Does man think that he will be left neglected?1

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
translation_text: Does man think he will be left alone?

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. Does man think that he will be left neglected (without being punished or rewarded for the obligatory duties enjoined by his Lord Allâh on him)?

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
translation_text: Does man1 think that he will be left alone, unquestioned?2

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
translation_text: Ayahsabu al-insanu an yutrakasuda

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
translation_text: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
translation_text: Does man think that he will be left uncontrolled, (without purpose)?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: Was he not an ejaculated drop of semen?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: Was he not just a drop of spilt-out sperm,

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. Was he not a Nutfah (mixed male and female sexual discharge) of semen emitted (poured forth)?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: Was he not a drop of ejaculated semen,

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: Alam yaku nutfatan min manayyin yumna

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
translation_text: Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: Then he became a clot of blood, then He created (him) and made (him) perfect,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allāh] created [his form] and proportioned [him]

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: which became a clinging form, which God shaped in due proportion,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Then he became an ‘Alaqah (a clot); then (Allâh) shaped and fashioned (him) in due proportion.1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: then he became a clot, and then Allah made it into a living body and proportioned its parts,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: Thumma kana AAalaqatan fakhalaqafasawwa

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: Then did he become a leech-like clot; then did (Allah) make and fashion (him) in due proportion.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: and made from him two kinds, male and female.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: fashioning from it the two sexes, male and female?

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. And made of him two sexes, male and female.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: and then He made of him a pair, male and female?

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: FajaAAala minhu azzawjayni aththakarawal-ontha

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: And made of him a pair, the male and female.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: And of him He made two sexes, male and female.

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
translation_text: Has He no power to give life to the dead?

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
translation_text: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. Is not He (Allâh Who does that) Able to give life to the dead? (Yes! He is Able to do all things).

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
translation_text: Does He who can do this not have the power to bring the dead back to life?

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
translation_text: Does He, then, not have the power to bring back the dead to life?1

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
translation_text: Alaysa thalika biqadirin AAalaan yuhyiya almawta

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
translation_text: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
translation_text: Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
translation_text: There has come upon man a period of time in which he was nothing worth mentioning.

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
translation_text: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
translation_text: Was there not a period of time when man was nothing to speak of ?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Has there not been over man a period of time, when he was not a thing worth mentioning?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
translation_text: Was there a period of time when man was not even worthy of a mention?1

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
translation_text: Hal ata AAala al-insani heenunmina addahri lam yakun shay-an mathkoora

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
translation_text: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
translation_text: Has there not been over Man a long period of Time, when he was nothing - (not even) mentioned?

text_uthmani: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
translation_text: We have created man from a mixed sperm-drop to put him to a test; then We made him able to hear, able to see.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
translation_text: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture1 that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
translation_text: We created man from a drop of mingled fluid to put him to the test; We gave him hearing and sight;

text_uthmani: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. Verily, We have created man from Nutfah (drops) of mixed semen (sexual discharge of man and woman), in order to try him: so We made him hearer and seer.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
translation_text: Verily We created man out of a drop of intermingled sperm1 so that We might try him,2 and We therefore endowed him with hearing and sight.3

text_uthmani: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
translation_text: Inna khalaqna al-insanamin nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi fajaAAalnahusameeAAan baseera

text_uthmani: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
translation_text: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
translation_text: Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
translation_text: We have shown him the way to be either grateful or ungrateful.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
translation_text: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
translation_text: We guided him to the right path, whether he was grateful or not.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. Verily, We showed him the way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
translation_text: Surely We showed him the Right Path, regardless of whether he chooses to be thankful or unthankful1 (to his Lord).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
translation_text: Inna hadaynahu assabeelaimma shakiran wa-imma kafoora

text_uthmani: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
translation_text: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
translation_text: We showed him the Way: whether he be grateful or ungrateful (rests on his will).

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
translation_text: We have prepared, for the disbelievers, shackles and iron-collars and a blazing Fire.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
translation_text: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
translation_text: We have prepared chains, iron collars, and blazing Fire for the disbelievers, but

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. Verily, We have prepared for the disbelievers iron chains, iron collars, and a blazing Fire.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
translation_text: For the unbelievers, We have kept ready chains and fetters and a Blazing Fire.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
translation_text: Inna aAAtadna lilkafireenasalasila waaghlalan wasaAAeera

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
translation_text: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
translation_text: For the Rejecters we have prepared chains, yokes, and a blazing Fire.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
translation_text: Indeed, the righteous will have a drink from a goblet, blended with (a drink from) Camphor

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
translation_text: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
translation_text: the righteous will have a drink mixed with kafur,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. Verily,, the Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism), shall drink of a cup (of wine) mixed with (water from a spring in Paradise called) Kâfûr

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
translation_text: The virtuous1 shall drink from a cup tempered with camphor water.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
translation_text: Inna al-abrara yashraboona min ka/sinkana mizajuha kafoora

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
translation_text: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
translation_text: As to the Righteous, they shall drink of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Kafur,-

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
translation_text: that will be a spring from which Allah’s servants will drink, making it flow (wherever they wish) profusely.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
translation_text: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allâh will drink, causing it to gush forth abundantly.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
translation_text: a spring for God’s servants, which flows abundantly at their wish.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
translation_text: This will be a gushing spring1 wherefrom Allah's servants2 shall drink wine, a spring from which they will take out channels wherever they wish.3

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
translation_text: AAaynan yashrabu biha AAibaduAllahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeera

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
translation_text: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
translation_text: A Fountain where the Devotees of Allah do drink, making it flow in unstinted abundance.

text_uthmani: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
translation_text: They (are the ones who) fulfill their vows, and fear a day whose evil (events) will spread far and wide,

text_uthmani: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
translation_text: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

text_uthmani: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. They (are those who) fulfil (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil will be wide-spreading.

text_uthmani: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
translation_text: They fulfil their vows; they fear a day of widespread woes;

text_uthmani: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
translation_text: These will be the ones who fulfil their vows1 and dread the Day whose woe shall be spread far and wide;

text_uthmani: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
translation_text: Yoofoona binnathri wayakhafoonayawman kana sharruhu mustateera

text_uthmani: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
translation_text: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,

text_uthmani: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
translation_text: They perform (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil flies far and wide.

text_uthmani: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
translation_text: and they give food, out of their love for Him (Allah), to the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,

text_uthmani: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
translation_text: And they give food in spite of love for it1 to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

text_uthmani: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
translation_text: they give food to the poor, the orphan, and the captive, though they love it themselves,

text_uthmani: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And they give food, inspite of their love for it (or for the love of Him), to the Miskîn1 (the poor), the orphan, and the captive

text_uthmani: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
translation_text: those who, for the love of Him,1 feed the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,2

text_uthmani: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
translation_text: WayutAAimona attaAAamaAAala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseera

text_uthmani: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
translation_text: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,

text_uthmani: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
translation_text: And they feed, for the love of Allah, the indigent, the orphan, and the captive,-

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
translation_text: (saying to them,) “We feed you only for the sake of Allah; we have no intention of (receiving) either a return from you or thanks.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
translation_text: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. (Saying): "We feed you seeking Allâh’s Countenance only. We wish for no reward, nor thanks from you.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
translation_text: saying, ‘We feed you for the sake of God alone: We seek neither recompense nor thanks from you.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
translation_text: (saying):1 “We feed you only for Allah's sake; we do not seek of you any recompense or thanks,2

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
translation_text: Innama nutAAimukum liwajhi Allahila nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukoora

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
translation_text: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
translation_text: (Saying),"We feed you for the sake of Allah alone: no reward do we desire from you, nor thanks.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
translation_text: In fact, we are fearful of a day, from the side of our Lord, that will be frowning, extremely malignant.”

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
translation_text: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
translation_text: We fear the Day of our Lord––a woefully grim Day.’

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. "Verily, We fear from our Lord a Day, hard and distressful, that will make the faces look horrible (from extreme dislike to it)."

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
translation_text: we fear from our Lord a Day that shall be long and distressful.”

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
translation_text: Inna nakhafu min rabbinayawman AAaboosan qamtareera

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
translation_text: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
translation_text: "We only fear a Day of distressful Wrath from the side of our Lord."

text_uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
translation_text: So Allah will save them from the evil of that day, and will grant them bloom and delight,

text_uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
translation_text: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

text_uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. So Allâh saved them from the evil of that Day, and gave them Nadrah (a light of beauty) and joy.

text_uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
translation_text: So God will save them from the woes of that Day, give them radiance and gladness,

text_uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
translation_text: So Allah shall guard them against the woe of that Day, and will procure them freshness and joy,1

text_uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
translation_text: Fawaqahumu Allahu sharra thalikaalyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasuroora

text_uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
translation_text: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;

text_uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
translation_text: But Allah will deliver them from the evil of that Day, and will shed over them a Light of Beauty and (blissful) Joy.

text_uthmani: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
translation_text: and will give them, in return for their patience, Paradise and (garments of) silk,

text_uthmani: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
translation_text: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

text_uthmani: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. And their recompense shall be Paradise, and silken garments, because they were patient.

text_uthmani: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
translation_text: and reward them, for their steadfastness, with a Garden and silken robes.

text_uthmani: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
translation_text: and will reward them for their steadfastness1 with Paradise and robes of silk.

text_uthmani: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
translation_text: Wajazahum bima sabaroojannatan wahareera

text_uthmani: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
translation_text: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;

text_uthmani: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
translation_text: And because they were patient and constant, He will reward them with a Garden and (garments of) silk.

text_uthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
translation_text: wherein they will be reclining on couches, feeling neither heat of the sun nor intense cold.

text_uthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
translation_text: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

text_uthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
translation_text: They will sit on couches, feeling neither scorching heat nor biting cold,

text_uthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. Reclining therein on raised thrones, they will see there neither the excessive heat of the sun, nor the excessive bitter cold, (as in Paradise there is no sun and no moon).

text_uthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
translation_text: There they will recline on elevated couches and will be subjected neither to the burning heat of the sun nor to bitter cold.

text_uthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
translation_text: Muttaki-eena feeha AAala al-ara-ikila yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareera

text_uthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
translation_text: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.

text_uthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
translation_text: Reclining in the (Garden) on raised thrones, they will see there neither the sun's (excessive heat) nor (the moon's) excessive cold.

text_uthmani: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
translation_text: And shades of gardens will be hanging low on them, and their fruits will be placed totally under their command.

text_uthmani: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
translation_text: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

text_uthmani: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
translation_text: with shady [branches] spread above them and clusters of fruit hanging close at hand.

text_uthmani: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. And the shade thereof is close upon them, and the bunches of fruit thereof will hang low within their reach.

text_uthmani: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
translation_text: The shades of Paradise will bend over them, and its fruits will be brought within their easy reach;

text_uthmani: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
translation_text: Wadaniyatan AAalayhim thilaluhawathullilat qutoofuha tathleela

text_uthmani: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
translation_text: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.

text_uthmani: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
translation_text: And the shades of the (Garden) will come low over them, and the bunches (of fruit), there, will hang low in humility.

text_uthmani: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
translation_text: Circulated among them will be vessels of silver, and cups that will be (as transparent as) crystals,

text_uthmani: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
translation_text: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

text_uthmani: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
translation_text: They will be served with silver plates

text_uthmani: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and cups of crystal -

text_uthmani: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
translation_text: and there shall be passed around them vessels of silver1 and goblets of crystal,2

text_uthmani: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
translation_text: Wayutafu AAalayhim bi-aniyatinmin fiddatin waakwabin kanat qawareera

text_uthmani: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
translation_text: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass

text_uthmani: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
translation_text: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,-

text_uthmani: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
translation_text: -crystals (as shining as if made) of silver, measured by those (who filled them) with due measure.

text_uthmani: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
translation_text: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

text_uthmani: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
translation_text: and gleaming silver goblets according to their fancy,

text_uthmani: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. Crystal-clear, made of silver. They will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).

text_uthmani: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
translation_text: goblets bright as crystal but made of silver, filled to exact measure.1

text_uthmani: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
translation_text: Qawareera min fiddatinqaddarooha taqdeera

text_uthmani: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
translation_text: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).

text_uthmani: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
translation_text: Crystal-clear, made of silver: they will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).

text_uthmani: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
translation_text: And they will be served with goblet of a drink blended with ginger,

text_uthmani: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
translation_text: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

text_uthmani: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
translation_text: and they will be given a drink infused with ginger

text_uthmani: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. And they will be given to drink there of a cup (of wine) mixed with Zanjabîl (ginger),

text_uthmani: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
translation_text: Therein they shall be served a cup flavoured with ginger,

text_uthmani: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
translation_text: Wayusqawna feeha ka/san kanamizajuha zanjabeela

text_uthmani: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
translation_text: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,

text_uthmani: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
translation_text: And they will be given to drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Zanjabil,-

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
translation_text: (acquired from) a spring therein called Salsabīl.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
translation_text: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
translation_text: from a spring called Salsabil.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. A spring there, called Salsabîl.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
translation_text: drawn from a spring (in Paradise) called Salsabil.1

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
translation_text: AAaynan feeha tusammasalsabeela

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
translation_text: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
translation_text: A fountain there, called Salsabil.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
translation_text: And circling around them will be serving boys, blessed with eternal youth; when you would see them, you would take them as scattered pearls.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
translation_text: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. And round about them will (serve) boys of everlasting youth. If you see them, you would think them scattered pearls.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
translation_text: Everlasting youths will attend them––if you could see them, you would think they were scattered pearls––

text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
translation_text: There boys of everlasting youth shall go about attending them: when you see them, you would think that they are scattered pearls.1

text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
translation_text: Wayatoofu AAalayhim wildanunmukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum lu/lu-anmanthoora

text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
translation_text: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.

text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
translation_text: And round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness): If thou seest them, thou wouldst think them scattered Pearls.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
translation_text: When you will look around there, you will see the Bliss and a magnificent realm.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
translation_text: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. And when you look there (in Paradise), you will see a delight (that cannot be imagined), and a great dominion.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
translation_text: and if you were to look around, you would see bliss and great wealth:

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
translation_text: Whitherto you look around, you will see an abundance of bliss and the glories of a great kingdom.1

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
translation_text: Wa-itha raayta thamma raaytanaAAeeman wamulkan kabeera

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
translation_text: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
translation_text: And when thou lookest, it is there thou wilt see a Bliss and a Realm Magnificent.

text_uthmani: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
translation_text: Upon them will be garments of green sundus (a kind of fine silk), and of istabraq (a kind of thick silk), and they will be adorned by bracelets of silver. Their Lord will give them a pure beverage to drink:

text_uthmani: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
translation_text: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

text_uthmani: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
translation_text: they will wear garments of green silk and brocade; they will be adorned with silver bracelets; their Lord will give them a pure drink.

text_uthmani: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. Their garments will be of fine green silk, and gold embroidery. They will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.

text_uthmani: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
translation_text: They [i.e., the virtuous] shall be attired in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade1 and will be adorned with bracelets of silver.2 Their Lord will give them a pure wine to drink.3

text_uthmani: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
translation_text: AAaliyahum thiyabu sundusinkhudrun wa-istabraqun wahulloo asawira minfiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahoora

text_uthmani: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
translation_text: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.

text_uthmani: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
translation_text: Upon them will be green Garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, and they will be adorned with Bracelets of silver; and their Lord will give to them to drink of a Wine Pure and Holy.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
translation_text: “This is a reward for you, and your effort has been appreciated.”

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
translation_text: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. (And it will be said to them): "Verily, this is a reward for you, and your endeavour has been accepted."

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
translation_text: [It will be said], ‘This is your reward. Your endeavours are appreciated.’

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
translation_text: Behold, this is your recompense and your endeavour has been appreciated.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
translation_text: Inna hatha kana lakum jazaanwakana saAAyukum mashkoora

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
translation_text: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
translation_text: "Verily this is a Reward for you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised."

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
translation_text: Indeed we have revealed to you the Qur’ān through a gradual process.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
translation_text: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
translation_text: We Ourself have sent down this Quran to you [Prophet] in gradual revelation.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. Verily, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’ân to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) by stages.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
translation_text: (O Prophet), indeed We have revealed the Qur'an to you in portions.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
translation_text: Inna nahnu nazzalnaAAalayka alqur-ana tanzeela

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
translation_text: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;

text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
translation_text: It is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to thee by stages.

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
translation_text: So, be steadfast patiently in (obeying) your Lord’s command, and do not obey any one of them who is sinner or ungrateful.

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
translation_text: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. Therefore be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) with constancy to the Command of your Lord (Allâh, by doing your duty to Him and by conveying His Message to mankind), and obey neither a sinner nor a disbeliever among them.

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
translation_text: Await your Lord’s Judgement with patience; do not yield to any of these sinners or disbelievers;

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
translation_text: So persevere with the command of your Lord1 and do not pay any heed to the wicked and the unbelieving,2

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
translation_text: Fasbir lihukmi rabbikawala tutiAA minhum athiman aw kafoora

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
translation_text: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.

text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
translation_text: Therefore be patient with constancy to the Command of thy Lord, and hearken not to the sinner or the ingrate among them.

text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
translation_text: And pronounce the name of Allah morning and evening.

text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
translation_text: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. And remember the Name of your Lord every morning and afternoon [i.e. offering of the Morning (Fajr), Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers].

text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
translation_text: remember the name of your Lord at dawn and in the evening;

text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
translation_text: and remember the name of your Lord, morning and evening;

text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
translation_text: Wathkuri isma rabbikabukratan waaseela

text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
translation_text: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.

text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
translation_text: And celebrate the name of thy Lord morning and evening,

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
translation_text: And in some parts of night prostrate yourself before Him, and pronounce His purity for long times at night.

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
translation_text: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And during night, prostrate yourself to Him (i.e. the offering of Maghrib and ‘Ishâ’ prayers), and glorify Him a long night through (i.e. Tahajjud prayer).

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
translation_text: bow down before Him, and glorify Him at length by night.

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
translation_text: and prostrate yourself before Him at night, and extol His Glory during the long watches of the night.1

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
translation_text: Wamina allayli fasjud lahu wasabbihhulaylan taweela

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
translation_text: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.

text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
translation_text: And part of the night, prostrate thyself to Him; and glorify Him a long night through.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
translation_text: In fact these people love that which is immediate, and neglect a Heavy Day ahead of them.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
translation_text: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them1 a grave Day.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. Verily, these (disbelievers) love the present life of this world, and put behind them a heavy Day (that will be hard).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
translation_text: These people love the fleeting life. They put aside [all thoughts of] a Heavy Day.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
translation_text: Verily they love (the good of this world) that is hastily obtainable and are oblivious of the burdensome Day ahead of them.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
translation_text: Inna haola-i yuhibboonaalAAajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawmanthaqeela

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
translation_text: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
translation_text: As to these, they love the fleeting life, and put away behind them a Day (that will be) hard.

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
translation_text: We have created them and have made their joints strong. And whenever We will, We would replace them with others like them, a total replacement.

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
translation_text: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. It is We Who created them, and We have made them of strong built. And when We will, We can replace them with others like them with a complete replacement.

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
translation_text: Yet We created them; We strengthened their constitution; if We please, We can replace such people completely.

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
translation_text: We created them and strengthened their joints; and whenever We wish, We can change their faces entirely.1

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
translation_text: Nahnu khalaqnahum washadadnaasrahum wa-itha shi/na baddalna amthalahumtabdeela

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
translation_text: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.

text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
translation_text: It is We Who created them, and We have made their joints strong; but, when We will, We can substitute the like of them by a complete change.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: Indeed, this is a reminder; so let anyone who so wishes, adopt a way to his Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes, take the way to his Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. Verily, this (Verse of the Qur’ân) is an admonition, so whosoever wills, let him take a Path to his Lord (Allâh).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: Verily this is an Exhortation; so let him who so will take a way to his Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: Inna hathihi tathkiratun famanshaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeela

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
translation_text: This is an admonition: Whosoever will, let him take a (straight) Path to his Lord.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
translation_text: And you will not so wish unless Allah so wills. Indeed Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
translation_text: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
translation_text: But you will only wish to do so if God wills- God is all knowing, all wise-

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. But you cannot will, unless Allâh wills. Verily, Allâh is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
translation_text: But your willing shall be of no avail until Allah Himself so wills.1 Surely Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
translation_text: Wama tashaoona illa anyashaa Allahu inna Allaha kanaAAaleeman hakeema

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
translation_text: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
translation_text: But ye will not, except as Allah wills; for Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.

text_uthmani: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
translation_text: He admits whomsoever He wills to His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

text_uthmani: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
translation_text: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

text_uthmani: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
translation_text: He admits whoever He will into His Mercy and has prepared a painful torment for the disbelievers.

text_uthmani: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. He will admit to His Mercy whom He wills and as for the Zâlimûn - (polytheists, wrong-doers) He has prepared a painful torment.

text_uthmani: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
translation_text: He admits to His Mercy whomsoever He pleases. As for the wrong-doers, He has prepared for them a grievous chastisement.1

text_uthmani: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
translation_text: Yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihiwaththalimeena aAAadda lahum AAathabanaleema

text_uthmani: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
translation_text: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.

text_uthmani: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
translation_text: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will; But the wrong-doers,- for them has He prepared a grievous Penalty.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
translation_text: (I swear) by those (winds) that are sent one after the other,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
translation_text: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. By the winds (or angels or the Messengers of Allâh) sent forth one after another.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
translation_text: By the [winds] sent forth in swift succession,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
translation_text: By the (winds) sent forth in quick succession,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
translation_text: Walmursalati AAurfa

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
translation_text: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another

text_uthmani: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
translation_text: By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man's profit);

text_uthmani: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
translation_text: and by those that blow violently,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
translation_text: And the winds that blow violently

text_uthmani: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. And by the winds that blow violently.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
translation_text: violently storming,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
translation_text: which then blow tempestuously

text_uthmani: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
translation_text: FalAAasifati AAasfa

text_uthmani: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
translation_text: By the raging hurricanes,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
translation_text: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
translation_text: and by those that spread (clouds) all over,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
translation_text: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And by the winds that scatter clouds and rain.

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
translation_text: scattering far and wide,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
translation_text: and raise (clouds) and scatter them around,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
translation_text: Wannashirati nashra

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
translation_text: By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive;

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
translation_text: And scatter (things) far and wide;

text_uthmani: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
translation_text: and by those (angels) who differentiate (between right and wrong) distinctly,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
translation_text: And those [angels] who bring criterion1
