text_uthmani: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
translation_text: separating forcefully,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And by the Verses (of the Qur’ân) that separate the right from the wrong.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
translation_text: then winnow them thoroughly,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
translation_text: Falfariqati farqa

text_uthmani: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
translation_text: By those who winnow with a winnowing,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
translation_text: Then separate them, one from another,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: then bring down the advice,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: And those [angels] who deliver a message

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: delivering a reminder,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. And by the angels that bring the revelations to the Messengers,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: and then cast (Allah's) remembrance (in people's hearts),

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: Falmulqiyati thikra

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: By those who bring down the Reminder,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
translation_text: Then spread abroad a Message,

text_uthmani: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
translation_text: leaving no excuse (for the disbelievers) or giving warnings,

text_uthmani: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
translation_text: As justification or warning,

text_uthmani: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
translation_text: as a proof or a warning:

text_uthmani: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. To cut off all excuses or to warn.

text_uthmani: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
translation_text: to serve as an excuse or a warning.1

text_uthmani: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
translation_text: AAuthran aw nuthra

text_uthmani: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
translation_text: To excuse or to warn,

text_uthmani: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
translation_text: Whether of Justification or of Warning;-

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: that which you are promised is sure to happen.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: what you are promised will come to pass.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. Surely, what you are promised must come to pass.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: Surely what you are promised1 shall come to pass. 2

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: Innama tooAAadoona lawaqiAA

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation_text: Assuredly, what ye are promised must come to pass.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
translation_text: So, when the stars will be extinguished,

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
translation_text: So when the stars are obliterated

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. Then when the stars lose their lights.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
translation_text: When the stars are dimmed

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
translation_text: So when the stars are extinguished,1

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
translation_text: Fa-itha annujoomu tumisat

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
translation_text: So when the stars are put out,

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
translation_text: Then when the stars become dim;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
translation_text: and when the sky will be split,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
translation_text: And when the heaven is opened

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. And when the heaven is cleft asunder.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
translation_text: and the sky is torn apart,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
translation_text: and the sky is rent asunder,1

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
translation_text: Wa-itha assamao furijat

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
translation_text: And when the sky is riven asunder,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
translation_text: When the heaven is cleft asunder;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
translation_text: and when the mountains will be blown away as dust,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
translation_text: And when the mountains are blown away

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. And when the mountains are blown away.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
translation_text: when the mountains are turned to dust

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
translation_text: and the mountains are blown away,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
translation_text: Wa-itha aljibalu nusifat

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
translation_text: And when the mountains are blown away,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
translation_text: When the mountains are scattered (to the winds) as dust;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
translation_text: and when the messengers will be assembled at the appointed time, (then all matters will be decided.)

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
translation_text: And when the messengers' time has come...1

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. And when the Messengers are gathered to their time appointed.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
translation_text: and the messengers given their appointed time––

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
translation_text: and the appointed time to bring the Messengers together arrives,(then shall the promised event come to pass).1

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
translation_text: Wa-itha arrusulu oqqitat

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
translation_text: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
translation_text: And when the messengers are (all) appointed a time (to collect);-

text_uthmani: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
translation_text: (Do you know) for which day has all this been delayed?

text_uthmani: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
translation_text: For what Day was it postponed?1

text_uthmani: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. For what Day are these signs postponed?

text_uthmani: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
translation_text: for what Day has all this been set?

text_uthmani: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
translation_text: To which Day has this task been deferred?

text_uthmani: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
translation_text: Li-ayyi yawmin ojjilat

text_uthmani: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
translation_text: For what day is the time appointed?

text_uthmani: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
translation_text: For what Day are these (portents) deferred?

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: For the Day of Decision!

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: For the Day of Judgement.

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. For the Day of Sorting Out (the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell).

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: The Day of Decision.

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: To the Day of Judgement.

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: Liyawmi alfasl

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: For the Day of Decision.

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: For the Day of Sorting out.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: And what may let you know what the Day of Decision is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: What will explain to you what the Day of Decision is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. And what will explain to you what is the Day of Sorting Out?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: What do you know what the Day of Judgement is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: Wama adraka ma yawmualfasl

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
translation_text: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe that Day to the deniers!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe,1 that Day, to the deniers.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!1

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Waylun yawma-ithin lilmukaththibeen

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Did We not destroy the earlier people?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Did We not destroy the first [of them]?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. Did We not destroy the ancients?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Did We not destroy many a nation of the earlier times?1

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Alam nuhliki al-awwaleen

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Destroyed We not the former folk,

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Did We not destroy the men of old (for their evil)?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: Then We will cause the later ones to follow them.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: Then We will follow them with the later ones.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: We shall make the last follow them:

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. So shall We make later generations to follow them.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: And We shall cause those of later times1 to follow them.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: Thumma nutbiAAuhumu al-akhireen

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: Then caused the latter folk to follow after?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
translation_text: So shall We make later (generations) follow them.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Thus We deal with the guilty people.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We deal with the criminals.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. Thus do We deal with the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals).

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: this is how We deal with the guilty.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We deal with the guilty.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Kathalika nafAAalu bilmujrimeen

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.

text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We deal with men of sin.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe that Day to the deniers!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!1

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Waylun yawma-ithin lilmukaththibeen

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: Did We not create you from a worthless fluid?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: Did We not make you from an underrated fluid

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Did We not create you from a despised water (semen)?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: Did We not create you of a mean fluid,

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: Alam nakhluqkum min ma-in maheen

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: Did We not create you from a base fluid

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
translation_text: Have We not created you from a fluid (held) despicable?-

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
translation_text: Then We put it in a firm place of rest

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
translation_text: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
translation_text: which We housed in a safe lodging

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. Then We placed it in a place of safety (womb),

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
translation_text: which We then placed in a secure repository1

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
translation_text: FajaAAalnahu fee qararinmakeen

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
translation_text: Which We laid up in a safe abode

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
translation_text: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: for a known period.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: For a known extent.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: for a determined period?

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. For a known period (determined by gestation)?

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: until an appointed time?1

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: Ila qadarin maAAloom

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: For a known term?

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation_text: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?

text_uthmani: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: Thus We did (all this with perfect) measure; so We are the best to measure.

text_uthmani: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.

text_uthmani: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: We determine [it]: how excellently We determine!

text_uthmani: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. So We did measure; and We are the Best to measure (the things).

text_uthmani: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: See that We had the power to do so. Great indeed is Our power to do what We will.1

text_uthmani: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: Faqadarna faniAAma alqadiroon

text_uthmani: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!

text_uthmani: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
translation_text: For We do determine (according to need); for We are the best to determine (things).

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe that Day to the deniers!

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
translation_text: and they will be given no chance to offer any excuses.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
translation_text: nor will they be allowed to proffer excuses.1

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
translation_text: Wala yu/thanu lahum fayaAAtathiroon

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
translation_text: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
translation_text: Nor will it be open to them to put forth pleas.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe that Day to the deniers!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Waylun yawma-ithin lilmukaththibeen

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: (It will be said to them,) “This is the Day of Decision. We have assembled you and the earlier ones together.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: [They will be told], ‘This is the Day of Decision: We have gathered you and earlier generations.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together!

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: That is the Day of Judgement on which We have assembled you as well as all those who went before you.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Hatha yawmu alfasli jamaAAnakumwal-awwaleen

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.

text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!

text_uthmani: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
translation_text: Now, if you have a trick, use the trick against Me.”

text_uthmani: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
translation_text: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.

text_uthmani: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
translation_text: If you have any plots against Me, try them now.’

text_uthmani: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. So if you have a plot, use it against Me (Allâh جل جلاله)!

text_uthmani: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
translation_text: So if you have any ploy, try it against Me!1

text_uthmani: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
translation_text: Fa-in kana lakum kaydun fakeedoon

text_uthmani: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
translation_text: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.

text_uthmani: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
translation_text: Now, if ye have a trick (or plot), use it against Me!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe that Day to the deniers!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Waylun yawma-ithin lilmukaththibeen

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Of course, the God-fearing will be amid shades and streams,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: But those who took heed of God will enjoy cool shade, springs,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) shall be amidst shades and springs.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Behold, today the God-fearing1 will be amidst shades and springs,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Inna almuttaqeena fee thilalinwaAAuyoon

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation_text: As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).

text_uthmani: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation_text: and fruits of their desire.

text_uthmani: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation_text: And fruits from whatever they desire,

text_uthmani: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation_text: and any fruit they desire;

text_uthmani: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 42. And fruits, such as they desire.

text_uthmani: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation_text: and the fruits that they desire (will be ready at hand).

text_uthmani: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation_text: Wafawakiha mimma yashtahoon

text_uthmani: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation_text: And fruits such as they desire.

text_uthmani: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
translation_text: And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: It will be said to them, “Eat and drink with pleasure because of what you used to do.”

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: [they will be told], ‘Eat and drink to your hearts’ content as a reward for your deeds:

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. "Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do."

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Eat and drink and may every joy attend you as a reward for your deeds.

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: Kuloo washraboo hanee-an bimakuntum taAAmaloon

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
translation_text: "Eat ye and drink ye to your heart's content: for that ye worked (Righteousness).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: This is how We reward those who do good deeds.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: this is how We reward those who do good.’

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers. See V.2:112).

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We reward those that do good.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineen

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We reward the good.

text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation_text: Thus do We certainly reward the Doers of Good.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe that Day to the deniers!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 45. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe on that Day to those that give the lie to the Truth!1

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Waylun yawma-ithin lilmukaththibeen

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: “(O disbelievers,) eat and drink for a while! You are guilty ones.”

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: [You may] eat and enjoy yourselves for a short while, evildoers that you are.

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 46. (O you disbelievers)! Eat and enjoy yourselves (in this worldly life) for a little while. Verily, you are the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals).

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: Eat1 and enjoy yourselves for a while.2 Surely you are evil-doers.

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: Kuloo watamattaAAoo qaleelan innakummujrimoon

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.

text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
translation_text: (O ye unjust!) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (but) a little while, for that ye are Sinners.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe that Day to the deniers!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 47. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. And We have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water.

translation_text: 17. Verily, the Day of Decision is a fixed time,

translation_text: Surely the Day of Judgement has an appointed time;

text_uthmani: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا
translation_text: Save a boiling fluid and a fluid, dark, murky, intensely cold,

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
translation_text: this being a punishment, fully commensurate (with their deeds).

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
translation_text: An appropriate recompense.1

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
translation_text: a fitting requital,

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. An exact recompense (according to their evil crimes).

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
translation_text: a befitting recompense for their deeds.

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
translation_text: Jazaan wifaqa

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
translation_text: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
translation_text: A fitting recompense (for them).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
translation_text: They did not expect (to face) accounting (of their deeds),

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
translation_text: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
translation_text: for they did not fear a reckoning,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
translation_text: For indeed they did not look forward to any reckoning,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
translation_text: Innahum kanoo la yarjoona hisaba

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
translation_text: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
translation_text: For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds),

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
translation_text: and they rejected Our signs totally.

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
translation_text: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
translation_text: and they rejected Our messages as lies.

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. But they belied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, and that which Our Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم brought) completely.

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
translation_text: and roundly denied Our Signs as false.1

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
translation_text: Wakaththaboo bi-ayatinakiththaba

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
translation_text: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
translation_text: But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false.

text_uthmani: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
translation_text: And everything (from their deeds) is thoroughly recorded by Us in writing.

text_uthmani: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
translation_text: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

text_uthmani: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. And all things We have recorded in a Book.

text_uthmani: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
translation_text: We have recorded everything in a Record.

text_uthmani: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
translation_text: And everything have We recorded in a Book.1

text_uthmani: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
translation_text: Wakulla shay-in ahsaynahu kitaba

text_uthmani: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
translation_text: Everything have We recorded in a Book.

text_uthmani: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
translation_text: And all things have We preserved on record.

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
translation_text: “So now taste! We will add nothing to you but torment.”

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
translation_text: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."1

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
translation_text: ‘Taste this: all you will get from Us is more torment.’

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. So taste you (the results of your evil actions). No increase shall We give you, except in torment.

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
translation_text: So taste (the fruit of your deeds). We shall only increase your torment.

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
translation_text: Fathooqoo falan nazeedakum illaAAathaba

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
translation_text: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.

text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
translation_text: "So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment."

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
translation_text: Of course, the God-fearing will have great achievement,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
translation_text: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment1 -

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
translation_text: For those who were aware of God there is supreme fulfilment:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Verily, for the Muttaqûn,1 there will be a success (Paradise);

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
translation_text: Surely the state of triumph awaits the God-fearing:1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
translation_text: Inna lilmuttaqeena mafaza

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
translation_text: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -

text_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
translation_text: Verily for the Righteous there will be a fulfilment of (the heart's) desires;

text_uthmani: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
translation_text: -gardens and grapes,

text_uthmani: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
translation_text: Gardens and grapevines

text_uthmani: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
translation_text: private gardens, vineyards,

text_uthmani: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. Gardens and vineyards,

text_uthmani: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
translation_text: gardens and vineyards,

text_uthmani: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
translation_text: Hada-iqa waaAAnaba

text_uthmani: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
translation_text: Gardens enclosed and vineyards,

text_uthmani: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
translation_text: Gardens enclosed, and grapevines;

text_uthmani: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
translation_text: and buxom maidens of matching age,

text_uthmani: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
translation_text: And young women [companions] of equal age.

text_uthmani: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
translation_text: nubile, well-matched companions,

text_uthmani: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. And young full-breasted (mature) maidens of equal age,

text_uthmani: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
translation_text: and youthful maidens of like age,1

text_uthmani: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
translation_text: WakawaAAiba atraba

text_uthmani: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
translation_text: And voluptuous women of equal age;

text_uthmani: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
translation_text: And voluptuous women of equal age;

text_uthmani: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
translation_text: and goblets filled up to the brim.

text_uthmani: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
translation_text: And a full cup.1

text_uthmani: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
translation_text: and an overflowing cup.

text_uthmani: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 34. And a full cup (of wine).

text_uthmani: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
translation_text: and an overflowing cup.

text_uthmani: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
translation_text: Waka/san dihaqa

text_uthmani: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
translation_text: And a full cup.

text_uthmani: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
translation_text: And a cup full (to the brim).

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
translation_text: They will not hear any vain talk therein, nor lies,

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
translation_text: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
translation_text: There they will hear no vain or lying talk:

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 35. No Laghw (dirty, false, evil talk) shall they hear therein, nor lying;

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
translation_text: Therein they shall hear no idle talk, nor any falsehood;1

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
translation_text: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwanwala kiththaba

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
translation_text: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -

text_uthmani: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
translation_text: No vanity shall they hear therein, nor Untruth:-

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
translation_text: this being a reward from their Lord, a well calculated grant,

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
translation_text: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,1

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
translation_text: a reward from your Lord, a fitting gift

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: A reward from your Lord, an ample calculated gift (according to the best of their good deeds),1

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
translation_text: a recompense from your Lord and an ample reward1

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
translation_text: Jazaan min rabbika AAataan hisaba

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
translation_text: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -

text_uthmani: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
translation_text: Recompense from thy Lord, a gift, (amply) sufficient,

text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
translation_text: (from) the Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the All-Merciful. No one will have power to address Him,

text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
translation_text: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.1

text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
translation_text: from the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between, the Lord of Mercy. They will have no authority from Him to speak.

text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatsoever is in between them, the Most Gracious, with Whom they cannot dare to speak (on the Day of Resurrection except by His Leave).

text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
translation_text: from the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of that which is between them; the Most Merciful Lord before Whom none dare utter a word.1

text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
translation_text: Rabbi assamawati wal-ardiwama baynahuma arrahmani layamlikoona minhu khitaba

text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
translation_text: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.

text_uthmani: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
translation_text: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between, (Allah) Most Gracious: None shall have power to argue with Him.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
translation_text: on the Day when the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows. They will not speak, except the one who is permitted by the RaHmān (the All-Merciful Allah) and speaks aright.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
translation_text: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
translation_text: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in rows, they will not speak except for those to whom the Lord of Mercy gives permission, who will say only what is right.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. The Day that Ar-Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel) or another angel] and the angels will stand forth in rows, they will not speak except him whom the Most Gracious (Allâh) allows, and he will speak what is right.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
translation_text: The Day when the Spirit1 and the angels are ranged row on row. None shall speak save he whom the Merciful Lord will permit; and he too will speak what is right.2

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
translation_text: Yawma yaqoomu arroohu walmala-ikatusaffan la yatakallamoona illa man athinalahu arrahmanu waqala sawaba

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
translation_text: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
translation_text: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand forth in ranks, none shall speak except any who is permitted by (Allah) Most Gracious, and He will say what is right.

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
translation_text: That is the Day that is sure to come. So whoever so wishes may take refuge with his Lord.

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
translation_text: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.1

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
translation_text: That is the Day of Truth. So whoever wishes to do so should take the path that leads to his Lord.

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. That is (without doubt) the True Day. So, whosoever wills, let him seek a place with (or a way to) His Lord (by obeying Him in this worldly life)!

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
translation_text: That Day is sure to come. So let him who will seek a resort with his Lord.

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
translation_text: Thalika alyawmu alhaqqu famanshaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi maaba

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
translation_text: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.

text_uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
translation_text: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord!

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
translation_text: We have warned you of an approaching torment (that will be inflicted) on a day when one will see what his hands have sent ahead, and the disbeliever will say, “O would that I had turned into dust.”

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
translation_text: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth1 and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
translation_text: We have warned you of imminent torment, on the Day when every person will see what their own hands have sent ahead for them, when the disbeliever will say, ‘If only I were dust!’

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. Verily, We have warned you of a near torment - the Day when man will see that (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say: "Woe to me! Would that I were dust!"

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
translation_text: Lo! We warn you of a chastisement near at hand;1 the Day when a man will look on what his own hands have sent forth, and the unbelievers shall say: “Oh would that I were utter dust.”2

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
translation_text: Inna antharnakum AAathabanqareeban yawma yanthuru almaro ma qaddamatyadahu wayaqoolu alkafiru ya laytanee kuntuturaba

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
translation_text: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
translation_text: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (mere) dust!"

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
translation_text: I swear by those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the infidels) with extreme force,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
translation_text: By those [angels] who extract with violence1

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
translation_text: By the forceful chargers

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: By those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the disbelievers and the wicked) with great violence.

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
translation_text: By those (angels) that pluck out the soul from depths,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
translation_text: WannaziAAati gharqa

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
translation_text: By those who drag forth to destruction,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
translation_text: By the (angels) who tear out (the souls of the wicked) with violence;

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
translation_text: and by those (angels) who untie the knot (of the souls of the believers) smoothly,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
translation_text: And [by] those who remove with ease1

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
translation_text: raring to go,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. By those (angels) who gently take out (the souls of the believers).

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
translation_text: and gently take it away;

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
translation_text: Wannashitati nashta

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
translation_text: By the meteors rushing,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
translation_text: By those who gently draw out (the souls of the blessed);

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
translation_text: and by those who float (in the atmosphere) swiftly,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
translation_text: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming1

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And by those that swim along (i.e. angels or planets in their orbits).

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
translation_text: sweeping ahead at full stretch,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
translation_text: and by those that speedily glide along (the cosmos),

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
translation_text: Wassabihati sabha

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
translation_text: By the lone stars floating,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
translation_text: And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),

text_uthmani: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
translation_text: then proceed forward quickly,

text_uthmani: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
translation_text: And those who race each other in a race1

text_uthmani: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
translation_text: overtaking swiftly

text_uthmani: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And by those that press forward as in a race (i.e. the angels or stars or the horses).

text_uthmani: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
translation_text: and vie with the others(in carrying out their Lord's behests);

text_uthmani: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
translation_text: Fassabiqati sabqa

text_uthmani: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
translation_text: By the angels hastening,

text_uthmani: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
translation_text: Then press forward as in a race,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: then manage (to do) everything (they are ordered to do,)

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: And those who arrange [each] matter,1

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: to bring the matter to an end,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. And by those angels who arrange to do the Commands of their Lord, (so verily, you disbelievers will be called to account).

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: and then manage the affairs of the Universe(according to their Lord's commands).1

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: Falmudabbirati amra

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: And those who govern the event,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation_text: Then arrange to do (the Commands of their Lord),

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
translation_text: (you will be resurrected) on the Day when the shocking event (i.e. the first blowing of the trumpet) will shock (everything),

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
translation_text: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
translation_text: on the Day when the blast reverberates

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. On the Day (when the first blowing of the Trumpet is blown), the earth and the mountains will shake violently (and everybody will die).

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
translation_text: The Day when the quaking will cause a violent convulsion,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
translation_text: Yawma tarjufu arrajifa

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
translation_text: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
translation_text: One Day everything that can be in commotion will be in violent commotion,

text_uthmani: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
translation_text: followed by the next one (i.e. the second blowing of the trumpet.)

text_uthmani: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
translation_text: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

text_uthmani: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. The second blowing of the Trumpet follows it (and everybody will be resurrected).

text_uthmani: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
translation_text: and the second blast follows,

text_uthmani: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
translation_text: and will be followed by another quaking.1

text_uthmani: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
translation_text: TatbaAAuha arradifa

text_uthmani: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
translation_text: And the second followeth it,

text_uthmani: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
translation_text: Followed by oft-repeated (commotions):

text_uthmani: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
translation_text: On that day, hearts (of people) will be throbbing,

text_uthmani: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
translation_text: Hearts,1 that Day, will tremble,

text_uthmani: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
translation_text: hearts will tremble

text_uthmani: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. (Some) hearts that Day will shake with fear and anxiety.

text_uthmani: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
translation_text: On that Day some hearts shall tremble (with fright),1

text_uthmani: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
translation_text: Quloobun yawma-ithin wajifa

text_uthmani: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
translation_text: On that day hearts beat painfully

text_uthmani: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
translation_text: Hearts that Day will be in agitation;

text_uthmani: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
translation_text: with their eyes downcast.

text_uthmani: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
translation_text: Their eyes1 humbled.

text_uthmani: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
translation_text: and eyes will be downcast.

text_uthmani: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. Their eyes will be downcast.

text_uthmani: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
translation_text: and their eyes shall be downcast with dread.

text_uthmani: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
translation_text: Absaruha khashiAAa

text_uthmani: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
translation_text: While eyes are downcast

text_uthmani: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
translation_text: Cast down will be (their owners') eyes.

text_uthmani: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
translation_text: They (the infidels) say, “Are we going to be brought back to our former state (of Life)?

text_uthmani: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
translation_text: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

text_uthmani: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. They say: "Shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state of life?

text_uthmani: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
translation_text: They say, ‘What? shall we be brought back to life,

text_uthmani: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
translation_text: They say: “Shall we indeed be restored to life,

text_uthmani: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
translation_text: Yaqooloona a-inna lamardoodoona feealhafira

text_uthmani: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
translation_text: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state

text_uthmani: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
translation_text: They say (now): "What! shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state?

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
translation_text: Is it when we are turned into decayed bones?”

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
translation_text: Even if we should be decayed bones?"1

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. "Even after we are crumbled bones?"

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
translation_text: after we have turned into decayed bones?’ and they say,

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
translation_text: even after we have been reduced to bones, hollow and rotten?”

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
translation_text: A-itha kunna AAithamannakhira

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
translation_text: Even after we are crumbled bones?

text_uthmani: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
translation_text: "What! - when we shall have become rotten bones?"

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: They say, “If so, that will be a harmful homecoming.”

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."1

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: ‘Such a return is impossible!’

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. They say: "It would in that case, be a return with loss!"

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: They say: “That will then be a return with a great loss!”1

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: Qaloo tilka ithan karratun khasira

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.

text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
translation_text: They say: "It would, in that case, be a return with loss!"

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: In fact, it will be only a single harsh voice,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: But all it will take is a single blast,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. But it will be only a single Zajrah [shout (i.e., the second blowing of the Trumpet)], (See Verse 37:19).

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: Surely they will need no more than a single stern blast,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: Fa-innama hiya zajratun wahida

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: Surely it will need but one shout,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
translation_text: But verily, it will be but a single (Compelling) Cry,

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
translation_text: and in no time they will be (brought) into the plain (of Hashr).

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
translation_text: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
translation_text: and they will be back above ground.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. When behold, they find themselves on the surface of the earth alive after their death,

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
translation_text: and lo, they will all be in the open plain.1

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
translation_text: Fa-itha hum bissahira

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
translation_text: And lo! they will be awakened.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
translation_text: When, behold, they will be in the (full) awakening (to Judgment).

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
translation_text: Has there come to you the narrative about Mūsā?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
translation_text: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
translation_text: Have you [Prophet] heard the story of Moses?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. Has there come to you the story of Mûsâ (Moses)?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
translation_text: Has1 Moses' story reached you?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
translation_text: Hal ataka hadeethu moosa

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
translation_text: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
translation_text: Has the story of Moses reached thee?

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
translation_text: (Recall) when his Lord called to him in the blessed valley of Tuwā:

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
translation_text: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tûwâ,

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
translation_text: His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
translation_text: When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,1

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
translation_text: Ith nadahu rabbuhu bilwadialmuqaddasi tuwa

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
translation_text: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,

text_uthmani: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
translation_text: Behold, thy Lord did call to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:-

text_uthmani: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
translation_text: “Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh). Indeed, he has crossed all bounds.

text_uthmani: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
translation_text: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

text_uthmani: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
translation_text: ‘Go to Pharaoh, for he has exceeded all bounds,

text_uthmani: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh); verily he has transgressed all bounds (in crimes, sins, polytheism, disbelief).

text_uthmani: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
translation_text: and directed him: “Go to Pharaoh, he has rebelled,

text_uthmani: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
translation_text: Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha

text_uthmani: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
translation_text: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -

text_uthmani: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
translation_text: "Go thou to Pharaoh for he has indeed transgressed all bounds:

text_uthmani: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: And say (to him,) ‘Would you like to purify yourself,

text_uthmani: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself

text_uthmani: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: and ask him, “Do you want to purify yourself [of sin]?

text_uthmani: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. And say to him: "Would you purify yourself (from the sin of disbelief by becoming a believer)?"

text_uthmani: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: and say to him: 'Are you willing to be purified,

text_uthmani: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: Faqul hal laka ila an tazakka

text_uthmani: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?

text_uthmani: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: "And say to him, 'Wouldst thou that thou shouldst be purified (from sin)?-

text_uthmani: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: and that I should guide you to your Lord, so that you fear (Him)?’”

text_uthmani: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

text_uthmani: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: Do you want me to guide you to your Lord, so that you may hold Him in awe?” ’

text_uthmani: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. "And that I guide you to your Lord, so you should fear Him?"

text_uthmani: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: that I may direct you to your Lord and then you hold Him1 in awe?' ”

text_uthmani: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: Waahdiyaka ila rabbika fatakhsha

text_uthmani: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).

text_uthmani: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: "'And that I guide thee to thy Lord, so thou shouldst fear Him?'"

text_uthmani: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: So, he (Mūsā) showed him the biggest sign.

text_uthmani: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: And he showed him the greatest sign,1

text_uthmani: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: Moses showed him the great sign,

text_uthmani: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. Then [Mûsâ (Moses)] showed him the great sign (miracles).

text_uthmani: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: Then Moses (went to Pharaoh and) showed him the Great Sign;1

text_uthmani: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: Faarahu al-ayata alkubra

text_uthmani: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: And he showed him the tremendous token.

text_uthmani: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: Then did (Moses) show him the Great Sign.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
translation_text: But he rejected and disobeyed,

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
translation_text: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
translation_text: but he denied it and refused [the faith].

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. But [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] belied and disobeyed.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
translation_text: but he denied it as false and disobeyed,

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
translation_text: Fakaththaba waAAasa

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
translation_text: But he denied and disobeyed,

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
translation_text: But (Pharaoh) rejected it and disobeyed (guidance);

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: then he turned back, and tried hard (to refute the Messenger),

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: He turned away and hastily

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. Then he turned his back, striving (against Allâh).

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: and then he turned back to have recourse to his craftiness,1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: Thumma adbara yasAAa

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: Then turned he away in haste,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: Further, he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).

text_uthmani: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
translation_text: then he gathered (his people) and shouted

text_uthmani: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
translation_text: And he gathered [his people] and called out

text_uthmani: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
translation_text: gathered his people, proclaiming,

text_uthmani: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. Then he gathered (his people) and cried aloud,

text_uthmani: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
translation_text: and gathered his people and declared:1

text_uthmani: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
translation_text: Fahashara fanada

text_uthmani: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
translation_text: Then gathered he and summoned

text_uthmani: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
translation_text: Then he collected (his men) and made a proclamation,

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: and said, “I am your supreme lord.”

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. Saying: "I am your lord, most high."

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: ‘I am your supreme lord,’

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: “I am the supreme lord of you all.”

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: Faqala ana rabbukumu al-aAAla

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: Saying, "I am your Lord, Most High".

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: So, Allah seized him for an exemplary punishment in the Hereafter and the present world.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].1.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: so God condemned him to punishment in the life to come as well as in this life:

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: So Allâh, seized him with punishment for his last1 and first2 transgression. [Tafsir At-Tabari]

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: Thereupon Allah seized him for the chastisement of the World to Come as well as of the present.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: Faakhathahu Allahu nakalaal-akhirati wal-oola

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.

text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
translation_text: But Allah did punish him, (and made an) example of him, - in the Hereafter, as in this life.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
translation_text: Indeed, there is a lesson for him who fears (Allah).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
translation_text: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. Verily, in this is an instructive admonition for whosoever fears Allâh.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
translation_text: there truly is a lesson in this for anyone who stands in awe of God.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
