translation_text: Surely there is a great lesson in it for whoever would fear (Allah).1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
translation_text: Inna fee thalika laAAibratan limanyakhsha

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
translation_text: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
translation_text: Verily in this is an instructive warning for whosoever feareth (Allah).

text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: Is your creation more difficult or that of the sky? He has built it,

text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.

text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. Are you more difficult to create or is the heaven that He constructed?

text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: Which is harder to create: you people or the sky that He built,

text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: Is1 it harder to create you or the heaven?2 But Allah built it,

text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: Aantum ashaddu khalqan ami assamaobanaha

text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?

text_uthmani: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: What! Are ye the more difficult to create or the heaven (above)? (Allah) hath constructed it:

text_uthmani: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: He has raised its height, then made it proper,

text_uthmani: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

text_uthmani: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. He raised its height, and has perfected it.

text_uthmani: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: raising it high and perfecting it,

text_uthmani: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: and raised its vault high and proportioned it;

text_uthmani: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: RafaAAa samkaha fasawwaha

text_uthmani: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;

text_uthmani: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: On high hath He raised its canopy, and He hath given it order and perfection.

text_uthmani: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: and darkened its night, and brought forth its daylight,

text_uthmani: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.1

text_uthmani: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: giving darkness to its night and bringing out its morning brightness,

text_uthmani: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. Its night He covers with darkness and its forenoon He brings out (with light)

text_uthmani: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: and covered its night with darkness and brought forth from it its day;1

text_uthmani: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: Waaghtasha laylaha waakhraja duhaha

text_uthmani: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.

text_uthmani: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: Its night doth He endow with darkness, and its splendour doth He bring out (with light).

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
translation_text: and, after that, He spread out the earth.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
translation_text: And after that He spread the earth.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. And after that He spread the earth,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
translation_text: and the earth, too, He spread out,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
translation_text: and thereafter spread out the earth,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
translation_text: Wal-arda baAAda thalikadahaha

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
translation_text: And after that He spread the earth,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
translation_text: And the earth, moreover, hath He extended (to a wide expanse);

text_uthmani: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
translation_text: From it, He brought out its water and its meadows,

text_uthmani: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
translation_text: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

text_uthmani: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. And brought forth therefrom its water and its pasture.

text_uthmani: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
translation_text: bringing waters and pastures out of it,

text_uthmani: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
translation_text: and brought out of it its water and its pasture,1

text_uthmani: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
translation_text: Akhraja minha maahawamarAAaha

text_uthmani: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
translation_text: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,

text_uthmani: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
translation_text: He draweth out therefrom its moisture and its pasture;

text_uthmani: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: and firmly fixed the mountains,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: And the mountains He set firmly

text_uthmani: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: and setting firm mountains [in it]

text_uthmani: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. And the mountains He has fixed firmly,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: and firmly fixed in it mountains;

text_uthmani: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: Waljibala arsaha

text_uthmani: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: And He made fast the hills,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: And the mountains hath He firmly fixed;-

text_uthmani: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
translation_text: (all this) as a benefit to you and your cattle.

text_uthmani: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
translation_text: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

text_uthmani: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
translation_text: for you and your animals to enjoy?

text_uthmani: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.

text_uthmani: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
translation_text: all this as provision for you and your cattle.1

text_uthmani: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
translation_text: MataAAan lakum wali-anAAamikum

text_uthmani: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
translation_text: A provision for you and for your cattle.

text_uthmani: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
translation_text: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: So when the Greatest Havoc will take place

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity1 -

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: When the great overwhelming event arrives

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 34. But when there comes the greatest catastrophe (i.e. the Day of Recompense) -

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: But when the great calamity will come about1

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: Fa-itha jaati attammatualkubra

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: But when the great disaster cometh,

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: Therefore, when there comes the great, overwhelming (Event),-

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: on the day when man will recall what he did,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 35. The Day when man shall remember what he strove for.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: on the Day that man remembers what he has done

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: on the Day when man will recall all his strivings,1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: Yawma yatathakkaru al-insanu masaAAa

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
translation_text: The Day when man shall remember (all) that he strove for,

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
translation_text: and the Hell will be exposed for all who see,

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
translation_text: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
translation_text: and Hell is there for all to see,

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. And Hell-fire shall be made apparent in full view for (every) one who sees.

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
translation_text: and Hell will be brought in sight for anyone to see:

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
translation_text: Waburrizati aljaheemu liman yara

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
translation_text: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,

text_uthmani: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
translation_text: And Hell-Fire shall be placed in full view for (all) to see,-

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
translation_text: then for the one who had rebelled,

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
translation_text: So as for he who transgressed

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 37. Then for him who transgressed all bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and evil deeds of disobedience to Allâh).

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
translation_text: for anyone who has transgressed

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
translation_text: then he who transgressed

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
translation_text: Faamma man tagha

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
translation_text: Then, as for him who rebelled

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
translation_text: Then, for such as had transgressed all bounds,

text_uthmani: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: and preferred the worldly life (to the Hereafter),

text_uthmani: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: And preferred the life of the world,

text_uthmani: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: and preferred the present life

text_uthmani: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 38. And preferred the life of this world (by following his evil desires and lusts),

text_uthmani: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: and preferred the life of this world,

text_uthmani: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: Waathara alhayata addunya

text_uthmani: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: And chose the life of the world,

text_uthmani: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
translation_text: And had preferred the life of this world,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: the Hell will be the abode,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: Hell will be home;

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 39. Verily, his abode will be Hell-fire;

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: most surely his abode shall be Hell.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: Fa-inna aljaheema hiya alma/wa

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: Lo! hell will be his home.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: The Abode will be Hell-Fire;

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
translation_text: whereas for the one who feared to stand before his Lord, and restrained his self from the (evil) desire,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
translation_text: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord1 and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
translation_text: for anyone who feared the meeting with his Lord and restrained himself from base desires,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 40. But as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and restrained himself from impure evil desires and lusts.

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
translation_text: But he who feared to stand before his Lord, and restrained himself from evil desires,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
translation_text: Waama man khafa maqamarabbihi wanaha annafsa AAani alhawa

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
translation_text: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
translation_text: And for such as had entertained the fear of standing before their Lord's (tribunal) and had restrained (their) soul from lower desires,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: the Paradise will be the abode.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: Paradise will be home.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 41. Verily, Paradise will be his abode.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: most surely his abode shall be Paradise.1

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: Fa-inna aljannata hiya alma/wa

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: Lo! the Garden will be his home.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
translation_text: Their abode will be the Garden.

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: They ask you (O Prophet,) about the Hour (the Day of Judgment) as to when it will take place.

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?1

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: They ask you [Prophet] about the Hour,

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 42. They ask you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) about the Hour - when will be its appointed time?

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: They ask you about the Hour: “When will it be?”1

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: Yas-aloonaka AAani assaAAatiayyana mursaha

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?

text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
translation_text: They ask thee about the Hour,-'When will be its appointed time?

text_uthmani: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
translation_text: In which capacity are you to tell this?

text_uthmani: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
translation_text: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?1

text_uthmani: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
translation_text: saying, ‘When will it arrive?’, but how can you tell [them that]?

text_uthmani: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 43. You have no knowledge to say anything about it.

text_uthmani: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
translation_text: What concern do you have to speak about that?

text_uthmani: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
translation_text: Feema anta min thikraha

text_uthmani: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
translation_text: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?

text_uthmani: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
translation_text: Wherein art thou (concerned) with the declaration thereof?

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
translation_text: With your Lord is the final word about it.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
translation_text: To your Lord is its finality.1

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
translation_text: Its time is known only to your Lord;

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 44. To your Lord belongs (the knowledge of) the term thereof?

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
translation_text: Its knowledge rests with your Lord.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
translation_text: Ila rabbika muntahaha

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
translation_text: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.

text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
translation_text: With thy Lord in the Limit fixed therefor.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: You are only a warner for anyone who fears it.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 45. You (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are only a warner for those who fear it,

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: you are only sent to warn those who fear it.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: You are only a warner to him who has a fear of it.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: Innama anta munthiru manyakhshaha

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.

text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: The day they will see it, it will seem to them as if they did not live (in the world) but only for one afternoon or for the morning thereof.

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: It will be, on the Day they see it,1 as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 46. The Day they see it, (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an afternoon or a morning.

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: On the Day they see it, it will seem they lingered [in this life] an evening [at most,] or its morning.

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: On the Day they see it, they will feel as though they had stayed (in the grave) no more than one evening or one morning.1

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: Kaannahum yawma yarawnaha lamyalbathoo illa AAashiyyatan aw duhaha

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.

text_uthmani: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they had tarried but a single evening, or (at most till) the following morn!

text_uthmani: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation_text: He (the Prophet) frowned and turned his face,

text_uthmani: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation_text: He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away

text_uthmani: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. (The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم) frowned and turned away.

text_uthmani: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation_text: He frowned and turned away

text_uthmani: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation_text: He frowned and turned away

text_uthmani: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation_text: AAabasa watawalla

text_uthmani: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation_text: He frowned and turned away

text_uthmani: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
translation_text: (The Prophet) frowned and turned away,

text_uthmani: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
translation_text: because the blind man came to him!

text_uthmani: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
translation_text: Because there came to him the blind man,1 [interrupting].

text_uthmani: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. Because there came to him the blind man (i.e. ‘Abdullâh bin Umm-Maktûm, who came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم while he was preaching to one or some of the Quraish chiefs).

text_uthmani: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
translation_text: when the blind man came to him––

text_uthmani: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
translation_text: that the blind man came to him.1

text_uthmani: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
translation_text: An jaahu al-aAAma

text_uthmani: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
translation_text: Because the blind man came unto him.

text_uthmani: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
translation_text: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting).

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
translation_text: What could tell you (O prophet about the prospects of the blind man?) May be, (if you had attended him properly,) he would have attained purity,

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
translation_text: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified1

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And how can you know that he might become pure (from sins)?

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
translation_text: for all you know, he might have grown in spirit,

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
translation_text: How could you know? Perhaps he would cleanse himself,

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
translation_text: Wama yudreeka laAAallahu yazzakka

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
translation_text: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
translation_text: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: or have received the advice, and the advice would have benefited him.

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. Or he might receive admonition, and the admonition might profit him?

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: or taken note of something useful to him.

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: or he might be mindful and good counsel might avail him.

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: Aw yaththakkaru fatanfaAAahu aththikra

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?

text_uthmani: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
translation_text: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him?

text_uthmani: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: As for the one who does not care (about faith),

text_uthmani: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: As for he who thinks himself without need,1

text_uthmani: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,

text_uthmani: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: For the self-satisfied one

text_uthmani: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: Now he who waxes indifferent,

text_uthmani: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: Amma mani istaghna

text_uthmani: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: As for him who thinketh himself independent,

text_uthmani: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
translation_text: you are anxious to pursue him,

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
translation_text: To him you give attention.

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. To him you attend;

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
translation_text: you go out of your way––

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
translation_text: you attend to him,

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
translation_text: Faanta lahu tasadda

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
translation_text: Unto him thou payest regard.

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
translation_text: To him dost thou attend;

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
translation_text: while there is no blame on you, if he does not attain purity.

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
translation_text: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.1

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. What does it matter to you if he will not become pure (from disbelief: you are only a Messenger, your duty is to convey the Message of Allâh).

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
translation_text: though you are not to be blamed for his lack of spiritual growth––

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
translation_text: though you are not to blame if he would not cleanse himself.

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
translation_text: Wama AAalayka alla yazzakka

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
translation_text: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).

text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
translation_text: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding).

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: As regards the one who has come to you rushing eagerly,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. But as to him who came to you running,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: but from the one who has come to you full of eagerness

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: But he who comes to you running,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: Waamma man jaaka yasAAa

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
translation_text: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly,

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: while he fears (Allah),

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: While he fears [Allāh],

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. And is afraid (of Allâh and His punishment).

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: and awe

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: and fears (Allah),

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: Wahuwa yakhsha

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: And hath fear,

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: And with fear (in his heart),

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
translation_text: to him you pay no heed!

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
translation_text: From him you are distracted.

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another,

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
translation_text: you allow yourself to be distracted.

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
translation_text: you pay no heed to him.1

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
translation_text: Faanta AAanhu talahha

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
translation_text: From him thou art distracted.

text_uthmani: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
translation_text: Of him wast thou unmindful.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: Never! (you should never act in this way,) Indeed this (Qur’ān) is an advice.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Nay, (do not do like this); indeed it (this Qur’ân) is an admonition.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: No indeed! This [Quran] is a lesson

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: No indeed;1 this is only a Reminder.2

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: Kalla innaha tathkira

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
translation_text: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: So, whoever so wills may pay heed to it.

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: So whoever wills may remember it.1

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. So whoever wills, let him pay attention to it.

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: from which those who wish to be taught should learn,

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: So whoso wills may give heed to it.

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: Faman shaa thakarah

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,

text_uthmani: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
translation_text: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance.

text_uthmani: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
translation_text: It is (recorded) in those scripts (of the Preserved Tablet) that are honoured,

text_uthmani: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
translation_text: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,

text_uthmani: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. (It is) in Records held (greatly) in honour (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz),

text_uthmani: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
translation_text: [written] on honoured,

text_uthmani: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
translation_text: It is contained in scrolls highly honoured,

text_uthmani: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
translation_text: Fee suhufin mukarrama

text_uthmani: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
translation_text: On honoured leaves

text_uthmani: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
translation_text: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour,

text_uthmani: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
translation_text: exalted, purified,

text_uthmani: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
translation_text: Exalted and purified,

text_uthmani: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. Exalted (in dignity), purified,

text_uthmani: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
translation_text: exalted, pure pages,

text_uthmani: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
translation_text: most exalted and purified,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
translation_text: and by the night when it departs,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
translation_text: And by the night as it closes in1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
translation_text: by the night that descends,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. And by the night as it departs.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
translation_text: and by the night as it recedes,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
translation_text: Wallayli itha AAasAAas

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
translation_text: And the close of night,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
translation_text: And the Night as it dissipates;

text_uthmani: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
translation_text: and the morning when it starts breathing,

text_uthmani: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
translation_text: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]

text_uthmani: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
translation_text: by the dawn that softly breathes:

text_uthmani: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. And by the dawn as it brightens.

text_uthmani: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
translation_text: and the morn as it breathes.1

text_uthmani: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
translation_text: Wassubhi ithatanaffas

text_uthmani: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
translation_text: And the breath of morning

text_uthmani: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
translation_text: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: it (the Qur’ān) is surely the word of a noble messenger (Jibra’īl X),

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: this is the speech of a noble messenger,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. Verily, this is the Word (this Qur’ân brought by) a most honourable messenger [Jibrîl (Gabrîl), from Allâh to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم].

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: Verily this is the word of a noble message-bearer;1

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareem

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
translation_text: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger,

text_uthmani: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
translation_text: the one possessing power and a high status with the Lord of the Throne,

text_uthmani: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
translation_text: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

text_uthmani: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
translation_text: who possesses great strength and is held in honour by the Lord of the Throne––

text_uthmani: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. Owner of power, (and high rank) with (Allâh), the Lord of the Throne,

text_uthmani: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
translation_text: one mighty1 and held in honour with the Lord of the Throne;

text_uthmani: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
translation_text: Thee quwwatin AAinda theealAAarshi makeen

text_uthmani: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
translation_text: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,

text_uthmani: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
translation_text: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,

text_uthmani: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: the one obeyed there, trusted.

text_uthmani: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

text_uthmani: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: he is obeyed there and worthy of trust.

text_uthmani: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. Obeyed (by the angels in the heavens), and trustworthy.

text_uthmani: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: there he is obeyed1 and held trustworthy.2

text_uthmani: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: MutaAAin thamma ameen

text_uthmani: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy;

text_uthmani: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
translation_text: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust.

text_uthmani: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: Your companion (Muhammad ) is not a madman,

text_uthmani: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.1

text_uthmani: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: Your companion is not mad:

text_uthmani: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. And (O people) your companion (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is not a madman.

text_uthmani: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: (O people of Makkah), your companion1 is not mad;

text_uthmani: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: Wama sahibukum bimajnoon

text_uthmani: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: And your comrade is not mad.

text_uthmani: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
translation_text: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed;

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_text: and he did see him (Jibra’īl X) on the clear horizon.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_text: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.1

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_text: he did see him on the clear horizon.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. And indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw him [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] in the clear horizon (towards the east).

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_text: he indeed saw the message-bearer on the clear horizon;1

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_text: Walaqad raahu bilofuqialmubeen

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_text: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.

text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
translation_text: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
translation_text: And he (the Prophet) is not stingy about (the news of) the unseen.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
translation_text: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.1

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
translation_text: He does not withhold what is revealed to him from beyond.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. And he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) withholds not a knowledge of the Unseen.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
translation_text: nor does he grudge (conveying this knowledge about) the Unseen;1

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
translation_text: Wama huwa AAala alghaybi bidaneen

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
translation_text: And he is not avid of the Unseen.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
translation_text: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
translation_text: Nor is it the word of an outcast satan (devil).

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
translation_text: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
translation_text: This is not the word of an outcast devil.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. And it (the Qur’ân) is not the word of the outcast Shaitân (Satan).

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
translation_text: nor is it a word of an accursed Satan.1

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
translation_text: Wama huwa biqawli shaytaninrajeem

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
translation_text: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
translation_text: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed.

text_uthmani: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
translation_text: Then where are you going?

text_uthmani: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
translation_text: So where are you going?1

text_uthmani: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
translation_text: So where are you [people] going?

text_uthmani: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. Then where are you going?

text_uthmani: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
translation_text: Where to are you then heading?

text_uthmani: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
translation_text: Faayna tathhaboon

text_uthmani: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
translation_text: Whither then go ye?

text_uthmani: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
translation_text: When whither go ye?

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: It is nothing else but a message of advice for all the worlds,

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: This is a message for all people;

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Verily, this (the Qur’ân) is no less than a Reminder to (all) the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn)1

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: It is nothing but Good Counsel for everyone in the world,

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameen

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,

text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds:

text_uthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: for the benefit of any one from among you who intends to go straight.

text_uthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

text_uthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: for those who wish to take the straight path.

text_uthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight.

text_uthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: for everyone of you who wishes to follow the Straight Way;1

text_uthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: Liman shaa minkum an yastaqeem

text_uthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.

text_uthmani: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And you cannot intend (to do anything) unless it is so willed by Allah, the Lord of all the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. And you cannot will unless (it be) that Allâh wills - the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: But you will only wish to do so by the will of God, the Lord of all people.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: but your wishing will not avail unless Allah, the Lord of the Universe, so wishes.1

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Wama tashaoona illa anyashaa Allahu rabbu alAAalameen

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: But ye shall not will except as Allah wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds.

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ

translation_text: When the sky will be cleft asunder,

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
translation_text: When the sky breaks apart

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. When the heaven is cleft asunder.

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
translation_text: When the sky is torn apart,

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
translation_text: When the heaven is split asunder,1

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
translation_text: Itha assamao infatarat

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
translation_text: When the heaven is cleft asunder,

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
translation_text: When the Sky is cleft asunder;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
translation_text: and when the stars will disperse,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
translation_text: And when the stars fall, scattering,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. And when the stars have fallen and scattered.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
translation_text: when the stars are scattered,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
translation_text: when the stars are scattered,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
translation_text: Wa-itha alkawakibu intatharat

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
translation_text: When the planets are dispersed,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
translation_text: When the Stars are scattered;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
translation_text: and when the seas will be burst forth,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
translation_text: And when the seas are erupted

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And when the seas are burst forth.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
translation_text: when the seas burst forth,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
translation_text: when the seas are made to burst forth,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
translation_text: Wa-itha albiharu fujjirat

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
translation_text: When the seas are poured forth,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
translation_text: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
translation_text: and when the graves will be overturned,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
translation_text: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And when the graves are turned upside down (and bring out their contents)

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
translation_text: when graves turn inside out:

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
translation_text: and when graves are laid open,1

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
translation_text: Wa-itha alqubooru buAAthirat

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
translation_text: And the sepulchres are overturned,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
translation_text: And when the Graves are turned upside down;-

text_uthmani: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
translation_text: then one will know what he sent ahead and what he left behind.

text_uthmani: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
translation_text: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

text_uthmani: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. (Then) a person will know what he has sent forward and (what he has) left behind (of good or bad deeds).

text_uthmani: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
translation_text: each soul will know what it has done and what it has left undone.

text_uthmani: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
translation_text: everyone shall know all his deeds, both the earlier and the later.1

text_uthmani: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
translation_text: AAalimat nafsun ma qaddamatwaakhkharat

text_uthmani: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
translation_text: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.

text_uthmani: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
translation_text: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ

translation_text: O man! What has deceived you about your Gracious Lord,

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
translation_text: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. O man! What has made you careless about your Lord, the Most Generous?

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
translation_text: Mankind, what has lured you away from God,

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
translation_text: O man! What has deceived you about your generous Lord

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
translation_text: Ya ayyuha al-insanu magharraka birabbika alkareem

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
translation_text: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
translation_text: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent?-

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
translation_text: who created you, then perfected you, then brought you in due proportion?

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
translation_text: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
translation_text: your generous Lord, who created you, shaped you, proportioned you,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
translation_text: Who created you, shaped you, and made you well-proportioned,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
translation_text: Allathee khalaqaka fasawwakafaAAadalak

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
translation_text: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
translation_text: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias;

فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
translation_text: He composed you in whichever form He willed.

text_uthmani: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
translation_text: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

text_uthmani: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. In whatever form He willed, He put you together.

text_uthmani: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
translation_text: in whatever form He chose?

text_uthmani: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
translation_text: and set you in whatever form He pleased?1

text_uthmani: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
translation_text: Fee ayyi sooratin ma shaarakkabak

text_uthmani: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
translation_text: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.

text_uthmani: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
translation_text: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Never! (i.e. one should never be heedless towards him.) But you deny the Requital,

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: No! But you deny the Recompense.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. Nay! But you deny Ad-Dîn (i.e. the Day of Recompense).

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Yet you still take the Judgement to be a lie!

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: No indeed;1 (the fact is that) you deny the Reckoning,2 declaring it a lie;

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Kalla bal tukaththiboona biddeen

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Nay! But ye do reject Right and Judgment!

وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: while (appointed) over you there are watchers,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: But verily, over you (are appointed angels in charge of mankind) to watch you,1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: Over you stand

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: you do so the while there are watchers over you;

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: Wa-inna AAalaykum lahafitheen

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: Lo! there are above you guardians,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you,-

text_uthmani: كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
translation_text: who are noble, writers (of the deeds),

text_uthmani: كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
translation_text: Noble and recording;

text_uthmani: كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Kirâman (Honourable) Kâtibîn writing down (your deeds),1

text_uthmani: كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
translation_text: watchers, noble recorders

text_uthmani: كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
translation_text: noble scribes,

text_uthmani: كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
translation_text: Kiraman katibeen

text_uthmani: كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
translation_text: Generous and recording,

text_uthmani: كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
translation_text: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):

text_uthmani: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: who know whatever you do.

text_uthmani: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: They know whatever you do.

text_uthmani: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. They know all that you do.

text_uthmani: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: who know what you do:

text_uthmani: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: who know what you do.1

text_uthmani: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: YaAAlamoona ma tafAAaloon

text_uthmani: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: Who know (all) that ye do.

text_uthmani: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: They know (and understand) all that ye do.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Surely the righteous will be in bliss,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. Verily, the Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) will be in Delight (Paradise);

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: the good will live in bliss,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Surely the virtuous shall be in Bliss,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Inna al-abrara lafee naAAeem

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss;

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
translation_text: and the sinners in Hell,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
translation_text: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. And verily, the Fujjâr (the wicked, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners and evil-doers) will be in the blazing Fire (Hell),

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
translation_text: and the wicked will burn in the Fire.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
translation_text: and the wicked shall be in the Blazing Fire.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
translation_text: Wa-inna alfujjara lafee jaheem

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
translation_text: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
translation_text: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire,

text_uthmani: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: in which they will enter on the Day of Requital,

text_uthmani: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

text_uthmani: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They will enter it on the Day of Judgement

text_uthmani: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. Therein they will enter, and taste its burning flame on the Day of Recompense,

text_uthmani: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They shall enter it on the Day of Recompense

text_uthmani: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Yaslawnaha yawma addeen

text_uthmani: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,

text_uthmani: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment,

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
translation_text: and they will not (be able to) keep away from it.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
translation_text: And never therefrom will they be absent.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. And they (Al-Fujjâr) will not be absent therefrom.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
translation_text: and they will find no escape.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
translation_text: and then shall never come out of it.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
translation_text: Wama hum AAanha bigha-ibeen

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
translation_text: And will not be absent thence.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
translation_text: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: And what may let you know what the Day of Requital is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. And what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: What do you know what the Day of Recompense is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Wama adraka ma yawmu addeeni

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Again, what may let you know what the Day of Requital is?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. Again, what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Yes! What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Again, what do you know what the Day of Recompense is?

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Thumma ma adraka mayawmu addeen

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
translation_text: A Day when no one will have power to do any thing for another! And command, on that Day, will belong to Allah (alone).

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
translation_text: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. (It will be) the Day when no person shall have power (to do) anything for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allâh.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
translation_text: The Day when no soul will be able to do anything for another; on that Day, command will belong to God.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
translation_text: It is the Day when no one shall have the power to do anything for another,1 and all command shall be Allah's.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
translation_text: Yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsinshay-an wal-amru yawma-ithin lillah

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
translation_text: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
translation_text: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
translation_text: Woe to the curtailers

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
translation_text: Woe to those who give less [than due],1

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
translation_text: Woe to those who give short measure,

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Woe to Al-Mutaffifûn (those who give less in measure and weight).

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
translation_text: Woe to the stinters; 1

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
translation_text: Waylun lilmutaffifeen

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
translation_text: Woe unto the defrauders:

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
translation_text: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
translation_text: who, when they measure something to receive from people, take it in full,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
translation_text: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
translation_text: who demand of other people full measure for themselves,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, demand full measure,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
translation_text: those who, when they take from others by measure, take their full share; 1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
translation_text: Allatheena itha iktalooAAala annasi yastawfoon

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
translation_text: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
translation_text: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
translation_text: and when they measure or weigh something to give it to them, give less than due.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
translation_text: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
translation_text: but give less than they should when it is they who weigh or measure for others!

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And when they have to give by measure or weight to (other) men, give less than due.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
translation_text: but who, when they measure or weigh for others, give less than their due.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
translation_text: Wa-itha kaloohum aw wazanoohumyukhsiroon

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
translation_text: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
translation_text: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.

text_uthmani: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: Do they not think that they have to be raised up

text_uthmani: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

text_uthmani: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. Do they not think that they will be resurrected (for reckoning),

text_uthmani: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: Do these people not realize that they will be raised up

text_uthmani: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: Do they not realise that they will be raised to life

text_uthmani: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: Ala yathunnu ola-ikaannahum mabAAoothoon

text_uthmani: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again

text_uthmani: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
translation_text: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-

لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

translation_text: For a tremendous Day -

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: on a mighty Day,

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

translation_text: 5. On a Great Day?

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: Unto an Awful Day,

text_uthmani: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation_text: On a Mighty Day,

يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: the Day when all the people will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: a Day when everyone will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)?

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: a Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the Universe?

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: Yawma yaqoomu annasu lirabbialAAalameen

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation_text: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
translation_text: Never! (i.e. they should never act in such a way.) Indeed the record of deeds of the sinners is in Sijjīn .

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
translation_text: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
translation_text: No indeed! The list of the wicked is in Sijjin––

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Nay! Truly, the Record (writing of the deeds) of the Fujjâr (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, evil-doers and the wicked) is (preserved) in Sijjîn.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
translation_text: No indeed!1 Verily the deeds of the wicked are in the Record locked up in the prison-house!2

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
translation_text: Kalla inna kitaba alfujjarilafee sijjeen

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
translation_text: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
translation_text: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
translation_text: And what may let you know what Sijjīn is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
translation_text: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
translation_text: what will explain to you what Sijjin is?––

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. And what will make you know what Sijjîn is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
translation_text: And how would you know what the Record of the prison-house is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
translation_text: Wama adraka ma sijjeen

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
translation_text: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
translation_text: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: A register, inscribed!

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: It is [their destination1 recorded in] a register inscribed.

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. A Register inscribed.

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: a clearly numbered list.

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: It is a Book inscribed.

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: Kitabun marqoom

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: A written record.

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe that day to the deniers,

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe on that day to the deniers,
