text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. Woe, that Day, to those who deny.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, then, to those that give the lie,

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Waylun yawma-ithin lilmukaththibeen

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation_text: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: who deny the Day of Requital!

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: those who deny the Day of Judgement!

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Those who deny the Day of Recompense.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: those that give the lie to the Day of Recompense.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Allatheena yukaththiboonabiyawmi addeen

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Those who deny the Day of Judgment

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: And none denies it but every sinful transgressor.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: Only the evil aggressor denies it:

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and disobedience to Allâh) the sinner!

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: Yet none gives the lie to it except the transgressor immersed in sin;

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: Wama yukaththibu bihi illakullu muAAtadin atheem

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
translation_text: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “(These are) tales of the ancients.”

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: when Our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘Ancient fables!’

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. When Our Verses (of the Qur’ân) are recited to him he says: "Tales of the ancients!"

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: who, when Our verses are recited to him,1 says: “Mere tales of olden times!”

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatunaqala asateeru al-awwaleen

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.

text_uthmani: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation_text: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: No! But that which they used to commit has covered their hearts with rust.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.1

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: No indeed! Their hearts are encrusted with what they have done.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Nay! But on their hearts is the Rân (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn.1

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: No indeed! The truth is that their hearts have become rusted on account of their evil deeds.1

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: Kalla bal rana AAalaquloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboon

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation_text: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
translation_text: No! Indeed they will be screened off from their Lord on that Day.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
translation_text: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.1

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
translation_text: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from their Lord,

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. Nay! Surely they (evil-doers) will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
translation_text: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from seeing their Lord,1

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
translation_text: Kalla innahum AAan rabbihim yawma-ithinlamahjooboon

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
translation_text: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
translation_text: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Then they will have to enter the Hell.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: they will burn in Hell,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. Then, verily, they will indeed enter (and taste) the burning flame of Hell.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: and then they shall enter Hell,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Thumma innahum lasaloo aljaheem

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
translation_text: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: Then it will be said, “This is what you used to deny.”

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: and they will be told, ‘This is what you called a lie.’

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. Then, it will be said to them: "This is what you used to deny!"

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: whereafter they will be told: “This is what you used to give the lie to.”

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: Thumma yuqalu hatha allatheekuntum bihi tukaththiboon

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
translation_text: No! The record of deeds of the righteous is in ‘Illiyyūn .

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
translation_text: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
translation_text: No indeed! The list of the truly good is in 'Illiyyin––

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. Nay! Verily, the Record (writing of the deeds) of Al-Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) is (preserved) in ‘Illiyyûn

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
translation_text: No indeed!1 Verily, the deeds of the virtuous shall be in the record of the exalted ones.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
translation_text: Kalla inna kitaba al-abrarilafee AAilliyyeen

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
translation_text: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
translation_text: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
translation_text: And what may let you know what ‘Illiyyūn is ?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
translation_text: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
translation_text: what will explain to you what 'Illiyyin is?––

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. And what will make you know what ‘Illiyyûn is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
translation_text: And what do you know what the Record of the exalted ones is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
translation_text: Wama adraka maAAilliyyoon

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
translation_text: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
translation_text: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: A register inscribed,

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: It is [their destination1 recorded in] a register inscribed

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: a clearly written list,

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. A Register inscribed,

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: It is a Book inscribed,

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: Kitabun marqoom

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: A written record,

text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
translation_text: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed,

text_uthmani: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: attended by those (angels) who are blessed with nearness to Allah!

text_uthmani: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].

text_uthmani: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: witnessed by those brought near.

text_uthmani: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. To which bear witness those nearest (to Allâh, i.e. the angels).

text_uthmani: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: which the angels placed near Allah to safeguard.

text_uthmani: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: Yashhaduhu almuqarraboon

text_uthmani: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).

text_uthmani: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Indeed the righteous will be in absolute bliss.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: The truly good will live in bliss,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. Verily, Al-Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) will be in Delight (Paradise).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Verily the virtuous shall be in Bliss;

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Inna al-abrara lafee naAAeem

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
translation_text: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: While (sitting) on thrones they will be watching (the scenes of Paradise).

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: On adorned couches, observing.

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: seated on couches, gazing around.

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. On thrones, looking (at all things).

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: resting on couches, looking around.

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: AAala al-ara-iki yanthuroon

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: On couches, gazing,

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):

text_uthmani: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: You will recognize the glamour of bliss on their faces.

text_uthmani: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

text_uthmani: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: You will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss.

text_uthmani: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. You will recognise in their faces the brightness of delight.

text_uthmani: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: You shall see upon their faces the glow of bliss.

text_uthmani: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: TaAArifu fee wujoohihim nadrata annaAAeem

text_uthmani: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.

text_uthmani: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation_text: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.

text_uthmani: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
translation_text: They will be served with a pure sealed wine to drink,

text_uthmani: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
translation_text: They will be given to drink [pure] wine1 [which was] sealed.

text_uthmani: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
translation_text: They will be served a sealed nectar,

text_uthmani: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. They will be given to drink of pure sealed wine.

text_uthmani: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
translation_text: They will be served a drink of the finest sealed wine,1

text_uthmani: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
translation_text: Yusqawna min raheeqin makhtoom

text_uthmani: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
translation_text: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,

text_uthmani: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
translation_text: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:

text_uthmani: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
translation_text: the seal of which will be of musk.-It is this (bliss) in aspiring for which the competitors should race each other.

text_uthmani: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
translation_text: The last of it1 is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.

text_uthmani: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
translation_text: its seal [perfumed with] a fragrant herb––let those who strive, strive for this––

text_uthmani: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. The last thereof (that wine) will be the smell of Musk, and for this let (all) those strive who want to strive (i.e. hasten earnestly to the obedience of Allah).

text_uthmani: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
translation_text: whose seal is musk – so let all aspirants aspire after that –

text_uthmani: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
translation_text: Khitamuhu miskun wafee thalikafalyatanafasi almutanafisoon

text_uthmani: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
translation_text: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -

text_uthmani: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
translation_text: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:

text_uthmani: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
translation_text: -and it will be blended with (a drink from) Tasnīm ,

text_uthmani: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
translation_text: And its mixture is of Tasneem,1

text_uthmani: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
translation_text: mixed with the water of Tasnim,

text_uthmani: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. It (that wine) will be mixed with Tasnîm:

text_uthmani: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
translation_text: a wine whose mixture is Tasnim,1

text_uthmani: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
translation_text: Wamizajuhu min tasneem

text_uthmani: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
translation_text: And mixed with water of Tasnim,

text_uthmani: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
translation_text: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: a spring from which will drink those who are blessed with nearness.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: a spring from which those brought near will drink.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allâh.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: a fountain at which the chosen ones shall drink.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: AAaynan yashrabu biha almuqarraboon

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.

text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
translation_text: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: Indeed those who were guilty used to laugh at those who believed,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: The wicked used to laugh at the believers––

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. Verily, (during the worldly life) those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: Behold, the wicked were wont to laugh at the believers:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoomina allatheena amanoo yadhakoon

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
translation_text: and when they passed by them, they used to wink at one another,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
translation_text: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
translation_text: they would wink at one another when the believers passed by them,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another (in mockery).

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
translation_text: when they passed by them they winked,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
translation_text: Wa-itha marroo bihim yataghamazoon

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
translation_text: And wink one to another when they passed them;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
translation_text: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
translation_text: and when they went back to their family, they went enjoying their mockery,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
translation_text: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
translation_text: joke about them when they got back to their own people,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 31. And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
translation_text: and when they went back to their families, they went back jesting,1

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
translation_text: Wa-itha inqalaboo ila ahlihimuinqalaboo fakiheen

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
translation_text: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
translation_text: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: and when they saw them, they said, “Surely these are the ones who have gone astray”

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: and say, when they saw them, ‘These people are misguided,’

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 32. And when they saw them, they said: "Verily these have indeed gone astray!"

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: and when they saw the believers, they said: “Lo! These are the erring ones”;1

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: Wa-itha raawhum qaloo inna haola-iladalloon

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
translation_text: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: while they were not sent as watchmen over them.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: though they were not sent to be their keepers-

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 33. But they (disbelievers, sinners) had not been sent as watchers over them (the believers).

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: (they said so although) they had not been appointed watchers over them.1

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: Wama orsiloo AAalayhim hafitheen

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
translation_text: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: So, today those who believed will laugh at the disbelievers.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: So Today1 those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: so today the believers are laughing at the disbelievers

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: But this Day (the Day of Resurrection) those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers1

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: But today the believers are laughing at the unbelievers;

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: Falyawma allatheena amanoomina alkuffari yadhakoon

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
translation_text: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: While (sitting) on thrones, they will be seeing

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: On adorned couches, observing.

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: On (high) thrones, looking (at all things).

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: as they sit on couches, gazing around.

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: seated upon their couches, they are looking around.

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: AAala al-ara-iki yanthuroon

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: On high couches, gazing.

text_uthmani: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
translation_text: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).

text_uthmani: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: whether the disbelievers have been paid back for what they used to do.

text_uthmani: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?

text_uthmani: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: Have the disbelievers [not] been repaid for their deeds?

text_uthmani: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 36. Are not the disbelievers paid (fully) for what they used to do?

text_uthmani: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: Have the unbelievers been duly rewarded for their deeds?1

text_uthmani: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: Hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanooyafAAaloon

text_uthmani: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?

text_uthmani: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
translation_text: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
translation_text: When the sky will split apart,

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
translation_text: When the sky has split [open]

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: When the heaven is split asunder,

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
translation_text: When the sky is ripped apart,

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
translation_text: When the sky is rent asunder

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
translation_text: Itha assamao inshaqqat

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
translation_text: When the heaven is split asunder

text_uthmani: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
translation_text: When the sky is rent asunder,

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: and will listen to (the command of) its Lord,- and it ought to,-

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: And has listened [i.e., responded]1 to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. And listens to and obeys its Lord - and it must do so.

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: obeying its Lord as it rightly must,

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: and hearkens to the command1 of its Lord, doing what it should;

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: Waathinat lirabbiha wahuqqat

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: And attentive to her Lord in fear,

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
translation_text: and when the earth will be stretched (to give room to more people),

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
translation_text: And when the earth has been extended1

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And when the earth is stretched forth,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
translation_text: when the earth is levelled out,

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
translation_text: and when the earth is stretched out1

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
translation_text: Wa-itha al-ardu muddat

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
translation_text: And when the earth is spread out

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
translation_text: And when the earth is flattened out,

text_uthmani: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
translation_text: and it will throw up whatever it contains, and will become empty,

text_uthmani: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
translation_text: And has cast out that within it1 and relinquished [it]

text_uthmani: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And has cast out all that was in it and became empty.

text_uthmani: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
translation_text: casts out its contents, and becomes empty,

text_uthmani: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
translation_text: and casts out what is within it and is emptied,1

text_uthmani: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
translation_text: Waalqat ma feeha watakhallat

text_uthmani: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
translation_text: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty

text_uthmani: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
translation_text: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty,

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: and will listen to (the command of) its Lord,- and it ought to,- (then man will see the consequences of his deeds.)

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] –

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: obeying its Lord as it rightly must,

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. And listens to and obeys its Lord - and it must do so.

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: and hearkens to the command of its Lord, doing what it should.1

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: Waathinat lirabbiha wahuqqat

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: And attentive to her Lord in fear!

text_uthmani: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
translation_text: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality).

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
translation_text: O man, you have to work hard constantly to reach your Lord, and then you have to meet Him.

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
translation_text: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion1 and will meet it.2

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
translation_text: you humans, toiling laboriously towards your Lord, will meet Him:

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions (good or bad), a sure returning, and you will meet (the results of your deeds which you did).

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
translation_text: O man, you are striving unto your Lord1 and you will meet Him.

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
translation_text: Ya ayyuha al-insanuinnaka kadihun ila rabbika kadhanfamulaqeeh

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
translation_text: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
translation_text: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him.

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
translation_text: So, as for him whose book (of deeds) will be given to him in his right hand,

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
translation_text: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
translation_text: whoever is given his record in his right hand

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand,

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
translation_text: Whoever is given the Record in his right hand

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
translation_text: Faama man ootiya kitabahubiyameenih

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
translation_text: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
translation_text: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand,

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
translation_text: he will be called to account in an easy manner,

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
translation_text: He will be judged with an easy account

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
translation_text: will have an easy reckoning

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. He surely will receive an easy reckoning,

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
translation_text: shall be called to an easy accounting,1

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
translation_text: Fasawfa yuhasabu hisabanyaseera

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
translation_text: He truly will receive an easy reckoning

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
translation_text: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning,

text_uthmani: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: and he will go back to his people joyfully.

text_uthmani: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: And return to his people in happiness.

text_uthmani: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. And will return to his family in joy!

text_uthmani: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: and return to his people well pleased,

text_uthmani: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: and shall return to his people joyfully.1

text_uthmani: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: Wayanqalibu ila ahlihi masroora

text_uthmani: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: And will return unto his folk in joy.

text_uthmani: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
translation_text: As for the one whose book (of deeds) will be given to him from his backside,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
translation_text: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. But whosoever is given his Record behind his back,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
translation_text: but whoever is given his record from behind his back

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
translation_text: But he who is given the Record behind his back,1

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
translation_text: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu waraathahrih

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
translation_text: But whoso is given his account behind his back,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
translation_text: But he who is given his Record behind his back,-

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
translation_text: he will pray for death,

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
translation_text: He will cry out for destruction

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. He will invoke (for his) destruction,

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
translation_text: will cry out for destruction––

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
translation_text: shall cry for “perdition,”

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
translation_text: Fasawfa yadAAoo thuboora

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
translation_text: He surely will invoke destruction

text_uthmani: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
translation_text: Soon will he cry for perdition,

text_uthmani: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
translation_text: and will enter the blazing fire.

text_uthmani: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
translation_text: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

text_uthmani: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. And he shall enter a blazing Fire, and be made to taste its burning.

text_uthmani: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
translation_text: he will burn in the blazing Fire.

text_uthmani: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
translation_text: and will enter the Blazing Fire.

text_uthmani: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
translation_text: Wayasla saAAeera

text_uthmani: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
translation_text: And be thrown to scorching fire.

text_uthmani: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
translation_text: And he will enter a Blazing Fire.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: He had been joyful among his people (in the world).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. Verily, he was among his people in joy!

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: He used to live among his people well pleased.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: He used to live joyfully among his people,1

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: Innahu kana fee ahlihi masroora

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: He verily lived joyous with his folk,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
translation_text: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing!

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
translation_text: He thought he would never revert (to Allah).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
translation_text: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
translation_text: He thought he would never return [to his Lord]––

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. Verily, he thought that he would never come back (to Us)!

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
translation_text: thinking he would never revert (to Us).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
translation_text: Innahu thanna an lan yahoor

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
translation_text: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
translation_text: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)!

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
translation_text: No! Indeed his Lord was watchful over him.

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
translation_text: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
translation_text: indeed he will! His Lord was watching him.

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
translation_text: But no; (how would he not revert)? His Lord was ever watching him.1

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
translation_text: Bala inna rabbahu kana bihi baseera

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
translation_text: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!

text_uthmani: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
translation_text: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
translation_text: So, I swear by the twilight (after sunset),

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
translation_text: So I swear by the twilight glow

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
translation_text: I swear by the glow of sunset,

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. So I swear by the afterglow of sunset;

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
translation_text: Nay; I swear by the twilight;

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
translation_text: Fala oqsimu bishshafaq

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
translation_text: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,

text_uthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
translation_text: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
translation_text: and by the night and what it envelops,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
translation_text: And [by] the night and what it envelops

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
translation_text: by the night and what it covers,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. And by the night and whatever it gathers in its darkness,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
translation_text: and by the night and what it enfolds,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
translation_text: Wallayli wama wasaq

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
translation_text: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
translation_text: The Night and its Homing;

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
translation_text: and by the moon when it develops at the full,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
translation_text: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
translation_text: by the full moon,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. And by the moon when it is at the full.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
translation_text: and by the moon, when it reaches its fullness:

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
translation_text: Walqamari itha ittasaq

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
translation_text: And by the moon when she is at the full,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
translation_text: And the Moon in her fullness:

text_uthmani: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
translation_text: you shall certainly ascend from stage to stage.

text_uthmani: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
translation_text: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.1

text_uthmani: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. You shall certainly travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter).

text_uthmani: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
translation_text: you will progress from stage to stage.

text_uthmani: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
translation_text: you shall proceed onwards from stage to stage.1

text_uthmani: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
translation_text: Latarkabunna tabaqan AAan tabaq

text_uthmani: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
translation_text: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.

text_uthmani: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
translation_text: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage.

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: So, what is wrong with them that they do not believe,

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: So why do they not believe?

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. What is the matter with them, that they believe not?

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: So, what is the matter with them that they do not believe,

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: Fama lahum la yu/minoon

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: What aileth them, then, that they believe not

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
translation_text: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not?-

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
translation_text: and when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not offer sajdah (prostration)?

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
translation_text: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. And when the Qur’ân is recited to them, they fall not prostrate.

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
translation_text: Why, when the Quran is read to them, do they not prostrate themselves [to God]?

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
translation_text: and when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate1 themselves?

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
translation_text: Wa-itha quri-a AAalayhimu alqur-anula yasjudoon

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
translation_text: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?

text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
translation_text: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: Rather, those who disbelieve deny (the truth).

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: But those who have disbelieved deny,

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: No! The disbelievers reject the Quran––

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Nay, those who disbelieve belie (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and whatever he brought, i.e. this Qur’ân and Islâmic Monotheism, etc.).1

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: Instead, the unbelievers reject it, calling it a lie.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: Bali allatheena kafaroo yukaththiboon

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
translation_text: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it).

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
translation_text: And Allah is most aware of what they store.

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
translation_text: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
translation_text: God knows best what they keep hidden inside––

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. And Allâh knows best what they gather (of good and bad deeds),

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
translation_text: Allah knows best what they are accumulating (in their Record).1

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
translation_text: Wallahu aAAlamu bimayooAAoon

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
translation_text: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
translation_text: But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)

text_uthmani: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: So, give him the ‘good news’ of a painful punishment,

text_uthmani: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

text_uthmani: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: so give them news of a painful torment.

text_uthmani: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. So announce to them a painful torment.

text_uthmani: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: So give them the good news of a painful chastisement,

text_uthmani: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: Fabashshirhum biAAathabin aleem

text_uthmani: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: So give them tidings of a painful doom,

text_uthmani: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
translation_text: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: but those who believed and did righteous deeds will have a reward that will never be interrupted.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. Save those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end (i.e. Paradise).

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: But those who believe and do good deeds will have a never-ending reward.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: except for those who believe and do good deeds. Theirs shall be an unending reward.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: Illa allatheena amanoowaAAamiloo assalihati lahum ajrun ghayrumamnoon

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
translation_text: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
translation_text: I swear by the sky, the one having stellar formations,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
translation_text: By the sky containing great stars

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
translation_text: By the sky with its towering constellations,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: By the heaven holding the big stars.1

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
translation_text: By the heaven with its impregnable castles;1

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
translation_text: Wassama-i thatialburooj

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
translation_text: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
translation_text: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs;

text_uthmani: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
translation_text: and by the Promised Day,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
translation_text: And [by] the promised Day

text_uthmani: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. And by the Promised Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

text_uthmani: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
translation_text: by the promised Day,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
translation_text: by the Promised Day,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
translation_text: Walyawmi almawAAood

text_uthmani: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
translation_text: And by the Promised Day.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
translation_text: By the promised Day (of Judgment);

text_uthmani: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
translation_text: and by that which attends, and that which is attended,

text_uthmani: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
translation_text: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

text_uthmani: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
translation_text: by the Witness and that which is witnessed,

text_uthmani: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And by the Witnessing day (i.e. Friday), and by the Witnessed day [i.e. the day of ‘Arafât (Hajj) the ninth of Dhul-Hijjah];

text_uthmani: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
translation_text: and by the witness and what is witnessed:1

text_uthmani: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
translation_text: Washahidin wamashhood

text_uthmani: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
translation_text: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,

text_uthmani: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
translation_text: By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness;-

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
translation_text: cursed were the People of the Trench,

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
translation_text: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench1

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
translation_text: damned were the makers of the trench,

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Cursed were the people of the Ditch (in the story of the Boy and the King).1

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
translation_text: the people of the pit were destroyed

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
translation_text: Qutila as-habu alukhdood

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
translation_text: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch

text_uthmani: قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
translation_text: Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire),

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
translation_text: the (people of the) fire that was rich with fuel,

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
translation_text: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
translation_text: the makers of the fuel-stoked fire!

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. Of fire fed with fuel,

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
translation_text: with fire abounding in fuel,

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
translation_text: Annari thati alwaqood

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
translation_text: Of the fuel-fed fire,

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
translation_text: Fire supplied (abundantly) with fuel:

text_uthmani: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
translation_text: when they were sitting by it,

text_uthmani: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
translation_text: When they were sitting near it.

text_uthmani: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
translation_text: They sat down

text_uthmani: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. When they sat by it (fire),

text_uthmani: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
translation_text: while they sat around it,

text_uthmani: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
translation_text: Ith hum AAalayha quAAood

text_uthmani: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
translation_text: When they sat by it,

text_uthmani: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
translation_text: Behold! they sat over against the (fire),

text_uthmani: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
translation_text: and were watching what they were doing with the believers.

text_uthmani: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
translation_text: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses. 1

text_uthmani: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
translation_text: to watch what they were doing to the believers.

text_uthmani: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. And they witnessed what they were doing against the believers (i.e. burning them).

text_uthmani: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
translation_text: and were witnessing what they did to the believers.1

text_uthmani: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
translation_text: Wahum AAala ma yafAAaloona bilmu/mineenashuhood

text_uthmani: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
translation_text: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.

text_uthmani: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
translation_text: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers.

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation_text: They punished them for nothing but that they believed in Allah, the All-Mighty, the Worthy of All Praise,

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation_text: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation_text: Their only grievance against them was their faith in God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy,

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. And they had no fault except that they believed in Allâh, the All-Mighty, Worthy of all Praise!

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation_text: Against these they had no grudge except that they believed in Allah, the Most Mighty, the Most Praiseworthy,

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation_text: Wama naqamoo minhum illa anyu/minoo billahi alAAazeezi alhameed

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation_text: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,

text_uthmani: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
translation_text: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in Allah, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise!-

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: the One to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is witness over every thing.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: to whom all control over the heavens and earth belongs: God is witness over all things.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. To Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allâh is Witness over everything.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Allah witnesses everything.1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: Allathee lahu mulku assamawatiwal-ardi wallahu AAala kullishay-in shaheed

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
translation_text: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness to all things.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation_text: Surely, those who persecuted the believing men and the believing women, then did not repent, -for them there is the torment of Jahannam (Hell), and for them there is the torment of burning.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation_text: Indeed, those who have tortured1 the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation_text: For those who persecute believing men and women, and do not repent afterwards, there will be the torment of Hell and burning.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and believing women (by torturing them and burning them), and then do not turn in repentance (to Allâh), then they will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation_text: Surely those who tormented the believing men and the believing women and then did not repent, theirs shall be the chastisement of Hell, and theirs shall be the chastisement of burning.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation_text: Inna allatheena fatanoo almu/mineenawalmu/minati thumma lam yatooboo falahum AAathabujahannama walahum AAathabu alhareeq

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation_text: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
translation_text: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation_text: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them there are gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the big achievement.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation_text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation_text: But for those who believe and do good deeds there will be Gardens graced with flowing streams: that is the great triumph.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise). That is the great success.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation_text: As for those who believed and acted righteously, theirs shall be Gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great triumph.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation_text: Inna allatheena amanoowaAAamiloo assalihati lahum jannatuntajree min tahtiha al-anharu thalikaalfawzu alkabeer

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation_text: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
translation_text: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires),

text_uthmani: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: The seizure of your Lord is severe indeed!

text_uthmani: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: [Prophet], your Lord’s punishment is truly stern––

text_uthmani: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. Verily, (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the Seizure (punishment) of your Lord is severe and painful. [See V.11:102].

text_uthmani: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: Stern indeed is your Lord's punishment.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: Inna batsha rabbika lashadeed

text_uthmani: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
translation_text: Surely He originates (creation) and repeats (it after death).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
translation_text: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
translation_text: it is He who brings people to life, and will restore them to life again––

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. Verily, He it is Who begins (punishment) and repeats (punishment in the Hereafter) (or originates the creation of everything, and then repeats it on the Day of Resurrection).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
translation_text: He it is Who creates for the first time and He it is Who will create again,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
translation_text: Innahu huwa yubdi-o wayuAAeed

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
translation_text: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
translation_text: It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life).

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
translation_text: And He is the Most-Forgiving, the Most-Loving,

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
translation_text: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
translation_text: and He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Loving.

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. And He is Oft-Forgiving, full of love (towards the pious who are real true believers of Islâmic Monotheism),

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
translation_text: and He is the Ever Forgiving, the Most Loving

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
translation_text: Wahuwa alghafooru alwadood

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
translation_text: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,

text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
translation_text: And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,

text_uthmani: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
translation_text: the Master of the Throne, the Glorious.

text_uthmani: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
translation_text: Honorable Owner of the Throne,

text_uthmani: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. Owner of the throne, the Glorious,

text_uthmani: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
translation_text: The Glorious Lord of the Throne,

text_uthmani: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
translation_text: – the Lord of the Glorious Throne,

text_uthmani: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
translation_text: Thoo alAAarshi almajeed

text_uthmani: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
translation_text: Lord of the Throne of Glory,

text_uthmani: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
translation_text: Lord of the Throne of Glory,

text_uthmani: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
translation_text: He is ever doer of what He intends.

text_uthmani: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
translation_text: Effecter of what He intends.

text_uthmani: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. (He is the) Doer of whatsoever He intends (or wills).

text_uthmani: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
