translation_text: He does whatever He will.

text_uthmani: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
translation_text: the Executor of what He wills.1

text_uthmani: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
translation_text: FaAAAAalun lima yureed

text_uthmani: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
translation_text: Doer of what He will.

text_uthmani: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
translation_text: Doer (without let) of all that He intends.

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
translation_text: Has there come to you the story of the forces,

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
translation_text: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. Has the story reached you of the hosts,

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
translation_text: Have you [not] heard the stories of the forces

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
translation_text: Has the story of the armies reached you,

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
translation_text: Hal ataka hadeethu aljunood

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
translation_text: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts

text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
translation_text: Has the story reached thee, of the forces-

text_uthmani: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
translation_text: of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and Thamūd?

text_uthmani: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
translation_text: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamūd?

text_uthmani: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
translation_text: of Pharaoh and Thamud?

text_uthmani: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. Of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and Thamûd?

text_uthmani: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
translation_text: the armies of Pharaoh and Thamud?1

text_uthmani: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
translation_text: FirAAawna wathamood

text_uthmani: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
translation_text: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?

text_uthmani: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
translation_text: Of Pharaoh and the Thamud?

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
translation_text: But those who disbelieve are (engaged) in denying (the truth).

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
translation_text: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
translation_text: Yet still the disbelievers persist in denial.

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. Nay! The disbelievers (persisted) in denying (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and his Message of Islâmic Monotheism).

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
translation_text: The unbelievers are indeed engaged in denying it, calling it a lie,

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
translation_text: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee taktheeb

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
translation_text: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial

text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
translation_text: And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)!

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
translation_text: Allah has encompassed them from all sides.

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
translation_text: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.1

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
translation_text: God surrounds them all.

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. And Allâh encompasses them from behind! (i.e. all their deeds are within His Knowledge, and He will requite them for their deeds).

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
translation_text: although Allah surrounds them.

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
translation_text: Wallahu min wara-ihimmuheet

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
translation_text: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.

text_uthmani: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
translation_text: But Allah doth encompass them from behind!

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
translation_text: The reality is that it is the glorious Qur’ān,

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
translation_text: But this is an honored Qur’ān

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. Nay! This is a Glorious Qur’ân,

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
translation_text: This is truly a glorious Quran

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
translation_text: Nay; but this is a glorious Qur'an,

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
translation_text: Bal huwa qur-anun majeed

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
translation_text: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.

text_uthmani: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
translation_text: Nay, this is a Glorious Qur'an,

text_uthmani: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
translation_text: (recorded) in the Preserved Tablet (LauH MaHfūZ).

text_uthmani: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
translation_text: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.

text_uthmani: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. (Inscribed) in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz (The Preserved Tablet)!

text_uthmani: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
translation_text: [written] on a preserved Tablet.

text_uthmani: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
translation_text: inscribed on a well-guarded Tablet.1

text_uthmani: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
translation_text: Fee lawhin mahfooth

text_uthmani: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
translation_text: On a guarded tablet.

text_uthmani: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
translation_text: (Inscribed) in a Tablet Preserved!

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
translation_text: I swear by the sky and by the Night-Comer,-

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
translation_text: By the sky and the knocker

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
translation_text: By the sky and the night-comer––

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. By the heaven, and At-Târiq (the night-comer, i.e. the bright star);

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
translation_text: By the heaven, and the night-visitor,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
translation_text: Wassama-i wattariq

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
translation_text: By the heaven and the Morning Star

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
translation_text: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein);-

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
translation_text: -and what may let you know what the Night-Comer is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
translation_text: And what can make you know what is the knocker?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
translation_text: What will explain to you what the night-comer is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. And what will make you to know what At-Târiq (night-comer) is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
translation_text: what do you know what the night-visitor is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
translation_text: Wama adraka ma attariq

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
translation_text: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
translation_text: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
translation_text: The star of piercing brightness!- -

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
translation_text: It is the piercing star1.

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
translation_text: The piercing star––

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. (It is) the star of piercing brightness;

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
translation_text: It is the piercing star.

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
translation_text: Annajmu aththaqib

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
translation_text: - The piercing Star!

text_uthmani: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
translation_text: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness;-

text_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
translation_text: -there is no human being, but there is a watcher over him.

text_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
translation_text: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

text_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
translation_text: there is a watcher over every soul.

text_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: There is no human being but has a protector over him (or her) (i.e. angels in charge of each human being guarding him, writing his good and bad deeds)1

text_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
translation_text: There is no living being but there is a protector over it.1

text_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
translation_text: In kullu nafsin lamma AAalayha hafith

text_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
translation_text: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.

text_uthmani: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
translation_text: There is no soul but has a protector over it.

text_uthmani: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
translation_text: So, let man consider of which stuff he is created.

text_uthmani: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
translation_text: So let man observe from what he was created.

text_uthmani: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
translation_text: Man should reflect on what he was created from.

text_uthmani: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. So let man see from what he is created!

text_uthmani: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
translation_text: So let man consider of what he was created.1

text_uthmani: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
translation_text: Falyanthuri al-insanumimma khuliq

text_uthmani: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
translation_text: So let man consider from what he is created.

text_uthmani: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
translation_text: Now let man but think from what he is created!

خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
translation_text: He is created of spouting water

translation_text: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

text_uthmani: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
translation_text: He is created from spurting fluid,

text_uthmani: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. He is created from a water gushing forth,

text_uthmani: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
translation_text: He was created of a gushing fluid,

text_uthmani: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
translation_text: Khuliqa min ma-in dafiq

text_uthmani: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
translation_text: He is created from a gushing fluid

text_uthmani: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
translation_text: He is created from a drop emitted-

text_uthmani: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
translation_text: that comes out from between the loins and the chest-bones.

text_uthmani: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
translation_text: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

text_uthmani: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
translation_text: then he emerges from between the backbone and breastbone:

text_uthmani: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs.

text_uthmani: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
translation_text: emanating from between the loins and the ribs.1

text_uthmani: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
translation_text: Yakhruju min bayni assulbi wattara-ib

text_uthmani: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
translation_text: That issued from between the loins and ribs.

text_uthmani: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
translation_text: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
translation_text: Surely He is Powerful to bring him back

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
translation_text: Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. Verily, (Allâh) is Able to bring him back (to life)!

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
translation_text: God is certainly able to bring him back to life.

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
translation_text: Surely He (the Creator) has the power to bring him back (to life).1

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
translation_text: Innahu AAala rajAAihi laqadir

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
translation_text: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
translation_text: Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!

يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
translation_text: on a day when all the secrets will be searched out,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
translation_text: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. The Day when all the secrets (deeds, prayers, fasting, etc.) will be examined (as to their truth).

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
translation_text: On the Day when secrets are laid bare

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
translation_text: On the Day when man's deepest secrets shall be put to the test1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
translation_text: Yawma tubla assara-ir

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
translation_text: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
translation_text: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested,

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
translation_text: and he will have neither strength (to defend), nor a supporter.

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
translation_text: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
translation_text: he will have no power and no one to help him.

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. Then he will have no power, nor any helper.

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
translation_text: he shall have no power, and no helper.

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
translation_text: Fama lahu min quwwatin wala nasir

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
translation_text: Then will he have no might nor any helper.

text_uthmani: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
translation_text: (Man) will have no power, and no helper.

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
translation_text: I swear by the sky that rains,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
translation_text: By the sky which sends back1

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. By the sky (having rain clouds) which gives rain, again and again.

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
translation_text: By the sky and its recurring rain,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
translation_text: By the heaven with its recurring cycle of rain,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
translation_text: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
translation_text: By the Firmament which returns (in its round),

وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
translation_text: and the earth that cracks open (for plants),

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
translation_text: And [by] the earth which splits,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
translation_text: by the earth that cracks open!

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. And the earth which splits (with the growth of trees and plants).

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
translation_text: and by the earth ever bursting with verdure,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
translation_text: Wal-ardi thati assadAA

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
translation_text: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)

translation_text: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation),-

إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
translation_text: this is a decisive word,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
translation_text: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. Verily, this (the Qur’ân) is the Word that separates (the truth from falsehood, and commands strict laws for mankind to cut the roots of evil).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
translation_text: This is truly a decisive statement;

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
translation_text: this (Qur'an) is surely a decisive Word,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
translation_text: Innahu laqawlun fasl

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
translation_text: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
translation_text: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):

وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
translation_text: and it is not a joke.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
translation_text: And it is not amusement.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. And it is not a thing for amusement.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
translation_text: it is not something to be taken lightly.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
translation_text: not a flippant jest.1

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
translation_text: Wama huwa bilhazl

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
translation_text: It is no pleasantry.

text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
translation_text: It is not a thing for amusement.

إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
translation_text: They are devising plans,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
translation_text: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. Verily, they are but plotting a plot (against you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم).

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
translation_text: They plot and scheme,

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
translation_text: They are devising a guile,1

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
translation_text: Innahum yakeedoona kayda

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
translation_text: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)

text_uthmani: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
translation_text: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme,

text_uthmani: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا

translation_text: and I Am devising plans.

text_uthmani: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
translation_text: But I am planning a plan.

text_uthmani: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. And I (too) am planning a plan.

text_uthmani: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
translation_text: but so do I:

text_uthmani: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
translation_text: and I too am devising a guile.1

text_uthmani: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
translation_text: Waakeedu kayda

text_uthmani: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
translation_text: And I plot a plot (against them).

text_uthmani: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
translation_text: And I am planning a scheme.

text_uthmani: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا

translation_text: So leave the disbelievers alone at the moment; give them respite for a while.

text_uthmani: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
translation_text: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.1

text_uthmani: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
translation_text: [Prophet], let the disbelievers be, let them be for a while.

text_uthmani: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. So give a respite to the disbelievers; deal gently with them for a while.

text_uthmani: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
translation_text: So leave the unbelievers to themselves; respite them awhile.1

text_uthmani: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا

text_uthmani: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
translation_text: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.

text_uthmani: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
translation_text: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).

سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
translation_text: Pronounce the purity of the name of your most exalted Lord,

text_uthmani: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
translation_text: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

text_uthmani: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,

text_uthmani: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
translation_text: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Most High,

text_uthmani: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
translation_text: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High,1

text_uthmani: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
translation_text: Sabbihi isma rabbika al-aAAla

text_uthmani: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
translation_text: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,

text_uthmani: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
translation_text: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: who created (everything), then made (it) well,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: Who created and proportioned

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. Who has created (everything), and then proportioned it.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: who created [all things] in due proportion;

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: Who created all things and fashioned them in good proportion;1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: Allathee khalaqa fasawwa

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: Who createth, then disposeth;

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
translation_text: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: and who determined a measure (for everything), then guided (it),

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: And who destined and [then] guided

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And Who has measured (preordainments for everything even to be blessed or wretched); and then guided (i.e. showed mankind the right as well as the wrong paths, and guided the animals to pasture).

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: who determined their destinies and guided them;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: Who determined1 and guided them,2

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: Wallathee qaddara fahada

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: Who measureth, then guideth;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
translation_text: and who brought forth pasturage,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
translation_text: And who brings out the pasture

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And Who brings out the pasturage,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
translation_text: who brought out the green pasture

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
translation_text: Who brought forth the pasture,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
translation_text: Wallathee akhraja almarAAa

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
translation_text: Who bringeth forth the pasturage,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
translation_text: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture,

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
translation_text: then turned it into a blackening stubble.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
translation_text: And [then] makes it black stubble.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
translation_text: then made it dark debris.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. And then makes it dark stubble.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
translation_text: and then made it into a blackish straw.1

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
translation_text: FajaAAalahu ghuthaan ahwa

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
translation_text: Then turneth it to russet stubble.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
translation_text: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.

text_uthmani: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
translation_text: We will make you recite, then you will not forget

text_uthmani: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
translation_text: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget,

text_uthmani: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
translation_text: [Prophet], We shall teach you [the Quran] and you will not forget––

text_uthmani: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. We shall make you to recite (the Qur’ân), so you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) shall not forget (it),

text_uthmani: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
translation_text: We shall make you recite and then you will not forget,1

text_uthmani: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
translation_text: Sanuqri-oka fala tansa

text_uthmani: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
translation_text: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget

text_uthmani: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
translation_text: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
translation_text: except that which Allah wills. Indeed He knows what is manifest and what is hidden.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
translation_text: Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. Except what Allâh may will. He knows what is apparent and what is hidden.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
translation_text: unless God wishes; He knows both what is open and what is hidden––

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
translation_text: except what Allah should wish.1 He knows all that is manifest and all that is hidden.2

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
translation_text: Illa ma shaa Allahuinnahu yaAAlamu aljahra wama yakhfa

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
translation_text: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
translation_text: Except as Allah wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden.

text_uthmani: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: And We will facilitate for you (to reach) the easiest way.

text_uthmani: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: And We will ease you toward ease.1

text_uthmani: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: We shall show you the easy way.

text_uthmani: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. And We shall make easy for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the easy way (i.e. the doing of righteous deeds).

text_uthmani: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: We shall ease you to follow the way of Ease.

text_uthmani: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: Wanuyassiruka lilyusra

text_uthmani: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.

text_uthmani: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path).

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: So, extend advice (to people) if advice is useful.

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;1

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: So remind, if reminding will help.

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. Therefore remind (men) in case the reminder profits (them).

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: So render good counsel if good counsel will avail.1

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: Fathakkir in nafaAAati aththikra

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).

text_uthmani: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: The one who fears (Allah) will observe the advice,

text_uthmani: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.

text_uthmani: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. The reminder will be received by him who fears (Allâh),

text_uthmani: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: Those who stand in awe of God will heed the reminder,

text_uthmani: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: He who fears (Allah) shall heed it,1

text_uthmani: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: Sayaththakkaru man yakhsha

text_uthmani: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: He will heed who feareth,

text_uthmani: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
translation_text: The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah):

text_uthmani: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: and it will be avoided by the most wretched one

text_uthmani: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: But the wretched one will avoid it –

text_uthmani: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. But it will be avoided by the wretched,

text_uthmani: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: but it will be ignored by the most wicked,

text_uthmani: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: but the wretched will turn away from it.

text_uthmani: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: Wayatajannabuha al-ashqa

text_uthmani: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: But the most hapless will flout it,

text_uthmani: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: who will enter the Biggest Fire,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. Who will enter the great Fire (and will be made to taste its burning).

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: who will enter the Great Fire,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: He will be cast into the Great Fire.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: Allathee yasla annaraalkubra

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: He who will be flung to the great Fire

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
translation_text: Who will enter the Great Fire,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
translation_text: then he will neither die therein, nor live (a desirable life).

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
translation_text: Neither dying therein nor living.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. There he will neither die (to be in rest) nor live (a good living).

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
translation_text: where they will neither die nor live.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
translation_text: Then he will neither die in it, nor live.1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
translation_text: Thumma la yamootu feeha walayahya

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
translation_text: Wherein he will neither die nor live.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
translation_text: In which they will then neither die nor live.

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: Success is surely achieved by him who purifies himself,

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. Indeed whosoever purifies himself (by avoiding polytheism and accepting Islâmic Monotheism) shall achieve success,

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: Prosperous are those who purify themselves,

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: He who purified himself shall prosper,1

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: Qad aflaha man tazakka

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: He is successful who groweth,

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: But those will prosper who purify themselves,

text_uthmani: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
translation_text: and pronounces the name of his Lord, then offers prayer.

text_uthmani: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
translation_text: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

text_uthmani: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. And remembers (glorifies) the Name of his Lord (worships none but Allâh), and prays (five compulsory prayers and Nawâfil - additional prayers).

text_uthmani: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
translation_text: remember the name of their Lord, and pray.

text_uthmani: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
translation_text: in which they will not hear any absurd talk.

text_uthmani: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
translation_text: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.1

text_uthmani: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Where they shall neither hear harmful speech nor falsehood.

text_uthmani: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
translation_text: where they will hear no idle talk,

text_uthmani: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
translation_text: wherein they shall hear no vain talk.1

text_uthmani: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
translation_text: La tasmaAAu feeha laghiya

text_uthmani: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
translation_text: Where they hear no idle speech,

text_uthmani: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
translation_text: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity:

text_uthmani: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
translation_text: In it there is a flowing spring.

text_uthmani: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
translation_text: Within it is a flowing spring.

text_uthmani: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. Therein will be a running spring.

text_uthmani: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
translation_text: with a flowing spring,

text_uthmani: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
translation_text: In it there shall be a flowing spring,

text_uthmani: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
translation_text: Feeha AAaynun jariya

text_uthmani: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
translation_text: Wherein is a gushing spring,

text_uthmani: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
translation_text: Therein will be a bubbling spring:

text_uthmani: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
translation_text: In it there are elevated couches

text_uthmani: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
translation_text: Within it are couches raised high

text_uthmani: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
translation_text: raised couches,

text_uthmani: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. Therein will be thrones raised high.

text_uthmani: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
translation_text: and couches raised high,

text_uthmani: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
translation_text: Feeha sururun marfooAAa

text_uthmani: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
translation_text: Wherein are couches raised

text_uthmani: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
translation_text: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high,

text_uthmani: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
translation_text: and goblets, well placed,

text_uthmani: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
translation_text: And cups put in place

text_uthmani: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
translation_text: goblets placed before them,

text_uthmani: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. And cups set at hand.

text_uthmani: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
translation_text: and goblets laid out,1

text_uthmani: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
translation_text: Waakwabun mawdooAAa

text_uthmani: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
translation_text: And goblets set at hand

text_uthmani: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
translation_text: Goblets placed (ready),

text_uthmani: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
translation_text: and cushions, arrayed

text_uthmani: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
translation_text: And cushions lined up

text_uthmani: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
translation_text: cushions set in rows,

text_uthmani: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. And cushions set in rows.

text_uthmani: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
translation_text: and cushions arrayed in rows,

text_uthmani: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
translation_text: Wanamariqu masfoofa

text_uthmani: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
translation_text: And cushions ranged

text_uthmani: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
translation_text: And cushions set in rows,

text_uthmani: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
translation_text: and carpets, spread around.

text_uthmani: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
translation_text: And carpets spread around.

text_uthmani: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
translation_text: and carpets spread.

text_uthmani: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. And rich carpets (all) spread out.

text_uthmani: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
translation_text: and rich carpets levelled out.

text_uthmani: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
translation_text: Wazarabiyyu mabthootha

text_uthmani: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
translation_text: And silken carpets spread.

text_uthmani: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
translation_text: And rich carpets (all) spread out.

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
translation_text: So, do they not look at the camels how they are created,

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
translation_text: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
translation_text: Do the disbelievers not see how rain clouds are formed 1

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. Do they not look at the camels, how they are created?

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
translation_text: Do (these unbelievers) not observe the camels: how they were created?

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
translation_text: Afala yanthuroona ilaal-ibili kayfa khuliqat

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
translation_text: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?

text_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
translation_text: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made?-

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
translation_text: and at the sky, how it is raised high,

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
translation_text: And at the sky - how it is raised?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. And at the heaven, how it is raised?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
translation_text: how the heavens are lifted,

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
translation_text: And the sky: how it was raised high?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
translation_text: Wa-ila assama-i kayfarufiAAat

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
translation_text: And the heaven, how it is raised?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
translation_text: And at the Sky, how it is raised high?-

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
translation_text: and at the mountains, how they are installed,

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
translation_text: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. And at the mountains, how they are rooted (and fixed firm)?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
translation_text: how the mountains are raised high,

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
translation_text: And the mountains: how they were fixed?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
translation_text: Wa-ila aljibali kayfa nusibat

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
translation_text: And the hills, how they are set up?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
translation_text: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm?-

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
translation_text: and at the earth, how it is spread out?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
translation_text: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
translation_text: how the earth is spread out?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. And at the earth, how it is outspread?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
translation_text: And the earth: how it was spread out?1

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
translation_text: Wa-ila al-ardi kayfa sutihat

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
translation_text: And the earth, how it is spread?

text_uthmani: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
translation_text: And at the Earth, how it is spread out?

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
translation_text: So, (O Prophet,) keep on preaching; you are only a preacher.

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
translation_text: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
translation_text: So [Prophet] warn them: your only task is to give warning,

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. So remind them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) - you are only one who reminds.

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
translation_text: So render good counsel, for you are simply required to counsel,

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
translation_text: Fathakkir innama anta muthakkir

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
translation_text: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,

text_uthmani: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
translation_text: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish.

text_uthmani: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
translation_text: You are not a taskmaster set up over them,

text_uthmani: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
translation_text: You are not over them a controller.

text_uthmani: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
translation_text: you are not there to control them.

text_uthmani: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. You are not a dictator over them -

text_uthmani: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
translation_text: and are not invested with the authority to compel them.1

text_uthmani: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
translation_text: Lasta AAalayhim bimusaytir

text_uthmani: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
translation_text: Thou art not at all a warder over them.

text_uthmani: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
translation_text: Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
translation_text: but whoever turns away and disbelieves,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
translation_text: However, he who turns away and disbelieves –

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
translation_text: As for those who turn away and disbelieve,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Save the one who turns away and disbelieves.1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
translation_text: But whoever will turn away (from the Truth),

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
translation_text: Illa man tawalla wakafar

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
translation_text: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
translation_text: But if any turn away and reject Allah,-

text_uthmani: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
translation_text: Allah will punish him with the greatest torment.

text_uthmani: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
translation_text: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

text_uthmani: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
translation_text: God will inflict the greatest torment upon them.

text_uthmani: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 24. Then Allâh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

text_uthmani: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
translation_text: Allah will chastise him with the most terrible chastisement.

text_uthmani: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
translation_text: FayuAAaththibuhu Allahu alAAathabaal-akbar

text_uthmani: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
translation_text: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.

text_uthmani: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
translation_text: Allah will punish him with a mighty Punishment,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
translation_text: Surely towards Us they have to return,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
translation_text: Indeed, to Us is their return.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
translation_text: It is to Us they will return,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. Verily, to Us will be their return;

text_uthmani: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
translation_text: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
translation_text: Surely your Lord is ever on the watch.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
translation_text: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
translation_text: Your Lord is always watchful.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. Verily, your Lord is Ever Watchful (over them).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
translation_text: Truly your Lord is ever watchful.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
translation_text: Inna rabbaka labilmirsad

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
translation_text: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
translation_text: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
translation_text: As for man, when his Lord tests him, and thus gives him honour and bounties, he says, “My Lord has honoured me.”

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
translation_text: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."1

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. As for man, when his Lord tries him by giving him honour and bounties, then he says (in exultation): "My Lord has honoured me."

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
translation_text: [The nature of] man is that, when his Lord tries him through honour and blessings, he says, ‘My Lord has honoured me,’

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
translation_text: As for man,1 when his Lord tests him by exalting him and bestowing His bounties upon him, he says: “My Lord has exalted me.”

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
translation_text: Faamma al-insanu itha maibtalahu rabbuhu faakramahu wanaAAAAamahu fayaqoolu rabbeeakraman

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
translation_text: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
translation_text: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
translation_text: But when he tests him, and thus straitens his provision for him, he says, “My Lord has disgraced me.”

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
translation_text: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
translation_text: but when He tries him through the restriction of his provision, he says, ‘My Lord has humiliated me.’

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. But when He tries him by straitening his means of life, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me!"

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
translation_text: But when He tests him by straitening his sustenance, he says: “My Lord has humiliated me.”1

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
translation_text: Waamma itha ma ibtalahufaqadara AAalayhi rizqahu fayaqoolu rabbee ahanan

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
translation_text: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
translation_text: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: No! But you do not honour the orphan,

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: No!1 But you do not honor the orphan

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. Nay! But you treat not the orphans with kindness and generosity (i.e. you neither treat them well, nor give them their exact right of inheritance)!

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: No indeed! You [people] do not honour orphans,

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: But no;1 you do not treat the orphan honourably,2

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: Kalla bal la tukrimoonaalyateem

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan

text_uthmani: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans!

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: and do not encourage one another to feed the needy.

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: you do not urge one another to feed the poor,

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. And urge not one another on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor)!

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: and do not urge one another to feed the poor,1

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: Wala tahaddoona AAala taAAamialmiskeen

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.

text_uthmani: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor!-

text_uthmani: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
translation_text: And you devour the inheritance with a sweeping gulp,

text_uthmani: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
translation_text: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,1

text_uthmani: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
translation_text: you consume inheritance greedily,

text_uthmani: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. And you devour the inheritance all with greed.

text_uthmani: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
translation_text: and greedily devour the entire inheritance,1

text_uthmani: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
translation_text: Wata/kuloona atturatha aklanlamma

text_uthmani: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
translation_text: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.

text_uthmani: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
translation_text: And ye devour inheritance - all with greed,

text_uthmani: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
translation_text: and love wealth, an excessive love.

text_uthmani: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
translation_text: And you love wealth with immense love.

text_uthmani: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. And you love wealth with much love.

text_uthmani: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
translation_text: and you love wealth with a passion.

text_uthmani: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
translation_text: and love the riches, loving them ardently.1

text_uthmani: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
translation_text: Watuhibboona almala hubbanjamma

text_uthmani: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
translation_text: And love wealth with abounding love.

text_uthmani: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
translation_text: And ye love wealth with inordinate love!

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
translation_text: No! When the earth will be crushed thoroughly to be turned into bits,

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
translation_text: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
translation_text: No indeed! When the earth is pounded to dust, pounded and pounded,

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. Nay! When the earth is ground to powder.

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
translation_text: But no;1 when the earth is ground to powder,

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
translation_text: Kalla itha dukkati al-ardudakkan dakka

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
translation_text: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,

text_uthmani: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
translation_text: Nay! When the earth is pounded to powder,

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
translation_text: and your Lord will come, and the angels as well, lined up in rows,

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
translation_text: And your Lord has come1 and the angels, rank upon rank,

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 22. And your Lord comes with the angels in rows.

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
translation_text: when your Lord comes with the angels, rank upon rank,

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
translation_text: and when your Lord appears1 with rows upon rows of angels,

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
translation_text: Wajaa rabbuka walmalaku saffansaffa

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
translation_text: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,

text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
translation_text: And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank,

text_uthmani: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: and Jahannam (Hell), on that day, will be brought forward, it will be the day when man will realize the truth, but from where will he take advantage of such realization?

text_uthmani: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but how [i.e., what good] to him will be the remembrance?

text_uthmani: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: when Hell is that Day brought near- on that Day man will take heed, but what good will that be to him then?

text_uthmani: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 23. And Hell will be brought near that Day. On that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance (then) avail him?

text_uthmani: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: and when Hell is brought near that Day. On that Day will man understand, but of what avail will that understanding be?1

text_uthmani: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: Wajee-a yawma-ithin bijahannamayawma-ithin yatathakkaru al-insanu waannalahu aththikra

text_uthmani: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?

text_uthmani: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
translation_text: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
translation_text: He will say, “O Would that I had sent ahead (some good deeds) for (this) my life!”

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
translation_text: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."1

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
translation_text: He will say, ‘Would that I had provided for this life to come!’

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: He will say: "Alas! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my life!"

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
translation_text: He will say: “Would that I had sent ahead what would be of avail for this life of mine!”

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
translation_text: Yaqoolu ya laytanee qaddamtu lihayatee

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
translation_text: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!

text_uthmani: يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
translation_text: He will say: "Ah! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my (Future) Life!"

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: So no one can punish like He will punish, that day,

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 25. So on that Day none will punish as He will punish.

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: On that Day, no one will punish as He punishes,

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: Then on that Day Allah will chastise as none other can chastise;

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: Fayawma-ithin la yuAAaththibuAAathabahu ahad

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!

text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict,

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: nor can anyone shackle like He will shackle.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 26. And none will bind (the wicked, disbelievers and polytheists) as He will bind.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: and no one will bind as He binds.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: and Allah will bind as none other can bind.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: Wala yoothiqu wathaqahu ahad

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: None bindeth as He then will bind.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind.

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
translation_text: (As for an obedient man, it will be said to him,) “O content soul,

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
translation_text: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 27. (It will be said to the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism): "O (you) the one in (complete) rest and satisfaction!

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
translation_text: ‘[But] you, soul at peace:

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
translation_text: (On the other hand it will be said): “O serene soul!1

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
translation_text: Ya ayyatuha annafsualmutma-inna

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
translation_text: But ah! thou soul at peace!

text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
translation_text: (To the righteous soul will be said:) "O (thou) soul, in (complete) rest and satisfaction!

text_uthmani: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
translation_text: come back to your Lord, well-pleased, well-pleasing.

text_uthmani: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
translation_text: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],

text_uthmani: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 28. "Come back to your Lord well-pleased (yourself) and well-pleasing (unto Him)!

text_uthmani: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
translation_text: return to your Lord well pleased and well pleasing;

text_uthmani: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
translation_text: Return to your Lord1 well-pleased (with your blissful destination), well-pleasing (to your Lord).

text_uthmani: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
translation_text: IrjiAAee ila rabbiki radiyatanmardiyya

text_uthmani: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
translation_text: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!

text_uthmani: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
translation_text: "Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him!

text_uthmani: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى
فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى
translation_text: So, enter among My (special) servants,

text_uthmani: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى
translation_text: And enter among My [righteous] servants

text_uthmani: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 29. "Enter you then among My (honoured) slaves,

text_uthmani: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى
translation_text: go in among My servants;

text_uthmani: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى
translation_text: So enter among My (righteous) servants

text_uthmani: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى
translation_text: Fadkhulee fee AAibadee

text_uthmani: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى
translation_text: Enter thou among My bondmen!

text_uthmani: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى
translation_text: "Enter thou, then, among My devotees!

text_uthmani: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
translation_text: and enter My Paradise.”

text_uthmani: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
translation_text: And enter My Paradise."

text_uthmani: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 30. "And enter you My Paradise!"

text_uthmani: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
translation_text: and into My Garden.’

text_uthmani: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
translation_text: and enter My Paradise.”

text_uthmani: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
translation_text: Wadkhulee jannatee

text_uthmani: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
translation_text: Enter thou My Garden!

text_uthmani: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
translation_text: "Yea, enter thou My Heaven!

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: I swear by this city,

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah] –

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: I swear by this city––

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: I swear by this city (Makkah);

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: Nay!1 I swear by this city2

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: La oqsimu bihatha albalad

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: Nay, I swear by this city -

text_uthmani: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: I do call to witness this City;-

text_uthmani: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: -and (O Prophet,) you are going to be allowed (to fight) in this city-

text_uthmani: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city –

text_uthmani: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And you are free (from sin, and to punish the enemies of Islâm on the Day of the conquest) in this city (Makkah).1

text_uthmani: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: and you [Prophet] are an inhabitant of this city––

text_uthmani: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: – this city wherein you have been rendered violable–1

text_uthmani: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: Waanta hillun bihatha albalad

text_uthmani: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: And thou art an indweller of this city -

text_uthmani: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
translation_text: And thou art a freeman of this City;-

text_uthmani: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
translation_text: and by the father and all those he begot,

text_uthmani: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
translation_text: And [by] the father1 and that which was born [of him],

text_uthmani: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And by the begetter (i.e. Adam عليه السلام) and that which he begot (i.e. his progeny).

text_uthmani: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
translation_text: [I swear] by parent and offspring,

text_uthmani: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
translation_text: and I swear by the parent and his offspring:1

text_uthmani: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
translation_text: Wawalidin wama walad

text_uthmani: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
translation_text: And the begetter and that which he begat,

text_uthmani: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
translation_text: And (the mystic ties of) parent and child;-

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
translation_text: indeed We have created man (to live) in hard struggle.

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
translation_text: We have certainly created man into hardship.

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. Verily, We have created man in toil.

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
translation_text: that We have created man for toil and trial.

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
translation_text: Verily We have created man into toil and hardship.1

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
translation_text: Laqad khalaqna al-insana feekabad

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
translation_text: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
translation_text: Verily We have created man into toil and struggle.

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: Does he think that no one has power over him?

text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
translation_text: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ

translation_text: - then he did not join those who believe and advise each other to be patient and advise each other to be merciful.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
translation_text: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
translation_text: and to be one of those who believe and urge one another to steadfastness and compassion.

translation_text: 17. Then he became one of those who believed (in the Islamic Monotheism) and recommended one another to perseverance and patience, and (also) recommended one another to pity and compassion.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
translation_text: and, then besides this, he be one of those who believed,1 and enjoined upon one another steadfastness and enjoined upon one another compassion.2

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ

translation_text: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
translation_text: Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion.

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ

translation_text: 18. They are those on the Right Hand (i.e. the dwellers of Paradise),

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
