text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_text: Ola-ika as-habualmaymana

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_text: Their place will be on the right hand.

text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
translation_text: Such are the Companions of the Right Hand.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: As for those who reject Our verses, they are the People of the Left Hand. (i.e. their books of deeds will be given in their left hands.)

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. But those who disbelieved in Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), they are those on the Left Hand (the dwellers of Hell).

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: but those who disbelieve in Our revelations will be on the left-hand side,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: As for those who rejected Our Signs, they are the People of the Left Hand.1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: Wallatheena kafaroo bi-ayatinahum as-habu almash-ama

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
translation_text: But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand.

text_uthmani: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
translation_text: Upon them will be the Fire, enveloping them with closed exits.

text_uthmani: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
translation_text: Over them will be fire closed in.1

text_uthmani: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: The Fire will be shut over them (i.e. they will be enveloped by the Fire without any opening or window or outlet.1

text_uthmani: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
translation_text: and the Fire will close in on them.

text_uthmani: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
translation_text: Upon them shall be a Fire that will hem them in.1

text_uthmani: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
translation_text: AAalayhim narun mu/sada

text_uthmani: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
translation_text: Fire will be an awning over them.

text_uthmani: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
translation_text: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).

text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: I swear by the sun and his broad light,

text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: By the sun and its brightness

text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: By the sun in its morning brightness

text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. By the sun and its brightness.

text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: By the sun and its heat and brightness,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: Washshamsi waduhaha

text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: By the sun and his brightness,

text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
translation_text: By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour;

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the moon when she follows him,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
translation_text: And [by] the moon when it follows it

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. By the moon as it follows it (the sun).

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the moon as it follows it,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the moon as it follows it;

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
translation_text: Walqamari itha talaha

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
translation_text: And the moon when she followeth him,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
translation_text: By the Moon as she follows him;

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the day when it shows his brightness,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
translation_text: And [by] the day when it displays it1

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
translation_text: by the day as it displays the sun’s glory

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. By the day as it shows up (the sun’s) brightness.

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the day as it displays the sun's glory,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
translation_text: Wannahari itha jallaha

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
translation_text: And the day when it revealeth him,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
translation_text: By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) glory;

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the night when it envelops him,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. By the night as it conceals it (the sun).

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the night as it conceals it,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the night as it envelopes the sun;1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: Wallayli itha yaghshaha

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: And the night when it enshroudeth him,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
translation_text: By the Night as it conceals it;

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the sky, and the One who built it,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. By the heaven and Him Who built it.

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: by the sky and how He built it

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the sky and by Him Who made it;1

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: Wassama-i wama banaha

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: And the heaven and Him Who built it,

text_uthmani: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
translation_text: By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure;

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the earth, and the One who spread it,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
translation_text: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. By the earth and Him Who spread it.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the earth and how He spread it,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the earth and by Him Who stretched it out;

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
translation_text: Wal-ardi wama tahaha

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
translation_text: And the earth and Him Who spread it,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
translation_text: By the Earth and its (wide) expanse:

text_uthmani: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the soul, and the One who made it well,

text_uthmani: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it1

text_uthmani: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: by the soul and how He formed it

text_uthmani: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. By Nafs (Adam or a person or a soul), and Him Who perfected him in proportion;

text_uthmani: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: and by the soul and by Him Who perfectly proportioned it,1

text_uthmani: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: Wanafsin wama sawwaha

text_uthmani: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: And a soul and Him Who perfected it

text_uthmani: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it;

text_uthmani: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
translation_text: then inspired it with its (instincts of) evil and piety,

text_uthmani: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
translation_text: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

text_uthmani: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
translation_text: and inspired it [to know] its own rebellion and piety!

text_uthmani: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. Then He showed him what is wrong for him and what is right for him.

text_uthmani: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
translation_text: and imbued it with (the consciousness of) its evil and its piety:1

text_uthmani: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
translation_text: Faalhamaha fujooraha wataqwaha

text_uthmani: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
translation_text: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.

text_uthmani: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
translation_text: And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right;-

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
translation_text: success is really attained by him who purifies it,

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
translation_text: He has succeeded who purifies it,

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
translation_text: The one who purifies his soul succeeds

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. Indeed he succeeds who purifies his ownself (i.e. obeys and performs all that Allâh ordered, by following the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism and by doing righteous good deeds).

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
translation_text: He who purifies it will prosper,

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
translation_text: Qad aflaha man zakkaha

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
translation_text: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,

text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
translation_text: Truly he succeeds that purifies it,

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
translation_text: and failure is really suffered by him who pollutes it.

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
translation_text: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
translation_text: and the one who corrupts it fails.

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. And indeed he fails who corrupts his ownself (i.e. disobeys what Allâh has ordered by rejecting the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism or by following polytheism or by doing every kind of evil wicked deeds).

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
translation_text: and he who suppresses it will be ruined.1

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
translation_text: Waqad khaba man dassaha

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
translation_text: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.

text_uthmani: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
translation_text: And he fails that corrupts it!

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
translation_text: (The People of) Thamūd denied the truth because of their transgression,

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
translation_text: Thamūd denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
translation_text: In their arrogant cruelty, the people of Thamud called [their messenger] a liar,

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Thamûd (people) denied (their Prophet) through their transgression (by rejecting the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism, and by following polytheism, and by committing every kind of sin).

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
translation_text: In their presumptuous insolence the Thamud1 called the Truth a lie2

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
translation_text: Kaththabat thamoodu bitaghwaha

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
translation_text: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,

text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
translation_text: The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing,

text_uthmani: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
translation_text: when rose up the one who was most wretched of them.

text_uthmani: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
translation_text: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.1

text_uthmani: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
translation_text: when the most wicked man among them rose [against him].

text_uthmani: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. When the most wicked man among them went forth (to kill the she-camel).

text_uthmani: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
translation_text: when their arch-criminal rose up in rage.

text_uthmani: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
translation_text: Ithi inbaAAatha ashqaha

text_uthmani: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
translation_text: When the basest of them broke forth

text_uthmani: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
translation_text: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety).

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
translation_text: So, the Messenger of Allah said to them, “Be careful of Allah’s she-camel and her right to drink.”

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
translation_text: And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
translation_text: The messenger of God said to them, ‘[Leave] God’s camel to drink,’

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. But the Messenger of Allâh [Sâlih عليه السلام] said to them: "Be cautious! (Fear the evil end). That is the she-camel of Allâh! (Do not harm it) and bar it not from having its drink!"

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
translation_text: Then Allah's Messenger warned them: “Hands off the she-camel and her drink!”1

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
translation_text: Faqala lahum rasoolu Allahi naqataAllahi wasuqyaha

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
translation_text: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!

text_uthmani: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
translation_text: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink!"

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: But they rejected him and killed her, so their Lord sent eradicating torment upon them because of their sin, and made it equal for all.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: But they denied him and hamstrung1 her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: but they called him a liar and hamstrung her. Their Lord destroyed them for their crime and levelled them.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. Then they denied him and they killed it. So their Lord destroyed them because of their sin, and made them equal in destruction (i.e. all grades of people, rich and poor, strong and weak, etc.)!

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: But they rejected his statement as a lie and hamstrung the she-camel.1 For that crime their Lord rumbled down upon them, utterly razing them to the ground.

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: Fakaththaboohu faAAaqaroohafadamdama AAalayhim rabbuhum bithanbihim fasawwaha

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).

text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
translation_text: Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)!

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا
وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا
translation_text: And He has no fear of its consequence.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا
translation_text: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.1

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. And He (Allâh) feared not the consequences thereof.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا
translation_text: He did not hesitate to punish them.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا
translation_text: He has no fear of its sequel.1

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا
translation_text: Wala yakhafu AAuqbaha

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا
translation_text: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا
translation_text: And for Him is no fear of its consequences.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: I swear by the night when it covers (the sun),

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: By the night when it covers1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: By the enshrouding night,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. By the night as it envelops.

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: By the night when it enshrouds,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: Wallayli itha yaghsha

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: By the night enshrouding

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
translation_text: By the Night as it conceals (the light);

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
translation_text: and by the day when it unveils itself,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
translation_text: And [by] the day when it appears

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. By the day as it appears in brightness.

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
translation_text: by the radiant day,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
translation_text: and by the day when it breaks in its glory,

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Wannahari itha tajalla

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
translation_text: And the day resplendent

text_uthmani: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
translation_text: By the Day as it appears in glory;

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: and by the One who created the male and the female,

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: And [by] He who created the male and female,

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: by His creation of male and female!

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. By Him Who created male and female.

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: and by Him Who created the male and the female:

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: Wama khalaqa aththakarawal-ontha

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: And Him Who hath created male and female,

text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
translation_text: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female;-

text_uthmani: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
translation_text: your efforts are diverse:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
translation_text: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
translation_text: The ways you take differ greatly.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. Certainly, your efforts and deeds are diverse (different in aims and purposes);

text_uthmani: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
translation_text: surely your strivings are divergent.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
translation_text: Inna saAAyakum lashatta

text_uthmani: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
translation_text: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
translation_text: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse.

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
translation_text: As for the one who gives (in charity) and fears Allah,

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
translation_text: As for he who gives and fears Allāh

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
translation_text: There is the one who gives, who is mindful of God,

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allâh and fears Him,

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
translation_text: As for him who gave out his wealth (for Allah's sake) and abstained (from disobeying Him),

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
translation_text: Faamma man aAAta wattaqa

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
translation_text: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
translation_text: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah),

text_uthmani: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: and believes in the best (religion),

text_uthmani: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: And believes in the best [reward].

text_uthmani: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: who testifies to goodness––

text_uthmani: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And believes in Al-Husnâ.1

text_uthmani: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: and affirmed the Truth of goodness:1

text_uthmani: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: Wasaddaqa bilhusna

text_uthmani: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: And believeth in goodness;

text_uthmani: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: We will facilitate for him the way to extreme ease (i.e. the comforts of Paradise).

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: We will ease him toward ease.

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: We shall smooth his way towards ease.

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. We will make smooth for him the path of ease (goodness).

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: We shall facilitate for him the Way to Bliss.1

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: Fasanuyassiruhu lilyusra

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: But the one who is miser and deems himself self-sufficient,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: There is the one who is miserly, who is self-satisfied,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: But he who is greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient.1

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: As for him who was a miser and behaved with aversion (to Allah),

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: Waamma man bakhila wastaghna

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient,

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: and rejects the best (religion),

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: And denies the best [reward],

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: who denies goodness––

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. And belies Al-Husnâ (See the footnote of the Verse No.6)

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: and denied the Truth of goodness:1

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: Wakaththaba bilhusna

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: And disbelieveth in goodness;

text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
translation_text: And gives the lie to the best,-

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: We will facilitate for him the way to extreme distress.

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: We will ease him toward difficulty.

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: We shall smooth his way towards hardship

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. We will make smooth for him the path for evil.

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: We shall facilitate for him the way to Hardship,1

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: Fasanuyassiruhu lilAAusra

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.

text_uthmani: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
translation_text: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
translation_text: And his wealth will not help him when he will fall down (into Hell).

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
translation_text: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?1

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
translation_text: and his wealth will not help him as he falls.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. And what will his wealth avail him when he goes down (in destruction)?.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
translation_text: and his wealth shall be of no avail to him when he perishes.1

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
translation_text: Wama yughnee AAanhu maluhu ithataradda

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
translation_text: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.

text_uthmani: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
translation_text: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
translation_text: Of course, it is undertaken by Us to guide,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
translation_text: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
translation_text: Our part is to provide guidance––

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 12. Truly! On Us is (to give) guidance.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
translation_text: Surely it is for Us to show the Right Way,1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
translation_text: Inna AAalayna lalhuda

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
translation_text: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance

text_uthmani: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
translation_text: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: and in Our control is the Hereafter and the worldly life.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: And indeed, to us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: this world and the next belong to Us––

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 13. And truly, unto Us (belong) the last (Hereafter) and the first (this world).

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: and to Us belong the Next Life and the present.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: Wa-inna lana lal-akhirata wal-oola

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning.

text_uthmani: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
translation_text: So I have warned you of a blazing fire.

text_uthmani: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
translation_text: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.

text_uthmani: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
translation_text: so I warn you about the raging Fire,

text_uthmani: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 14. Therefore I have warned you of a blazing Fire (Hell).

text_uthmani: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
translation_text: I have now warned you of a Blazing Fire,

text_uthmani: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
translation_text: Faanthartukum naran talaththa

text_uthmani: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
translation_text: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire

text_uthmani: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
translation_text: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely;

text_uthmani: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: None will enter it but the wretched one,

text_uthmani: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one

text_uthmani: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: in which none but the most wicked one will burn,

text_uthmani: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 15. None shall enter it save the most wretched.

text_uthmani: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: where none shall burn except the most wicked,

text_uthmani: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: La yaslaha illaal-ashqa

text_uthmani: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: Which only the most wretched must endure,

text_uthmani: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
translation_text: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: who rejected (the truth) and turned away (from it).

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Who had denied and turned away.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: who denied [the truth], and turned away.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 16. Who denies and turns away.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: who rejected the Truth, calling it falsehood and turned his back on it.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Allathee kaththaba watawalla

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: He who denieth and turneth away.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
translation_text: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs.

text_uthmani: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
translation_text: And saved from it will be the most God-fearing one,

text_uthmani: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
translation_text: But the righteous one will avoid it –

text_uthmani: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
translation_text: The most pious one will be spared this––

text_uthmani: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 17. And Al-Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) will be far removed from it (Hell).

text_uthmani: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
translation_text: But the God-fearing shall be kept away from it,

text_uthmani: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
translation_text: Wasayujannabuha al-atqa

text_uthmani: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
translation_text: Far removed from it will be the righteous

text_uthmani: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
translation_text: But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it,-

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: who gives his wealth (in charity) to become purified,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: who gives his wealth away as self-purification,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. He who spends his wealth for increase in self-purification,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: the Godfearing who spends his wealth to purify himself;1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: Allathee yu/tee malahuyatazakka

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
translation_text: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,

text_uthmani: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
translation_text: while no one has conferred any favour on him for which he would give a return,

text_uthmani: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
translation_text: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded1 –

text_uthmani: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
translation_text: not to return a favour to anyone

text_uthmani: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. And who has (in mind) no favour from anyone to be paid back,

text_uthmani: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
translation_text: not as payment for any favours that he received,

text_uthmani: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
translation_text: Wama li-ahadin AAindahu minniAAmatin tujza

text_uthmani: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
translation_text: And none hath with him any favour for reward,

text_uthmani: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
translation_text: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: but (he gave his wealth in charity) only to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: But only seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of his Lord, Most High.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 20. Except to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: but for the sake of his Lord the Most High––

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: but only to seek the good pleasure of his Lord Most High.1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: Illa ibtighaa wajhi rabbihial-aAAla

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
translation_text: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
translation_text: And surely he will soon be happy.

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
translation_text: And he is going to be satisfied.

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 21. He surely will be pleased (when he enters Paradise).

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
translation_text: and he will be well pleased.

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
translation_text: He will surely be well-pleased (with him).1

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
translation_text: Walasawfa yarda

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
translation_text: He verily will be content.

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
translation_text: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.

text_uthmani: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
translation_text: I swear by the forenoon,

text_uthmani: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
translation_text: By the morning brightness

text_uthmani: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
translation_text: By the morning brightness

text_uthmani: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: By the forenoon (after sunrise).1

text_uthmani: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
translation_text: By the bright forenoon,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
translation_text: Wadduha

text_uthmani: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
translation_text: By the morning hours

text_uthmani: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
translation_text: By the Glorious Morning Light,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
translation_text: and by the night when it becomes peaceful,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
translation_text: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
translation_text: and by the night when it grows still,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. By the night when it darkens (and stand still).

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
translation_text: and by the night when it covers the world with peace:1

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
translation_text: Wallayli itha saja

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
translation_text: And by the night when it is stillest,

text_uthmani: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
translation_text: And by the Night when it is still,-

text_uthmani: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
translation_text: your Lord (O Prophet,) has neither forsaken you, nor has become displeased.

text_uthmani: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
translation_text: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you].

text_uthmani: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
translation_text: your Lord has not forsaken you [Prophet], nor does He hate you,

text_uthmani: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. Your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has neither forsaken you nor hates you.

text_uthmani: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
translation_text: (O Prophet), your Lord has neither forsaken you, nor is He displeased.1

text_uthmani: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
translation_text: Ma waddaAAaka rabbuka wama qala

text_uthmani: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
translation_text: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,

text_uthmani: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
translation_text: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.

text_uthmani: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: Surely the Hereafter is much better for you than the present life.

text_uthmani: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].

text_uthmani: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: and the future will be better for you than the past;

text_uthmani: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And indeed the Hereafter is better for you than the present (life of this world).

text_uthmani: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: Indeed what is to come will be better for you than what has gone by.1

text_uthmani: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: Walal-akhiratu khayrun laka minaal-oola

text_uthmani: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,

text_uthmani: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
translation_text: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: And of course, your Lord will give you so much that you will be pleased.

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: your Lord is sure to give you so much that you will be well satisfied.

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. And verily, your Lord will give you (all good) so that you shall be well-pleased.

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: Verily your Lord will soon give you so amply that you will be well-pleased.1

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: Walasawfa yuAAteeka rabbuka fatarda

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.

text_uthmani: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
translation_text: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
translation_text: Did He not find you an orphan, and give you shelter?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
translation_text: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
translation_text: Did He not find you an orphan and shelter you?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. Did He not find you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) an orphan and gave you a refuge?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
translation_text: Did He not find you an orphan and then gave you shelter?1

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
translation_text: Alam yajidka yateeman faawa

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
translation_text: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
translation_text: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ
وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: And He found you unaware of the way (the Sharī‘ah ), then He guided you.

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: And He found you lost and guided [you],

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: Did He not find you lost and guide you?

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. And He found you unaware (of the Qur’ân, its laws, and Prophethood) and guided you?

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: Did He not find you unaware of the Right Way, and then directed you to it?1

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: Wawajadaka dallan fahada

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّا فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: and He found you in need, then made you need-free.

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: Did He not find you in need and make you self-sufficient?

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. And He found you poor and made you rich (self-sufficient with self-contentment)?

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: And did He not find you in want, and then enriched you?1

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: Wawajadaka AAa-ilan faaghna

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?

text_uthmani: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
translation_text: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
translation_text: Therefore, as for orphan, do not oppress him,

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
translation_text: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. Therefore, treat not the orphan with oppression.

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
translation_text: So do not be harsh with the orphan

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
translation_text: Therefore, be not harsh with the orphan;1

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
translation_text: Faamma alyateema fala taqhar

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
translation_text: Therefor the orphan oppress not,

text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
translation_text: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
translation_text: and as for the beggar, do not scold him.

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
translation_text: And as for the petitioner,1 do not repel [him].

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 10. And repulse not the beggar.

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
translation_text: and do not chide the one who asks for help;

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
translation_text: and chide not him who asks,1

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
translation_text: Waamma assa-ila falatanhar

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
translation_text: Therefor the beggar drive not away,

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
translation_text: Nor repulse the petitioner (unheard);

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
translation_text: And about the bounty of your Lord, do talk.

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
translation_text: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. And proclaim the Grace of your Lord (i.e. the Prophethood and all other Graces).

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
translation_text: talk about the blessings of your Lord.

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
translation_text: and proclaim the bounty of your Lord.1

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
translation_text: Waamma biniAAmati rabbika fahaddith

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
translation_text: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.

text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
translation_text: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
translation_text: Have We not caused your bosom to be wide open for you?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
translation_text: Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?1

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
translation_text: Did We not relieve your heart for you [Prophet],

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. Have We not opened your breast for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
translation_text: (O Prophet), Did We not lay open your breast1

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
translation_text: Alam nashrah laka sadrak

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
translation_text: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
translation_text: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-

text_uthmani: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
translation_text: And We removed from you your burden

text_uthmani: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
translation_text: And We removed from you your burden1

text_uthmani: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. And removed from you your burden.

text_uthmani: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
translation_text: and remove the burden

text_uthmani: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
translation_text: and relieve you of the burden

text_uthmani: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
translation_text: WawadaAAna AAanka wizrak

text_uthmani: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
translation_text: And eased thee of the burden

text_uthmani: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
translation_text: And removed from thee thy burden

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
translation_text: that had (almost) broken your back,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
translation_text: Which had weighed upon your back

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. Which weighed down your back?

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
translation_text: that weighed so heavily on your back,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
translation_text: that had well-nigh broken your back?1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
translation_text: Allathee anqada thahrak

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
translation_text: Which weighed down thy back;

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
translation_text: The which did gall thy back?-

text_uthmani: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
translation_text: and We raised high your name.

text_uthmani: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
translation_text: And raised high for you your repute.

text_uthmani: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And have We not raised high your fame?

text_uthmani: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
translation_text: and raise your reputation high?

text_uthmani: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
translation_text: And did We not exalt your fame?1

text_uthmani: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
translation_text: WarafaAAna laka thikrak

text_uthmani: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
translation_text: And exalted thy fame?

text_uthmani: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
translation_text: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: So, undoubtedly, along with the hardship there is ease.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief].

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. Verily, along with every hardship is relief,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: So truly where there is hardship there is also ease;

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: Indeed, there is ease with hardship.

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: Fa-inna maAAa alAAusri yusra

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,

text_uthmani: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:

text_uthmani: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: Undoubtedly, along with the hardship there is ease.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. Verily, along with every hardship is relief (i.e. there is one hardship with two reliefs, so one hardship cannot overcome two reliefs).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: truly where there is hardship there is also ease.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: Most certainly, there is ease with hardship.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: Inna maAAa alAAusri yusra

text_uthmani: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: Lo! with hardship goeth ease;

text_uthmani: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
translation_text: So, when you are free (from collective services), toil hard (in worship),

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
translation_text: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. So when you have finished (your occupation), devote yourself for Allâh’s worship.

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
translation_text: The moment you are freed [of one task] work on,

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
translation_text: So, whenever you are free, strive in devotion,

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
translation_text: Fa-itha faraghta fansab

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
translation_text: So when thou art relieved, still toil

text_uthmani: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
translation_text: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,

text_uthmani: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
translation_text: and towards your Lord turn with eagerness.

text_uthmani: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
translation_text: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

text_uthmani: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
translation_text: and turn to your Lord for everything.

text_uthmani: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. And to your Lord (Alone) turn (all your) intentions and hopes.

text_uthmani: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
translation_text: and turn to your Lord with longing.1

text_uthmani: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
translation_text: Wa-ila rabbika farghab

text_uthmani: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
translation_text: And strive to please thy Lord.

text_uthmani: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
translation_text: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.

text_uthmani: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
translation_text: I swear by the Fig and the Olive,

text_uthmani: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
translation_text: By the fig and the olive1

text_uthmani: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. By the fig, and the olive.

text_uthmani: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
translation_text: By the fig, by the olive,

text_uthmani: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
translation_text: By the fig and the olive;1

text_uthmani: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
translation_text: Watteeni wazzaytoon

text_uthmani: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
translation_text: By the fig and the olive,

text_uthmani: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
translation_text: By the Fig and the Olive,

text_uthmani: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
translation_text: and by Tūr, the mount of Sinai,

text_uthmani: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
translation_text: And [by] Mount Sinai

text_uthmani: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
translation_text: by Mount Sinai,

text_uthmani: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. By Mount Sinai.

text_uthmani: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
translation_text: and by the Mount Sinai,1

text_uthmani: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
translation_text: Watoori seeneen

text_uthmani: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
translation_text: By Mount Sinai,

text_uthmani: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
translation_text: And the Mount of Sinai,

text_uthmani: وَهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
وَهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
translation_text: and by this peaceful city,

text_uthmani: وَهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
translation_text: And [by] this secure city [i.e., Makkah],

text_uthmani: وَهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
translation_text: by this safe town,

text_uthmani: وَهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: By this city of security (Makkah).1

text_uthmani: وَهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
translation_text: and by this city (of Makkah), a haven of peace:

text_uthmani: وَهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
translation_text: Wahatha albaladi al-ameen

text_uthmani: وَهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
translation_text: And by this land made safe;

text_uthmani: وَهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
translation_text: And this City of security,-

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
translation_text: We have created man in the best composition,

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
translation_text: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;1

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
translation_text: We create man in the finest state

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. Verily, We created man in the best stature (mould).

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
translation_text: surely We created man in the best mould;1

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
translation_text: Laqad khalaqna al-insana fee ahsanitaqweem

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
translation_text: Surely We created man of the best stature

text_uthmani: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
translation_text: We have indeed created man in the best of moulds,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَـٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَـٰفِلِينَ
ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَـٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَـٰفِلِينَ
translation_text: then We turned him into the lowest of the low,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَـٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَـٰفِلِينَ
translation_text: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَـٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَـٰفِلِينَ
translation_text: then reduce him to the lowest of the low,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَـٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَـٰفِلِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. Then We reduced him to the lowest of the low.

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَـٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَـٰفِلِينَ
translation_text: then We reverted him to the lowest of the low,1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَـٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَـٰفِلِينَ
translation_text: Thumma radadnahu asfala safileen

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَـٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَـٰفِلِينَ
translation_text: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَـٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَـٰفِلِينَ
translation_text: Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low,-

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: except those who believed and did righteous deeds, because for them there is a reward never ending.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: except those who believe and do good deeds–– they will have an unfailing reward.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. Save those who believe (in Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds. Then they shall have a reward without end (Paradise).

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: except those who have faith and do righteous deeds. Theirs is a never ending reward.1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: Illa allatheena amanoowaAAamiloo assalihati falahum ajrun ghayrumamnoon

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
translation_text: Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing.

text_uthmani: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: So, what can make you, after all this, to deny the Requital?

text_uthmani: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?1

text_uthmani: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. Then what (or who) causes you (O disbelievers) to deny the Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)?

text_uthmani: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: After this, what makes you [man] deny the Judgement?

text_uthmani: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Who, then, can give the lie to you, (O Prophet), about the Reward and the Punishment?1

text_uthmani: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Fama yukaththibuka baAAdu biddeen

text_uthmani: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?

text_uthmani: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)?

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
translation_text: Is Allah not the Greatest Ruler of all the rulers?

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
translation_text: Is not Allāh the most just of judges?

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. Is not Allâh the Best of judges?

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
translation_text: Is God not the most decisive of judges?

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
translation_text: Is not Allah the Greatest of all sovereigns?1

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
translation_text: Alaysa Allahu bi-ahkami alhakimeen

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
translation_text: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?

text_uthmani: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
translation_text: Is not Allah the wisest of judges?

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
translation_text: Read with the name of your Lord who created (every thing),

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
translation_text: Recite in the name of your Lord who created –

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
translation_text: Read! In the name of your Lord who created:

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Read! In the Name of your Lord Who has created (all that exists).

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
translation_text: Recite1 in the name of your Lord2 Who created,3

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
translation_text: Iqra/ bi-ismi rabbika allathee khalaq

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
translation_text: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
translation_text: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created-

خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
translation_text: He created man from a clot of blood.

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
translation_text: Created man from a clinging substance.

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. He has created man from a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood).

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
translation_text: He created man from a clinging form.

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
translation_text: created man from a clot of congealed blood.1

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
translation_text: Khalaqa al-insana min AAalaq

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
translation_text: Createth man from a clot.

text_uthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
translation_text: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood:

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
translation_text: Read, and your Lord is the most gracious,

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
translation_text: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
translation_text: Read! Your Lord is the Most Bountiful One

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous.

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
translation_text: Recite: and your Lord is Most Generous,

text_uthmani: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
translation_text: Iqra/ warabbuka al-akram
