translation_text: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades):

text_uthmani: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
translation_text: We will call the soldiers of the Hell.

text_uthmani: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
translation_text: We will call the angels of Hell.1

text_uthmani: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
translation_text: We shall summon the guards of Hell.

text_uthmani: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 18. We will call out the guards of Hell (to deal with him)!

text_uthmani: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
translation_text: We too shall summon the guards of Hell.1

text_uthmani: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
translation_text: SanadAAu azzabaniya

text_uthmani: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
translation_text: We will call the guards of hell.

text_uthmani: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
translation_text: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)!

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
translation_text: No! Never obey him, and bow down in sajdah, and come close to Me.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
translation_text: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allāh].

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
translation_text: No! Do not obey him [Prophet]: bow down in worship and draw close.

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 19. Nay! (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)! Do not obey him (Abû Jahl). Fall prostrate and draw near to Allâh!

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
translation_text: No, not at all. Never obey him. But prostrate yourself and become nigh (to your Lord).1

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
translation_text: Kalla la tutiAAhu wasjudwaqtarib

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
translation_text: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).

text_uthmani: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
translation_text: Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)!

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: We have sent it (the Qur’ān) down in the Night of Qadr.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: We sent it down on the Night of Glory.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Verily, We have sent it (this Qur’ân) down in the night of Al-Qadr (Decree).1

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: Behold, We revealed this (Qur'an) on the Night of Power.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: Inna anzalnahu fee laylatialqadr

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power:

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: And what may let you know what the Night of Qadr is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: What will explain to you what that Night of Glory is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. And what will make you know what the night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: And what do you know what the Night of Power is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: Wama adraka ma laylatualqadr

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
translation_text: And what will explain to thee what the night of power is?

text_uthmani: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
translation_text: The Night of Qadr is much better than one thousand months.

text_uthmani: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
translation_text: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

text_uthmani: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
translation_text: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months;

text_uthmani: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. The night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is better than a thousand months (i.e. worshipping Allâh in that night is better than worshipping Him a thousand months, i.e. 83 years and 4 months).

text_uthmani: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
translation_text: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.1

text_uthmani: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
translation_text: Laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahr

text_uthmani: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
translation_text: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.

text_uthmani: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
translation_text: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.

text_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
translation_text: The angels and the Spirit descend in it, with the leave of your Lord, along with every command.

text_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
translation_text: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.1

text_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
translation_text: on that night the angels and the Spirit descend again and again with their Lord’s permission on every task;

text_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. Therein descend the angels and the Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabrîl)] by Allâh’s Permission with all Decrees,

text_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
translation_text: The angels along with the Spirit1 descend in it by the permission of their Lord2 with all kinds of decrees.

text_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
translation_text: Tanazzalu almala-ikatu warroohufeeha bi-ithni rabbihim min kulli amr

text_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
translation_text: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.

text_uthmani: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
translation_text: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand:

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
translation_text: Peace it is till the debut of dawn.

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
translation_text: Peace it is1 until the emergence of dawn.

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: (All that night), there is Peace (and Goodness from Allâh to His believing slaves) until the appearance of dawn.1

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
translation_text: [there is] peace that night until the break of dawn.

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
translation_text: All peace is that night until the rise of dawn.1

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
translation_text: Salamun hiya hatta matlaAAialfajr

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
translation_text: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.

text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
translation_text: Peace!... This until the rise of morn!

text_uthmani: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: Those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not (expected) to desist (from their wrong beliefs) unless there comes to them a clear proof,

text_uthmani: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief]1 until there came to them clear evidence –

text_uthmani: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Book and the idolaters were not about to change their ways until they were sent clear evidence,

text_uthmani: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Those who disbelieve from among the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) and Al-Mushrikûn,1 were not going to leave (their disbelief) until there came to them clear evidence.

text_uthmani: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: Those who disbelieved1 – be they from the People of the Book or from those who associated2 others with Allah in His Divinity – will not desist from unbelief until the Clear Proof should come to them;3

text_uthmani: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: Lam yakuni allatheena kafaroo min ahlialkitabi walmushrikeena munfakkeena hattata/tiyahumu albayyina

text_uthmani: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them,

text_uthmani: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, were not going to depart (from their ways) until there should come to them Clear Evidence,-

text_uthmani: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
translation_text: a messenger from Allah who recites the purified scrolls

text_uthmani: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
translation_text: A Messenger from Allāh, reciting purified1 scriptures

text_uthmani: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
translation_text: a messenger from God, reading out pages [blessed with] purity,

text_uthmani: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. A Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from Allâh, reciting (the Qur’ân) purified pages [purified from Al-Bâtil (falsehood)].

text_uthmani: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
translation_text: a Messenger1 from Allah, reciting from Purified Scrolls;2

text_uthmani: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
translation_text: Rasoolun mina Allahi yatloo suhufanmutahhara

text_uthmani: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
translation_text: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages

text_uthmani: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
translation_text: An messenger from Allah, rehearsing scriptures kept pure and holy:

text_uthmani: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
translation_text: containing (right and) straight writings.

text_uthmani: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
translation_text: Within which are correct writings [i.e., rulings and laws].

text_uthmani: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
translation_text: containing true scriptures.

text_uthmani: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. Wherein are correct and straight laws from Allâh.

text_uthmani: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
translation_text: in writings wherein are scriptures, absolutely true and unerring.

text_uthmani: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
translation_text: Feeha kutubun qayyima

text_uthmani: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
translation_text: Containing correct scriptures.

text_uthmani: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ
translation_text: Wherein are laws (or decrees) right and straight.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: And those who were given the Book did not disagree but after the clear proof came to them,

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided1 until after there had come to them clear evidence.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: [Yet] those who were given the Scripture became divided only after they were sent [such] clear evi-dence

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) differed not until after there came to them clear evidence (i.e. Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and whatever was revealed to him).

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: Nor did those to whom the Book had been given split up until after the Proof (of the Right Way) had come to them.1

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: Wama tafarraqa allatheena ootooalkitaba illa min baAAdi ma jaat-humualbayyina

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: Nor were the People of the Scripture divided until after the clear proof came unto them.

text_uthmani: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
translation_text: Nor did the People of the Book make schisms, until after there came to them Clear Evidence.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
translation_text: while they were not ordered but to worship Allah, making their submission exclusive for him with no deviation, and to establish Salāh and pay Zakāh. That is the way of the straight religion.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
translation_text: And they were not commanded except to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakāh. And that is the correct religion.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. And they were commanded not, but that they should worship Allâh, and worship none but Him Alone (abstaining from ascribing partners to Him), and perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât) and give Zakât, and that is the right religion.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
translation_text: though all they are ordered to do is worship God alone, sincerely devoting their religion to Him as people of true faith, keep up the prayer, and pay the prescribed alms, for that is the true religion.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
translation_text: Yet all that they had been commanded was that they serve Allah, with utter sincerity, devoting themselves exclusively to Him, and that they establish Prayer and pay Zakah. That is the Right Faith.1

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
translation_text: Wama omiroo illa liyaAAbudooAllaha mukhliseena lahu addeena hunafaawayuqeemoo assalata wayu/too azzakatawathalika deenu alqayyima

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
translation_text: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
translation_text: And they have been commanded no more than this: To worship Allah, offering Him sincere devotion, being true (in faith); to establish regular prayer; and to practise regular charity; and that is the Religion Right and Straight.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: Surely those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the fire of Jahannam , in which they will be living forever. Those are the worst of all human beings.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Verily, those who disbelieve (in the religion of Islâm, the Qur’ân and Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from among the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) and Al-Mushrikûn will abide in the Fire of Hell. They are the worst of creatures.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Book and the idolaters will have the Fire of Hell, there to remain. They are the worst of creation.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: Those who disbelieved1 – be they from among the People of the Book or among those who associated others with Allah in His Divinity– shall be in the Fire, and will abide in it. They are the worst of creatures.2

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: Inna allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabiwalmushrikeena fee nari jahannama khalideenafeeha ola-ika hum sharru albariyya

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, will be in Hell-Fire, to dwell therein (for aye). They are the worst of creatures.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, they are the best of all human beings.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. Verily, those who believe [in the Oneness of Allâh, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) including all obligations ordered by Islâm] and do righteous good deeds, they are the best of creatures.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: Those who believe and do good deeds are the best of creation.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: But those that believe and work righteous deeds, they are the best of creatures.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: Inna allatheena amanoowaAAamiloo assalihati ola-ika humkhayru albariyya

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: (And) lo! those who believe and do good works are the best of created beings.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
translation_text: Those who have faith and do righteous deeds,- they are the best of creatures.

text_uthmani: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
translation_text: Their reward, with their Lord, is gardens of eternity beneath which rivers flow, in which they will be abiding forever. Allah is well pleased with them, and they are well pleased with Him. That (reward) is for him who has awe of his Lord.

text_uthmani: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
translation_text: Their reward with their Lord will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allāh being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.

text_uthmani: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. Their reward with their Lord is ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (Gardens of Eternity), underneath which rivers flow. They will abide therein forever, Allâh will be pleased with them, and they with Him. That is for him who fears his Lord.

text_uthmani: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
translation_text: Their reward with their Lord is everlasting Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will stay forever. God is well pleased with them and they with Him. All this is for those who stand in awe of their Lord.

text_uthmani: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
translation_text: Their recompense lies with their Lord: Gardens of eternity beneath which rivers flow; therein they shall dwell, forever and ever. Allah is well-pleased with them, and they are well-pleased with Him. All this is for him who fears his Lord.1

text_uthmani: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
translation_text: Jazaohum AAinda rabbihim jannatuAAadnin tajree min tahtiha al-anharu khalideenafeeha abadan radiya Allahu AAanhum waradooAAanhu thalika liman khashiya rabbah

text_uthmani: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
translation_text: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.

text_uthmani: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
translation_text: Their reward is with Allah: Gardens of Eternity, beneath which rivers flow; they will dwell therein for ever; Allah well pleased with them, and they with Him: all this for such as fear their Lord and Cherisher.

text_uthmani: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
translation_text: When the earth will be trembled with its quake,

text_uthmani: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
translation_text: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake

text_uthmani: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
translation_text: When the earth is shaken violently in its [last] quaking,

text_uthmani: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. When the earth is shaken with its (final) earthquake.

text_uthmani: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
translation_text: When the earth will be shaken with a mighty shaking,1

text_uthmani: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
translation_text: Itha zulzilati al-ardu zilzalaha

text_uthmani: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
translation_text: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake

text_uthmani: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
translation_text: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,

text_uthmani: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
translation_text: and the earth will bring forth its burdens,

text_uthmani: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
translation_text: And the earth discharges its burdens1

text_uthmani: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. And when the earth throws out its burdens.

text_uthmani: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
translation_text: when the earth throws out its burdens,

text_uthmani: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
translation_text: and the earth will throw up all her burdens,1

text_uthmani: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
translation_text: Waakhrajati al-ardu athqalaha

text_uthmani: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
translation_text: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,

text_uthmani: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
translation_text: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),

وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا لَهَا
translation_text: and man will say, “What has happened to it?”

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا لَهَا
translation_text: And man says,1 "What is [wrong] with it?" -

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا لَهَا
translation_text: when man cries, ‘What is happening to it?’;

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا لَهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And man will say: "What is the matter with it?"

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا لَهَا
translation_text: and man will cry out: “What is the matter with her?”1

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا لَهَا
translation_text: Waqala al-insanu ma laha

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا لَهَا
translation_text: And man saith: What aileth her?

text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا لَهَا
translation_text: And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her?'-

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
translation_text: That day it will describe all its happenings,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
translation_text: That Day, it will report its news

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. That Day it will declare its information (about all that happened over it of good or evil).

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
translation_text: on that Day, it will tell all

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
translation_text: On that Day it will relate all her news,1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
translation_text: Yawma-ithin tuhaddithu akhbaraha

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
translation_text: That day she will relate her chronicles,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
translation_text: On that Day will she declare her tidings:

text_uthmani: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
translation_text: because its Lord will have so commanded it.

text_uthmani: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
translation_text: Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.

text_uthmani: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
translation_text: because your Lord will inspire it [to do so].

text_uthmani: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. Because your Lord will inspire it.

text_uthmani: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
translation_text: for your Lord will have commanded her (to do so).

text_uthmani: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
translation_text: Bi-anna rabbaka awha laha

text_uthmani: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
translation_text: Because thy Lord inspireth her.

text_uthmani: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
translation_text: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ

translation_text: That day the people will come back (from the place of reckoning) in different groups, so that they may be shown (the fruits of) their deeds.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
translation_text: That Day, the people will depart1 separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
translation_text: On that Day, people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds:

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: That Day mankind will proceed in scattered groups that they may be shown their deeds.1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
translation_text: On that Day people will go forth in varying states1 so that they be shown their deeds.2

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
translation_text: Yawma-ithin yasduru annasuashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
translation_text: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
translation_text: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).

text_uthmani: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: So, whoever does any good act (even) to the weight of a particle will see it.

text_uthmani: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: So whoever does an atom's weight1 of good will see it,

text_uthmani: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: whoever has done an atom’s-weight of good will see it,

text_uthmani: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. So whosoever does good equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant) shall see it.

text_uthmani: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: So, whoever does an atom's weight of good shall see it;

text_uthmani: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: Faman yaAAmal mithqala tharratinkhayran yarah

text_uthmani: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,

text_uthmani: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it!

text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: And whoever does evil (even) to the weight of a particle will see it.

text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. And whosoever does evil equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant) shall see it.

text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: but whoever has done an atom’s-weight of evil will see that.

text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: and whoever does an atom's weight of evil shall see it.1

text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: Waman yaAAmal mithqala tharratinsharran yarah

text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.

text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
translation_text: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it.

وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا
translation_text: (I swear) by those (horses) that run snorting,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا
translation_text: By the racers, panting,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا
translation_text: By the charging steeds that pant

text_uthmani: وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. By the (steeds) that run, with panting.

text_uthmani: وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا
translation_text: By (the horses) that charge snorting,1

text_uthmani: وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا
translation_text: WalAAadiyati dabha

text_uthmani: وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا
translation_text: By the snorting courses,

text_uthmani: وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا
translation_text: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا
فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا
translation_text: then those that create sparks by striking (their hoofs) on the stones,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا
translation_text: And the producers of sparks [when] striking1

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. Striking sparks of fire (by their hooves).

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا
translation_text: and strike sparks with their hooves,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا
translation_text: then raise sparks of fire (by their hoofs),1

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا
translation_text: Falmooriyati qadha

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا
translation_text: Striking sparks of fire

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا
translation_text: And strike sparks of fire,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
translation_text: then those that invade at morning,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
translation_text: And the chargers at dawn,1

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
translation_text: who make dawn raids,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And scouring to the raid at dawn.

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
translation_text: then raid by the dawn,1

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
translation_text: Falmugheerati subha

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
translation_text: And scouring to the raid at dawn,

text_uthmani: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًا
translation_text: And push home the charge in the morning,

text_uthmani: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
translation_text: then raise, at the same time, a trail of dust,

text_uthmani: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
translation_text: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,

text_uthmani: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. And raise the dust in clouds the while.

text_uthmani: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
translation_text: raising a cloud of dust,

text_uthmani: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
translation_text: and blaze a trail of dust,

text_uthmani: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
translation_text: Faatharna bihi naqAAa

text_uthmani: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
translation_text: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,

text_uthmani: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًا
translation_text: And raise the dust in clouds the while,

text_uthmani: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
translation_text: then enter, at the same time, into the centre of the (opposing) host,

text_uthmani: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
translation_text: Arriving thereby in the center1 collectively,

text_uthmani: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. And penetrating forthwith as one into the midst (of the foe).

text_uthmani: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
translation_text: and plunging into the midst of the enemy,

text_uthmani: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
translation_text: and penetrate deep into a host.

text_uthmani: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
translation_text: Fawasatna bihi jamAAa

text_uthmani: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
translation_text: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),

text_uthmani: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
translation_text: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
translation_text: man is, indeed, very ungrateful to his Lord,

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
translation_text: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
translation_text: man is ungrateful to his Lord––

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. Verily, man (disbeliever) is ungrateful to his Lord.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
translation_text: Verily man is most ungrateful to his Lord;1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
translation_text: Inna al-insana lirabbihi lakanood

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
translation_text: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌ
translation_text: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
translation_text: and he himself is a witness to that fact,

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
translation_text: And indeed, he is to that a witness.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. And to that he bears witness (by his deeds).

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
translation_text: and He is witness to this––

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
translation_text: and he himself is a witness to that,1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
translation_text: Wa-innahu AAala thalikalashaheed

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
translation_text: And lo! he is a witness unto that;

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ
translation_text: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: and in his love for wealth, he is very intense.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 8. And verily, he is violent in the love of wealth.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: he is truly excessive in his love of wealth.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: and surely he loves riches with a passionate loving.1

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: Wa-innahu lihubbi alkhayri lashadeed

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.

text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
translation_text: And violent is he in his love of wealth.

text_uthmani: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation_text: Does he not then know (what will happen) when all that is contained in the graves will be overturned,

text_uthmani: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation_text: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered

text_uthmani: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 9. Knows he not that when the contents of the graves are poured forth (all mankind is resurrected)?

text_uthmani: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation_text: Does he not know that when the contents of graves burst forth,

text_uthmani: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation_text: Is he not aware that when whatever lies (buried) in the graves is overthrown;1

text_uthmani: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation_text: Afala yaAAlamu itha buAAthira mafee alquboor

text_uthmani: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation_text: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth

text_uthmani: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
translation_text: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad

text_uthmani: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_text: and all that is contained in the hearts will be exposed.

text_uthmani: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_text: And that within the breasts is obtained,1

text_uthmani: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_text: when the secrets of hearts are uncovered, on that Day,

text_uthmani: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And that which is in the breasts (of men) is made known?

text_uthmani: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_text: and the secrets of the hearts are laid bare (and examined)?1

text_uthmani: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_text: Wahussila ma fee assudoor

text_uthmani: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_text: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,

text_uthmani: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
translation_text: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
translation_text: Surely your Lord, that day, is fully aware of them.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
translation_text: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
translation_text: their Lord will be fully aware of them all?

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 11. Verily, that Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them (as to their deeds and will reward them for their deeds).

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
translation_text: Surely on that Day will their Lord be fully informed about them.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
translation_text: Inna rabbahum bihim yawma-ithinlakhabeer

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
translation_text: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
translation_text: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?

text_uthmani: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: The Striking Event!

text_uthmani: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: The Striking Calamity -

text_uthmani: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: The Crashing Blow!

text_uthmani: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Al-Qâri‘ah (the striking Hour i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

text_uthmani: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: The Calamity!1

text_uthmani: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: AlqariAAa

text_uthmani: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: The Calamity!

text_uthmani: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: The (Day) of Noise and Clamour:

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: What is the Striking Event?

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: What is the Striking Calamity?

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: What is the Crashing Blow?

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. What is the striking (Hour)?

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: What is the Calamity?

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: Ma alqariAAa

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: What is the Calamity?

text_uthmani: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: And what may let you know what the Striking Event is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: What will explain to you what the Crashing Blow is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And what will make you know what the striking (Hour) is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: And what do you know what the Calamity is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: Wama adraka ma alqariAAa

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
translation_text: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is?

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
translation_text: (It will happen) on a day when people will be like scattered moths,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
translation_text: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,1

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
translation_text: On a Day when people will be like scattered moths

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. It is a Day whereon mankind will be like moths scattered about.

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
translation_text: On that Day human beings shall be like scattered moths,

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
translation_text: Yawma yakoonu annasu kalfarashialmabthooth

text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
translation_text: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths

translation_text: On that Day, you will be asked about your pleasures.

translation_text: Then, on that Day, you will be called to account for all the bounties you enjoyed.1

text_uthmani: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

translation_text: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ

text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
translation_text: Verily Man is in loss,

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
translation_text: except those who believed and did righteous deeds, and exhorted each other to follow truth, and exhorted each other to observe patience.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
translation_text: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. Except those who believe (in Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, and recommend one another to the truth [i.e. order one another to perform all kinds of good deeds (Al-Ma‘ruf) which Allâh has ordained, and abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds (Al-Munkar which Allâh has forbidden], and recommend one another to patience (for the sufferings, harms, and injuries which one may encounter in Allâh’s Cause during preaching His religion of Islâmic Monotheism or Jihâd).

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
translation_text: except for those who believe, do good deeds, urge one another to the truth, and urge one another to steadfastness.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
translation_text: save those who have faith and do righteous deeds, and counsel each other to hold on to truth and counsel each other to be steadfast.1

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
translation_text: Illa allatheena amanoowaAAamiloo assalihati watawasaw bilhaqqiwatawasaw bissabr

translation_text: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.

text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
translation_text: Except such as have Faith, and do righteous deeds, and (join together) in the mutual teaching of Truth, and of Patience and Constancy.

text_uthmani: وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُّمَزَةٍ
translation_text: Woe to every fault-finding backbiter

translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. Who has gathered wealth and counted it.

translation_text: who amasses riches, counting them over,

translation_text: 3. He thinks that his wealth will make him last forever!

text_uthmani: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ

translation_text: 4. Nay! Verily, he will be thrown into the crushing Fire.

translation_text: 5. And what will make you know what the crushing Fire is?

text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ

translation_text: 6. The fire of Allâh kindled,

text_uthmani: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ

text_uthmani: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ

text_uthmani: فِى عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
translation_text: in outstretched columns.1

text_uthmani: فِى عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
translation_text: Fee AAamadin mumaddada

text_uthmani: فِى عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
translation_text: In outstretched columns.

text_uthmani: فِى عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
translation_text: In columns outstretched.

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
translation_text: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the People of the Elephant?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
translation_text: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?1

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
translation_text: Do you [Prophet] not see how your Lord dealt with the army of the elephant?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. Have you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) not seen how your Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant? [The Elephant army which came from Yemen under the command of Abrahah Al-Ashram intending to destroy the Ka‘bah at Makkah].

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
translation_text: Have you not seen1 how your Lord dealt with the people of the elephants?2

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
translation_text: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka bi-as-habialfeel

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
translation_text: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
translation_text: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ
أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ
translation_text: Has He not turned their plan into nullity?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ
translation_text: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?1

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ
translation_text: Did He not utterly confound their plans?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. Did He not make their plot go astray?

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ
translation_text: Did He not bring their plan1 to naught?2

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ
translation_text: Alam yajAAal kaydahum fee tadleel

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ
translation_text: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,

text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍ
translation_text: Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray?

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
translation_text: And He sent upon them flying birds in flocks,

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
translation_text: And He sent against them birds in flocks,

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
translation_text: He sent ranks of birds against them,

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. And He sent against them birds, in flocks,

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
translation_text: And He sent against them swarms of birds1

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
translation_text: Waarsala AAalayhim tayran ababeel

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
translation_text: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,

text_uthmani: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
translation_text: And He sent against them Flights of Birds,

text_uthmani: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
translation_text: throwing upon them stones of baked clay,

text_uthmani: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
translation_text: Striking them with stones of hard clay,

text_uthmani: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
translation_text: pelting them with pellets of hard-baked clay:

text_uthmani: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. Striking them with stones of Sijjîl (baked clay).

text_uthmani: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
translation_text: which smote them with stones of baked clay,1

text_uthmani: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
translation_text: Tarmeehim bihijaratin minsijjeel

text_uthmani: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
translation_text: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,

text_uthmani: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
translation_text: Striking them with stones of baked clay.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
translation_text: and thus He turned them into an eaten-up chaff.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
translation_text: And He made them like eaten straw.1

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And He made them like (an empty field of) stalks (of which the corn has been eaten up by cattle).1

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
translation_text: He made them [like] cropped stubble.

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
translation_text: and made them like straw eaten up (by cattle).1

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
translation_text: FajaAAalahum kaAAasfin ma/kool

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
translation_text: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?

text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
translation_text: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.

text_uthmani: لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
translation_text: Because of the familiarity of the Quraish,

text_uthmani: لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
translation_text: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh1 -

text_uthmani: لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
translation_text: [He did this] to make the Quraysh feel secure,

text_uthmani: لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. (It is a great Grace from Allâh) for the protection of the Quraish,

text_uthmani: لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
translation_text: Since the Quraysh became accustomed,1

text_uthmani: لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
translation_text: Li-eelafi quraysh

text_uthmani: لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
translation_text: For the taming of Qureysh.

text_uthmani: لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
translation_text: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish,

text_uthmani: إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
translation_text: that is, their familiarity with the trips of winter and summer,

text_uthmani: إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
translation_text: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer1 -

text_uthmani: إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
translation_text: secure in their winter and summer journeys.

text_uthmani: إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. (And with all those Allâh’s Grace and Protections, We cause) the (Quraish) caravans to set forth safe in winter (to the south) and in summer (to the north without any fear),

text_uthmani: إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
translation_text: accustomed to the journey of winter and summer,1

text_uthmani: إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
translation_text: Eelafihim rihlata ashshita-iwassayf

text_uthmani: إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
translation_text: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.

text_uthmani: إِۦلَـٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
translation_text: Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer,-

text_uthmani: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
translation_text: they must worship the Lord of this House,

text_uthmani: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
translation_text: Let them worship the Lord of this House,1

text_uthmani: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
translation_text: So let them worship the Lord of this House:

text_uthmani: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. So let them worship (Allâh) the Lord of this House (the Ka‘bah in Makkah),

text_uthmani: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
translation_text: therefore, let them worship the Lord of this House;1

text_uthmani: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
translation_text: FalyaAAbudoo rabba hatha albayt

text_uthmani: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
translation_text: So let them worship the Lord of this House,

text_uthmani: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَـٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
translation_text: Let them adore the Lord of this House,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
translation_text: who gave them food against hunger, and gave them security against fear.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
translation_text: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. (He) Who has fed them against hunger, and has made them safe from fear.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
translation_text: who provides them with food to ward off hunger, safety to ward off fear.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
translation_text: Who fed them against hunger,1 and secured them against fear.2

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
translation_text: Allathee atAAamahum min jooAAinwaamanahum min khawf

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
translation_text: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
translation_text: Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger).

text_uthmani: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Have you seen him who denies the Requital?

text_uthmani: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?

text_uthmani: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: [Prophet], have you considered the person who denies the Judgement?

text_uthmani: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Have you seen him who denies the Recompense?

text_uthmani: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Did you see him1 who gives the lie to the Reward and Punishment2 of the Hereafter?3

text_uthmani: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Araayta allathee yukaththibu biddeen

text_uthmani: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?

text_uthmani: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
translation_text: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)?

text_uthmani: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: So, he is the one who pushes away the orphan,

text_uthmani: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: For that is the one who drives away the orphan

text_uthmani: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: It is he who pushes aside the orphan

text_uthmani: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: That is he who repulses the orphan (harshly),1

text_uthmani: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: Such is1 the one who repulses the orphans away,2

text_uthmani: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: Fathalika allathee yaduAAAAualyateem

text_uthmani: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: That is he who repelleth the orphan,

text_uthmani: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
translation_text: Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness),

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: and does not persuade (others) to feed the needy.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: and does not urge others to feed the needy.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: And urges not on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor),1

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: and urges1 not the feeding of the needy.2

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: Wala yahuddu AAalataAAami almiskeen

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.

text_uthmani: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
translation_text: And encourages not the feeding of the indigent.

فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

translation_text: 4. So woe unto those performers of Salât (prayers) (hypocrites),

translation_text: So woe to those who pray

text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_text: Woe, then, to those who pray,1

text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_text: Fawaylun lilmusalleen

text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_text: Ah, woe unto worshippers

text_uthmani: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
translation_text: So woe to the worshippers

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
translation_text: but are heedless of their prayer;

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. Those who delay their Salât (prayer from their stated fixed times).

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
translation_text: but are heedless in their Prayers,1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
translation_text: Allatheena hum AAan salatihimsahoon

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
translation_text: Who are heedless of their prayer;

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
translation_text: Who are neglectful of their prayers,

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
translation_text: who (do good only to) show off,

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
translation_text: Those who make show [of their deeds]

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. Those who do good deeds only to be seen (of men),

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
translation_text: those who are all show

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
translation_text: those who do good (in order) to be seen,1

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
translation_text: Allatheena hum yuraoon

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
translation_text: Who would be seen (at worship)

text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
translation_text: Those who (want but) to be seen (of men),

وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
translation_text: and refuse (to give even) small gifts.

text_uthmani: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
translation_text: And withhold [simple] assistance.

text_uthmani: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 7. And prevent Al-Mâ‘ûn (small kindnesses like salt, sugar, water).

translation_text: and forbid common kindnesses.

text_uthmani: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
translation_text: and deny people the articles of common necessity.1

text_uthmani: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
translation_text: WayamnaAAoona almaAAoon

text_uthmani: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
translation_text: Yet refuse small kindnesses!

text_uthmani: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
translation_text: But refuse (to supply) (even) neighbourly needs.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ

translation_text: (O Prophet,) surely We have given to you Al-Kauthar.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
translation_text: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
translation_text: We have truly given abundance to you [Prophet]––

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: Verily, We have granted you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) Al-Kauthar (a river in Paradise).1

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
translation_text: (O Prophet), We have surely bestowed upon you good in abundance.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
translation_text: Inna aAAtaynakaalkawthar

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
translation_text: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;

text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
translation_text: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance).

فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
translation_text: So, offer Salāh (prayer) to your Lord, and sacrifice.

text_uthmani: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
translation_text: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].

text_uthmani: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
translation_text: so pray to your Lord and make your sacrifice to Him alone––

text_uthmani: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. Therefore turn in prayer to your Lord and sacrifice (to Him only).

text_uthmani: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
translation_text: So offer Prayer and sacrifice1 to your Lord alone.

text_uthmani: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
translation_text: Fasalli lirabbika wanhar

text_uthmani: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
translation_text: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.

text_uthmani: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
translation_text: Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
translation_text: Surely it is your enemy whose traces are cut off.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
translation_text: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: For he who hates you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), he will be cut off (from posterity and every good thing in this world and in the Hereafter).1

text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
translation_text: it is the one who hates you who has been cut off.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
translation_text: Verily your enemy1 alone has been cut off from the roots.2

text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
translation_text: Inna shani-aka huwa al-abtar

text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
translation_text: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.

text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
translation_text: For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope).

translation_text: Say, “O disbelievers,

translation_text: Say, "O disbelievers,

translation_text: Say [Prophet], ‘Disbelievers:

text_uthmani: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 1. Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to these Mushrikûn and Kâfirûn): "O Al-Kafirûn (disbelievers in Allâh, in His Oneness, in His Angels, in His Books, in His Messengers, in the Day of Resurrection, and in Al-Qadar)!

text_uthmani: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
translation_text: Say: “O unbelievers!”1

text_uthmani: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
translation_text: Qul ya ayyuha alkafiroon

text_uthmani: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
translation_text: Say: O disbelievers!

text_uthmani: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
translation_text: Say: O ye that reject Faith!

لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: I do not worship that which you worship,

text_uthmani: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: I do not worship what you worship.

text_uthmani: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 2. "I worship not that which you worship,

text_uthmani: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: I do not worship what you worship,

text_uthmani: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: I do not worship those that you worship1

text_uthmani: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: La aAAbudu ma taAAbudoon

text_uthmani: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: I worship not that which ye worship;

text_uthmani: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
translation_text: I worship not that which ye worship,

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

translation_text: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 3. "Nor will you worship that which I worship.

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_text: you do not worship what I worship,

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_text: neither do you worship Him Whom I worship;1

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_text: Wala antum AAabidoona maaAAbud

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_text: Nor worship ye that which I worship.

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_text: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.

translation_text: And neither I am going to worship that which you have worshipped,

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
translation_text: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 4. "And I shall not worship that which you are worshipping.

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
translation_text: I will never worship what you worship,

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
translation_text: nor will I worship those whom you have worshipped;

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
translation_text: Wala ana AAabidun maAAabadtum

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
translation_text: And I shall not worship that which ye worship.

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
translation_text: And I will not worship that which ye have been wont to worship,

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_text: nor will you worship the One whom I worship.

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_text: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_text: you will never worship what I worship:

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 5. "Nor will you worship that which I worship.

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_text: nor are you going to worship Him Whom I worship.1

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_text: Wala antum AAabidoona maaAAbud

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_text: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.

text_uthmani: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَـٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
translation_text: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.

translation_text: For you is your faith, and for me, my faith.”

text_uthmani: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
translation_text: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."

text_uthmani: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
translation_author: Muhammad Taqi-ud-Din al-Hilali & Muhammad Muhsin Khan
translation_text: 6. "To you be your religion, and to me my religion (Islâmic Monotheism)."

text_uthmani: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
translation_text: you have your religion and I have mine.’

text_uthmani: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
translation_text: To you is your religion, and to me, my religion.1

text_uthmani: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
translation_text: Lakum deenukum waliya deen

text_uthmani: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
translation_text: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.

text_uthmani: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
translation_text: To you be your Way, and to me mine.

translation_text: (O Prophet,) When there comes Allah’s help and the Victory,

text_uthmani: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
